name: Sporadic.SimsChain.inv_mapsTo
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : O.image (fun z => g • z) ⊆ O := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    exact h z hz
  have hcard : O.card ≤ (O.image (fun z => g • z)).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective O (MulAction.injective g)]
  have himg : O.image (fun z => g • z) = O :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub hcard
  intro z hz
  rw [← himg] at hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hgw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
  have : g⁻¹ • (g • w) = w := by
    simp [smul_smul]
  rw [← hgw, this]
  exact hw

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.carries_one
statement:
theorem carries_one (O : Finset α) (T : α → G) (K : Subgroup G) :
    Carries O T K 1
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨by simpa using hz, ?_⟩
  simp [K.one_mem]

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.carries_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨hyO, hyK⟩ := hy z hz
  obtain ⟨hxO, hxK⟩ := hx (y • z) hyO
  constructor
  · simpa [mul_smul] using hxO
  · have hmem := K.mul_mem hxK hyK
    have hprod : (T (x • y • z))⁻¹ * x * T (y • z) *
        ((T (y • z))⁻¹ * y * T z) =
        (T (x • y • z))⁻¹ * (x * y) * T z := by
      group
    rw [hprod] at hmem
    simpa [mul_smul] using hmem

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.carries_inv
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hxinvO : x⁻¹ • z ∈ O :=
    inv_mapsTo (fun w hw => (hx w hw).1) z hz
  obtain ⟨_, hxK⟩ := hx (x⁻¹ • z) hxinvO
  have hz' : x • x⁻¹ • z = z := by
    simp [smul_smul]
  refine ⟨hxinvO, ?_⟩
  have hmem := K.inv_mem hxK
  rw [hz'] at hmem
  have hshape : ((T z)⁻¹ * x * T (x⁻¹ • z))⁻¹ =
      (T (x⁻¹ • z))⁻¹ * x⁻¹ * T z := by
    group
  rwa [hshape] at hmem

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.carries_of_closure
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => Carries O T K x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro s hs z hz
    exact ⟨hO s hs z hz, hSch s hs z hz⟩
  · exact carries_one O T K
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact carries_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact carries_inv hx

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
statement:
theorem mem_of_fixes_base {S : Set G} {O : Finset α} {T : α → G}
    {K : Subgroup G} {b : α}
    (hO : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ O, s • z ∈ O)
    (hSch : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ O, (T (s • z))⁻¹ * s * T z ∈ K)
    (hbO : b ∈ O) (hTb : T b = 1)
    {g : G} (hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (hfix : g • b = b) :
    g ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hK⟩ := carries_of_closure hO hSch g hg b hbO
  rw [hfix, hTb] at hK
  simpa using hK

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.smul_mem_orbitSet
proof:
:=
  (carries_of_closure hO hSch g hg z hz).1

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.permEqB_sound

theorem permEqB_sound {n : ℕ} {f g : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (h : permEqB n f g = true) : f = g
proof:
:= by

  intro x
  have hx := List.all_eq_true.mp h x (List.mem_finRange x)

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.foldl_mul_mem
statement:
theorem foldl_mul_mem {G : Type*} [Group G] (K : Subgroup G) :
    ∀ (l : List G), (∀ g ∈ l, g ∈ K) → ∀ init ∈ K,
      l.foldl (fun p g => g * p) init ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      intro _ init hinit
      simpa using hinit
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro h init hinit
      have ha : a ∈ K := h a (by simp)
      have hrest : ∀ g ∈ rest, g ∈ K := fun g hg =>
        h g (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hg)
      simpa using ih hrest (a * init) (K.mul_mem ha hinit)

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.foldl_getD_mem
statement:
theorem foldl_getD_mem {G : Type*} [Group G] (K : Subgroup G)
    (gens : List G) (hg : ∀ g ∈ gens, g ∈ K) :
    ∀ (idx : List ℕ) (init : G), init ∈ K →
      idx.foldl (fun p i => gens.getD i 1 * p) init ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  induction idx with
  | nil =>
      intro init hinit
      simpa using hinit
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro init hinit
      have ha : gens.getD a 1 ∈ K := by
        by_cases h : a < gens.length
        · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem gens 1 h]
          exact hg _ (List.getElem_mem h)
        · rw [List.getD_eq_default gens 1 (Nat.le_of_not_lt h)]
          exact K.one_mem
      simpa using ih (gens.getD a 1 * init) (K.mul_mem ha hinit)

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.rowOkB_sound
statement:
theorem rowOkB_sound {n : ℕ} {P : Fin n → Bool} :
    ∀ (len lo : ℕ), rowOkB n P lo len = true →
      ∀ u : Fin n, lo ≤ u.val → u.val < lo + len → P u = true
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      intro lo _ u hlo hhi
      exact absurd hhi (by omega)
  | succ m ih =>
      intro lo hOk u hlo hhi
      rw [rowOkB, List.range'_succ, List.all_cons,
        Bool.and_eq_true] at hOk
      obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hOk
      by_cases hu : u.val = lo
      · have hlt : lo < n := hu ▸ u.isLt
        rw [dif_pos hlt] at hhead
        have hueq : (⟨lo, hlt⟩ : Fin n) = u := Fin.ext hu.symm
        rwa [hueq] at hhead
      · exact ih (lo + 1) htail u (by omega) (by omega)

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply
statement:
theorem foldl_perm_apply {α : Type*} (gens : List (Equiv.Perm α)) :
    ∀ (idx : List ℕ) (p : Equiv.Perm α) (x : α),
      (idx.foldl (fun q i => gens.getD i 1 * q) p) x =
        idx.foldl (fun y i => (gens.getD i 1) y) (p x)
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  induction idx with
  | nil =>
      intro p x
      rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro p x
      rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons, ih]
      rfl

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.foldl_table_inv
statement:
theorem foldl_table_inv {α : Type*} (f g : ℕ → α → α)
    (h : ∀ i y, g i (f i y) = y) :
    ∀ (idx : List ℕ) (x : α),
      idx.reverse.foldl (fun y i => g i y) (idx.foldl (fun y i => f i y) x)
        = x
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  induction idx with
  | nil => intro x; simp
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro x
      simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil]
      rw [ih (f a x), h a x]

name: Sporadic.SimsChain.foldl_table_inv'
statement:
theorem foldl_table_inv' {α : Type*} (f g : ℕ → α → α)
    (h : ∀ i y, f i (g i y) = y) :
    ∀ (idx : List ℕ) (x : α),
      idx.foldl (fun y i => f i y) (idx.reverse.foldl (fun y i => g i y) x)
        = x
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  induction idx with
  | nil => intro x; simp
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro x
      simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil]
      rw [h a]
      exact ih x

name: Sporadic.SuzGraph.testBit_foldMask
statement:
private theorem testBit_foldMask (g : Fin 1782 → Fin 1782)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) (m : Nat) (v : Fin 1782) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin 1782),
      (foldMask g m l).testBit (g v).val =
        (decide (v ∈ l) && m.testBit v.val)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [foldMask, Nat.zero_testBit]
  | cons i t ih =>
      have hunf : foldMask g m (i :: t) =
          if m.testBit i.val then
            foldMask g m t ||| (1 <<< (g i).val)
          else foldMask g m t := rfl
      rw [hunf]
      by_cases hbit : m.testBit i.val
      · rw [if_pos hbit, Nat.testBit_lor, ih]
        rw [Nat.one_shiftLeft]
        by_cases hiv : i = v
        · subst hiv
          simp [hbit, Nat.testBit_two_pow_self]
        · have hne : (g i).val ≠ (g v).val := by
            intro hcon
            exact hiv (hg (Fin.ext hcon))
          rw [Nat.testBit_two_pow_of_ne hne]
          simp [hiv, Ne.symm hiv]
      · rw [if_neg hbit, ih]
        by_cases hiv : i = v
        · subst hiv
          simp [hbit]
        · simp [hiv, Ne.symm hiv]

name: Sporadic.SuzGraph.testBit_permMask

    (hg : Function.Injective g) (m : Nat) (v : Fin 1782) :
    (permMask g m).testBit (g v).val = m.testBit v.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [permMask_eq_foldMask, testBit_foldMask g hg m v]
  simp [List.mem_finRange]

proof:
:= by

  | cons a t ih =>

      have hunf : G24Fam.rowMask (a :: t) =
          G24Fam.rowMask t ||| (1 <<< a.val) := rfl
      rw [hunf, Nat.testBit_lor]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'

name: Sporadic.SuzBridge.bridgeOkB_sound
statement:
private theorem bridgeOkB_sound :
    ∀ (len lo : Nat), bridgeOkB lo len = true →
      ∀ u : Fin 416, lo ≤ u.val → u.val < lo + len →
        ∀ v : Fin 416,
          SuzGraph.suzAdjB ⟨u.val + 1, by omega⟩
              ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩ = true ↔
            v ∈ G24Graph.nbrs u
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      intro lo _ u hlo hhi
      exact absurd hhi (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
      intro lo hOk u hlo hhi v
      rw [bridgeOkB, List.range'_succ, List.all_cons,
        Bool.and_eq_true] at hOk
      obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hOk
      by_cases hu : u.val = lo
      · have hlt : lo < 416 := hu ▸ u.isLt
        have hhead' : (if h : lo < 416 then
            (List.finRange 416).all fun w =>
              SuzGraph.suzAdjB ⟨lo + 1, by omega⟩
                  ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩ ==
                (G24Fam.rowMask
                  (G24Graph.nbrsRow ⟨lo, h⟩)).testBit w.val
            else true) = true := hhead
        rw [dif_pos hlt] at hhead'
        have hbeq := List.all_eq_true.mp hhead' v (List.mem_finRange v)
        have heq := eq_of_beq hbeq
        have hueq : (⟨lo, hlt⟩ : Fin 416) = u := Fin.ext hu.symm
        rw [hueq] at heq
        have hmk : (⟨lo + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 1782) =
            ⟨u.val + 1, by omega⟩ :=
          Fin.ext (show lo + 1 = u.val + 1 by omega)
        rw [hmk] at heq
        rw [heq]
        constructor
        · intro hbit
          have hm := G24Fam.mem_of_testBit_rowMask
            (G24Graph.nbrsRow u) v.val hbit v.isLt
          rw [Fin.eta] at hm
          exact G24Graph.mem_nbrs_iff.mpr hm
        · intro hmem
          exact testBit_rowMask_of_mem (G24Graph.nbrsRow u) v
            (G24Graph.mem_nbrs_iff.mp hmem)
      · have hlo' : lo + 1 ≤ u.val := by omega
        exact ih (lo + 1) htail u hlo' (by omega) v

name: Sporadic.SuzBridge.bridge416
statement:
theorem bridge416 :
    ∀ u v : Fin 416,
      SuzGraph.suzAdjB ⟨u.val + 1, by omega⟩
          ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩ = true ↔
        v ∈ G24Graph.nbrs u
proof:
:= by
  intro u v
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 104 with h1 | h1
  · exact bridgeOkB_sound 104 0 Shards.bridgeOk_0 u (by omega) (by omega) v
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 208 with h2 | h2
  · exact bridgeOkB_sound 104 104 Shards.bridgeOk_1 u h1 (by omega) v
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 312 with h3 | h3
  · exact bridgeOkB_sound 104 208 Shards.bridgeOk_2 u h2 (by omega) v
  exact bridgeOkB_sound 104 312 Shards.bridgeOk_3 u h3 (by omega) v

theorem suz_preserves :
    ∀ g ∈ SuzSubgroup, PreservesSuz g
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun y _ => PreservesSuz y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact suza_preserves
    · exact suzb_preserves
    · exact suzc_preserves
    · exact suzd_preserves
    · exact suze_preserves
    · exact suzf_preserves
  · exact preservesSuz_one
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    exact preservesSuz_mul ha hb
  · intro a _ ha
    exact preservesSuz_inv ha

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.adj_zero_true
proof:
:= by
  have hz := SuzResidual.adj_zero_iff v
  have hz' := SuzResidual.adj_zero_iff (π v)
  have hpre := hpres 0 v
  rw [h0] at hpre
  have : suzAdjB 0 (π v) = suzAdjB 0 v := hpre
  rw [hz, hz'] at this
  have hv' : decide (1 ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < 417) = true := by
    simpa using hv
  rw [hv'] at this
  simpa using this.symm

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.maps_416
statement:
theorem maps_416 {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1782)} (hpres : PreservesSuz π)
    (h0 : π 0 = 0) {v : Fin 416} :
    1 ≤ (π ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val ∧
      (π ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val < 417
proof:
:=
  adj_zero_true hpres h0 (by
    constructor
    · show 1 ≤ v.val + 1
      omega
    · show v.val + 1 < 417
      have := v.isLt
      omega)

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.restr416_val
statement:
theorem restr416_val (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1782))
    (hpres : PreservesSuz π) (h0 : π 0 = 0) (v : Fin 416) :
    (restr416 π hpres h0 v).val =
      (π ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.sRestrHom_injective
statement: theorem sRestrHom_injective : Function.Injective sRestrHom
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hker : sRestrHom (g * h⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hgh, mul_inv_cancel]
  set d := g * h⁻¹ with hd
  have hlow : ∀ v : Fin 1782, 1 ≤ v.val → v.val < 417 →
      d.1.1 v = v := by
    intro v hv1 hv2
    have happ := congrArg (fun σ => σ ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩) hker
    have hval : (d.1.1 ⟨(v.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1 =
        v.val - 1 := by
      simpa [sRestrHom, restr416] using congrArg Fin.val happ
    have hb := maps_416 (sstab_pres d) (sstab_fixes d)
      (v := ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩)
    have hmk : (⟨(v.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 1782) = v :=
      Fin.ext (show (v.val - 1) + 1 = v.val by omega)
    rw [hmk] at hval hb
    apply Fin.ext
    omega
  have hone : d.1.1 = 1 :=
    SuzResidual.fixed_low_unique d.1.1 (sstab_pres d) (sstab_fixes d)
      hlow
  have hd1 : d = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hone
  have := congrArg (fun x => x * h) hd1
  simpa [hd, mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.restr_eq_of_cert
statement:
private theorem restr_eq_of_cert (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1782))
    (hpres : PreservesSuz π) (h0 : π 0 = 0)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416))
    (hcert : ∀ v : Fin 416,
      (π ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val = (τ v).val + 1) :
    restr416 π hpres h0 = τ
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro v
  apply Fin.ext
  show (π ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1 = (τ v).val
  rw [hcert v]
  omega

Sporadic.SuzDescent.S_le_AutG416
statement: theorem S_le_AutG416 : SImage ≤ G24Aut.AutG416
proof:
:= by
  rintro τ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  rw [G24Aut.mem_AutG416]
  intro v
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    have hb := (SuzBridge.bridge416 v w).mpr hw
    have hpre := (sstab_pres g) ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩
      ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩
    have himg : suzAdjB
        (g.1.1 ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩) (g.1.1 ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩) =
          true := by
      rw [hpre]
      exact hb
    have hm1 : g.1.1 ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩ =
        ⟨(sRestrHom g v).val + 1, by
          have := (sRestrHom g v).isLt
          omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      show (g.1.1 ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val = _
      have := maps_416 (sstab_pres g) (sstab_fixes g) (v := v)
      show _ = ((g.1.1 ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1) + 1
      omega
    have hm2 : g.1.1 ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩ =
        ⟨(sRestrHom g w).val + 1, by
          have := (sRestrHom g w).isLt
          omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      show (g.1.1 ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩).val = _
      have := maps_416 (sstab_pres g) (sstab_fixes g) (v := w)
      show _ = ((g.1.1 ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1) + 1
      omega
    rw [hm1, hm2] at himg
    have := (SuzBridge.bridge416 (sRestrHom g v)
      (sRestrHom g w)).mp himg
    exact this
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (sRestrHom g).injective,
      G24Graph.nbrs_card_all, G24Graph.nbrs_card_all]

  have hge := card_S_ge
  have hle := card_S_le
  rw [hk] at hge hle ⊢

name: Sporadic.SuzDescent.card_S_ne_double
statement: theorem card_S_ne_double : Nat.card SImage ≠ 503193600
proof:
:= by
  intro hcase
  have hEq : SImage = G24Aut.AutG416 := by
    apply Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge S_le_AutG416
    rw [hcase]
    exact G24Aut.card_AutG416_le
  have hrho : SuzRho.rhoPerm ∈ SImage := by
    rw [hEq]
    rw [G24Aut.mem_AutG416]
    
    
    intro v
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      have hb := (SuzBridge.bridge416 v w).mpr hw
      have hpre := SuzBeta.beta_preserves ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩
        ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩
      have himg : suzAdjB
          (SuzBeta.betaPerm ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩)
          (SuzBeta.betaPerm ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩) = true := by
        rw [hpre]
        exact hb
      have hm1 : SuzBeta.betaPerm ⟨v.val + 1, by omega⟩ =
          ⟨(SuzRho.rhoPerm v).val + 1, by
            have := (SuzRho.rhoPerm v).isLt
            omega⟩ :=
        Fin.ext (SuzRho.beta_restr v)
      have hm2 : SuzBeta.betaPerm ⟨w.val + 1, by omega⟩ =
          ⟨(SuzRho.rhoPerm w).val + 1, by
            have := (SuzRho.rhoPerm w).isLt
            omega⟩ :=
        Fin.ext (SuzRho.beta_restr w)
      rw [hm1, hm2] at himg
      have := (SuzBridge.bridge416 (SuzRho.rhoPerm v)
        (SuzRho.rhoPerm w)).mp himg
      exact this
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ SuzRho.rhoPerm.injective,
        G24Graph.nbrs_card_all, G24Graph.nbrs_card_all]
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hrho
  
  have hlow : ∀ v : Fin 1782, 1 ≤ v.val → v.val < 417 →
      (g.1.1⁻¹ * SuzBeta.betaPerm) v = v := by
    intro v hv1 hv2
    have hval : (g.1.1 ⟨(v.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩).val - 1 =
        (SuzRho.rhoPerm ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩).val := by
      have := congrArg (fun σ => (σ ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩).val) hg
      simpa [sRestrHom, restr416] using this
    have hbeta : (SuzBeta.betaPerm ⟨(v.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩).val =
        (SuzRho.rhoPerm ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1 :=
      SuzRho.beta_restr ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩
    have hmk : (⟨(v.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 1782) = v :=
      Fin.ext (show (v.val - 1) + 1 = v.val by omega)
    rw [hmk] at hval hbeta
    have hb := maps_416 (sstab_pres g) (sstab_fixes g)
      (v := ⟨v.val - 1, by omega⟩)
    rw [hmk] at hb
    have hagree : SuzBeta.betaPerm v = g.1.1 v := by
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    show g.1.1⁻¹ (SuzBeta.betaPerm v) = v
    rw [hagree, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hδ0 : (g.1.1⁻¹ * SuzBeta.betaPerm) 0 = 0 := by
    show g.1.1⁻¹ (SuzBeta.betaPerm 0) = 0
    rw [SuzBeta.betaPerm_fixes_zero]
    exact inv_fixes_zero (sstab_fixes g)
  have hδpres : PreservesSuz (g.1.1⁻¹ * SuzBeta.betaPerm) :=
    preservesSuz_mul (preservesSuz_inv (sstab_pres g))
      SuzBeta.beta_preserves
  have hone := SuzResidual.fixed_low_unique _ hδpres hδ0 hlow
  have hbeta_eq : SuzBeta.betaPerm = g.1.1 := by
    rw [inv_mul_eq_one] at hone
    exact hone.symm
  exact SuzSign.beta_not_mem (hbeta_eq ▸ sstab_mem g)

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.stab_seg_witness
statement:
theorem stab_seg_witness (p q : Fin 1782)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < 417) (hq : 1 ≤ q.val ∧ q.val < 417) :
    ∃ s : SuzT, s.1 0 = 0 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Sp := wordEl (SuzChain.stab416Word ⟨p.val - 1, by omega⟩)
  set Sq := wordEl (SuzChain.stab416Word ⟨q.val - 1, by omega⟩)
  obtain ⟨hSp0, hSp1⟩ :=
    SuzChain.stab416Word_cert ⟨p.val - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨hSq0, hSq1⟩ :=
    SuzChain.stab416Word_cert ⟨q.val - 1, by omega⟩
  have hSp1' : Sp.1 (1 : Fin 1782) = p := by
    have h : Sp.1 (1 : Fin 1782) =
        ⟨(p.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩ := hSp1
    rw [h]
    exact Fin.ext (show (p.val - 1) + 1 = p.val by omega)
  have hSq1' : Sq.1 (1 : Fin 1782) = q := by
    have h : Sq.1 (1 : Fin 1782) =
        ⟨(q.val - 1) + 1, by omega⟩ := hSq1
    rw [h]
    exact Fin.ext (show (q.val - 1) + 1 = q.val by omega)
  refine ⟨Sq * Sp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (Sq.1 * Sp.1⁻¹) 0 = 0
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show Sp.1⁻¹ (0 : Fin 1782) = 0 by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hSp0]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _]
    exact hSq0
  · show (Sq.1 * Sp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show Sp.1⁻¹ p = 1 by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hSp1']
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _]
    exact hSq1'

proof:
:= by

    SuzChain.stabFamWord_cert ⟨q.val - 417, by omega⟩

        ⟨(p.val - 417) + 417, by omega⟩ := hSp1

  have hSq1' : Sq.1 (417 : Fin 1782) = q := by

        ⟨(q.val - 417) + 417, by omega⟩ := hSq1

  refine ⟨Sq * Sp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (Sq.1 * Sp.1⁻¹) 0 = 0
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

      conv_lhs => rw [← hSp0]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _]

  · show (Sq.1 * Sp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 1782)
    (hxy : y ∈ suzNbrs x) :
    ∃ g : SuzT, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  set W := wordEl (SuzChain.levelZeroWord x) with hW
  have hW0 : W.1 (0 : Fin 1782) = x := level0_at x
  have hWpres : PreservesSuz W.1 := suz_preserves W.1 W.2
  have hz : suzAdjB 0 (W.1⁻¹ y) = true := by
    have h := hWpres 0 (W.1⁻¹ y)
    rw [hW0, perm_apply_inv_self] at h
    rw [← h]
    rw [mem_suzNbrs] at hxy
    exact hxy
  have hseg := seg416_of_adj_zero hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1⟩ := stab_seg_witness 1 (W.1⁻¹ y)
    ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ hseg
  refine ⟨W * s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (W.1 * s.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hs0]
    exact hW0
  · show (W.1 * s.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hs1]
    exact perm_apply_inv_self _ _

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 1782)
    (hxy : y ∉ suzNbrs x) (hyx : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : SuzT, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 417 = y
proof:
:= by
  set W := wordEl (SuzChain.levelZeroWord x) with hW
  have hW0 : W.1 (0 : Fin 1782) = x := level0_at x
  have hWpres : PreservesSuz W.1 := suz_preserves W.1 W.2
  have hz : suzAdjB 0 (W.1⁻¹ y) = false := by
    have h := hWpres 0 (W.1⁻¹ y)
    rw [hW0, perm_apply_inv_self] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact not_adj_of_not_mem hxy
  have hz0 : W.1⁻¹ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcon
    apply hyx
    have := congrArg W.1 hcon
    rw [perm_apply_inv_self, hW0] at this
    exact this
  have hfam := fam_of_not_adj_zero hz hz0
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1⟩ := stab_fam_witness 417 (W.1⁻¹ y)
    (by norm_num) hfam
  refine ⟨W * s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (W.1 * s.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hs0]
    exact hW0
  · show (W.1 * s.1) 417 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hs1]
    exact perm_apply_inv_self _ _

:= by
  intro x hx hx0
  have hall := List.all_eq_true.mp commonNbrOk x (List.mem_finRange x)
  have hall' : (if suzAdjB 0 x = false ∧ x ≠ 0 then
      (List.finRange 1782).any fun w => suzAdjB 0 w && suzAdjB x w
    else true) = true := hall
  rw [if_pos ⟨hx, hx0⟩] at hall'
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hall'
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
  exact ⟨w, hw.1, hw.2⟩

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.common_non_nbr_zero
statement:
private theorem common_non_nbr_zero :
    ∀ x : Fin 1782, suzAdjB 0 x = true →
      ∃ w : Fin 1782, suzAdjB 0 w = false ∧ w ≠ 0 ∧
        suzAdjB x w = false ∧ w ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hall := List.all_eq_true.mp commonNonNbrOk x
    (List.mem_finRange x)
  have hall' : (if suzAdjB 0 x = true then
      (List.finRange 1782).any fun w =>
        !(suzAdjB 0 w) && !(w == 0) && !(suzAdjB x w) && !(w == x)
    else true) = true := hall
  rw [if_pos hx] at hall'
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hall'
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩ := hw
  refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases hb : suzAdjB 0 w
    · rfl
    · rw [hb] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · intro hcon
    rw [hcon, beq_self_eq_true] at h2
    exact absurd h2 (by decide)
  · cases hb : suzAdjB x w
    · rfl
    · rw [hb] at h3
      exact absurd h3 (by decide)
  · intro hcon
    rw [hcon, beq_self_eq_true] at h4
    exact absurd h4 (by decide)

theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :

proof:

statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : SuzT} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 1782} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ suzNbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 1782) (huv : v ∈ suzNbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  rw [show g.1⁻¹ u = p by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hgp]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _]
  exact hgq

proof:

  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.normal_zero_witness
statement:
theorem normal_zero_witness (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : SuzT} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 1782} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 1782) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ suzNbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ suzNbrs 0
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx⟩ := common_nbr_zero x
        (not_adj_of_not_mem hxadj) hx0
      have hw0' : w ∈ suzNbrs 0 := mem_suzNbrs.mpr hw0
      have hwx' : w ∈ suzNbrs x := mem_suzNbrs.mpr hwx
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 w hw0'
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (suzNbrs_symm _ _ hwx')
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ suzNbrs 0
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw0', hwx, hwxne⟩ := common_non_nbr_zero x
        (mem_suzNbrs.mp hxadj)
      have hwmem : w ∉ suzNbrs 0 := by
        rw [mem_suzNbrs, hw0]
        simp
      have hxw : w ∉ suzNbrs x := by
        rw [mem_suzNbrs, hwx]
        simp
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 w hwmem hw0'
      have hwx2 : x ∉ suzNbrs w := fun h =>
        hxw (suzNbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hwx2
          (Ne.symm hwxne)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 x hxadj hx0

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.normal_orbit_zero_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_zero_eq_univ (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : SuzT} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 1782} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (0 : Fin 1782) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_zero_witness N hN hnN hp x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩,
      by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf SStabSub = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 1782) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 11) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 1782 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 11 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 11) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : Sylow 11 N, ∀ Q : Sylow 11 N, Q = P0 := by
    have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one 11 N
    have hmod' : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) % 11 = 1 := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq at hmod
      omega
    have hdvd : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) ∣ 1782 := by
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow 11 N))
      refine (P.card_dvd_index).trans ?_
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ (by rw [P.1.card_mul_index, hcard])
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) ≤ 1782 :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    have hforce : ∀ k < 1783, k ∣ 1782 → k % 11 = 1 → k = 1 := by
      decide
    have hn11 : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) = 1 :=
      hforce _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle) hdvd hmod'
    rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists] at hn11
    exact hn11
  have hmemP0 : ∀ n : N, orderOf n = 11 → n ∈ P0.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hz : IsPGroup 11 (Subgroup.zpowers n) := by
      apply IsPGroup.of_card
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hn, pow_one]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hz.exists_le_sylow
    have hQP := hP0 Q
    subst hQP
    exact hQ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers n)
  have hcardP0 : Nat.card P0.1 ≤ 11 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp P0.2
    have hdvdP : Nat.card P0.1 ∣ 1782 := by
      simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hF] using
        Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card P0.1
    rw [hn] at hdvdP
    have hn1 : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hgt
      push Not at hgt
      exact absurd ((pow_dvd_pow 11 hgt).trans hdvdP) (by decide)
    calc Nat.card P0.1 = 11 ^ n := hn
      _ ≤ 11 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn1
      _ = 11 := by norm_num
  have hKcard : K.card ≤ 11 := by
    have hsub : K ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hmemP0 n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2⟩
    have hfil : (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card =
        Nat.card P0.1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
    calc K.card
        ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = Nat.card P0.1 := hfil
      _ ≤ 11 := hcardP0
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 0 = m.1.1 0 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 0 = 0 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 0 = 0
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_zero N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_zero N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 11 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hconj : ∀ (s : SuzT), s.1 0 = 0 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 0 = s.1 (n.1.1 0) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 0 = s.1 (n.1.1 0)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [show (0 : Fin 1782) = s.1 0 from hs.symm]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 0) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = K.card := by
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n _ m _ h
    exact hphi_inj n m h
  have hclose_nbr : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ suzNbrs 0 →
      ∀ y ∈ suzNbrs 0, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsx⟩ := stab_nbr_witness x y hxn hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs0 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hclose_far : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ suzNbrs 0 → x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ y, y ∉ suzNbrs 0 → y ≠ 0 → y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn hx0 y hy hy0
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsx⟩ := stab_far_witness x y hxn hx0 hy hy0
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs0 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hKimg0 : (0 : Fin 1782) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 0 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  by_cases hA : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ suzNbrs 0
  · by_cases hB : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ suzNbrs 0 ∧ x ≠ 0
    · have hAll : Kimg = Finset.univ.erase 0 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            ⟨fun h => hKimg0 (h ▸ hy), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro hy
          have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
          by_cases hyn : y ∈ suzNbrs 0
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
            exact hclose_nbr x hx hxn y hyn
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn, hx0⟩ := hB
            exact hclose_far x hx hxn hx0 y hyn hy0
      rw [hAll] at hcard_eq
      have hcount : K.card = 1781 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide +kernel
      omega
    · push Not at hB
      have hAll : Kimg = suzNbrs 0 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          by_contra hyn
          have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h => hKimg0 (h ▸ hy)
          exact hy0 (hB y hy hyn)
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
          exact hclose_nbr x hx hxn y hy
      rw [hAll] at hcard_eq
      have hcount : K.card = 416 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide +kernel
      omega
  · push Not at hA
    have hz0n : z0.1.1 0 ∉ suzNbrs 0 := hA _ hz0img
    have hz00 : z0.1.1 0 ≠ 0 := hK_moves z0 hz0K
    have hAll : Kimg = (Finset.univ.erase 0) \ suzNbrs 0 := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h => hKimg0 (h ▸ hy)
        exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hy0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hA y hy⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨hy', hyn⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
        have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy').1
        exact hclose_far _ hz0img hz0n hz00 y hyn hy0
    rw [hAll] at hcard_eq
    have hcount : K.card = 1365 := by
      rw [← hcard_eq]
      decide +kernel
    omega

name: Sporadic.SuzSimplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup SuzT) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_zero_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_1782_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup SStabSub := isSimpleGroup_SStab
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf SStabSub).Normal := hN.subgroupOf SStabSub
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard1782 : Nat.card N = 1782 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard1782
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SStabSub) = 251596800 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_SStab
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card SuzT := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, SuzCardinality.card_Suz]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

proof:
:= by

name: Sporadic.SuzResidual.fam_ext
statement:
theorem fam_ext {v w : Fin 1782} (hv : 417 ≤ v.val) (hw : 417 ≤ w.val)
    (h : ∀ u : Fin 1782, u.val < 417 → suzAdjB v u = suzAdjB w u) :
    v = w
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : lowPart (suzMask v) = lowPart (suzMask w) := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
    intro i
    rw [lowPart, lowPart, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow,
      Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
    by_cases hi : i < 417
    · have hu := h ⟨i, by omega⟩ hi
      rw [show (suzMask v).testBit i = suzAdjB v ⟨i, by omega⟩ from rfl,
        show (suzMask w).testBit i = suzAdjB w ⟨i, by omega⟩ from rfl,
        hu]
    · simp [hi]
  have hvj : v = ⟨417 + (v.val - 417), by have := v.isLt; omega⟩ :=
    Fin.ext (show v.val = 417 + (v.val - 417) by omega)
  have hwj : w = ⟨417 + (w.val - 417), by have := w.isLt; omega⟩ :=
    Fin.ext (show w.val = 417 + (w.val - 417) by omega)
  have hj : famLow ⟨v.val - 417, by omega⟩ =
      famLow ⟨w.val - 417, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [famLow, famLow]
    have hv' : (⟨417 + (v.val - 417), by have := v.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 1782) = v :=
      hvj.symm
    have hw' : (⟨417 + (w.val - 417), by have := w.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 1782) = w :=
      hwj.symm
    rw [hv', hw', hlow]
  have := famLow_strictMono.injective hj
  have hval : v.val - 417 = w.val - 417 := congrArg Fin.val this
  apply Fin.ext
  omega

name: Sporadic.SuzResidual.fixed_low_unique
statement:
theorem fixed_low_unique (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1782))
    (hpres : PreservesSuz π) (h0 : π 0 = 0)
    (hlow : ∀ v : Fin 1782, 1 ≤ v.val → v.val < 417 → π v = v) :
    π = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : ∀ v : Fin 1782, v.val < 417 → π v = v := by
    intro v hv
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos v.val with hz | hp
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := Fin.ext hz
      rw [hv0]
      exact h0
    · exact hlow v hp hv
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro v
  show π v = (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1782)) v
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge v.val 417 with hv | hv
  · rw [hfix v hv]
    rfl
  · 
    
    have hπv : 417 ≤ (π v).val := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have hfixπ : π (π v) = π v := hfix (π v) hcon
      have := π.injective hfixπ
      omega
    have hsame : ∀ u : Fin 1782, u.val < 417 →
        suzAdjB (π v) u = suzAdjB v u := by
      intro u hu
      have hfu : π u = u := hfix u hu
      calc suzAdjB (π v) u = suzAdjB (π v) (π u) := by rw [hfu]
        _ = suzAdjB v u := by
            rw [suzAdjB_symm (π v) (π u), hpres u v,
              suzAdjB_symm u v]
    have := fam_ext hπv hv hsame
    rw [this]
    rfl

name: Sporadic.SuzGraph.symmOkB_sound
statement:
private theorem symmOkB_sound :
    ∀ (len lo : Nat), symmOkB lo len = true →
      ∀ u : Fin 1782, lo ≤ u.val → u.val < lo + len →
        ∀ v : Fin 1782, suzAdjB u v = suzAdjB v u
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      intro lo _ u hlo hhi
      exact absurd hhi (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
      intro lo hOk u hlo hhi v
      rw [symmOkB, List.range'_succ, List.all_cons,
        Bool.and_eq_true] at hOk
      obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hOk
      by_cases hu : u.val = lo
      · have hlt : lo < 1782 := hu ▸ u.isLt
        have hhead' : (if h : lo < 1782 then
            (List.finRange 1782).all fun w =>
              suzAdjB ⟨lo, h⟩ w == suzAdjB w ⟨lo, h⟩
            else true) = true := hhead
        rw [dif_pos hlt] at hhead'
        have hueq : (⟨lo, hlt⟩ : Fin 1782) = u := Fin.ext hu.symm
        rw [hueq] at hhead'
        have hbeq := List.all_eq_true.mp hhead' v
          (List.mem_finRange v)
        exact eq_of_beq hbeq
      · have hlo' : lo + 1 ≤ u.val := by omega
        exact ih (lo + 1) htail u hlo' (by omega) v

name: Sporadic.He.S0.anyT_apply
statement:
theorem anyT_apply (j : Nat) (y : Nat) (x : Fin 2058) :
    anyT j y x = anyTApp j y x
proof:
:= by
  match j with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | n + 4 => rfl

name: Sporadic.He.S0.siftProd_apply
statement:
theorem siftProd_apply (l : List (Nat × Nat)) (x : Fin 2058) :
    siftProd l x = siftProdApp l x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [siftProd, siftProdApp, List.foldr_cons]
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      show anyT a.1 a.2 (siftProd rest x) = _
      rw [ih, anyT_apply]
      rfl

name: Sporadic.He.S0.TGammaY_eq_word
statement: theorem TGammaY_eq_word (z : Fin 2058) : TGammaY z = TGammaYWord z
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 2058) (idx : ℕ) => (sList1.getD idx 1) y) =
      (fun y idx => sApp1 idx y) := by
    funext y idx
    exact sApp1_eq idx y
  rw [TGammaY_apply, TGammaYWord, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.He.S0.TGammaY_memK

proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [TGammaY_eq_word, TGammaYWord]
  exact SimsChain.foldl_getD_mem K1 sList1 sList1_mem
    (gammaYPath z) 1 K1.one_mem

name: Sporadic.He.S0.gammaY_invariant
statement:
theorem gammaY_invariant :
    ∀ g ∈ K1, ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGammaY z = true → inGammaY ((g : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGammaY z = true → inGammaY ((g⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGammaY z = true → inGammaY ((x : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGammaY z = true → inGammaY ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · have h := closGY_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_0_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGY_1_all z

name: Sporadic.He.closure_gens
statement: theorem closure_gens : Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : Perm2058) (hx : x ∈ K0),
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y hy =>
        (⟨y, hy⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gA])
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gB])
    · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ ihy ihz
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ ihy ihz
    · intro y _ ihy
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ ihy
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  exact key x hx

name: Sporadic.He.closure_odd_gens
statement:
theorem closure_odd_gens :
    Subgroup.closure ({gB, gAB} : Set K0T) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hA : gA ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gB, gAB} : Set K0T) := by
    have h1 : gAB * gB⁻¹ = gA := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show (hea * heb) * heb⁻¹ = hea
      exact mul_inv_cancel_right hea heb
    rw [← h1]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _
      (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp))
      (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)))
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← closure_gens, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · exact hA
  · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

name: Sporadic.He.eq_top_of_index_le_two
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_index_le_two (N : Subgroup K0T) [hN : N.Normal]
    (hix : N.index ≤ 2) (hix0 : N.index ≠ 0) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hix1 : 1 ≤ N.index := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hix0
  interval_cases h : N.index
  · exact Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp h
  · 
    have hcard : Nat.card (K0T ⧸ N) = 2 := by
      rw [← Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      exact h
    have hfin : Finite (K0T ⧸ N) := by
      apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
      omega
    have hkill : ∀ g : K0T, ∀ k : ℕ, g ^ k = 1 → Nat.Coprime k 2 →
        g ∈ N := by
      intro g k hgk hcop
      have h1 : (QuotientGroup.mk g : K0T ⧸ N) ^ k = 1 := by
        rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, hgk]
        rfl
      have h2 : orderOf (QuotientGroup.mk g : K0T ⧸ N) ∣ k :=
        orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h1
      have h3 : orderOf (QuotientGroup.mk g : K0T ⧸ N) ∣ 2 := by
        rw [← hcard]
        exact orderOf_dvd_natCard _
      have h4 : orderOf (QuotientGroup.mk g : K0T ⧸ N) ∣ 1 := by
        have := Nat.dvd_gcd h2 h3
        rwa [Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one hcop] at this
      have h5 : (QuotientGroup.mk g : K0T ⧸ N) = 1 :=
        orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp (Nat.dvd_one.mp h4)
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mp h5
    have hB : gB ∈ N := hkill gB 7 gB_pow7 (by decide)
    have hAB : gAB ∈ N := hkill gAB 17 gAB_pow17 (by decide)
    rw [← top_le_iff, ← closure_odd_gens, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hB
    · exact hAB

name: Sporadic.He.NS0_normal
statement: theorem NS0_normal (hN : N.Normal) : (NS0 N).Normal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro q hq s
  rw [NS0, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf, Subgroup.mem_map] at hq ⊢
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hval⟩ := hq
  have hsK0 : ((s : ↥S0.S0Subgroup) : Perm2058) ∈ K0 :=
    K1_le_K0 (S0.S0_le_K1 s.2)
  refine ⟨_, hN.conj_mem n hn ⟨(s : Perm2058), hsK0⟩, ?_⟩
  show (s : Perm2058) * (K0.subtype n) * (s : Perm2058)⁻¹ =
    ((s * q * s⁻¹ : ↥S0.S0Subgroup) : Perm2058)
  rw [hval]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.He.eq_top_of_NS0_top
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_NS0_top (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : IsPretransitive N (Fin 2058)) (h : NS0 N = ⊤) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hle : S0.S0Subgroup ≤ N.map K0.subtype := by
    rw [NS0, Subgroup.subgroupOf_eq_top] at h
    exact h
  
  have hinj : ∃ f : ↥S0.S0Subgroup → stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058),
      Function.Injective f := by
    classical
    refine ⟨fun p => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp : (p : Perm2058) ∈ N.map K0.subtype := hle p.2
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map] at hp
      refine ⟨⟨hp.choose, hp.choose_spec.1⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_stabilizer_iff]
      have hval : (K0.subtype) hp.choose = (p : Perm2058) :=
        hp.choose_spec.2
      have hfix : ((p : Perm2058)) (0 : Fin 2058) = 0 :=
        K1_fix_b0 _ (S0.S0_le_K1 p.2)
      change ((⟨hp.choose, hp.choose_spec.1⟩ : ↥N) : K0T) • (0 : Fin 2058)
        = (0 : Fin 2058)
      have : ((hp.choose : K0T) : Perm2058) = (p : Perm2058) := hval
      simp only [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def]
      rw [this]
      exact hfix
    · intro p q hpq
      have hp : (p : Perm2058) ∈ N.map K0.subtype := hle p.2
      have hq : (q : Perm2058) ∈ N.map K0.subtype := hle q.2
      have h1 : (K0.subtype) hp.choose = (p : Perm2058) :=
        hp.choose_spec.2
      have h2 : (K0.subtype) hq.choose = (q : Perm2058) :=
        hq.choose_spec.2
      have h3 : hp.choose = hq.choose := by
        have := congrArg (fun w => ((w.1 : ↥N) : K0T)) hpq
        exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val this)
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [← h1, ← h2, h3]
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hinj
  have hcardge : 979200 ≤ Nat.card (stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058)) := by
    have := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hf
    rwa [show Nat.card ↥S0.S0Subgroup = 979200 from S0.card_eq] at this
  have hcardN := card_eq_stab_mul (N := N) htrans
  have hHe : Nat.card N * N.index = 4030387200 := by
    have := Subgroup.card_mul_index N
    rwa [show Nat.card K0T = 4030387200 from card_eq] at this
  have hix0 : N.index ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hHe
    omega
  have hix2 : N.index ≤ 2 := by
    by_contra hgt
    push_neg at hgt
    have hNge : 2015193600 ≤ Nat.card N := by
      calc 2015193600 = 979200 * 2058 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ Nat.card (stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058)) * 2058 :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcardge
        _ = Nat.card N := hcardN.symm
    have : 3 * 2015193600 ≤ N.index * Nat.card N :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hgt hNge
    rw [mul_comm N.index (Nat.card N)] at this
    rw [hHe] at this
    omega
  exact eq_top_of_index_le_two N hix2 hix0

name: Sporadic.He.card_stab_le_two
statement:
theorem card_stab_le_two (h : NS0 N = ⊥) :
    Nat.card (stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun n : stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058) =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk (stabHom n) : K1T ⧸ S0K1)) := by
    intro n m hnm
    have hq : (stabHom n)⁻¹ * stabHom m ∈ S0K1 :=
      QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp (Quotient.eq''.mp hnm)
    have hperm : (((stabHom n)⁻¹ * stabHom m : K1T) : Perm2058) ∈
        S0.S0Subgroup := by
      rw [S0K1, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf] at hq
      exact hq
    have hval : (((stabHom n)⁻¹ * stabHom m : K1T) : Perm2058) =
        ((n.1 : K0T) : Perm2058)⁻¹ * ((m.1 : K0T) : Perm2058) := by
      rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, InvMemClass.coe_inv, stabHom_val,
        stabHom_val]
    have hmem : (((stabHom n)⁻¹ * stabHom m : K1T) : Perm2058) ∈
        N.map K0.subtype := by
      rw [hval, Subgroup.mem_map]
      exact ⟨(n.1)⁻¹ * m.1,
        N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem n.1.2) m.1.2, rfl⟩
    have hbot : (⟨_, hperm⟩ : ↥S0.S0Subgroup) ∈ NS0 N := by
      rw [NS0, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
      exact hmem
    rw [h, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hbot
    have h1 : (((stabHom n)⁻¹ * stabHom m : K1T) : Perm2058) = 1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hbot
    have h2 : ((n.1 : K0T) : Perm2058) = ((m.1 : K0T) : Perm2058) := by
      rw [hval] at h1
      exact inv_mul_eq_one.mp h1
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h2
  have hle := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ hinj
  have hq2 : Nat.card (K1T ⧸ S0K1) = 2 := index_S0K1
  omega

name: Sporadic.He.caseB_absurd
statement:
theorem caseB_absurd (hN : N.Normal)
    (hcard : Nat.card N = 2058 ∨ Nat.card N = 4116) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfac : (Nat.card N).factorization 7 = 3 := by
    rcases hcard with h | h <;>
      · rw [h]
        exact factorization_eq_of_pow_dvd_of_not_dvd (by norm_num)
          (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨P⟩ : Nonempty (Sylow 7 ↥N) := inferInstance
  have hcardP : Nat.card (P : Subgroup ↥N) = 343 := by
    rw [Sylow.card_eq_multiplicity, hfac]
    norm_num
  
  have hone : Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) = 1 := by
    have hmod : Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) % 7 = 1 :=
      card_sylow_modEq_one 7 ↥N
    have hdvd := Sylow.card_dvd_index P
    have hindex : (P : Subgroup ↥N).index ∣ 12 := by
      have hmul := Subgroup.card_mul_index (P : Subgroup ↥N)
      rw [hcardP] at hmul
      rcases hcard with h | h <;> rw [h] at hmul
      · have h6 : (P : Subgroup ↥N).index = 6 := by omega
        rw [h6]
        norm_num
      · have h12 : (P : Subgroup ↥N).index = 12 := by omega
        rw [h12]
    have hd12 : Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) ∣ 12 := hdvd.trans hindex
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) ≤ 12 :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hd12
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) := Nat.card_pos
    interval_cases h : Nat.card (Sylow 7 ↥N) <;> omega
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton (Sylow 7 ↥N) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hone).1
  
  haveI hchar : ((P : Subgroup ↥N)).Characteristic :=
    Sylow.characteristic_of_subsingleton P
  haveI hnormP : ((P : Subgroup ↥N).map N.subtype).Normal :=
    map_normal_of_characteristic N (P : Subgroup ↥N)
  have hcardP' : Nat.card ((P : Subgroup ↥N).map N.subtype) = 343 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.equivMapOfInjective (P : Subgroup ↥N)
      N.subtype N.subtype_injective).toEquiv]
    exact hcardP
  have hbotP : (P : Subgroup ↥N).map N.subtype ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, Subgroup.card_bot] at hcardP'
    omega
  haveI : IsPretransitive ((P : Subgroup ↥N).map N.subtype) (Fin 2058) :=
    isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot _ hbotP
  have hdvd2058 : (2058 : ℕ) ∣ 343 := by
    have := card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive
      (N := ((P : Subgroup ↥N).map N.subtype)) (X := Fin 2058)
      (0 : Fin 2058)
    rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin, hcardP'] at this
  norm_num at hdvd2058

name: Sporadic.He.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup K0T) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  refine Or.inr ?_
  haveI := hN
  haveI htrans : IsPretransitive N (Fin 2058) :=
    isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot N hbot
  by_cases hS0 : NS0 N = ⊤
  · exact eq_top_of_NS0_top hN htrans hS0
  · haveI hns := NS0_normal (N := N) hN
    have hbot0 : NS0 N = ⊥ := by
      rcases S0.simple_S0.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_normal (NS0 N) hns with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hS0
    have hstab2 := card_stab_le_two (N := N) hbot0
    have hcardN := card_eq_stab_mul (N := N) htrans
    have hstabpos : 0 < Nat.card (stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058)) :=
      Nat.card_pos
    have hcard : Nat.card N = 2058 ∨ Nat.card N = 4116 := by
      interval_cases h : Nat.card (stabilizer N (0 : Fin 2058)) <;> omega
    exact (caseB_absurd hN hcard).elim

proof:

  · exact T1_memK _

  · exact K2_le_K1 (K3_le_K2 (K4_le_K3 (T4_memK _)))

name: Sporadic.He.siftProd_mem0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp only [siftProd, List.foldr_nil]
      exact K1.one_mem
  | cons a rest ih =>
      have ha := anyT_mem0 a.1 a.2 (hl a (by simp)).1 (hl a (by simp)).2
      have hr := ih (fun q hq => hl q (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hq))
      simp only [siftProd, List.foldr_cons] at hr ⊢
      exact K1.mul_mem ha hr

name: Sporadic.He.facLv0_0
Sporadic.He.siftPt0_0
statement:
private theorem siftPt0_0 :
    ∀ z : Fin 2058, inOrb0 z = true → ∀ x : Fin 2058,
      heaApp (tApp0 z x) =
        tApp0 (heaApp z) (siftProdApp (siftFac0_0 z) x)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz x
  have h := sift0_0_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
  · rw [hz] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact eq_of_beq (List.all_eq_true.mp h2 x (List.mem_finRange x))

name: Sporadic.He.sift_sound0_0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit0.mp hz
  have heq : (T0 ((hea : Perm2058) z))⁻¹ * hea * T0 z =
      siftProd (siftFac0_0 z) := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    have hp := siftPt0_0 z hz0 x
    change tInvApp0 (heaApp z) (heaApp (tApp0 z x)) = _
    rw [hp, siftProd_apply]
    exact tApp0_left _ _
  rw [heq]
  exact siftProd_mem0 _ (facLv0_0 z)

proof:

  intro g h
  have hg := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2058)) hO5 hSch5 (by decide) T5_base
    g.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  have hh := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2058)) hO5 hSch5 (by decide) T5_base
    h.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp h.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg hh
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hg, hh]

name: Sporadic.He.S0.stab_ypt_eq
statement:
theorem stab_ypt_eq :
    stabilizer K0T yb = stabilizer K0T (33 : Fin 2058)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, mem_stabilizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hg
    simpa [ypt_smul_val, Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, yb]
      using this
  · intro hg
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [ypt_smul_val, Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, yb]
      using hg

name: Sporadic.He.S0.stab_orbit_eq
statement:
theorem stab_orbit_eq (x : Fin 2058) :
    orbit (stabilizer K0T (33 : Fin 2058)) x = orbit K1T x
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨stabEquiv0 g, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨stabEquiv0.symm g, rfl⟩

name: Sporadic.He.S0.orbit_ypt_iff
statement:
theorem orbit_ypt_iff (H : Subgroup K0T) (x z : Ypt) :
    z ∈ orbit H x ↔ z.1 ∈ orbit H x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨s, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨s, Subtype.ext hs⟩

name: Sporadic.He.S0.orbit_deltaY'
statement:
theorem orbit_deltaY' : ∀ x ∈ deltaY,
    orbit (stabilizer K0T yb) x = deltaY
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  ext z
  rw [orbit_ypt_iff, stab_ypt_eq, stab_orbit_eq,
    orbit_deltaY_of_mem x.1 hx]
  exact ⟨fun hh => Finset.mem_coe.mp hh, fun hh => Finset.mem_coe.mpr hh⟩

name: Sporadic.He.S0.orbit_gammaY'

    orbit_gammaY_of_mem x.1 hx]
  exact ⟨fun hh => Finset.mem_coe.mp hh, fun hh => Finset.mem_coe.mpr hh⟩

name: Sporadic.He.S0.closure_gens
statement: theorem closure_gens : Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : Perm2058) (hx : x ∈ K0),
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y hy =>
        (⟨y, hy⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gA])
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gB])
    · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ ihy ihz
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ ihy ihz
    · intro y _ ihy
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ ihy
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  exact key x hx

name: Sporadic.He.S0.sq17_not_dvd
statement: theorem sq17_not_dvd : ¬ (17 ^ 2 ∣ Nat.card K0T)
proof:

  decide

name: Sporadic.He.S0.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup K0T) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  refine Or.inr ?_
  haveI := hN
  haveI : IsPretransitive N Ypt :=
    isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have h136 : (136 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := by
    have := card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive (N := N) (X := Ypt) yb
    rwa [card_Ypt] at this
  have h17 : (17 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := dvd_trans (by decide) h136
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← closure_gens, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 17) N h17 sq17_not_dvd orderOf_gA
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 17) N h17 sq17_not_dvd orderOf_gB

name: Sporadic.He.S0.nontrivial_sub
statement: theorem nontrivial_sub : Nontrivial K0T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨gA, 1, ?_⟩⟩
  intro h
  exact s0a_ne_one (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: Sporadic.He.S0.simple_S0
statement: theorem simple_S0 : IsSimpleGroup S0Subgroup
proof:
:=
  letI := nontrivial_sub
  { exists_pair_ne := nontrivial_sub.exists_pair_ne
    eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_normal := fun N hN => normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top N hN }

name: Sporadic.He.mem_gamma1
statement:
theorem mem_gamma1 {z : Fin 2058} :
    z ∈ gamma1Set ↔ inGamma1 z = true

name: Sporadic.He.tGamma1App_left
statement:
theorem tGamma1App_left (z x : Fin 2058) :
    tGamma1InvApp z (tGamma1App z x) = x

name: Sporadic.He.tGamma1App_right
statement:
theorem tGamma1App_right (z x : Fin 2058) :
    tGamma1App z (tGamma1InvApp z x) = x

name: Sporadic.He.TGamma1_apply
statement:
theorem TGamma1_apply (z x : Fin 2058) :
    TGamma1 z x = tGamma1App z x

name: Sporadic.He.TGamma1_eq_word
statement: theorem TGamma1_eq_word (z : Fin 2058) : TGamma1 z = TGamma1Word z
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 2058) (idx : ℕ) => (sList1.getD idx 1) y) =
      (fun y idx => sApp1 idx y) := by
    funext y idx
    exact sApp1_eq idx y
  rw [TGamma1_apply, TGamma1Word, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.He.TGamma1_memK
statement: theorem TGamma1_memK : ∀ z, TGamma1 z ∈ K1
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [TGamma1_eq_word, TGamma1Word]
  exact SimsChain.foldl_getD_mem K1 sList1 sList1_mem
    (gamma1Path z) 1 K1.one_mem

name: Sporadic.He.TGamma1_maps
statement:
theorem TGamma1_maps :
    ∀ z ∈ gamma1Set, TGamma1 z (2 : Fin 2058) = z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have h := tGamma1Maps_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
  · rw [mem_gamma1.mp hz] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact eq_of_beq h2

name: Sporadic.He.gamma1_invariant
statement:
theorem gamma1_invariant :
    ∀ g ∈ K1, ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma1 z = true → inGamma1 ((g : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma1 z = true → inGamma1 ((g⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma1 z = true → inGamma1 ((x : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma1 z = true → inGamma1 ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closG1_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_0_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG1_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_1_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG1_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_2_apply]
          exact h2
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closGInv1_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv1_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv1_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
  · intro z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hy z).1 hz
      have h2 := (hx ((y : Perm2058) z)).1 h1
      simpa [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hx z).2 hz
      have h2 := (hy ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z)).2 h1
      simpa [mul_inv_rev, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
  · intro x _ hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact (hx z).2 hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using (hx z).1 hz

name: Sporadic.He.orbit_gamma1
statement: theorem orbit_gamma1 : orbit K1T (2 : Fin 2058) = ↑gamma1Set
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hpt : inGamma1 (2 : Fin 2058) = true :=
      mem_gamma1.mp gamma1_pt_mem
    have h := (gamma1_invariant g.1 g.2 (2 : Fin 2058)).1 hpt
    have hmem : (g.1 : Perm2058) (2 : Fin 2058) ∈ gamma1Set :=
      mem_gamma1.mpr h
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmem
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨⟨TGamma1 y, TGamma1_memK y⟩, ?_⟩
    have := TGamma1_maps y (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using this

name: Sporadic.He.orbit_gamma1_of_mem
statement:
theorem orbit_gamma1_of_mem :
    ∀ x ∈ gamma1Set, orbit K1T x = ↑gamma1Set
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_gamma1]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_gamma1]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.He.gamma2_invariant
statement:
theorem gamma2_invariant :
    ∀ g ∈ K1, ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma2 z = true → inGamma2 ((g : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma2 z = true → inGamma2 ((g⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma2 z = true → inGamma2 ((x : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma2 z = true → inGamma2 ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closG2_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_0_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG2_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_1_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG2_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_2_apply]
          exact h2
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closGInv2_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv2_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv2_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
  · intro z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hy z).1 hz
      have h2 := (hx ((y : Perm2058) z)).1 h1
      simpa [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hx z).2 hz
      have h2 := (hy ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z)).2 h1
      simpa [mul_inv_rev, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
  · intro x _ hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact (hx z).2 hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using (hx z).1 hz

name: Sporadic.He.orbit_gamma2
statement: theorem orbit_gamma2 : orbit K1T (33 : Fin 2058) = ↑gamma2Set
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hpt : inGamma2 (33 : Fin 2058) = true :=
      mem_gamma2.mp gamma2_pt_mem
    have h := (gamma2_invariant g.1 g.2 (33 : Fin 2058)).1 hpt
    have hmem : (g.1 : Perm2058) (33 : Fin 2058) ∈ gamma2Set :=
      mem_gamma2.mpr h
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmem
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨⟨TGamma2 y, TGamma2_memK y⟩, ?_⟩
    have := TGamma2_maps y (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using this

name: Sporadic.He.orbit_gamma2_of_mem

    ∀ x ∈ gamma2Set, orbit K1T x = ↑gamma2Set
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_gamma2]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_gamma2]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.He.TGamma3_eq_word

proof:

  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 2058) (idx : ℕ) => (sList1.getD idx 1) y) =

    exact sApp1_eq idx y
  rw [TGamma3_apply, TGamma3Word, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

    (gamma3Path z) 1 K1.one_mem

name: Sporadic.He.gamma3_invariant
statement:
theorem gamma3_invariant :
    ∀ g ∈ K1, ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma3 z = true → inGamma3 ((g : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma3 z = true → inGamma3 ((g⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => ∀ z : Fin 2058,
      (inGamma3 z = true → inGamma3 ((x : Perm2058) z) = true) ∧
      (inGamma3 z = true → inGamma3 ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z) = true))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closG3_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_0_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG3_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_1_apply]
          exact h2
      · have h := closG3_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [sg1_2_apply]
          exact h2
    · intro hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := closGInv3_0_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv3_1_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
      · have h := closGInv3_2_all z
        rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
        · rw [hz] at h1
          exact absurd h1 (by decide)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def]
          exact h2
  · intro z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hy z).1 hz
      have h2 := (hx ((y : Perm2058) z)).1 h1
      simpa [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
    · intro hz
      have h1 := (hx z).2 hz
      have h2 := (hy ((x⁻¹ : Perm2058) z)).2 h1
      simpa [mul_inv_rev, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using h2
  · intro x _ hx z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact (hx z).2 hz
    · intro hz
      simpa using (hx z).1 hz

name: Sporadic.He.orbit_gamma3
statement: theorem orbit_gamma3 : orbit K1T (78 : Fin 2058) = ↑gamma3Set
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hpt : inGamma3 (78 : Fin 2058) = true :=
      mem_gamma3.mp gamma3_pt_mem
    have h := (gamma3_invariant g.1 g.2 (78 : Fin 2058)).1 hpt
    have hmem : (g.1 : Perm2058) (78 : Fin 2058) ∈ gamma3Set :=
      mem_gamma3.mpr h
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmem
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨⟨TGamma3 y, TGamma3_memK y⟩, ?_⟩
    have := TGamma3_maps y (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using this

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
statement:
theorem isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [Finite X] [IsPretransitive G X]
    {a : X} {Δ Γ : Set X}
    (hcover : insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) = Set.univ)
    (haΔ : a ∉ Δ) (haΓ : a ∉ Γ)
    (hΔ : ∀ x ∈ Δ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Δ)
    (hΓ : ∀ x ∈ Γ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Γ)
    (hΔdvd : ¬ (Δ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X))
    (hΓdvd : ¬ (Γ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X)) :
    IsPreprimitive G X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPreprimitive.of_isTrivialBlock_base a
  intro B haB hB
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ B, orbit (stabilizer G a) x ⊆ B := by
    rintro x hx y ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hs : (s : G) • B = B := hB.stabilizer_le haB s.2
    have : (s : G) • x ∈ (s : G) • B := Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx
    rw [hs] at this
    exact this
  have key : ∀ S : Set X, (∀ x ∈ S, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S) →
      (S ∩ B).Nonempty → S ⊆ B := by
    rintro S hS ⟨x, hxS, hxB⟩
    rw [← hS x hxS]
    exact hsub x hxB
  have hmem : ∀ x, x = a ∨ x ∈ Δ ∨ x ∈ Γ := by
    intro x
    have : x ∈ insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simpa [or_assoc] using this
  by_cases hd : (Δ ∩ B).Nonempty <;> by_cases hg : (Γ ∩ B).Nonempty
  · right
    refine Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset ?_
    rw [← hcover]
    exact Set.insert_subset haB (Set.union_subset (key Δ hΔ hd) (key Γ hΓ hg))
  · exfalso
    have hBΓ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Γ := fun x hx hxΓ => hg ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Δ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΔ
        · exact absurd hxΓ (hBΓ x hx)
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Δ hΔ hd)
    apply hΔdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΔ] at this
  · exfalso
    have hBΔ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Δ := fun x hx hxΔ => hd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Γ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact absurd hxΔ (hBΔ x hx)
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΓ
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Γ hΓ hg)
    apply hΓdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΓ] at this
  · left
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
    · rcases hmem y with rfl | hyΔ | hyΓ
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΔ, hy⟩ hd
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΓ, hy⟩ hg
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩ hd
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩ hg

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [FaithfulSMul G X]
    [IsPreprimitive G X] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    IsPretransitive N X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsQuasiPreprimitive.isPretransitive_of_normal (N := N)
  intro hfix
  apply hN
  rw [Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall]
  intro n hn
  apply eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := X)
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ fixedPoints N X := by rw [hfix]; trivial
  simpa using hx ⟨n, hn⟩
