theorem card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive
    {N X : Type*} [Group N] [MulAction N X] [IsPretransitive N X] (x : X) :
    Nat.card X ∣ Nat.card N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← index_stabilizer_of_transitive N x]
  exact (stabilizer N x).index_dvd_card

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hn : n ≠ 0) (h1 : p ∣ n) (h2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ n) :
    n.factorization p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; simpa using h1
  have hb : ¬ 2 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; exact h2
  omega

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
statement:
theorem mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (N : Subgroup G) [hN : N.Normal]
    (hpN : p ∣ Nat.card N) (hp2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ Nat.card G)
    {g : G} (hg : orderOf g = p) : g ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hG0 : Nat.card G ≠ 0 := Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hpG : p ∣ Nat.card G := hpN.trans N.card_subgroup_dvd_card
  have hfac : (Nat.card G).factorization p = 1 :=
    factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd hp.out hG0 hpG hp2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := N) p hpN
  have hyG : orderOf (y : G) = p := (Subgroup.orderOf_coe y).trans hy
  have hcardQ : Nat.card (zpowers (y : G)) =
      p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hyG, hfac, pow_one]
  have hcardP : Nat.card (zpowers g) =
      p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hg, hfac, pow_one]
  set Q : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers (y : G)) hcardQ with hQ
  set P : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers g) hcardP with hP
  have hQN : (Q : Subgroup G) ≤ N := by
    rw [hQ, Sylow.coe_ofCard, zpowers_le]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G Q P
  have hgP : g ∈ (P : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [hP, Sylow.coe_ofCard]; exact mem_zpowers g
  rw [← hc] at hgP
  have hgQ : (MulAut.conj c)⁻¹ • g ∈ (Q : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [← Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    exact hgP
  have hmem : c⁻¹ * g * c ∈ N := by
    refine hQN ?_
    simpa [MulAut.conj, mul_assoc] using hgQ
  have := hN.conj_mem _ hmem c
  simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.map_normal_of_characteristic
statement:
theorem map_normal_of_characteristic {G : Type*} [Group G] (N : Subgroup G)
    [N.Normal] (H : Subgroup ↥N) [hH : H.Characteristic] :
    (H.map N.subtype).Normal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a ha g
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨MulAut.conjNormal g b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h2 : b ∈ H.comap (MulAut.conjNormal g).toMonoidHom :=
      (hH.fixed (MulAut.conjNormal g)).symm ▸ hb
    exact Subgroup.mem_comap.mp h2
  · simp [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.factorization_eq_of_pow_dvd_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_of_pow_dvd_of_not_dvd {p n k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hn : n ≠ 0) (h1 : p ^ k ∣ n) (h2 : ¬ p ^ (k + 1) ∣ n) :
    n.factorization p = k
proof:
:= by
  have ha : k ≤ n.factorization p :=
    (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn).mp h1
  have hb : ¬ (k + 1) ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]
    exact h2
  omega

name: Sporadic.HeLemmas.isPreprimitive_of_five_suborbits
statement:
theorem isPreprimitive_of_five_suborbits
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [Finite X] [IsPretransitive G X]
    {a : X} {S1 S2 S3 S4 : Set X}
    (hcover : insert a (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4))) = Set.univ)
    (ha1 : a ∉ S1) (ha2 : a ∉ S2) (ha3 : a ∉ S3) (ha4 : a ∉ S4)
    (hS1 : ∀ x ∈ S1, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S1)
    (hS2 : ∀ x ∈ S2, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S2)
    (hS3 : ∀ x ∈ S3, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S3)
    (hS4 : ∀ x ∈ S4, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S4)
    (hd12 : Disjoint S1 S2) (hd13 : Disjoint S1 S3)
    (hd14 : Disjoint S1 S4) (hd23 : Disjoint S2 S3)
    (hd24 : Disjoint S2 S4) (hd34 : Disjoint S3 S4)
    (hdvd : ∀ s ∈ [
      S1.ncard,
      S2.ncard,
      S3.ncard,
      S4.ncard,
      S1.ncard + S2.ncard,
      S1.ncard + S3.ncard,
      S1.ncard + S4.ncard,
      S2.ncard + S3.ncard,
      S2.ncard + S4.ncard,
      S3.ncard + S4.ncard,
      S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S3.ncard),
      S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S4.ncard),
      S1.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard),
      S2.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard)],
      ¬ (s + 1 ∣ Nat.card X)) :
    IsPreprimitive G X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPreprimitive.of_isTrivialBlock_base a
  intro B haB hB
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ B, orbit (stabilizer G a) x ⊆ B := by
    rintro x hx y ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hs : (s : G) • B = B := hB.stabilizer_le haB s.2
    have : (s : G) • x ∈ (s : G) • B := Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx
    rw [hs] at this
    exact this
  have key : ∀ S : Set X, (∀ x ∈ S, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S) →
      (S ∩ B).Nonempty → S ⊆ B := by
    rintro S hS ⟨x, hxS, hxB⟩
    rw [← hS x hxS]
    exact hsub x hxB
  have hmem : ∀ x, x = a ∨ x ∈ S1 ∨ x ∈ S2 ∨ x ∈ S3 ∨ x ∈ S4 := by
    intro x
    have : x ∈ insert a (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4))) := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simpa [or_assoc] using this
  by_cases hm1 : (S1 ∩ B).Nonempty
  · by_cases hm2 : (S2 ∩ B).Nonempty
    · by_cases hm3 : (S3 ∩ B).Nonempty
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · right
          refine Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset ?_
          rw [← hcover]
          exact Set.insert_subset haB (Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (Set.union_subset (key S3 hS3 hm3) (key S4 hS4 hm4))))
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S3)) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (h)))
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (key S3 hS3 hm3))
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S3)) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha2 h
            · exact ha3 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S3)).ncard = S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S3.ncard) := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq (Set.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd12, hd13⟩) (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _),
              Set.ncard_union_eq hd23 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S3.ncard)) (by simp) hdv
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S4)) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (h)))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (key S4 hS4 hm4))
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S4)) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha2 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ (S2 ∪ S4)).ncard = S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S4.ncard) := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq (Set.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd12, hd14⟩) (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _),
              Set.ncard_union_eq hd24 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + (S2.ncard + S4.ncard)) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ S2) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (key S2 hS2 hm2)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ S2) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha2 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ S2).ncard = S1.ncard + S2.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd12 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + S2.ncard) (by simp) hdv
    · by_cases hm3 : (S3 ∩ B).Nonempty
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (h)))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (Set.union_subset (key S3 hS3 hm3) (key S4 hS4 hm4))
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha3 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)).ncard = S1.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard) := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq (Set.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd13, hd14⟩) (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _),
              Set.ncard_union_eq hd34 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard)) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ S3) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (key S3 hS3 hm3)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ S3) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha3 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ S3).ncard = S1.ncard + S3.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd13 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + S3.ncard) (by simp) hdv
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1 ∪ S4) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S1 hS1 hm1) (key S4 hS4 hm4)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1 ∪ S4) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha1 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S1 ∪ S4).ncard = S1.ncard + S4.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd14 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard + S4.ncard) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S1) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact key S1 hS1 hm1
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S1) := by
            intro h
            exact ha1 h
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S1.ncard) (by simp) hdv
  · by_cases hm2 : (S2 ∩ B).Nonempty
    · by_cases hm3 : (S3 ∩ B).Nonempty
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S2 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (h)))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (Set.union_subset (key S3 hS3 hm3) (key S4 hS4 hm4))
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S2 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h | h
            · exact ha2 h
            · exact ha3 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S2 ∪ (S3 ∪ S4)).ncard = S2.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard) := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq (Set.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd23, hd24⟩) (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _),
              Set.ncard_union_eq hd34 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S2.ncard + (S3.ncard + S4.ncard)) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S2 ∪ S3) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (key S3 hS3 hm3)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S2 ∪ S3) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha2 h
            · exact ha3 h
          have hcard : (S2 ∪ S3).ncard = S2.ncard + S3.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd23 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S2.ncard + S3.ncard) (by simp) hdv
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S2 ∪ S4) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S2 hS2 hm2) (key S4 hS4 hm4)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S2 ∪ S4) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha2 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S2 ∪ S4).ncard = S2.ncard + S4.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd24 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S2.ncard + S4.ncard) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S2) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact key S2 hS2 hm2
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S2) := by
            intro h
            exact ha2 h
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S2.ncard) (by simp) hdv
    · by_cases hm3 : (S3 ∩ B).Nonempty
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S3 ∪ S4) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inl h)
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Or.inr (h))
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact Set.union_subset (key S3 hS3 hm3) (key S4 hS4 hm4)
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S3 ∪ S4) := by
            intro h
            rcases h with h | h
            · exact ha3 h
            · exact ha4 h
          have hcard : (S3 ∪ S4).ncard = S3.ncard + S4.ncard := by
            rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd34 (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin, hcard] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S3.ncard + S4.ncard) (by simp) hdv
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S3) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h)
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact key S3 hS3 hm3
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S3) := by
            intro h
            exact ha3 h
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S3.ncard) (by simp) hdv
      · by_cases hm4 : (S4 ∩ B).Nonempty
        · exfalso
          have hBeq : B = insert a (S4) := by
            apply Set.Subset.antisymm
            · intro x hx
              rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
              · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
              · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
              · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h)
            · refine Set.insert_subset haB ?_
              exact key S4 hS4 hm4
          have hanotin : a ∉ (S4) := by
            intro h
            exact ha4 h
          have hdv := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
          rw [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hanotin] at hdv
          exact hdvd (S4.ncard) (by simp) hdv

          intro x hx y hy
          have hxa : x = a := by
            rcases hmem x with rfl | h | h | h | h
            · rfl
            · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm1
            · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm2
            · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm3
            · exact absurd ⟨x, h, hx⟩ hm4
          have hya : y = a := by
            rcases hmem y with rfl | h | h | h | h
            · rfl
            · exact absurd ⟨y, h, hy⟩ hm1
            · exact absurd ⟨y, h, hy⟩ hm2
            · exact absurd ⟨y, h, hy⟩ hm3
            · exact absurd ⟨y, h, hy⟩ hm4
          rw [hxa, hya]

name: Sporadic.He.anyT_apply
statement:
theorem anyT_apply (j : Nat) (y : Nat) (x : Fin 2058) :
    anyT j y x = anyTApp j y x
proof:
:= by
  match j with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | 5 => rfl
  | n + 6 => rfl

name: Sporadic.He.siftProd_apply
statement:
theorem siftProd_apply (l : List (Nat × Nat)) (x : Fin 2058) :
    siftProd l x = siftProdApp l x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [siftProd, siftProdApp, List.foldr_cons]
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      show anyT a.1 a.2 (siftProd rest x) = _
      rw [ih, anyT_apply]
      rfl

name: Sporadic.He.S0.alpha0_memK
statement: theorem alpha0_memK : ∀ g ∈ alpha0, g ∈ K0
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  simp only [alpha0, List.mem_cons,
    List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hg
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  · exact K0.inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp))
  · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  · exact K0.inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp))

name: Sporadic.He.S0.K1_le_K0
statement: theorem K1_le_K0 : K1 ≤ K0
proof:
:= by
  rw [K1, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl
  · rw [sg1_0_eq_word]
    exact wordEval_mem alpha0_memK _
  · rw [sg1_1_eq_word]
    exact wordEval_mem alpha0_memK _

private theorem anyT_mem0 :
    ∀ j y, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ 3 → anyT j y ∈ K1
proof:
:= by
  intro j y h1 h2
  interval_cases j
  · exact T1_memK _
  · exact K2_le_K1 (T2_memK _)
  · exact K2_le_K1 (K3_le_K2 (T3_memK _))

name: Sporadic.He.S0.siftProd_mem0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp only [siftProd, List.foldr_nil]
      exact K1.one_mem
  | cons a rest ih =>
      have ha := anyT_mem0 a.1 a.2 (hl a (by simp)).1 (hl a (by simp)).2
      have hr := ih (fun q hq => hl q (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hq))

name: Sporadic.He.S0.stabLast_subsingleton
statement:
theorem stabLast_subsingleton :
    ∀ g h : MulAction.stabilizer K3T (39 : Fin 2058), g = h
proof:
:= by
  intro g h
  have hg := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2058)) hO3 hSch3 (by decide) T3_base
    g.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  have hh := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2058)) hO3 hSch3 (by decide) T3_base
    h.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp h.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg hh
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hg, hh]

  have h1 : Fintype.card

    exact ⟨⟨1, by
      rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
      rfl⟩, fun g => (stabLast_subsingleton g _)⟩

name: Sporadic.J1FamilyHom.chi_mem_closure
statement:
theorem chi_mem_closure (g : L211Subgroup) :
    chi g ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, x ∈ L211Subgroup →
      chiExt x ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => chiExt y ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · rw [chiExt_eq l211e1 l211e1_mem, chi_l211e1]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · rw [chiExt_eq l211e2 l211e2_mem, chi_l211e2]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
    · change chiExt 1 ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266)
      have h1 : chiExt 1 = chi 1 := chiExt_eq 1 (Subgroup.one_mem _)
      rw [h1, map_one]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro a b ha hb hpa hpb
      change chiExt (a * b) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266) := hpa
      have hpb' : chiExt b ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266) := hpb
      have hab : chiExt (a * b) = chi (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩ : L211Subgroup) :=
        chiExt_eq (a * b) (Subgroup.mul_mem _ ha hb)
      rw [hab, map_mul]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      rw [chiExt_eq b hb] at hpb'
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hpa' hpb'
    · intro a ha hpa
      change chiExt a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266) := hpa
      have hai : chiExt a⁻¹ = chi ((⟨a, ha⟩ : L211Subgroup)⁻¹) :=
        chiExt_eq a⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ ha)
      rw [hai, map_inv]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hpa'
  have hg : chi g = chiExt g.1 := (chiExt_eq g.1 g.2).symm
  rw [hg]
  exact key g.1 g.2

name: Sporadic.J1FamilyHom.embeddedL211_eq_closure

theorem embeddedL211_eq_closure :
    EmbeddedL211 = Subgroup.closure ({j1a, j1b} : Set Perm266)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro g hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact chi_mem_closure p
  · rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨l211e1, l211e1_mem⟩, chi_l211e1⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨l211e2, l211e2_mem⟩, chi_l211e2⟩

statement:
theorem stab_match_witness (p q : Fin 266)
    (hp : p ∈ subMatch) (hq : q ∈ subMatch) :
    ∃ s : J1, s.1 265 = 265 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p ∈ nbrs 265 := by rw [nbrs_star]; exact hp
  have hq' : q ∈ nbrs 265 := by rw [nbrs_star]; exact hq
  set Wp := Word.toJ1 (levelTwoWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toJ1 (levelTwoWord q) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 266) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all p hp'
  have hWp265 : Wp.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_fixes_star_all p hp'
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 266) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all q hq'
  have hWq265 : Wq.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_fixes_star_all q hq'
  have hWpInv265 : Wp.1⁻¹ (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp265]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 265 = 265
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv265, hWq265]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

proof:
:= by

  have hWpr : Wp.1 (11 : Fin 266) = p := by

  have hWp265 : Wp.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWp] using subPointWord_fixes_star p hp
  have hWqr : Wq.1 (11 : Fin 266) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using subPointWord_maps_rep q hq
  have hWq265 : Wq.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWq] using subPointWord_fixes_star q hq
  have hWpInv265 : Wp.1⁻¹ (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp265]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 11 := by
    rw [← hWpr, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 265 = 265
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv265, hWq265]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q

  have hWpr : Wp.1 (23 : Fin 266) = p := by

    simpa [hWq] using subHexAWord_maps_rep q hq
  have hWq265 : Wq.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWq] using subHexAWord_fixes_star q hq
  have hWpInv265 : Wp.1⁻¹ (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp265]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 23 := by
    rw [← hWpr, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 265 = 265
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv265, hWq265]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWqr]

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.stab_hexB_witness
statement:
theorem stab_hexB_witness (p q : Fin 266)
    (hp : p ∈ subHexB) (hq : q ∈ subHexB) :
    ∃ s : J1, s.1 265 = 265 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toJ1 (subHexBWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toJ1 (subHexBWord q) with hWq
  have hWpr : Wp.1 (133 : Fin 266) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using subHexBWord_maps_rep p hp
  have hWp265 : Wp.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWp] using subHexBWord_fixes_star p hp
  have hWqr : Wq.1 (133 : Fin 266) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using subHexBWord_maps_rep q hq
  have hWq265 : Wq.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    simpa [hWq] using subHexBWord_fixes_star q hq
  have hWpInv265 : Wp.1⁻¹ (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp265]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 133 := by
    rw [← hWpr, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 265 = 265
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv265, hWq265]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWqr]

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.orbSet_star_mem
statement: theorem orbSet_star_mem (N : Subgroup J1) : (265 : Fin 266) ∈ orbSet N

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.orbSet_apply_mem
statement:
theorem orbSet_apply_mem (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal) (g : J1)
    (hg : g.1 265 ∈ orbSet N) {x : Fin 266} (hx : x ∈ orbSet N) :
    g.1 x ∈ orbSet N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hm'x⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨m'', hm'', hm''s⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨g * m' * g⁻¹ * m'',
    N.mul_mem (by simpa [mul_assoc] using hN.conj_mem m' hm' g) hm'', ?_⟩
  change (g.1 * m'.1 * g.1⁻¹ * m''.1) 265 = g.1 x
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
    hm''s, perm_inv_apply_self, hm'x]

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.orbSet_closed_of_witness
statement:
theorem orbSet_closed_of_witness (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal)
    {x y : Fin 266} (hx : x ∈ orbSet N)
    (s : J1) (hs : s.1 265 = 265) (hsxy : s.1 x = y) : y ∈ orbSet N
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : s.1 265 ∈ orbSet N := by
    rw [hs]
    exact orbSet_star_mem N
  have := orbSet_apply_mem N hN s hstar hx
  rwa [hsxy] at this

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.refute_case
statement:
theorem refute_case (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal)
    (BU : Finset (Fin 266)) (w : Word) (xU : Fin 266)
    (hstar : (Word.eval w) 265 ∈ BU) (hxU : xU ∈ BU)
    (hmv : (Word.eval w) xU ∉ BU)
    (hsub : ∀ y ∈ BU, y ∈ orbSet N) (hsup : ∀ y ∈ orbSet N, y ∈ BU) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Word.toJ1 w).1 265 ∈ orbSet N := hsub _ hstar
  have h2 : xU ∈ orbSet N := hsub _ hxU
  have h3 := orbSet_apply_mem N hN (Word.toJ1 w) h1 h2
  exact hmv (hsup _ h3)

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup J1) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 266, (n : J1).1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.moved_star
statement:
theorem moved_star (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, (m : J1).1 265 ≠ 265
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  set g := Word.toJ1 (levelOneWord p) with hg
  have hg265 : g.1 (265 : Fin 266) = p := by
    simpa [hg] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all p
  refine ⟨g⁻¹ * n * g, by simpa [mul_assoc] using hN.conj_mem n hnN g⁻¹, ?_⟩
  change (g.1⁻¹ * n.1 * g.1) 265 ≠ 265
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hg265]
  intro h
  apply hp
  have := congrArg g.1 h
  rwa [perm_apply_inv_self, hg265] at this

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.normal_orbit_star_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_star_eq_univ (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    MulAction.orbit N (265 : Fin 266) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hall := orbSet_eq_univ_of_moved N hN (moved_star N hN hbot)
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := hall x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.card_normal_eq_266_mul_stab
statement:
theorem card_normal_eq_266_mul_stab (N : Subgroup J1)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (265 : Fin 266) = Set.univ) :
    Nat.card N = 266 * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (265 : Fin 266))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group N (265 : Fin 266)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, horbit, Set.ncard_univ]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := MulAction.stabilizer N (265 : Fin 266))]
  simp

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.card_stabInN_eq
statement:
theorem card_stabInN_eq (N : Subgroup J1) :

      Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast)

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_star
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_star (N : Subgroup J1)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : J1} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 265 = 265) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : J1) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 266) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 19) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 266 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 19 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 19) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : Sylow 19 N, ∀ Q : Sylow 19 N, Q = P0 := by
    have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one 19 N
    have hmod' : Nat.card (Sylow 19 N) % 19 = 1 := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq at hmod
      omega
    have hdvd : Nat.card (Sylow 19 N) ∣ 266 := by
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow 19 N))
      refine (P.card_dvd_index).trans ?_
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ (by rw [P.1.card_mul_index, hcard])
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 19 N) ≤ 266 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    have hforce : ∀ k < 267, k ∣ 266 → k % 19 = 1 → k = 1 := by decide
    have hn19 : Nat.card (Sylow 19 N) = 1 :=
      hforce _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle) hdvd hmod'
    rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists] at hn19
    exact hn19
  
  have hmemP0 : ∀ n : N, orderOf n = 19 → n ∈ P0.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hz : IsPGroup 19 (Subgroup.zpowers n) := by
      apply IsPGroup.of_card
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hn, pow_one]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hz.exists_le_sylow
    rw [hP0 Q] at hQ
    exact hQ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers n)
  
  have hcardP0 : Nat.card P0.1 = 19 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp P0.2
    have hdvdP : Nat.card P0.1 ∣ 266 := by
      rw [← hcard]
      exact Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card P0.1
    have hz0P : z0 ∈ P0.1 := hmemP0 z0 hz0
    have h19dvd : 19 ∣ Nat.card P0.1 := by
      have : orderOf (⟨z0, hz0P⟩ : P0.1) = 19 := by
        exact (orderOf_injective P0.1.subtype P0.1.subtype_injective
          (⟨z0, hz0P⟩ : P0.1)).symm.trans hz0
      simpa only [this] using
        (orderOf_dvd_natCard (⟨z0, hz0P⟩ : P0.1))
    rw [hn] at hdvdP h19dvd ⊢
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by
      by_contra h0
      push Not at h0
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
      rw [hn0, pow_zero] at h19dvd
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos h19dvd) (by norm_num)
    have hn2 : n < 2 := by
      by_contra hgt
      push Not at hgt
      have h361 : (361 : ℕ) ∣ 19 ^ n := by
        have : (19 : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ 19 ^ n := Nat.pow_dvd_pow _ hgt
        simpa using this
      have := h361.trans hdvdP
      norm_num at this
    have hn_eq : n = 1 := by omega
    rw [hn_eq, pow_one]
  
  have hKcard : K.card = 18 := by
    haveI : Fintype P0.1 := Fintype.ofFinite _
    set KP := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1) with hKP
    have hone : (1 : N) ∈ KP := by
      rw [hKP, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, P0.1.one_mem⟩
    have hKeq : K = KP.erase 1 := by
      ext n
      rw [hK, hKP, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨_, hn⟩
        refine ⟨?_, Finset.mem_univ _, hmemP0 n hn⟩
        intro h1
        rw [h1, orderOf_one] at hn
        norm_num at hn
      · intro ⟨hne, _, hmem⟩
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have horder : orderOf (⟨n, hmem⟩ : P0.1) = orderOf n :=
          (orderOf_injective P0.1.subtype P0.1.subtype_injective
            (⟨n, hmem⟩ : P0.1)).symm
        have hdvd19 : orderOf (⟨n, hmem⟩ : P0.1) ∣ 19 := by
          simpa only [hcardP0] using
            (orderOf_dvd_natCard (⟨n, hmem⟩ : P0.1))
        rcases (Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd (by decide) _ hdvd19) with h | h
        · exfalso
          rw [horder, orderOf_eq_one_iff] at h
          exact hne h
        · rw [← horder, h]
    have hKPcard : KP.card = 19 := by
      have : KP.card = Nat.card P0.1 := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
        rw [hKP]
        exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
      rw [this, hcardP0]
    rw [hKeq, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hone, hKPcard]
  
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 265 = m.1.1 265 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 265 = 265 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 265 = 265
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 265 ≠ 265 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 19 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  
  have hconj : ∀ (s : J1), s.1 265 = 265 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 265 = s.1 (n.1.1 265) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 265 = s.1 (n.1.1 265)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 265) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = 18 := by
    rw [hKimg]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn (fun n _ m _ h => hphi_inj n m h)]
    exact hKcard
  
  have hclose : ∀ (sub : Finset (Fin 266))
      (hwit : ∀ p q : Fin 266, p ∈ sub → q ∈ sub →
        ∃ s : J1, s.1 265 = 265 ∧ s.1 p = q),
      ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ sub → ∀ y ∈ sub, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro sub hwit x hx hxs y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs265, hsx⟩ := hwit x y hxs hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs265 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  
  have hKimg265 : (265 : Fin 266) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 265 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  
  have hHexA : ¬ ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subHexA := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩
    have hsub : subHexA ⊆ Kimg := fun y hy =>
      hclose subHexA stab_hexA_witness x hx hxs y hy
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [hcard_eq] at this
    have hA : subHexA.card = 110 := by decide
    omega
  have hHexB : ¬ ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subHexB := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩
    have hsub : subHexB ⊆ Kimg := fun y hy =>
      hclose subHexB stab_hexB_witness x hx hxs y hy
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [hcard_eq] at this
    have hB : subHexB.card = 132 := by decide
    omega
  
  have hsmall : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subMatch ∨ x ∈ subPoint := by
    intro x hx
    have hx265 : x ≠ 265 := fun h => hKimg265 (h ▸ hx)
    rcases suborbit_partition x hx265 with h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hx, h⟩ hHexA
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hx, h⟩ hHexB
  by_cases hM : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subMatch
  · by_cases hP : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subPoint
    · 
      have heq : Kimg = subMatch ∪ subPoint := by
        apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
        · intro x hx
          rcases hsmall x hx with h | h
          · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ h
          · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ h
        · intro y hy
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with h | h
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := hM
            exact hclose subMatch stab_match_witness x hx hxs y h
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := hP
            exact hclose subPoint stab_point_witness x hx hxs y h
      have : (subMatch ∪ subPoint).card = 23 := by decide
      rw [heq, this] at hcard_eq
      omega
    · 
      have heq : Kimg = subMatch := by
        apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
        · intro x hx
          rcases hsmall x hx with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd ⟨x, hx, h⟩ hP
        · intro y hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := hM
          exact hclose subMatch stab_match_witness x hx hxs y hy
      have : subMatch.card = 11 := by decide
      rw [heq, this] at hcard_eq
      omega
  · by_cases hP : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ subPoint
    · 
      have heq : Kimg = subPoint := by
        apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
        · intro x hx
          rcases hsmall x hx with h | h
          · exact absurd ⟨x, hx, h⟩ hM
          · exact h
        · intro y hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := hP
          exact hclose subPoint stab_point_witness x hx hxs y hy
      have : subPoint.card = 12 := by decide
      rw [heq, this] at hcard_eq
      omega
    · 
      rcases hsmall _ hz0img with h | h
      · exact hM ⟨_, hz0img, h⟩
      · exact hP ⟨_, hz0img, h⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup J1) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  have horbit := normal_orbit_star_eq_univ N hN hbot
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_266_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard266 : Nat.card N = 266 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard266
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 660 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card J1 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, J1Cardinality.card_J1]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

    (J1_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1) (J1_preserves_nbrs2 g.1.1.1)
    (J1_preserves_nbrs4 g.1.1.1)
    (stabBase_fixes_star g) (stabBase_fixes_zero g) (stabBase_fixes_one g)

name: Sporadic.J1Cardinality.card_stabBase_le
statement: theorem card_stabBase_le : Nat.card StabBase ≤ 6
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype StabBase := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have himg : Finset.univ.image (fun g : StabBase => g.1.1.1.1) ⊆ tailPerms := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact stabBase_toPerm_mem g
  calc Fintype.card StabBase
      = Finset.univ.card := Finset.card_univ.symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.image (fun g : StabBase => g.1.1.1.1)).card :=
        (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ stabBase_toPerm_injective).symm
    _ ≤ tailPerms.card := Finset.card_le_card himg
    _ ≤ 6 := tailPerms_card_le

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 23) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : M23, g.1 22 = x ∧ g.1 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toM23 (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA22 : A.1 (22 : Fin 23) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_last_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz22 : z ≠ 22 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (22 : Fin 23) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA22]
  set B := Word.toM23 (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (22 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_last_all z hz22
  have hBzero : B.1 (0 : Fin 23) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_zero_all z hz22
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 22 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA22]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBzero, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 23) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : M23, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 22 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 0 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup M23) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 23, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup M23) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M23} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 23} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 23) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.normal_orbit_last_eq_univ

theorem normal_orbit_last_eq_univ (N : Subgroup M23) (hN : N.Normal)

    MulAction.orbit N (22 : Fin 23) = Set.univ
proof:

  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp 22 x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup M23) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hcard : Nat.card N = 23)
    (htrans : ∀ x : Fin 23, ∃ n ∈ N, n.1 (22 : Fin 23) = x) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 23) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 23 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 23 (by rw [hF])
  have hzM : orderOf (z0.1 : M23) = 23 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective z0
    rw [hz0] at h
    exact h
  set zM : M23 := z0.1 with hzMdef
  have hzmem : zM ∈ N := z0.2
  
  have hle : Subgroup.zpowers zM ≤ N := Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr hzmem
  have hzcard : Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers zM) = 23 := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hzM]
  have hzpow_eq : Subgroup.zpowers zM = N := by
    apply SetLike.coe_injective
    apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le
    · exact hle
    · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
        SetLike.coe_sort_coe, SetLike.coe_sort_coe, hcard, hzcard]
    · exact Set.toFinite _
  
  have hconj_mem : aM * zM * aM⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers zM := by
    rw [hzpow_eq]
    exact hN.conj_mem zM hzmem aM
  have hconj_pow : ∃ j : ℕ, j < 23 ∧ zM ^ j = aM * zM * aM⁻¹ := by
    have hmem' : aM * zM * aM⁻¹ ∈ Submonoid.powers zM :=
      mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.mpr hconj_mem
    rw [Submonoid.mem_powers_iff] at hmem'
    obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := hmem'
    refine ⟨j0 % 23, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num), ?_⟩
    calc zM ^ (j0 % 23) = zM ^ (j0 % orderOf zM) := by rw [hzM]
      _ = zM ^ j0 := pow_mod_orderOf zM j0
      _ = aM * zM * aM⁻¹ := hj0
  obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hj⟩ := hconj_pow
  
  have hchain : ∀ k : ℕ, aM ^ k * zM * (aM ^ k)⁻¹ = zM ^ j ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have hstep : aM ^ (m + 1) * zM * (aM ^ (m + 1))⁻¹
          = aM * (aM ^ m * zM * (aM ^ m)⁻¹) * aM⁻¹ := by
        rw [pow_succ']
        group
      calc aM ^ (m + 1) * zM * (aM ^ (m + 1))⁻¹
          = aM * (aM ^ m * zM * (aM ^ m)⁻¹) * aM⁻¹ := hstep
        _ = aM * zM ^ j ^ m * aM⁻¹ := by rw [ih]
        _ = (aM * zM * aM⁻¹) ^ j ^ m := (conj_pow' aM zM (j ^ m)).symm
        _ = (zM ^ j) ^ j ^ m := by rw [hj]
        _ = zM ^ (j * j ^ m) := by rw [← pow_mul]
        _ = zM ^ j ^ (m + 1) := by rw [pow_succ']
  have h5 : zM ^ (1 : ℕ) = zM ^ j ^ 5 := by
    have h := hchain 5
    rw [aM_pow_five] at h
    simpa using h
  
  have hmod : (1 : ℕ) ≡ j ^ 5 [MOD 23] := by
    have h := pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq.mp h5
    rwa [hzM] at h
  have hj1 : j = 1 := by
    have harg : 1 % 23 = (j : ℕ) ^ 5 % 23 := hmod
    exact pow_five_mod_pin ⟨j, hjlt⟩ harg
  
  have hcomm : Commute aM zM := by
    have hz1 : zM = aM * zM * aM⁻¹ := by
      have := hj
      rwa [hj1, pow_one] at this
    have h' : aM * zM = zM * aM := by
      have h'' := congrArg (· * aM) hz1
      simpa [mul_assoc] using h''.symm
    exact h'
  
  apply m23a_ne_one
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, hn22⟩ := htrans x
  have hnz : n ∈ Subgroup.zpowers zM := by
    rw [hzpow_eq]
    exact hnN
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hnz
  have hcommn : Commute aM n := by
    rw [← ht]
    exact hcomm.zpow_right t
  have hfix : m23a x = x := by
    have hmul : (aM * n).1 (22 : Fin 23) = m23a x := by
      change (m23a * n.1) 22 = m23a x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hn22]
    have hmul' : (n * aM).1 (22 : Fin 23) = x := by
      change (n.1 * m23a) 22 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, m23a_fixes_last, hn22]
    rw [← hmul, hcommn.eq, hmul']
  simpa using hfix

name: Sporadic.M23Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup M23) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_last_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_23_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard23 : Nat.card N = 23 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hcard23
      (fun x => normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp 22 x)
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 443520 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card M23 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, M23Cardinality.card_M23]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 24) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : M24, g.1 23 = x ∧ g.1 22 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toM24 (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA23 : A.1 (23 : Fin 24) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_last_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz23 : z ≠ 23 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (23 : Fin 24) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA23]
  set B := Word.toM24 (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_23_all z hz23
  have hB22 : B.1 (22 : Fin 24) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_22_all z hz23
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 23 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA23]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 22 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hB22, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 24) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : M24, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 23 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 22 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.stab_pair_witness
statement:
theorem stab_pair_witness (p q : Fin 24) (hp : p ≠ 23) (hq : q ≠ 23) :
    ∃ s : M24, s.1 23 = 23 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toM24 (levelTwoWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toM24 (levelTwoWord q) with hWq
  have hWp22 : Wp.1 (22 : Fin 24) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_maps_22_all p hp
  have hWp23 : Wp.1 (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_fixes_23_all p hp
  have hWq22 : Wq.1 (22 : Fin 24) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_maps_22_all q hq
  have hWq23 : Wq.1 (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_fixes_23_all q hq
  have hWpInv23 : Wp.1⁻¹ (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp23]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 22 := by
    rw [← hWp22, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 23 = 23
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv23, hWq23]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq22]

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup M24) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 24, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup M24) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M24} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 24} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 24) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.normal_orbit_last_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_last_eq_univ (N : Subgroup M24) (hN : N.Normal)

    MulAction.orbit N (23 : Fin 24) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp 23 x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_last
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_last (N : Subgroup M24)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : M24} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 23 = 23) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.conj_witness
statement:
theorem conj_witness (N : Subgroup M24) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {n1 n2 : M24} (h1N : n1 ∈ N) (h2N : n2 ∈ N) (h1 : n1 ≠ 1) (h2 : n2 ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : M24, s * n1 * s⁻¹ = n2
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : n1.1 (23 : Fin 24) ≠ 23 := fun h =>
    h1 (eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb h1N h)
  have hp2 : n2.1 (23 : Fin 24) ≠ 23 := fun h =>
    h2 (eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb h2N h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs23, hsp⟩ := stab_pair_witness (n1.1 23) (n2.1 23) hp1 hp2
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  have hsinv : s.1⁻¹ (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hs23]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hm23 : (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1 (23 : Fin 24) = n2.1 23 := by
    change (s.1 * n1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 23 = n2.1 23
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hsinv, hsp]
  have hfix : (n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹)).1 (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
    change (n2.1⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1) 23 = 23
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm23, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hmem : n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹) ∈ N :=
    N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem h2N) (hN.conj_mem n1 h1N s)
  have hone := eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb hmem hfix
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hone).symm

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : M24) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup M24) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 24) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 24 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 2 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨x3, hx3⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 3 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  have h2 : orderOf (x2.1 : M24) = 2 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x2
    rw [hx2] at h
    exact h
  have h3 : orderOf (x3.1 : M24) = 3 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x3
    rw [hx3] at h
    exact h
  have hx2ne : (x2.1 : M24) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  have hx3ne : (x3.1 : M24) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h3
    norm_num at h3
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := conj_witness N hN hb x2.2 x3.2 hx2ne hx3ne
  have := orderOf_conj_eq s x2.1
  rw [hs, h2, h3] at this
  norm_num at this

name: Sporadic.M24Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup M24) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_last_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_24_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    apply regular_case_absurd N hN hb
    rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 10200960 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card M24 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, M24Cardinality.card_M24]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 12) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : M12, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toM12 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 12) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 12) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set B := Word.toM12 (zeroStabilizerWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabilizerWord_fixes_zero z hz0
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 12) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabilizerWord_maps_one z hz0
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 12) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : M12, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.stab_pair_witness
statement:
theorem stab_pair_witness (p q : Fin 12) (hp : p ≠ 11) (hq : q ≠ 11) :
    ∃ s : M12, s.1 11 = 11 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toM12 (aPowerWord p.val) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toM12 (aPowerWord q.val) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 12) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using aPowerWord_maps_zero_all p hp
  have hWp11 : Wp.1 (11 : Fin 12) = 11 := by
    simpa [hWp] using aPowerWord_fixes_eleven_all p
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 12) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using aPowerWord_maps_zero_all q hq
  have hWq11 : Wq.1 (11 : Fin 12) = 11 := by
    simpa [hWq] using aPowerWord_fixes_eleven_all q
  have hWpInv11 : Wp.1⁻¹ (11 : Fin 12) = 11 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp11]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 11 = 11
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv11, hWq11]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup M12) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 12, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup M12) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M12} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 12} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 12) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.normal_orbit_eleven_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_eleven_eq_univ (N : Subgroup M12) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M12} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 12} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (11 : Fin 12) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp 11 x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.card_normal_eq_twelve_mul_stab

proof:

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_eleven
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_eleven (N : Subgroup M12)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabEleven = ⊥)
    {m : M12} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 11 = 11) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabEleven := by
    rw [StabEleven, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabEleven) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabEleven :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.conj_witness
statement:
theorem conj_witness (N : Subgroup M12) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabEleven = ⊥)
    {n1 n2 : M12} (h1N : n1 ∈ N) (h2N : n2 ∈ N) (h1 : n1 ≠ 1) (h2 : n2 ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : M12, s * n1 * s⁻¹ = n2
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : n1.1 (11 : Fin 12) ≠ 11 := fun h =>
    h1 (eq_one_of_fixes_eleven N hb h1N h)
  have hp2 : n2.1 (11 : Fin 12) ≠ 11 := fun h =>
    h2 (eq_one_of_fixes_eleven N hb h2N h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs11, hsp⟩ := stab_pair_witness (n1.1 11) (n2.1 11) hp1 hp2
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  have hsinv : s.1⁻¹ (11 : Fin 12) = 11 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hs11]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hm11 : (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1 (11 : Fin 12) = n2.1 11 := by
    change (s.1 * n1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 11 = n2.1 11
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hsinv, hsp]
  have hfix : (n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹)).1 (11 : Fin 12) = 11 := by
    change (n2.1⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1) 11 = 11
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm11, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hmem : n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹) ∈ N :=
    N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem h2N) (hN.conj_mem n1 h1N s)
  have hone := eq_one_of_fixes_eleven N hb hmem hfix
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hone).symm

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : M12) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup M12) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabEleven = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 12) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 12 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 2 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨x3, hx3⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 3 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  have h2 : orderOf (x2.1 : M12) = 2 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x2
    rw [hx2] at h
    exact h
  have h3 : orderOf (x3.1 : M12) = 3 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x3
    rw [hx3] at h
    exact h
  have hx2ne : (x2.1 : M12) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  have hx3ne : (x3.1 : M12) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h3
    norm_num at h3
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := conj_witness N hN hb x2.2 x3.2 hx2ne hx3ne
  have := orderOf_conj_eq s x2.1
  rw [hs, h2, h3] at this
  norm_num at this

name: Sporadic.M12Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup M12) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_eleven_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_twelve_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabEleven := isSimpleGroup_stabEleven
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabEleven).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabEleven
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    apply regular_case_absurd N hN hb
    rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabEleven) = 7920 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabEleven
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card M12 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, M12Cardinality.card_M12]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

proof:
| [], _ => List.Pairwise.nil
  | [a], _ => by simp
  | a :: b :: t, h => by
      rw [sortedB, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨hab, ht⟩ := h
      have hp := sortedB_pairwise (b :: t) ht
      rw [List.pairwise_cons]
      refine ⟨?_, hp⟩
      intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact hab
      · exact lt_trans hab ((List.pairwise_cons.mp hp).1 x hx')

statement:
theorem hj_mem_map (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 100)) (hpres : PreservesHJ ρ)
    {u u' v : Fin 100} (hu : ρ u = u') (hv : v ∈ hjNbrs u) :
    ρ v ∈ hjNbrs u'

name: Sporadic.G24HJ.hj_not_mem_map
statement:

    (hpres : PreservesHJ ρ)

    ρ v ∉ hjNbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]

  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem

proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have himg : (hjNbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((hjNbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [himg, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.G24HJ.preservesHJ_inv
statement:
theorem preservesHJ_inv {g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 100)}
    (hg : PreservesHJ g) : PreservesHJ g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.G24HJ.tail_branch_0
statement:
theorem tail_branch_0 (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 100))
    (hpres : PreservesHJ ρ) (h99 : ρ 99 = 99) (h0 : ρ 0 = 0)
    (h38 : ρ 38 = 38) (h1 : ρ 1 = 1) :
    ρ = tailPerm0
proof:
:= by
  have hv3 : ρ 3 = 3 :=
  stepT0_0 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide))
  have hv12 : ρ 12 = 12 :=
  stepT0_1 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide)) (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres hv3 (by decide))
    (hj_ne_of_value ρ hv3 (by decide))
  have hv5 : ρ 5 = 5 :=
  stepT0_2 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv3 (by decide))
    (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres hv12 (by decide))
  have hv2 : ρ 2 = 2 :=
  stepT0_3 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv5 (by decide))
    (hj_ne_of_value ρ hv3 (by decide))
  have hv4 : ρ 4 = 4 :=
  stepT0_4 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv2 (by decide))
  have hv7 : ρ 7 = 7 :=
  stepT0_5 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv12 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv4 (by decide))
    (hj_ne_of_value ρ h0 (by decide))
  have hv8 : ρ 8 = 8 :=
  stepT0_6 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv12 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv5 (by decide))
    (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
  have hv10 : ρ 10 = 10 :=
  stepT0_7 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv4 (by decide)) (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide))
    (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres hv3 (by decide)) (hj_ne_of_value ρ hv7 (by decide))
  have hv13 : ρ 13 = 13 :=
  stepT0_8 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv2 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres hv12 (by decide))
    (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres hv3 (by decide))
  have hv6 : ρ 6 = 6 :=

name: Sporadic.G24Graph.nbrs_card_all
statement: theorem nbrs_card_all : ∀ v : Fin 416, (nbrs v).card = 100
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  show ((⟨↑(nbrsRow v), _⟩ : Finset (Fin 416))).card = 100
  rw [Finset.card_mk, Multiset.coe_card]
  exact nbrsRow_length_all v

name: Sporadic.G24Graph.g24e_preserves_nbrs
statement: theorem g24e_preserves_nbrs : PreservesNbrs G24Perm.g24e
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    exact mem_nbrs_iff.mpr (g24e_maps_nbrs v u (mem_nbrs_iff.mp hu))
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ G24Perm.g24e.injective,
      nbrs_card_all v, nbrs_card_all (G24Perm.g24e v)]

name: Sporadic.G24Graph.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416)) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 416} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.G24Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416))
    (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 416} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.G24Fam.mem_of_testBit_rowMask
statement:
theorem mem_of_testBit_rowMask :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 416)) (i : Nat),
      (rowMask l).testBit i = true →
      ∀ (h : i < 416), (⟨i, h⟩ : Fin 416) ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      intro i hbit _
      rw [rowMask] at hbit
      simp [Nat.zero_testBit] at hbit
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro i hbit h
      have hunf : rowMask (a :: t) = rowMask t ||| (1 <<< a.val) := rfl
      rw [hunf, Nat.testBit_lor, Bool.or_eq_true] at hbit
      rcases hbit with hbit | hbit
      · exact List.Mem.tail _ (ih i hbit h)
      · rw [Nat.one_shiftLeft] at hbit
        by_cases hia : a.val = i
        · have hfin : (⟨i, h⟩ : Fin 416) = a := Fin.ext hia.symm
          rw [hfin]
          exact List.Mem.head _
        · rw [Nat.testBit_two_pow_of_ne hia] at hbit
          exact absurd hbit (by simp)

name: Sporadic.G24Fam.famOkM_sound
statement:
theorem famOkM_sound (g : Fin 416 → Fin 416)
    (f : Fin 1365 → Fin 1365) :
    ∀ (len lo : Nat), famOkM g f lo len = true →
      ∀ j : Fin 1365, lo ≤ j.val → j.val < lo + len →
        ∀ v ∈ famRow j, g v ∈ famRow (f j)
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len with
  | zero =>
      intro lo _ j hlo hhi
      exact absurd hhi (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
      intro lo hOk j hlo hhi v hv
      rw [famOkM, List.range'_succ, List.all_cons,
        Bool.and_eq_true] at hOk
      obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hOk
      by_cases hj : j.val = lo
      · have hlt : lo < 1365 := hj ▸ j.isLt
        have hhead' : (if h : lo < 1365 then
            (famRow ⟨lo, h⟩).all (fun w =>
              (rowMask (famRow (f ⟨lo, h⟩))).testBit (g w).val)
            else true) = true := hhead
        rw [dif_pos hlt] at hhead'
        have hjeq : (⟨lo, hlt⟩ : Fin 1365) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        rw [hjeq] at hhead'
        have hbit := List.all_eq_true.mp hhead' v hv
        have hmem := mem_of_testBit_rowMask _ _ hbit (g v).isLt
        rwa [Fin.eta] at hmem
      · have hlo' : lo + 1 ≤ j.val := by omega
        exact ih (lo + 1) htail j hlo' (by omega) v hv

name: Sporadic.G24Group.preservesNbrs_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have himg : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [himg, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.G24Group.preservesNbrs_inv
statement:
theorem preservesNbrs_inv {g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416)}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.G24Group.g24_preserves_nbrs
statement:
theorem g24_preserves_nbrs :
    ∀ g ∈ G24Subgroup, PreservesNbrs g
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun y _ => PreservesNbrs y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact g24a_preserves_nbrs
    · exact g24b_preserves_nbrs
    · exact g24c_preserves_nbrs
    · exact g24d_preserves_nbrs
    · exact g24e_preserves_nbrs
  · exact preservesNbrs_one
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    exact preservesNbrs_mul ha hb
  · intro a _ ha
    exact preservesNbrs_inv ha
