name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 416) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : G24T, g.1 415 = x ∧ g.1 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  set W := wordEl (G24Chain.levelZeroWord x) with hW
  have hW415 : W.1 (415 : Fin 416) = x := G24Chain.levelZeroWord_cert x
  have hWpres : PreservesNbrs W.1 :=
    G24Group.g24_preserves_nbrs W.1 W.2
  have hz : W.1⁻¹ y ∈ nbrs (415 : Fin 416) := by
    have h := (mem_nbrs_map_iff (v := (415 : Fin 416)) (w := W.1⁻¹ y)
      hWpres)
    rw [perm_apply_inv_self, hW415] at h
    exact h.mp hxy
  have hzpts : W.1⁻¹ y ∈ G24Chain.levelOneWordPts :=
    (mem_levelOneWordPts_iff _).mpr ((mem_nbrs_inf_iff _).mp hz)
  set S := wordEl (G24Chain.levelOneWord (W.1⁻¹ y)) with hS
  obtain ⟨hS415, hS0⟩ := G24Chain.levelOneWord_cert (W.1⁻¹ y) hzpts
  refine ⟨W * S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (W.1 * S.1) 415 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show S.1 (415 : Fin 416) = 415 from hS415, hW415]
  · change (W.1 * S.1) 0 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show S.1 (0 : Fin 416) = W.1⁻¹ y from hS0,
      perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 416)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hyx : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : G24T, g.1 415 = x ∧ g.1 100 = y
proof:
:= by
  set W := wordEl (G24Chain.levelZeroWord x) with hW
  have hW415 : W.1 (415 : Fin 416) = x := G24Chain.levelZeroWord_cert x
  have hWpres : PreservesNbrs W.1 :=
    G24Group.g24_preserves_nbrs W.1 W.2
  have hz : W.1⁻¹ y ∉ nbrs (415 : Fin 416) := by
    intro hmem
    have h := (mem_nbrs_map_iff (v := (415 : Fin 416)) (w := W.1⁻¹ y)
      hWpres)
    rw [perm_apply_inv_self, hW415] at h
    exact hxy (h.mpr hmem)
  have hz415 : W.1⁻¹ y ≠ 415 := by
    intro hcon
    apply hyx
    have := congrArg W.1 hcon
    rw [perm_apply_inv_self, hW415] at this
    exact this
  have hzpts : W.1⁻¹ y ∈ G24Chain.level1bWordPts := by
    rw [G24Chain.mem_level1bWordPts _]
    constructor
    · by_contra hlt
      push Not at hlt
      exact hz ((mem_nbrs_inf_iff _).mpr hlt)
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (W.1⁻¹ y).val 415 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        apply hz415
        apply Fin.ext
        have := (W.1⁻¹ y).isLt
        omega
  set S := wordEl (G24Chain.level1bWord (W.1⁻¹ y)) with hS
  obtain ⟨hS415, hS100⟩ := G24Chain.level1bWord_cert (W.1⁻¹ y) hzpts
  refine ⟨W * S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (W.1 * S.1) 415 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show S.1 (415 : Fin 416) = 415 from hS415, hW415]
  · change (W.1 * S.1) 100 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show S.1 (100 : Fin 416) = W.1⁻¹ y from hS100,
      perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 416) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : G24T, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgp415, hgp0⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨gu, hgu415, hgu0⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  refine ⟨gu * gp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (gu.1 * gp.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show gp.1⁻¹ p = 415 by rw [← hgp415, perm_inv_apply_self]]
    exact hgu415
  · change (gu.1 * gp.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show gp.1⁻¹ q = 0 by rw [← hgp0, perm_inv_apply_self]]
    exact hgu0

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 416) (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p)
    (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : G24T, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgp415, hgp100⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨gu, hgu415, hgu100⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  refine ⟨gu * gp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (gu.1 * gp.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show gp.1⁻¹ p = 415 by rw [← hgp415, perm_inv_apply_self]]
    exact hgu415
  · change (gu.1 * gp.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [show gp.1⁻¹ q = 100 by rw [← hgp100, perm_inv_apply_self]]
    exact hgu100

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup G24T) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 416, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : G24T} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 416} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 416) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  rw [show g.1⁻¹ u = p from hinv]
  exact hgq

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : G24T} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 416} (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p)
    (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 416) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  rw [show g.1⁻¹ u = p from hinv]
  exact hgq

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.normal_inf_witness
statement:
theorem normal_inf_witness (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : G24T} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 416} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 416) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 415 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx415 : x = 415
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx415]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 415
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 415 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw415, hwx⟩ := common_nbr_415 x hxadj hx415
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 415 w hw415
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 415 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 415
    · obtain ⟨w, hw415, hw415', hwx, hwxne⟩ := common_non_nbr_415 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 415 w hw415 hw415'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw (Ne.symm hwxne)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 415 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 415 x hxadj hx415

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : G24T} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 416} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (415 : Fin 416) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_inf_witness N hN hnN hp x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩,
      by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.card_normal_eq_416_mul_stab
statement:
theorem card_normal_eq_416_mul_stab (N : Subgroup G24T)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (415 : Fin 416) = Set.univ) :
    Nat.card N =
      416 * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (415 : Fin 416))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group N
      (415 : Fin 416)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, horbit, Set.ncard_univ]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
    (α := MulAction.stabilizer N (415 : Fin 416))]
  simp

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.card_stabInN_eq
statement:
theorem card_stabInN_eq (N : Subgroup G24T) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (415 : Fin 416)) =
      Nat.card (N.subgroupOf GStabSub)

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_inf
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_inf (N : Subgroup G24T)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf GStabSub = ⊥)
    {m : G24T} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 415 = 415) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ GStabSub := by
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : GStabSub) ∈ N.subgroupOf GStabSub :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.stab_nbr_witness
statement:
theorem stab_nbr_witness (p q : Fin 416)
    (hp : p ∈ nbrs 415) (hq : q ∈ nbrs 415) :
    ∃ s : G24T, s.1 415 = 415 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hppts : p ∈ G24Chain.levelOneWordPts :=
    (mem_levelOneWordPts_iff _).mpr ((mem_nbrs_inf_iff _).mp hp)
  have hqpts : q ∈ G24Chain.levelOneWordPts :=
    (mem_levelOneWordPts_iff _).mpr ((mem_nbrs_inf_iff _).mp hq)
  set Wp := wordEl (G24Chain.levelOneWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := wordEl (G24Chain.levelOneWord q) with hWq
  obtain ⟨hWp415, hWp0⟩ := G24Chain.levelOneWord_cert p hppts
  obtain ⟨hWq415, hWq0⟩ := G24Chain.levelOneWord_cert q hqpts
  have hWpInv415 : Wp.1⁻¹ (415 : Fin 416) = 415 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show (415 : Fin 416) = Wp.1 415 from hWp415.symm]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [show p = Wp.1 0 from hWp0.symm, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 415 = 415
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv415]
    exact hWq415
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp]
    exact hWq0

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.stab_far_witness
statement:
theorem stab_far_witness (p q : Fin 416)
    (hp : p ∉ nbrs 415) (hp415 : p ≠ 415)
    (hq : q ∉ nbrs 415) (hq415 : q ≠ 415) :
    ∃ s : G24T, s.1 415 = 415 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hbnd : ∀ r : Fin 416, r ∉ nbrs (415 : Fin 416) → r ≠ 415 →
      r ∈ G24Chain.level1bWordPts := by
    intro r hr hr415
    rw [G24Chain.mem_level1bWordPts _]
    constructor
    · by_contra hlt
      push Not at hlt
      exact hr ((mem_nbrs_inf_iff _).mpr hlt)
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge r.val 415 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        apply hr415
        apply Fin.ext
        have := r.isLt
        omega
  set Wp := wordEl (G24Chain.level1bWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := wordEl (G24Chain.level1bWord q) with hWq
  obtain ⟨hWp415, hWp100⟩ := G24Chain.level1bWord_cert p (hbnd p hp hp415)
  obtain ⟨hWq415, hWq100⟩ := G24Chain.level1bWord_cert q (hbnd q hq hq415)
  have hWpInv415 : Wp.1⁻¹ (415 : Fin 416) = 415 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show (415 : Fin 416) = Wp.1 415 from hWp415.symm]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 100 := by
    rw [show p = Wp.1 100 from hWp100.symm, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 415 = 415
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv415]
    exact hWq415
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp]
    exact hWq100

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement:
theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : G24T) :
    orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf GStabSub = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 416) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 13) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 416 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 13 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 13) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : Sylow 13 N, ∀ Q : Sylow 13 N, Q = P0 := by
    have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one 13 N
    have hmod' : Nat.card (Sylow 13 N) % 13 = 1 := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq at hmod
      omega
    have hdvd : Nat.card (Sylow 13 N) ∣ 416 := by
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow 13 N))
      refine (P.card_dvd_index).trans ?_
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ (by rw [P.1.card_mul_index, hcard])
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 13 N) ≤ 416 :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    have hforce : ∀ k < 417, k ∣ 416 → k % 13 = 1 → k = 1 := by decide
    have hn13 : Nat.card (Sylow 13 N) = 1 :=
      hforce _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle) hdvd hmod'
    rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists] at hn13
    exact hn13
  have hmemP0 : ∀ n : N, orderOf n = 13 → n ∈ P0.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hz : IsPGroup 13 (Subgroup.zpowers n) := by
      apply IsPGroup.of_card
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hn, pow_one]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hz.exists_le_sylow
    have hQP := hP0 Q
    subst hQP
    exact hQ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers n)
  have hcardP0 : Nat.card P0.1 ≤ 13 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp P0.2
    have hdvdP : Nat.card P0.1 ∣ 416 := by
      simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hF] using Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card P0.1
    rw [hn] at hdvdP
    have hn1 : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hgt
      push Not at hgt
      exact absurd ((pow_dvd_pow 13 hgt).trans hdvdP) (by decide)
    calc Nat.card P0.1 = 13 ^ n := hn
      _ ≤ 13 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn1
      _ = 13 := by norm_num
  have hKcard : K.card ≤ 13 := by
    have hsub : K ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hmemP0 n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2⟩
    have hfil : (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card =
        Nat.card P0.1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
    calc K.card
        ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = Nat.card P0.1 := hfil
      _ ≤ 13 := hcardP0
  
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 415 = m.1.1 415 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 415 = 415 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 415 = 415
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_inf N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 415 ≠ 415 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_inf N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 13 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hconj : ∀ (s : G24T), s.1 415 = 415 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 415 = s.1 (n.1.1 415) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 415 = s.1 (n.1.1 415)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [show (415 : Fin 416) = s.1 415 from hs.symm]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 415) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = K.card := by
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n _ m _ h
    exact hphi_inj n m h
  have hclose_nbr : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 415 →
      ∀ y ∈ nbrs 415, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs415, hsx⟩ := stab_nbr_witness x y hxn hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs415 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hclose_far : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 415 → x ≠ 415 →
      ∀ y, y ∉ nbrs 415 → y ≠ 415 → y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn hx415 y hy hy415
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs415, hsx⟩ := stab_far_witness x y hxn hx415 hy hy415
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs415 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hKimg415 : (415 : Fin 416) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 415 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  by_cases hA : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 415
  · by_cases hB : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 415 ∧ x ≠ 415
    · have : Kimg = Finset.univ.erase 415 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            ⟨fun h => hKimg415 (h ▸ hy), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro hy
          have hy415 : y ≠ 415 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
          by_cases hyn : y ∈ nbrs 415
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
            exact hclose_nbr x hx hxn y hyn
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn, hx415⟩ := hB
            exact hclose_far x hx hxn hx415 y hyn hy415
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 415 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
    · push Not at hB
      have : Kimg = nbrs 415 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          by_contra hyn
          have hy415 : y ≠ 415 := fun h => hKimg415 (h ▸ hy)
          exact hy415 (hB y hy hyn)
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
          exact hclose_nbr x hx hxn y hy
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 100 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
  · push Not at hA
    have hz0n : z0.1.1 415 ∉ nbrs 415 := hA _ hz0img
    have hz0415 : z0.1.1 415 ≠ 415 := hK_moves z0 hz0K
    have : Kimg = (Finset.univ.erase 415) \ nbrs 415 := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy415 : y ≠ 415 := fun h => hKimg415 (h ▸ hy)
        exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hy415, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hA y hy⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨hy', hyn⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
        have hy415 : y ≠ 415 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy').1
        exact hclose_far _ hz0img hz0n hz0415 y hyn hy415
    rw [this] at hcard_eq
    have : K.card = 315 := by
      rw [← hcard_eq]
      decide
    omega

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup G24T) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_416_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup GStabSub := G24Descent.isSimpleGroup_GStab
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf GStabSub).Normal := hN.subgroupOf GStabSub
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard416 : Nat.card N = 416 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard416
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf GStabSub) = 604800 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact G24Descent.card_GStab
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card G24T := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, G24Cardinality.card_G24]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.g24a_moves
statement: theorem g24a_moves : ∃ x : Fin 416, G24Perm.g24a x ≠ x

name: Sporadic.G24Simplicity.nontrivial_G24
statement: theorem nontrivial_G24 : Nontrivial G24T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := g24a_moves
  refine ⟨⟨⟨G24Perm.g24a, G24Group.g24a_mem⟩, 1, ?_⟩⟩
  intro h
  apply hx
  have := congrArg (fun g : G24T => g.1 x) h
  simpa using this

statement:

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.perm_inv_apply_self
statement:
private theorem perm_inv_apply_self {α : Type*} (f : Equiv.Perm α)
    (x : α) : f⁻¹ (f x) = x

proof:
:= by

  simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.maps_lt100
statement:
theorem maps_lt100 {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416)} (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    (h415 : π 415 = 415) {v : Fin 416} (hv : v.val < 100) :
    (π v).val < 100
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : v ∈ nbrs (415 : Fin 416) :=
    mem_nbrs_iff.mpr ((G24Bridge.nbrsRow_inf v).mpr hv)
  have himg : π v ∈ nbrs (415 : Fin 416) :=
    mem_nbrs_map π hpres h415 hmem
  exact (G24Bridge.nbrsRow_inf (π v)).mp (mem_nbrs_iff.mp himg)

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.inv_fixes
statement:
theorem inv_fixes {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416)} (h415 : π 415 = 415) :
    π⁻¹ (415 : Fin 416) = 415
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← h415]
  exact perm_inv_apply_self π 415

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.restrPerm_apply
statement:
theorem restrPerm_apply (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416))
    (hpres : PreservesNbrs π) (h415 : π 415 = 415) (v : Fin 100) :
    restrPerm π hpres h415 v =
      ⟨(π ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1, maps_lt100 hpres h415 (by exact v.2)⟩

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.restrHom_injective
statement: theorem restrHom_injective : Function.Injective restrHom
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hker : restrHom (g * h⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hgh, mul_inv_cancel]
  set d := g * h⁻¹ with hd
  have hbelow : ∀ v : Fin 416, v.val < 100 → d.1.1 v = v := by
    intro v hv
    have happ := congrArg (fun σ => σ ⟨v.1, hv⟩) hker
    have hval : (d.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 = v.1 := by
      simpa [restrHom, restrPerm] using congrArg Fin.val happ
    apply Fin.ext
    calc (d.1.1 v).1 = (d.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 := by rw [Fin.eta]
      _ = v.1 := hval
  have hone : d.1.1 = 1 :=
    G24Bridge.fixed_segment_unique d.1.1 (gstab_pres d) (gstab_fixes d)
      hbelow
  have hd1 : d = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hone
  have := congrArg (fun x => x * h) hd1
  simpa [hd, mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.restr_gen_eq
statement:
theorem restr_gen_eq (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416))
    (hpres : PreservesNbrs π) (h415 : π 415 = 415)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 100))
    (hcert : ∀ v : Fin 100, (π ⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 416).val =
      (τ v).val) :
    restrPerm π hpres h415 = τ
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro v
  apply Fin.ext
  show (π ⟨v.1, _⟩).1 = (τ v).1
  exact hcert v

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.j2a_mem_R
statement: theorem j2a_mem_R : Sporadic.j2a ∈ RImage
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mkStab G24Perm.g24a G24Group.g24a_mem (by decide), ?_⟩
  show restrPerm _ (gstab_pres _) (gstab_fixes _) = Sporadic.j2a
  exact restr_gen_eq _ _ _ _ G24Bridge.g24a_restr

:= by
  refine ⟨mkStab G24Perm.g24b G24Group.g24b_mem (by decide), ?_⟩
  show restrPerm _ (gstab_pres _) (gstab_fixes _) = Sporadic.j2b

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.j2c_mem_R

proof:

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.R_le_AutHJ
statement: theorem R_le_AutHJ : RImage ≤ AutHJ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ρ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_AutHJ]
  intro v
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    rw [mem_hjNbrs, hjRow_iff416] at hw ⊢
    have he1 : (⟨(restrHom g w).1, by omega⟩ : Fin 416) =
        g.1.1 ⟨w.1, by omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have he2 : (⟨(restrHom g v).1, by omega⟩ : Fin 416) =
        g.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [he1, he2]
    exact (mem_nbrs_map_iff (gstab_pres g)).mpr hw
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (restrHom g).injective,
      hjNbrs_card, hjNbrs_card]

theorem card_R_cases :
    Nat.card RImage = 604800 ∨ Nat.card RImage = 1209600
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := card_R_dvd
  have hge := card_R_ge
  have hle := card_R_le
  rw [hk] at hge hle ⊢
  have hk12 : k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
  rcases hk12 with rfl | rfl
  · left; norm_num
  · right; norm_num

name: Sporadic.G24Descent.card_R_ne_double
statement: theorem card_R_ne_double : Nat.card RImage ≠ 1209600
proof:
:= by
  intro hcase
  have hEq : RImage = AutHJ := by
    apply Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge R_le_AutHJ
    rw [hcase]
    exact card_AutHJ_le
  have homega : omegaPerm ∈ RImage := by
    rw [hEq, mem_AutHJ]
    exact omega_preservesHJ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := homega
  
  have hpi_pres := gstab_pres g
  have hghat_pres := G24HJ.ghatT_preserves
  have hbelow : ∀ v : Fin 416, v.val < 100 →
      (g.1.1⁻¹ * G24Fam.ghatT) v = v := by
    intro v hv
    have hval : (g.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 = (omegaPerm ⟨v.1, hv⟩).1 := by
      have := congrArg Fin.val (congrArg (fun σ => σ ⟨v.1, hv⟩) hg)
      simpa [restrHom, restrPerm] using this
    have hghat : (G24Fam.ghatT ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 =
        (omegaPerm ⟨v.1, hv⟩).1 := G24HJ.ghatT_restr ⟨v.1, hv⟩
    have hagree : G24Fam.ghatT v = g.1.1 v := by
      apply Fin.ext
      calc (G24Fam.ghatT v).1 = (G24Fam.ghatT ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 := by
            rw [Fin.eta]
        _ = (omegaPerm ⟨v.1, hv⟩).1 := hghat
        _ = (g.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 := hval.symm
        _ = (g.1.1 v).1 := by rw [Fin.eta]
    show g.1.1⁻¹ (G24Fam.ghatT v) = v
    rw [hagree, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hδ_pres : PreservesNbrs (g.1.1⁻¹ * G24Fam.ghatT) :=
    G24Group.preservesNbrs_mul
      (G24Group.preservesNbrs_inv hpi_pres) hghat_pres
  have hδ415 : (g.1.1⁻¹ * G24Fam.ghatT) (415 : Fin 416) = 415 := by
    show g.1.1⁻¹ (G24Fam.ghatT 415) = 415
    rw [G24HJ.ghatT_fixes_inf]
    exact inv_fixes (gstab_fixes g)
  have hone := G24Bridge.fixed_segment_unique _ hδ_pres hδ415 hbelow
  have hghat_eq : G24Fam.ghatT = g.1.1 := by
    rw [inv_mul_eq_one] at hone
    exact hone.symm
  exact G24Fam.ghatT_not_mem (hghat_eq ▸ gstab_mem g)

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.gen_mem
statement: theorem gen_mem (g : Gen) : g.toPerm ∈ G24Group.G24Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  cases g with
  | a => exact G24Group.g24a_mem
  | aInv => exact inv_mem G24Group.g24a_mem
  | b => exact G24Group.g24b_mem
  | bInv => exact inv_mem G24Group.g24b_mem
  | c => exact G24Group.g24c_mem
  | cInv => exact inv_mem G24Group.g24c_mem
  | d => exact G24Group.g24d_mem
  | dInv => exact inv_mem G24Group.g24d_mem
  | e => exact G24Group.g24e_mem
  | eInv => exact inv_mem G24Group.g24e_mem

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.eval_mem
statement: theorem eval_mem (w : Word) : Word.eval w ∈ G24Group.G24Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact one_mem _
  | cons g rest ih =>
      rw [Word.eval_cons]
      exact mul_mem ih (gen_mem g)

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.first_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem first_orbit_witness (x : Fin 416) :
    ∃ g : G24T, g.1 (415 : Fin 416) = x

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.orbit_inf_eq_univ
statement:
theorem orbit_inf_eq_univ :
    MulAction.orbit G24T (415 : Fin 416) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.orbit_inf_ncard

    (MulAction.orbit G24T (415 : Fin 416)).ncard = 416

name: Sporadic.G24Cardinality.card_G24_eq_first
statement:
theorem card_G24_eq_first :
    Nat.card G24T = 416 * Nat.card GStab
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group G24T
      (415 : Fin 416)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, orbit_inf_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := GStab)]

theorem mem_AutG416 {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 416)} :
    π ∈ AutG416 ↔ PreservesNbrs π

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.autstab_pres
statement: theorem autstab_pres (g : AutStab) : PreservesNbrs g.1.1

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.autstab_fixes
statement: theorem autstab_fixes (g : AutStab) : g.1.1 (415 : Fin 416) = 415
proof:
:= by
  have hfix := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
  simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.card_AutG416_eq
statement:
theorem card_AutG416_eq :
    Nat.card AutG416T =
      (MulAction.orbit AutG416T (415 : Fin 416)).ncard *
        Nat.card AutStab
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group AutG416T
      (415 : Fin 416)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := AutStab)]

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.orbit_ncard_le
statement:
theorem orbit_ncard_le :
    (MulAction.orbit AutG416T (415 : Fin 416)).ncard ≤ 416
proof:
:= by
  have h := Set.ncard_le_ncard
    (Set.subset_univ (MulAction.orbit AutG416T (415 : Fin 416)))
    Set.finite_univ
  simpa [Set.ncard_univ] using h

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.autRestrHom_injective
statement: theorem autRestrHom_injective : Function.Injective autRestrHom
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hker : autRestrHom (g * h⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hgh, mul_inv_cancel]
  set d := g * h⁻¹ with hd
  have hbelow : ∀ v : Fin 416, v.val < 100 → d.1.1 v = v := by
    intro v hv
    have happ := congrArg (fun σ => σ ⟨v.1, hv⟩) hker
    have hval : (d.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 = v.1 := by
      simpa [autRestrHom, restrPerm] using congrArg Fin.val happ
    apply Fin.ext
    calc (d.1.1 v).1 = (d.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩).1 := by rw [Fin.eta]
      _ = v.1 := hval
  have hone : d.1.1 = 1 :=
    G24Bridge.fixed_segment_unique d.1.1 (autstab_pres d)
      (autstab_fixes d) hbelow
  have hd1 : d = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hone
  have := congrArg (fun x => x * h) hd1
  simpa [hd, mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.G24Aut.autRestr_mem_AutHJ
statement:
theorem autRestr_mem_AutHJ (g : AutStab) :
    autRestrHom g ∈ AutHJ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_AutHJ]
  intro v

        g.1.1 ⟨v.1, by omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [he1, he2]
    exact (mem_nbrs_map_iff (autstab_pres g)).mpr hw

name: Sporadic.G24HJ.card_stab3_le
statement: theorem card_stab3_le : Nat.card HJStab3 ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype HJStab3 := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have himg : Finset.univ.image (fun g : HJStab3 => g.1.1.1.1) ⊆
      tail8List.toFinset := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (stab3_toPerm_mem g)
  calc Fintype.card HJStab3
      = Finset.univ.card := Finset.card_univ.symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.image (fun g : HJStab3 => g.1.1.1.1)).card :=
        (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ stab3_toPerm_injective).symm
    _ ≤ tail8List.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card himg
    _ ≤ tail8List.length := tail8List.toFinset_card_le
    _ ≤ 8 := le_of_eq tail8_length

name: Sporadic.G24HJ.card_AutHJ_le
statement: theorem card_AutHJ_le : Nat.card AutHJT ≤ 1209600
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := card_AutHJ_eq
  have h1 := card_stab1_eq
  have h2 := card_stab2_eq
  calc Nat.card AutHJT
      = (MulAction.orbit AutHJT (99 : Fin 100)).ncard *
        ((MulAction.orbit HJStab1 (0 : Fin 100)).ncard *
          ((MulAction.orbit HJStab2 (38 : Fin 100)).ncard *
            Nat.card HJStab3)) := by rw [h0, h1, h2]
    _ ≤ 100 * (36 * (42 * 8)) := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul orbit1_ncard_le
          (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit2_ncard_le
            (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit3_ncard_le card_stab3_le))
    _ = 1209600 := by norm_num

    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h1 (by decide))
  have hv12 : ρ 12 = 4 :=
  stepT3_1 _ (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h99 (by decide)) (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h38 (by decide))
    (hj_mem_map ρ hpres h0 (by decide)) (hj_not_mem_map ρ hpres hv3 (by decide))

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 22) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : M22, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toM22 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 22) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 22) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set B := Word.toM22 (zeroStabilizerWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabilizerWord_fixes_zero_all z hz0
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 22) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabilizerWord_maps_one_all z hz0
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 22) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : M22, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.stab_pair_witness
statement:
theorem stab_pair_witness (p q : Fin 22) (hp : p ≠ 21) (hq : q ≠ 21) :
    ∃ s : M22, s.1 21 = 21 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toM22 (lastStabWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toM22 (lastStabWord q) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 22) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using lastStabWord_maps_all p hp
  have hWp21 : Wp.1 (21 : Fin 22) = 21 := by
    simpa [hWp] using lastStabWord_fixes_all p hp
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 22) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using lastStabWord_maps_all q hq
  have hWq21 : Wq.1 (21 : Fin 22) = 21 := by
    simpa [hWq] using lastStabWord_fixes_all q hq
  have hWpInv21 : Wp.1⁻¹ (21 : Fin 22) = 21 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp21]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 21 = 21
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv21, hWq21]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup M22) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 22, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup M22) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M22} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 22} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 22) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.normal_orbit_last_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_last_eq_univ (N : Subgroup M22) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : M22} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 22} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (21 : Fin 22) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp 21 x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.card_normal_eq_22_mul_stab
statement:
theorem card_normal_eq_22_mul_stab (N : Subgroup M22)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (21 : Fin 22) = Set.univ) :
    Nat.card N = 22 * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (21 : Fin 22))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group N (21 : Fin 22)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, horbit, Set.ncard_univ]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := MulAction.stabilizer N (21 : Fin 22))]
  simp

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_last
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_last (N : Subgroup M22)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : M22} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 21 = 21) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.conj_witness
statement:
theorem conj_witness (N : Subgroup M22) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {n1 n2 : M22} (h1N : n1 ∈ N) (h2N : n2 ∈ N) (h1 : n1 ≠ 1) (h2 : n2 ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : M22, s * n1 * s⁻¹ = n2
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : n1.1 (21 : Fin 22) ≠ 21 := fun h =>
    h1 (eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb h1N h)
  have hp2 : n2.1 (21 : Fin 22) ≠ 21 := fun h =>
    h2 (eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb h2N h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs21, hsp⟩ := stab_pair_witness (n1.1 21) (n2.1 21) hp1 hp2
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  have hsinv : s.1⁻¹ (21 : Fin 22) = 21 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hs21]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hm21 : (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1 (21 : Fin 22) = n2.1 21 := by
    change (s.1 * n1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 21 = n2.1 21
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hsinv, hsp]
  have hfix : (n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹)).1 (21 : Fin 22) = 21 := by
    change (n2.1⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹).1) 21 = 21
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm21, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hmem : n2⁻¹ * (s * n1 * s⁻¹) ∈ N :=
    N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem h2N) (hN.conj_mem n1 h1N s)
  have hone := eq_one_of_fixes_last N hb hmem hfix
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hone).symm

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup M22) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 22) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 11) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 22 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 2 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨x11, hx11⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 11 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  have h2 : orderOf (x2.1 : M22) = 2 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x2
    rw [hx2] at h
    exact h
  have h11 : orderOf (x11.1 : M22) = 11 := by
    have h := orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective x11
    rw [hx11] at h
    exact h
  have hx2ne : (x2.1 : M22) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  have hx11ne : (x11.1 : M22) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at h11
    norm_num at h11
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := conj_witness N hN hb x2.2 x11.2 hx2ne hx11ne
  have := orderOf_conj_eq s x2.1
  rw [hs, h2, h11] at this
  norm_num at this

name: Sporadic.M22Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup M22) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_last_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_22_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    apply regular_case_absurd N hN hb
    rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 20160 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card M22 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, M22Cardinality.card_M22]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

theorem fixes_last_of_mem_embeddedL34 {g : Perm22} (hg : g ∈ EmbeddedL34) :
    g 21 = 21
proof:
:= by
  rw [embeddedL34_eq_closure] at hg
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => x (21 : Fin 22) = 21)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact m22l1_fixes_last
      · exact m22l2_fixes_last
      · exact m22l3_fixes_last)
    (by simp)
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => by
      change (x * y) (21 : Fin 22) = 21
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hy, hx])
    (fun x _ hx => by
      change x⁻¹ (21 : Fin 22) = 21
      exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr hx.symm)
    hg

statement:
theorem holdsOnV_blocks {P : Fin 275 → Prop}
    (h0 : HoldsOnV 0 25 P)
    (h1 : HoldsOnV 25 50 P)
    (h2 : HoldsOnV 50 75 P)
    (h3 : HoldsOnV 75 100 P)
    (h4 : HoldsOnV 100 125 P)
    (h5 : HoldsOnV 125 150 P)
    (h6 : HoldsOnV 150 175 P)
    (h7 : HoldsOnV 175 200 P)

    (h10 : HoldsOnV 250 275 P) :
    ∀ x : Fin 275, P x
proof:
:= by
  have h0_1 : HoldsOnV 0 50 P := holdsOnV_union h0 h1
  have h0_2 : HoldsOnV 0 75 P := holdsOnV_union h0_1 h2
  have h0_3 : HoldsOnV 0 100 P := holdsOnV_union h0_2 h3
  have h0_4 : HoldsOnV 0 125 P := holdsOnV_union h0_3 h4

  have h0_8 : HoldsOnV 0 225 P := holdsOnV_union h0_7 h8
  have h0_9 : HoldsOnV 0 250 P := holdsOnV_union h0_8 h9
  have h0_10 : HoldsOnV 0 275 P := holdsOnV_union h0_9 h10
  intro x
  exact h0_10 x (Nat.zero_le _) x.isLt

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.mcla_ne_one
statement: theorem mcla_ne_one : mcla ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : mcla (1 : Fin 275) = 1 := by
    rw [h]
    rfl
  exact absurd h0 (by decide)

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.chi_injective
statement: theorem chi_injective : Function.Injective chi
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff]
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup U43Subgroup := simple_U43
  rcases Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (MonoidHom.normal_ker chi) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have hmem : (⟨u43e1, u43e1_mem⟩ : U43Subgroup) ∈ chi.ker := by
      rw [h]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top _
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, chi_u43e1] at hmem
    exact mcla_ne_one hmem

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.chiExt_eq
statement:
theorem chiExt_eq (x : Perm112) (hx : x ∈ U43Subgroup) :
    chiExt x = chi ⟨x, hx⟩

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.chi_mem_closure
statement:
theorem chi_mem_closure (g : U43Subgroup) :
    chi g ∈ Subgroup.closure ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, x ∈ U43Subgroup →
      chiExt x ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => chiExt y ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [chiExt_eq u43e1 u43e1_mem, chi_u43e1]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · rw [chiExt_eq u43e2 u43e2_mem, chi_u43e2]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      · rw [chiExt_eq u43e3 u43e3_mem, chi_u43e3]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
      · rw [chiExt_eq u43e4 u43e4_mem, chi_u43e4]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)))
    · show chiExt 1 ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275)
      have h1 : chiExt 1 = chi 1 := chiExt_eq 1 (Subgroup.one_mem _)
      rw [h1, map_one]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro a b ha hb hpa hpb
      show chiExt (a * b) ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275) := hpa
      have hpb' : chiExt b ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275) := hpb
      have hab : chiExt (a * b) = chi (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩ : U43Subgroup) :=
        chiExt_eq (a * b) (Subgroup.mul_mem _ ha hb)
      rw [hab, map_mul]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      rw [chiExt_eq b hb] at hpb'
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hpa' hpb'
    · intro a ha hpa
      show chiExt a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure
        ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275) := hpa
      have hai : chiExt a⁻¹ = chi ((⟨a, ha⟩ : U43Subgroup)⁻¹) :=
        chiExt_eq a⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ ha)
      rw [hai, map_inv]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hpa'
  have hg : chi g = chiExt g.1 := (chiExt_eq g.1 g.2).symm
  rw [hg]
  exact key g.1 g.2

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.embeddedU43_eq_closure
statement:
theorem embeddedU43_eq_closure :
    EmbeddedU43 = Subgroup.closure
      ({mcla, mclb, mclc, mcld} : Set Perm275)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro g hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact chi_mem_closure p
  · rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨u43e1, u43e1_mem⟩, chi_u43e1⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u43e2, u43e2_mem⟩, chi_u43e2⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u43e3, u43e3_mem⟩, chi_u43e3⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u43e4, u43e4_mem⟩, chi_u43e4⟩

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.card_embeddedU43
statement:
theorem card_embeddedU43 :

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.embeddedU43_le_McLSubgroup
statement: theorem embeddedU43_le_McLSubgroup : EmbeddedU43 ≤ McLSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [embeddedU43_eq_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro g hg
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
  rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact mcla_mem
  · exact mclb_mem
  · exact mclc_mem
  · exact mcld_mem

name: Sporadic.McLFamilyHom.fixes_star_of_mem_embeddedU43
statement:
theorem fixes_star_of_mem_embeddedU43 {g : Perm275}
    (hg : g ∈ EmbeddedU43) : g 274 = 274
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact Equiv.Perm.extendDomain_apply_not_subtype _ vertexEquiv (by decide)

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.perm_apply_inv_self
statement: theorem perm_apply_inv_self (f : Perm275) (x : Fin 275) : f (f⁻¹ x) = x

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.perm_inv_apply_self
statement: theorem perm_inv_apply_self (f : Perm275) (x : Fin 275) : f⁻¹ (f x) = x

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 275) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : McL, g.1 274 = x ∧ g.1 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toMcL (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA274 : A.1 (274 : Fin 275) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 274 := by
    rw [← hA274, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 274 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (McL_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toMcL (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_star_all z hz
  have hBzero : B.1 (0 : Fin 275) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 274 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA274]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBzero, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 275) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : McL, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 274 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 0 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 275)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : McL, g.1 274 = x ∧ g.1 112 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toMcL (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA274 : A.1 (274 : Fin 275) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 274 := by
    rw [← hA274, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 274 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (McL_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz274 : z ≠ 274 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (274 : Fin 275) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA274]
  set C := Word.toMcL (hemiWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hC] using hemiWord_fixes_star_all z hz hz274
  have hC112 : C.1 (112 : Fin 275) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using hemiWord_maps_all z hz hz274
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 274 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA274]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 112 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC112, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 275)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : McL, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 274 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 112 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup McL) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 275, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : McL} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 275} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 275) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : McL} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 275} (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p)
    (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 275) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.normal_star_witness
statement:
theorem normal_star_witness (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : McL} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 275} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (x : Fin 275) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 274 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx274 : x = 274
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx274]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 274
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 274 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw274, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 274 x (fun h => hx274 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 274 w hw274
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 274 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 274
    · obtain ⟨w, hw274, hwx, hw274', hwx'⟩ :=
        common_non_nbr_exists 274 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 274 w hw274 hw274'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 274 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 274 x hxadj hx274

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.normal_orbit_star_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_star_eq_univ (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : McL} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 275} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (274 : Fin 275) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_star_witness N hN hnN hp x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩,
      by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.card_normal_eq_275_mul_stab
statement:
theorem card_normal_eq_275_mul_stab (N : Subgroup McL)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (274 : Fin 275) = Set.univ) :
    Nat.card N =
      275 * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (274 : Fin 275))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group N
      (274 : Fin 275)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, horbit, Set.ncard_univ]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
    (α := MulAction.stabilizer N (274 : Fin 275))]
  simp

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.card_stabInN_eq
statement:
theorem card_stabInN_eq (N : Subgroup McL) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (274 : Fin 275)) =
      Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast)

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_star
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_star (N : Subgroup McL)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : McL} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 274 = 274) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.stab_line_witness
statement:
theorem stab_line_witness (p q : Fin 275)
    (hp : p ∈ nbrs 274) (hq : q ∈ nbrs 274) :
    ∃ s : McL, s.1 274 = 274 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toMcL (levelTwoWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toMcL (levelTwoWord q) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 275) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all p hp
  have hWp274 : Wp.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_fixes_star_all p hp
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 275) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all q hq
  have hWq274 : Wq.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_fixes_star_all q hq
  have hWpInv274 : Wp.1⁻¹ (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp274]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 274 = 274
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv274, hWq274]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.stab_hemi_witness
statement:
theorem stab_hemi_witness (p q : Fin 275)
    (hp : p ∉ nbrs 274) (hp274 : p ≠ 274)
    (hq : q ∉ nbrs 274) (hq274 : q ≠ 274) :
    ∃ s : McL, s.1 274 = 274 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toMcL (hemiWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toMcL (hemiWord q) with hWq
  have hWp112 : Wp.1 (112 : Fin 275) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using hemiWord_maps_all p hp hp274
  have hWp274 : Wp.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hWp] using hemiWord_fixes_star_all p hp hp274
  have hWq112 : Wq.1 (112 : Fin 275) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using hemiWord_maps_all q hq hq274
  have hWq274 : Wq.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    simpa [hWq] using hemiWord_fixes_star_all q hq hq274
  have hWpInv274 : Wp.1⁻¹ (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp274]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 112 := by
    rw [← hWp112, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 274 = 274
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv274, hWq274]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq112]

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : McL) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 275) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 11) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 275 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 11 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 11) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : Sylow 11 N, ∀ Q : Sylow 11 N, Q = P0 := by
    have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one 11 N
    have hmod' : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) % 11 = 1 := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq at hmod
      omega
    have hdvd : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) ∣ 275 := by
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow 11 N))
      refine (P.card_dvd_index).trans ?_
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ (by rw [P.1.card_mul_index, hcard])
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) ≤ 275 :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    have hforce : ∀ k < 276, k ∣ 275 → k % 11 = 1 → k = 1 := by decide
    have hn11 : Nat.card (Sylow 11 N) = 1 :=
      hforce _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle) hdvd hmod'
    rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists] at hn11
    exact hn11
  have hmemP0 : ∀ n : N, orderOf n = 11 → n ∈ P0.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hz : IsPGroup 11 (Subgroup.zpowers n) := by
      apply IsPGroup.of_card
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hn, pow_one]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hz.exists_le_sylow
    rw [hP0 Q] at hQ
    exact hQ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers n)
  have hcardP0 : Nat.card P0.1 ≤ 11 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp P0.2
    have hdvdP : Nat.card P0.1 ∣ 275 := by
      rw [← hcard]
      exact Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card P0.1
    rw [hn] at hdvdP ⊢
    have hn1 : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hgt
      push Not at hgt
      exact absurd ((pow_dvd_pow 11 hgt).trans hdvdP) (by decide)
    calc 11 ^ n ≤ 11 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn1
      _ = 11 := by norm_num
  have hKcard : K.card ≤ 11 := by
    have hsub : K ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hmemP0 n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2⟩
    have hfil : (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card =
        Nat.card P0.1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
    calc K.card
        ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = Nat.card P0.1 := hfil
      _ ≤ 11 := hcardP0
  
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 274 = m.1.1 274 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 274 = 274 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 274 = 274
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 274 ≠ 274 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 11 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hconj : ∀ (s : McL), s.1 274 = 274 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 274 = s.1 (n.1.1 274) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 274 = s.1 (n.1.1 274)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 274) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = K.card := by
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n _ m _ h
    exact hphi_inj n m h
  have hclose_line : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 274 →
      ∀ y ∈ nbrs 274, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs274, hsx⟩ := stab_line_witness x y hxn hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs274 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hclose_hemi : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 274 → x ≠ 274 →
      ∀ y, y ∉ nbrs 274 → y ≠ 274 → y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn hx274 y hy hy274
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs274, hsx⟩ := stab_hemi_witness x y hxn hx274 hy hy274
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs274 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hKimg274 : (274 : Fin 275) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 274 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  by_cases hA : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 274
  · by_cases hB : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 274 ∧ x ≠ 274
    · have : Kimg = Finset.univ.erase 274 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            ⟨fun h => hKimg274 (h ▸ hy), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro hy
          have hy274 : y ≠ 274 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
          by_cases hyn : y ∈ nbrs 274
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
            exact hclose_line x hx hxn y hyn
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn, hx274⟩ := hB
            exact hclose_hemi x hx hxn hx274 y hyn hy274
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 274 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
    · push Not at hB
      have : Kimg = nbrs 274 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          by_contra hyn
          have hy274 : y ≠ 274 := fun h => hKimg274 (h ▸ hy)
          exact hy274 (hB y hy hyn)
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
          exact hclose_line x hx hxn y hy
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 112 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
  · push Not at hA
    have hz0n : z0.1.1 274 ∉ nbrs 274 := hA _ hz0img
    have hz0274 : z0.1.1 274 ≠ 274 := hK_moves z0 hz0K
    have : Kimg = (Finset.univ.erase 274) \ nbrs 274 := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy274 : y ≠ 274 := fun h => hKimg274 (h ▸ hy)
        exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hy274, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hA y hy⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨hy', hyn⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
        have hy274 : y ≠ 274 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy').1
        exact hclose_hemi _ hz0img hz0n hz0274 y hyn hy274
    rw [this] at hcard_eq
    have : K.card = 162 := by
      rw [← hcard_eq]
      decide
    omega

name: Sporadic.McLSimplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup McL) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_star_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_275_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard275 : Nat.card N = 275 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard275
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 3265920 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card McL := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, McLCardinality.card_McL]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

name: Sporadic.Fi22.isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
statement:
theorem isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [Finite X] [IsPretransitive G X]
    {a : X} {Δ Γ : Set X}
    (hcover : insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) = Set.univ)
    (haΔ : a ∉ Δ) (haΓ : a ∉ Γ)
    (hΔ : ∀ x ∈ Δ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Δ)
    (hΓ : ∀ x ∈ Γ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Γ)
    (hΔdvd : ¬ (Δ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X))
    (hΓdvd : ¬ (Γ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X)) :
    IsPreprimitive G X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPreprimitive.of_isTrivialBlock_base a
  intro B haB hB
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ B, orbit (stabilizer G a) x ⊆ B := by
    rintro x hx y ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hs : (s : G) • B = B := hB.stabilizer_le haB s.2
    have : (s : G) • x ∈ (s : G) • B := Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx
    rw [hs] at this
    exact this
  have key : ∀ S : Set X, (∀ x ∈ S, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S) →
      (S ∩ B).Nonempty → S ⊆ B := by
    rintro S hS ⟨x, hxS, hxB⟩
    rw [← hS x hxS]
    exact hsub x hxB
  have hmem : ∀ x, x = a ∨ x ∈ Δ ∨ x ∈ Γ := by
    intro x
    have : x ∈ insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simpa [or_assoc] using this
  by_cases hd : (Δ ∩ B).Nonempty <;> by_cases hg : (Γ ∩ B).Nonempty
  · right
    refine Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset ?_
    rw [← hcover]
    exact Set.insert_subset haB (Set.union_subset (key Δ hΔ hd) (key Γ hΓ hg))
  · exfalso
    have hBΓ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Γ := fun x hx hxΓ => hg ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Δ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΔ
        · exact absurd hxΓ (hBΓ x hx)
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Δ hΔ hd)
    apply hΔdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΔ] at this
  · exfalso
    have hBΔ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Δ := fun x hx hxΔ => hd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Γ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact absurd hxΔ (hBΔ x hx)
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΓ
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Γ hΓ hg)
    apply hΓdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΓ] at this
  · left
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
    · rcases hmem y with rfl | hyΔ | hyΓ
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΔ, hy⟩ hd
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΓ, hy⟩ hg
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩ hd
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩ hg

name: Sporadic.Fi22.isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [FaithfulSMul G X]
    [IsPreprimitive G X] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    IsPretransitive N X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsQuasiPreprimitive.isPretransitive_of_normal (N := N)
  intro hfix
  apply hN
  rw [Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall]
  intro n hn
  apply eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := X)
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ fixedPoints N X := by rw [hfix]; trivial
  simpa using hx ⟨n, hn⟩

name: Sporadic.Fi22.factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h1 : p ∣ n) (h2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ n) : n.factorization p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; simpa using h1
  have hb : ¬ 2 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; exact h2
  omega

name: Sporadic.Fi22.mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
statement:
theorem mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (N : Subgroup G) [hN : N.Normal]
    (hpN : p ∣ Nat.card N) (hp2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ Nat.card G)
    {g : G} (hg : orderOf g = p) : g ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hG0 : Nat.card G ≠ 0 := Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hpG : p ∣ Nat.card G := hpN.trans N.card_subgroup_dvd_card
  have hfac : (Nat.card G).factorization p = 1 :=
    factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd hp.out hG0 hpG hp2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := N) p hpN
  have hyG : orderOf (y : G) = p := (Subgroup.orderOf_coe y).trans hy
  have hcardQ : Nat.card (zpowers (y : G)) = p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hyG, hfac, pow_one]
  have hcardP : Nat.card (zpowers g) = p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hg, hfac, pow_one]
  set Q : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers (y : G)) hcardQ with hQ
  set P : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers g) hcardP with hP
  have hQN : (Q : Subgroup G) ≤ N := by
    rw [hQ, Sylow.coe_ofCard, zpowers_le]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G Q P
  have hgP : g ∈ (P : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [hP, Sylow.coe_ofCard]; exact mem_zpowers g
  rw [← hc] at hgP
  have hgQ : (MulAut.conj c)⁻¹ • g ∈ (Q : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [← Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    exact hgP
  have hmem : c⁻¹ * g * c ∈ N := by
    refine hQN ?_
    simpa [MulAut.conj, mul_assoc] using hgQ
  have := hN.conj_mem _ hmem c
  simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.Fi22.closure_gens
statement: theorem closure_gens : Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : Perm3510) (hx : x ∈ K0),
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y hy => (⟨y, hy⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gA])
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gB])
    · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ ihy ihz
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ ihy ihz
    · intro y _ ihy
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ ihy
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  exact key x hx

name: Sporadic.Fi22.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup K0T) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  refine Or.inr ?_
  haveI := hN
  haveI : IsPretransitive N (Fin 3510) :=
    isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have h3510 : (3510 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := by
    have := card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive (N := N) (X := Fin 3510) 0
    rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at this
  have h13 : (13 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := dvd_trans (by decide) h3510
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← closure_gens, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 13) N h13 sq13_not_dvd orderOf_gA
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 13) N h13 sq13_not_dvd orderOf_gB

name: Sporadic.Fi22.alpha0_mem
statement: theorem alpha0_mem : ∀ g ∈ alpha0, g ∈ Fi22Subgroup

name: Sporadic.Fi22.tMaps0_all
statement: theorem tMaps0_all : ∀ u : Fin 3510, tMaps0Row u = true
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 439 with h1 | h1
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 0 tMaps0Ok0 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 878 with h2 | h2
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 439 tMaps0Ok1 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1317 with h3 | h3

  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1756 with h4 | h4

  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 2195 with h5 | h5
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 1756 tMaps0Ok4 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 2634 with h6 | h6
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 2195 tMaps0Ok5 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 3073 with h7 | h7
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 2634 tMaps0Ok6 u (by omega) (by omega)

name: Sporadic.Fi22.T0_maps
statement: theorem T0_maps : ∀ z ∈ orbit0Set, T0 z (0 : Fin 3510) = z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have h := tMaps0_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2

name: Sporadic.Fi22.orbit2_closed
statement:
theorem orbit2_closed :
    ∀ s ∈ sList2, ∀ z ∈ orbit2Set, s z ∈ orbit2Set
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit2.mp hz
  rw [mem_orbit2]
  simp only [sList2, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl
  · have h := clos2_0_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_1_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2

name: Sporadic.Fi22.T3_eq_word
statement: theorem T3_eq_word (z : Fin 3510) : T3 z = Tword3 z
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 3510) (i : ℕ) => (sList3.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp3 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp3_eq i y
  rw [T3_apply, Tword3, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.Fi22.T5_eq_word

proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 3510) (i : ℕ) => (sList5.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp5 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp5_eq i y
  rw [T5_apply, Tword5, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

theorem orbit5_closed :
    ∀ s ∈ sList5, ∀ z ∈ orbit5Set, s z ∈ orbit5Set
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit5.mp hz
  rw [mem_orbit5]
  simp only [sList5, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h := clos5_0_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_1_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_2_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_3_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_4_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_5_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_6_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos5_7_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2

name: Sporadic.Fi22.T6_eq_word

proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 3510) (i : ℕ) => (sList6.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp6 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp6_eq i y
  rw [T6_apply, Tword6, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

Sporadic.Fi22.siftPt0_0
statement:
private theorem siftPt0_0 :
    ∀ z : Fin 3510, inOrb0 z = true → ∀ x : Fin 3510,
      fi22aApp (tApp0 z x) =
        tApp0 (fi22aApp z) (siftProdApp (siftFac0_0 z) x)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz x
  have h := sift0_0_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
  · rw [hz] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact eq_of_beq (List.all_eq_true.mp h2 x (List.mem_finRange x))

name: Sporadic.Fi22.sift_sound0_0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit0.mp hz
  have heq : (T0 ((fi22a : Perm3510) z))⁻¹ * fi22a * T0 z =
      siftProd (siftFac0_0 z) := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    have hp := siftPt0_0 z hz0 x
    change tInvApp0 (fi22aApp z) (fi22aApp (tApp0 z x)) = _
    rw [hp, siftProd_apply]
    exact tApp0_left _ _
  rw [heq]
  exact siftProd_mem0 _ (facLv0_0 z)

name: Sporadic.Fi22.stabLast_subsingleton
statement:
theorem stabLast_subsingleton :
    ∀ g h : MulAction.stabilizer K8T (694 : Fin 3510), g = h
proof:
:= by
  intro g h
  have hg := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm3510)) hO8 hSch8 (by decide) T8_base
    g.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  have hh := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm3510)) hO8 hSch8 (by decide) T8_base
    h.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp h.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg hh
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hg, hh]

name: Sporadic.Fi22.card_level8
statement: theorem card_level8 : Nat.card K8T = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group K8T
      (694 : Fin 3510)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, orbit_ncard8]
  have h1 : Fintype.card
      (MulAction.stabilizer K8T (694 : Fin 3510)) = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨1, by
      rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
      rfl⟩, fun g => (stabLast_subsingleton g _)⟩
  rw [h1]

name: Sporadic.Fi22.TGamma_eq_word

proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 3510) (i : ℕ) => (sList1.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp1 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp1_eq i y
  rw [TGamma_apply, TGammaWord, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl
