name: Sporadic.Fi22.tGammaMaps_all
statement: theorem tGammaMaps_all : ∀ u : Fin 3510, tGammaMapsRow u = true
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 439 with h1 | h1
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 0 tGammaMapsOk0 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 878 with h2 | h2
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 439 tGammaMapsOk1 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1317 with h3 | h3
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 878 tGammaMapsOk2 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1756 with h4 | h4
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 1317 tGammaMapsOk3 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 2195 with h5 | h5
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 1756 tGammaMapsOk4 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 2634 with h6 | h6
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 2195 tGammaMapsOk5 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 3073 with h7 | h7
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 439 2634 tGammaMapsOk6 u (by omega) (by omega)
  exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 437 3073 tGammaMapsOk7 u (by omega) (by omega)

name: Sporadic.Fi22.TGamma_maps
statement: theorem TGamma_maps : ∀ z ∈ gammaSet, TGamma z (694 : Fin 3510) = z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have h := tGammaMaps_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
  · rw [mem_gamma.mp hz] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact eq_of_beq h2

name: Sporadic.Fi22.orbit_gamma
statement: theorem orbit_gamma : orbit K1T (694 : Fin 3510) = ↑gammaSet
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hy : (g : Perm3510) (694 : Fin 3510) ∈ gammaSet := by
      rcases suborbit_cover_pt ((g : Perm3510) (694 : Fin 3510)) with h | h | h
      · 
        exfalso
        have h0 : (g : Perm3510) (0 : Fin 3510) = 0 := K1_fix_b0 g g.2
        have : (((694 : Fin 3510)) : Fin 3510) = 0 :=
          (g : Perm3510).injective (by rw [h, h0])
        exact absurd this (by decide)
      · 
        exfalso
        apply gamma_pt_notin_orbit1
        have hmem : (g : Perm3510) (694 : Fin 3510) ∈ orbit1Set := mem_orbit1.mpr h
        have h1 : ((g : Perm3510) (694 : Fin 3510) : Fin 3510) ∈ orbit K1T (1 : Fin 3510) := by
          rw [orbit_eq1]; exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hmem
        have h2 : (694 : Fin 3510) ∈ orbit K1T (1 : Fin 3510) := by
          have := (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff (a := (g : Perm3510) (694 : Fin 3510))
            (b := (1 : Fin 3510)) (G := K1T)).mpr h1
          rw [← this]
          exact ⟨g⁻¹, by
            simp [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def,
              Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩
        rw [orbit_eq1] at h2
        exact Finset.mem_coe.mp h2
      · exact mem_gamma.mpr h
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hy
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨⟨TGamma y, TGamma_memK y⟩, ?_⟩
    have := TGamma_maps y (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using this

name: Sporadic.Fi22.orbit_gamma_of_mem
statement: theorem orbit_gamma_of_mem : ∀ x ∈ gammaSet, orbit K1T x = ↑gammaSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_gamma]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_gamma]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.Fi22.orbit_delta_of_mem
statement: theorem orbit_delta_of_mem : ∀ x ∈ orbit1Set, orbit K1T x = ↑orbit1Set
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_eq1]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_eq1]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.Fi22.anyT_apply
statement:
theorem anyT_apply (j : Nat) (y : Nat) (x : Fin 3510) :
    anyT j y x = anyTApp j y x
proof:
:= by
  match j with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | 5 => rfl
  | 6 => rfl
  | 7 => rfl
  | 8 => rfl
  | n + 9 => rfl

name: Sporadic.Fi22.siftProd_apply
statement:
theorem siftProd_apply (l : List (Nat × Nat)) (x : Fin 3510) :
    siftProd l x = siftProdApp l x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [siftProd, siftProdApp, List.foldr_cons]
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      show anyT a.1 a.2 (siftProd rest x) = _
      rw [ih, anyT_apply]
      rfl

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 100) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : HS, g.1 99 = x ∧ g.1 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toHS (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA99 : A.1 (99 : Fin 100) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 99 := by
    rw [← hA99, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 99 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (HS_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toHS (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all z hz
  have hBzero : B.1 (0 : Fin 100) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 99 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA99]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBzero, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 100) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : HS, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 99 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 0 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 100)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : HS, g.1 99 = x ∧ g.1 22 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toHS (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA99 : A.1 (99 : Fin 100) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 99 := by
    rw [← hA99, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 99 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (HS_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz99 : z ≠ 99 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (99 : Fin 100) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA99]
  set C := Word.toHS (hexadWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hC] using hexadWord_fixes_star_all z hz hz99
  have hC22 : C.1 (22 : Fin 100) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using hexadWord_maps_22_all z hz hz99
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 99 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA99]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 22 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC22, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 100)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : HS, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 99 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 22 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup HS) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 100, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : HS} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 100) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p := hadj
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hpq huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : HS} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p)
    (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 100) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.normal_star_witness
statement:
theorem normal_star_witness (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : HS} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (x : Fin 100) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 99 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx99 : x = 99
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx99]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 99
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 99 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw99, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 99 x (fun h => hx99 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 99 w hw99
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 99 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 99
    · obtain ⟨w, hw99, hwx, hw99', hwx'⟩ := common_non_nbr_exists 99 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 99 w hw99 hw99'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 99 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 99 x hxadj hx99

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.normal_orbit_star_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_star_eq_univ (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : HS} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (99 : Fin 100) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_star_witness N hN hnN hp x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.card_normal_eq_100_mul_stab

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.card_orderOf_eq_five_dvd
statement:
theorem card_orderOf_eq_five_dvd (G : Type*) [Group G] [Fintype G] :
    4 ∣ (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : G => orderOf x = 5)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : G => orderOf x = 5) with hS
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ S, orderOf x = 5 := by
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  
  have hfiber : ∀ x ∈ S,
      S.filter (fun y => Subgroup.zpowers y = Subgroup.zpowers x) =
        {x, x ^ 2, x ^ 3, x ^ 4} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx5 : orderOf x = 5 := horder x hx
    have hpow_mem : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 4 → x ^ k ∈ S ∧
        Subgroup.zpowers (x ^ k) = Subgroup.zpowers x := by
      intro k hk1 hk4
      have hord : orderOf (x ^ k) = 5 := by
        rw [orderOf_pow' x (by omega), hx5]
        interval_cases k <;> decide
      constructor
      · rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hord⟩
      · apply le_antisymm
        · rw [Subgroup.zpowers_le]
          exact Subgroup.pow_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x) k
        · have hcard1 : Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers (x ^ k)) = 5 := by
            rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hord]
          have hcard2 : Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers x) = 5 := by
            rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hx5]
          intro y hy
          have hle : Subgroup.zpowers (x ^ k) ≤ Subgroup.zpowers x := by
            rw [Subgroup.zpowers_le]
            exact Subgroup.pow_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x) k
          have : (Subgroup.zpowers (x ^ k) : Set G) = Subgroup.zpowers x := by
            apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le
            · exact hle
            · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
                SetLike.coe_sort_coe, SetLike.coe_sort_coe, hcard1, hcard2]
            · exact Set.toFinite _
          rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← this, SetLike.mem_coe] at hy
          exact hy
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨hyS, hyz⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
      have hy5 : orderOf y = 5 := horder y hyS
      
      have hymem : y ∈ Subgroup.zpowers x := by
        rw [← hyz]
        exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers y
      have hymem' : y ∈ Submonoid.powers x :=
        mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.mpr hymem
      rw [Submonoid.mem_powers_iff] at hymem'
      obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := hymem'
      have hk : x ^ (k0 % 5) = y := by
        calc x ^ (k0 % 5) = x ^ (k0 % orderOf x) := by rw [hx5]
          _ = x ^ k0 := pow_mod_orderOf x k0
          _ = y := hk0
      have hklt : k0 % 5 < 5 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
      have hkne : k0 % 5 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [h, pow_zero] at hk
        rw [← hk, orderOf_one] at hy5
        norm_num at hy5
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
      have hcases : k0 % 5 = 1 ∨ k0 % 5 = 2 ∨ k0 % 5 = 3 ∨ k0 % 5 = 4 := by
        omega
      rcases hcases with h | h | h | h
      · left
        rw [← hk, h, pow_one]
      · right; left
        rw [← hk, h]
      · right; right; left
        rw [← hk, h]
      · right; right; right
        rw [← hk, h]
    · intro hy
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨(hpow_mem 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).1,
          (hpow_mem 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2⟩
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨(hpow_mem 3 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).1,
          (hpow_mem 3 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2⟩
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨(hpow_mem 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).1,
          (hpow_mem 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2⟩
  
  have hfibercard : ∀ x ∈ S,
      (S.filter (fun y => Subgroup.zpowers y = Subgroup.zpowers x)).card = 4 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx5 : orderOf x = 5 := horder x hx
    rw [hfiber x hx]
    have hinj : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < 5 → j < 5 → x ^ i = x ^ j → i = j := by
      intro i j hi hj hij
      have := pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (x := x)
      rw [hx5] at this
      exact this (Set.mem_Iio.mpr hi) (Set.mem_Iio.mpr hj) hij
    have h12 : x ≠ x ^ 2 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 1 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by rw [pow_one]; exact h)
      norm_num at this
    have h13 : x ≠ x ^ 3 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 1 3 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by rw [pow_one]; exact h)
      norm_num at this
    have h14 : x ≠ x ^ 4 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 1 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by rw [pow_one]; exact h)
      norm_num at this
    have h23 : x ^ 2 ≠ x ^ 3 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 2 3 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
      norm_num at this
    have h24 : x ^ 2 ≠ x ^ 4 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 2 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
      norm_num at this
    have h34 : x ^ 3 ≠ x ^ 4 := by
      intro h
      have := hinj 3 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
      norm_num at this
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [h12, h13, h14]),
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [h23, h24]),
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [h34]),
      Finset.card_singleton]
  
  have hcount := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (f := fun x => Subgroup.zpowers x) (s := S)
    (t := S.image (fun x => Subgroup.zpowers x))
    (fun x hx => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
  rw [hcount]
  refine Finset.dvd_sum ?_
  intro H hH
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hH
  rw [hfibercard x hx]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_star
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_star (N : Subgroup HS)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : HS} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 99 = 99) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.stab_point_witness
statement:
theorem stab_point_witness (p q : Fin 100)
    (hp : p ∈ nbrs 99) (hq : q ∈ nbrs 99) :
    ∃ s : HS, s.1 99 = 99 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toHS (levelTwoWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toHS (levelTwoWord q) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 100) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all p hp
  have hWp99 : Wp.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all p hp
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 100) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all q hq
  have hWq99 : Wq.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all q hq
  have hWpInv99 : Wp.1⁻¹ (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp99]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 99 = 99
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv99, hWq99]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.stab_hexad_witness
statement:
theorem stab_hexad_witness (p q : Fin 100)
    (hp : p ∉ nbrs 99) (hp99 : p ≠ 99) (hq : q ∉ nbrs 99) (hq99 : q ≠ 99) :
    ∃ s : HS, s.1 99 = 99 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toHS (hexadWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toHS (hexadWord q) with hWq
  have hWp22 : Wp.1 (22 : Fin 100) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using hexadWord_maps_22_all p hp hp99
  have hWp99 : Wp.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWp] using hexadWord_fixes_star_all p hp hp99
  have hWq22 : Wq.1 (22 : Fin 100) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using hexadWord_maps_22_all q hq hq99
  have hWq99 : Wq.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWq] using hexadWord_fixes_star_all q hq hq99
  have hWpInv99 : Wp.1⁻¹ (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp99]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 22 := by
    rw [← hWp22, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 99 = 99
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv99, hWq99]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq22]

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : HS) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 100) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 100 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 5 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 5) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  have hdvd : 4 ∣ K.card := card_orderOf_eq_five_dvd N
  
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 99 = m.1.1 99 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 99 = 99 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 99 = 99
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 99 ≠ 99 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 5 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  
  have hconj : ∀ (s : HS), s.1 99 = 99 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 99 = s.1 (n.1.1 99) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 99 = s.1 (n.1.1 99)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 99) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = K.card := by
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n _ m _ h
    exact hphi_inj n m h
  
  have hclose_pt : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 99 → ∀ y ∈ nbrs 99, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs99, hsx⟩ := stab_point_witness x y hxn hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs99 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hclose_hex : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 99 → x ≠ 99 →
      ∀ y ∉ nbrs 99, y ≠ 99 → y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn hx99 y hy hy99
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs99, hsx⟩ := stab_hexad_witness x y hxn hx99 hy hy99
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs99 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  
  have hKimg99 : (99 : Fin 100) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 99 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  by_cases hA : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 99
  · by_cases hB : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 99 ∧ x ≠ 99
    · 
      have : Kimg = Finset.univ.erase 99 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            ⟨fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro hy
          have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
          by_cases hyn : y ∈ nbrs 99
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
            exact hclose_pt x hx hxn y hyn
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn, hx99⟩ := hB
            exact hclose_hex x hx hxn hx99 y hyn hy99
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 99 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
    · 
      push Not at hB
      have : Kimg = nbrs 99 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          by_contra hyn
          have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy)
          exact hy99 (hB y hy hyn)
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
          exact hclose_pt x hx hxn y hy
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 22 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
  · 
    push Not at hA
    have hz0x := hz0img
    have hz0n : z0.1.1 99 ∉ nbrs 99 := hA _ hz0img
    have hz099 : z0.1.1 99 ≠ 99 := hK_moves z0 hz0K
    have : Kimg = (Finset.univ.erase 99) \ nbrs 99 := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy)
        exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hy99, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hA y hy⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨hy', hyn⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
        have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy').1
        exact hclose_hex _ hz0img hz0n hz099 y hyn hy99
    rw [this] at hcard_eq
    have : K.card = 77 := by
      rw [← hcard_eq]
      decide
    omega

name: Sporadic.HSSimplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup HS) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_star_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_100_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard100 : Nat.card N = 100 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard100
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 443520 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card HS := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, HSCardinality.card_HS]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

name: Sporadic.HSCardinality.final_stabilizer_eq_one
statement: theorem final_stabilizer_eq_one (g : StabBase) : g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hperm : g.1.1.1.1.1.1.1 = (1 : Perm100) := by
    exact fixed_base_preserves_nbrs_eq_one g.1.1.1.1.1.1.1

name: Sporadic.HSBlockPermHom.chi_mem_closure
statement:
theorem chi_mem_closure (g : M22) :
    chi g ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, x ∈ M22Subgroup →
      chiExt x ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => chiExt y ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · rw [chiExt_eq m22a m22a_mem_M22Subgroup, chi_m22a]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · rw [chiExt_eq m22b m22b_mem_M22Subgroup, chi_m22b]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
    · change chiExt 1 ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100)
      have h1 : chiExt 1 = chi 1 := chiExt_eq 1 (Subgroup.one_mem _)
      rw [h1, map_one]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro a b ha hb hpa hpb
      change chiExt (a * b) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100) := hpa
      have hpb' : chiExt b ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100) := hpb
      have hab : chiExt (a * b) = chi (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩ : M22) :=
        chiExt_eq (a * b) (Subgroup.mul_mem _ ha hb)
      rw [hab, map_mul]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      rw [chiExt_eq b hb] at hpb'
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hpa' hpb'
    · intro a ha hpa
      change chiExt a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100) := hpa
      have hai : chiExt a⁻¹ = chi ((⟨a, ha⟩ : M22)⁻¹) :=
        chiExt_eq a⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ ha)
      rw [hai, map_inv]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hpa'
  have hg : chi g = chiExt g.1 := (chiExt_eq g.1 g.2).symm
  rw [hg]
  exact key g.1 g.2

name: Sporadic.HSBlockPermHom.embeddedM22_eq_closure
statement:
theorem embeddedM22_eq_closure :
    EmbeddedM22 = Subgroup.closure ({hsa, hsb} : Set Perm100)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro g hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact chi_mem_closure p
  · rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨m22a, m22a_mem_M22Subgroup⟩, chi_m22a⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨m22b, m22b_mem_M22Subgroup⟩, chi_m22b⟩

        rw [classSizeList_length]

proof:

name: Sporadic.M11Simplicity.selectedClassUnion_ncard
statement:
theorem selectedClassUnion_ncard (N : Subgroup M11) :
    (selectedClassUnion N).ncard = classSelectionSize (subgroupClassSelection N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold selectedClassUnion classSelectionSize
  have hfin : ∀ i : Fin 10, (selectedClassSet N i).Finite := fun _ => Set.toFinite _
  have hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on selectedClassSet N) := by
    intro i j hij
    change Disjoint (selectedClassSet N i) (selectedClassSet N j)
    by_cases hi : representativeM11 i ∈ N
    · by_cases hj : representativeM11 j ∈ N
      · simpa [selectedClassSet, hi, hj] using classOrbit_pairwiseDisjoint hij
      · simp [selectedClassSet, hi, hj]
    · by_cases hj : representativeM11 j ∈ N
      · simp [selectedClassSet, hi, hj]
      · simp [selectedClassSet, hi, hj]
  rw [Set.ncard_iUnion_of_finite hfin hdisj]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [selectedClassSet_ncard]

name: Sporadic.M11Simplicity.normal_subgroup_eq_selectedClassUnion
statement:
theorem normal_subgroup_eq_selectedClassUnion (N : Subgroup M11) [N.Normal] :
    (N : Set M11) = selectedClassUnion N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxuniv : x ∈ ⋃ i : Fin 10, classOrbit i := by
      rw [classOrbit_iUnion_eq_univ]
      simp
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxuniv with ⟨i, hxi⟩
    have hconj : IsConj x (representativeM11 i) := by
      simpa [classOrbit] using (ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp hxi)
    have hrep : representativeM11 i ∈ N := by
      rcases isConj_iff.mp hconj with ⟨g, hg⟩
      rw [← hg]
      exact normal_subgroup_closed_under_conj N hx g
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, by simp [selectedClassSet, hrep, hxi]⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩
    by_cases hrep : representativeM11 i ∈ N
    · have hxiOrbit : x ∈ classOrbit i := by
        simpa [selectedClassSet, hrep] using hxi
      exact conj_orbit_subset_of_normal N hrep hxiOrbit
    · simp [selectedClassSet, hrep] at hxi

name: Sporadic.J2FamilyHom.chi_injective
statement: theorem chi_injective : Function.Injective chi
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff]
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup U33Subgroup := simple_U33
  rcases Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (MonoidHom.normal_ker chi) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have hmem : (⟨u33e1, u33e1_mem⟩ : U33Subgroup) ∈ chi.ker := by
      rw [h]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top _
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, chi_u33e1] at hmem

name: Sporadic.J2FamilyHom.chi_mem_closure
statement:
theorem chi_mem_closure (g : U33Subgroup) :
    chi g ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, x ∈ U33Subgroup →
      chiExt x ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => chiExt y ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [chiExt_eq u33e1 u33e1_mem, chi_u33e1]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · rw [chiExt_eq u33e2 u33e2_mem, chi_u33e2]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      · rw [chiExt_eq u33e3 u33e3_mem, chi_u33e3]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    · change chiExt 1 ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100)
      have h1 : chiExt 1 = chi 1 := chiExt_eq 1 (Subgroup.one_mem _)
      rw [h1, map_one]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro a b ha hb hpa hpb
      change chiExt (a * b) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100) := hpa
      have hpb' : chiExt b ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100) := hpb
      have hab : chiExt (a * b) = chi (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩ : U33Subgroup) :=
        chiExt_eq (a * b) (Subgroup.mul_mem _ ha hb)
      rw [hab, map_mul]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      rw [chiExt_eq b hb] at hpb'
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hpa' hpb'
    · intro a ha hpa
      change chiExt a⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100)
      have hpa' : chiExt a ∈ Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100) := hpa
      have hai : chiExt a⁻¹ = chi ((⟨a, ha⟩ : U33Subgroup)⁻¹) :=
        chiExt_eq a⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ ha)
      rw [hai, map_inv]
      rw [chiExt_eq a ha] at hpa'
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hpa'
  have hg : chi g = chiExt g.1 := (chiExt_eq g.1 g.2).symm
  rw [hg]
  exact key g.1 g.2

name: Sporadic.J2FamilyHom.embeddedU33_eq_closure
statement:
theorem embeddedU33_eq_closure :
    EmbeddedU33 = Subgroup.closure ({j2a, j2b, j2c} : Set Perm100)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro g hg
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact chi_mem_closure p
  · rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨u33e1, u33e1_mem⟩, chi_u33e1⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u33e2, u33e2_mem⟩, chi_u33e2⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨u33e3, u33e3_mem⟩, chi_u33e3⟩

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 100) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : J2, g.1 99 = x ∧ g.1 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toJ2 (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA99 : A.1 (99 : Fin 100) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 99 := by
    rw [← hA99, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 99 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (J2_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toJ2 (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all z hz
  have hBzero : B.1 (0 : Fin 100) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 99 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA99]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBzero, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 100) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : J2, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 99 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 0 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 100)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : J2, g.1 99 = x ∧ g.1 36 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toJ2 (levelOneWord x) with hA
  have hA99 : A.1 (99 : Fin 100) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 99 := by
    rw [← hA99, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 99 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (J2_preserves_nbrs A)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz99 : z ≠ 99 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (99 : Fin 100) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA99]
  set C := Word.toJ2 (secantWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hC] using secantWord_fixes_99_all z hz hz99
  have hC36 : C.1 (36 : Fin 100) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using secantWord_maps_36_all z hz hz99
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 99 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA99]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 36 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC36, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 100)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : J2, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 99 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 36 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup J2) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 100, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : J2} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 100) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p := hadj
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hpq huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : J2} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p)
    (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 100) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.normal_star_witness
statement:
theorem normal_star_witness (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : J2} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (x : Fin 100) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 99 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx99 : x = 99
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx99]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 99
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 99 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw99, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 99 x (fun h => hx99 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 99 w hw99
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 99 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 99
    · obtain ⟨w, hw99, hwx, hw99', hwx'⟩ := common_non_nbr_exists 99 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 99 w hw99 hw99'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 99 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 99 x hxadj hx99

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.normal_orbit_star_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_star_eq_univ (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : J2} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 100} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (99 : Fin 100) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨m, hmN, hmx⟩ := normal_star_witness N hN hnN hp x
    exact ⟨⟨m, hmN⟩, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hmx⟩

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.card_normal_eq_100_mul_stab
statement:
theorem card_normal_eq_100_mul_stab (N : Subgroup J2)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (99 : Fin 100) = Set.univ) :
    Nat.card N = 100 * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (99 : Fin 100))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group N (99 : Fin 100)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, horbit, Set.ncard_univ]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := MulAction.stabilizer N (99 : Fin 100))]
  simp

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.card_stabInN_eq
statement:
theorem card_stabInN_eq (N : Subgroup J2) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (99 : Fin 100)) =
      Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast)

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.eq_one_of_fixes_star
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fixes_star (N : Subgroup J2)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥)
    {m : J2} (hmN : m ∈ N) (hfix : m.1 99 = 99) : m = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmS : m ∈ StabLast := by
    rw [StabLast, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmS⟩ : StabLast) ∈ N.subgroupOf StabLast :=
    Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hmN
  rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.stab_fam_witness
statement:
theorem stab_fam_witness (p q : Fin 100)
    (hp : p ∈ nbrs 99) (hq : q ∈ nbrs 99) :
    ∃ s : J2, s.1 99 = 99 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toJ2 (levelTwoWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toJ2 (levelTwoWord q) with hWq
  have hWp0 : Wp.1 (0 : Fin 100) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all p hp
  have hWp99 : Wp.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWp] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all p hp
  have hWq0 : Wq.1 (0 : Fin 100) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_maps_0_all q hq
  have hWq99 : Wq.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWq] using levelTwoWord_fixes_99_all q hq
  have hWpInv99 : Wp.1⁻¹ (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp99]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← hWp0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 99 = 99
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv99, hWq99]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq0]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.stab_secant_witness
statement:
theorem stab_secant_witness (p q : Fin 100)
    (hp : p ∉ nbrs 99) (hp99 : p ≠ 99) (hq : q ∉ nbrs 99) (hq99 : q ≠ 99) :
    ∃ s : J2, s.1 99 = 99 ∧ s.1 p = q
proof:
:= by
  set Wp := Word.toJ2 (secantWord p) with hWp
  set Wq := Word.toJ2 (secantWord q) with hWq
  have hWp36 : Wp.1 (36 : Fin 100) = p := by
    simpa [hWp] using secantWord_maps_36_all p hp hp99
  have hWp99 : Wp.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWp] using secantWord_fixes_99_all p hp hp99
  have hWq36 : Wq.1 (36 : Fin 100) = q := by
    simpa [hWq] using secantWord_maps_36_all q hq hq99
  have hWq99 : Wq.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    simpa [hWq] using secantWord_fixes_99_all q hq hq99
  have hWpInv99 : Wp.1⁻¹ (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hWp99]
    exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  have hWpInvp : Wp.1⁻¹ p = 36 := by
    rw [← hWp36, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨Wq * Wp⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) 99 = 99
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInv99, hWq99]
  · change (Wq.1 * Wp.1⁻¹) p = q
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hWpInvp, hWq36]

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.orderOf_conj_eq
statement: theorem orderOf_conj_eq (s x : J2) : orderOf (s * x * s⁻¹) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  have h : s * x * s⁻¹ = (MulAut.conj s) x := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom
    (MulAut.conj s).injective x

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hb : N.subgroupOf StabLast = ⊥) (hcard : Nat.card N = 100) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hF : Fintype.card N = 100 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 5 (by rw [hF]; norm_num)
  
  set K := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => orderOf n = 5) with hK
  have hz0K : z0 ∈ K := by
    rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : Sylow 5 N, ∀ Q : Sylow 5 N, Q = P0 := by
    have hmod := card_sylow_modEq_one 5 N
    have hmod' : Nat.card (Sylow 5 N) % 5 = 1 := by
      unfold Nat.ModEq at hmod
      omega
    have hdvd : Nat.card (Sylow 5 N) ∣ 100 := by
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow 5 N))
      refine (P.card_dvd_index).trans ?_
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ (by rw [P.1.card_mul_index, hcard])
    have hle : Nat.card (Sylow 5 N) ≤ 100 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    have hforce : ∀ k < 101, k ∣ 100 → k % 5 = 1 → k = 1 := by decide
    have hn5 : Nat.card (Sylow 5 N) = 1 :=
      hforce _ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle) hdvd hmod'
    rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists] at hn5
    exact hn5
  
  have hmemP0 : ∀ n : N, orderOf n = 5 → n ∈ P0.1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hz : IsPGroup 5 (Subgroup.zpowers n) := by
      apply IsPGroup.of_card
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hn, pow_one]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hz.exists_le_sylow
    rw [hP0 Q] at hQ
    exact hQ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers n)
  
  have hcardP0 : Nat.card P0.1 ≤ 25 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp P0.2
    have hdvdP : Nat.card P0.1 ∣ 100 := by
      rw [← hcard]
      exact Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card P0.1
    rw [hn] at hdvdP ⊢
    have h5n : 5 ^ n ≤ 100 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvdP
    have hn2 : n ≤ 2 := by
      by_contra hgt
      push Not at hgt
      have h125 : 5 ^ 3 ≤ 5 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hgt
      norm_num at h125
      omega
    calc 5 ^ n ≤ 5 ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn2
      _ = 25 := by norm_num
  
  have hKcard : K.card ≤ 25 := by
    have hsub : K ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hmemP0 n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2⟩
    have hfil : (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card =
        Nat.card P0.1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
    calc K.card
        ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun n : N => n ∈ P0.1)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = Nat.card P0.1 := hfil
      _ ≤ 25 := hcardP0
  
  have hphi_inj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 99 = m.1.1 99 → n = m := by
    intro n m h
    have hmem : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1) ∈ N := N.mul_mem (N.inv_mem m.2) n.2
    have hfix : (m.1⁻¹ * n.1).1 99 = 99 := by
      change (m.1.1⁻¹ * n.1.1) 99 = 99
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h, perm_inv_apply_self]
    have := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb hmem hfix
    have hmn : m.1⁻¹ * n.1 = 1 := this
    have : n.1 = m.1 := by
      rw [← one_mul n.1, ← mul_inv_cancel m.1, mul_assoc, hmn, mul_one]
    exact Subtype.ext this
  
  have hK_moves : ∀ n : N, n ∈ K → n.1.1 99 ≠ 99 := by
    intro n hn h
    have h1 : n.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_fixes_star N hb n.2 h
    have : orderOf n = 5 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hn1 : n = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    rw [hn1, orderOf_one] at this
    norm_num at this
  
  have hconj : ∀ (s : J2), s.1 99 = 99 → ∀ n : N, n ∈ K →
      ∃ m : N, m ∈ K ∧ m.1.1 99 = s.1 (n.1.1 99) := by
    intro s hs n hn
    have hmem : s * n.1 * s⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 s
    refine ⟨⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hK, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have horder : orderOf (⟨s * n.1 * s⁻¹, hmem⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (s * n.1 * s⁻¹) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      have horder' : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf n.1 :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype N.subtype_injective _).symm
      rw [horder, orderOf_conj_eq]
      rw [← horder']
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    · change (s.1 * n.1.1 * s.1⁻¹) 99 = s.1 (n.1.1 99)
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      congr 2
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs]
      exact perm_inv_apply_self _ _
  
  set Kimg := K.image (fun n : N => n.1.1 99) with hKimg
  have hcard_eq : Kimg.card = K.card := by
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n _ m _ h
    exact hphi_inj n m h
  
  have hclose_fam : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 99 → ∀ y ∈ nbrs 99, y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn y hy
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs99, hsx⟩ := stab_fam_witness x y hxn hy
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs99 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  have hclose_sec : ∀ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 99 → x ≠ 99 →
      ∀ y ∉ nbrs 99, y ≠ 99 → y ∈ Kimg := by
    intro x hx hxn hx99 y hy hy99
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hnx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs99, hsx⟩ := stab_secant_witness x y hxn hx99 hy hy99
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm⟩ := hconj s hs99 n hnK
    rw [hKimg]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨m, hmK, by rw [hm, hnx, hsx]⟩
  
  have hKimg99 : (99 : Fin 100) ∉ Kimg := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hnK, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hK_moves n hnK hn
  
  have hz0img : z0.1.1 99 ∈ Kimg := by
    rw [hKimg]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hz0K
  by_cases hA : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∈ nbrs 99
  · by_cases hB : ∃ x ∈ Kimg, x ∉ nbrs 99 ∧ x ≠ 99
    · 
      have : Kimg = Finset.univ.erase 99 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            ⟨fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro hy
          have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy).1
          by_cases hyn : y ∈ nbrs 99
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
            exact hclose_fam x hx hxn y hyn
          · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn, hx99⟩ := hB
            exact hclose_sec x hx hxn hx99 y hyn hy99
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 99 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
    · 
      push Not at hB
      have : Kimg = nbrs 99 := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          by_contra hyn
          have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy)
          exact hy99 (hB y hy hyn)
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ := hA
          exact hclose_fam x hx hxn y hy
      rw [this] at hcard_eq
      have : K.card = 36 := by
        rw [← hcard_eq]
        decide
      omega
  · 
    push Not at hA
    have hz0n : z0.1.1 99 ∉ nbrs 99 := hA _ hz0img
    have hz099 : z0.1.1 99 ≠ 99 := hK_moves z0 hz0K
    have : Kimg = (Finset.univ.erase 99) \ nbrs 99 := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := fun h => hKimg99 (h ▸ hy)
        exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hy99, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hA y hy⟩
      · intro hy
        obtain ⟨hy', hyn⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
        have hy99 : y ≠ 99 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hy').1
        exact hclose_sec _ hz0img hz0n hz099 y hyn hy99
    rw [this] at hcard_eq
    have : K.card = 63 := by
      rw [← hcard_eq]
      decide
    omega

name: Sporadic.J2Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup J2) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_star_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_100_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup StabLast := isSimpleGroup_stabLast
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf StabLast).Normal := hN.subgroupOf StabLast
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcard100 : Nat.card N = 100 := by
      rw [hcardN, hb, Subgroup.card_bot]
    exact regular_case_absurd N hN hb hcard100
  · have hcardS : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf StabLast) = 6048 := by
      rw [ht, Subgroup.card_top]
      exact card_stabLast
    have hcard : Nat.card N = Nat.card J2 := by
      rw [hcardN, hcardS, J2Cardinality.card_J2]
    exact Subgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq N hcard

  refine le_trans (Finset.card_insert_le _ _) (Nat.succ_le_succ ?_)

name: Sporadic.J2Cardinality.stabBase_toPerm_mem
statement: theorem stabBase_toPerm_mem (g : StabBase) : g.1.1.1.1 ∈ tailPerms
proof:
:= by
  have h := fixed_base_cases g.1.1.1.1
    (J2_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1) (J2_toPerm_sign g.1.1.1)
    (stabBase_fixes_star g) (stabBase_fixes_zero g) (stabBase_fixes_38 g)
  rcases h with h | h | h | h
  · rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  · rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  · rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
  · rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)))

name: Sporadic.J2Cardinality.stabBase_toPerm_injective

theorem stabBase_toPerm_injective :

name: Sporadic.J2Cardinality.card_stabBase_le
statement: theorem card_stabBase_le : Nat.card StabBase ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype StabBase := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have himg : Finset.univ.image (fun g : StabBase => g.1.1.1.1) ⊆ tailPerms := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact stabBase_toPerm_mem g
  calc Fintype.card StabBase
      = Finset.univ.card := Finset.card_univ.symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.image (fun g : StabBase => g.1.1.1.1)).card :=
        (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ stabBase_toPerm_injective).symm
    _ ≤ tailPerms.card := Finset.card_le_card himg
    _ ≤ 4 := tailPerms_card_le

name: Sporadic.Co3Group.lift_mem

theorem lift_mem {m : Perm275} (hm : m ∈ McLSubgroup) :
    liftHom m ∈ Co3Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : McLSubgroup.map liftHom ≤ Co3Subgroup := by
    unfold McLSubgroup Co3Subgroup
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure]
    apply Subgroup.closure_mono
    rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [co3a, co3b, co3c, co3d, co3e]
  exact hmap ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

proof:

name: Sporadic.Co3Group.preservesTwoG_inv
statement:
theorem preservesTwoG_inv {g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)}
    (hg : PreservesTwoG g) : PreservesTwoG g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro q r s
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ q) (g⁻¹ r) (g⁻¹ s)
  have e1 : g (g⁻¹ q) = q := Equiv.apply_symm_apply g q
  have e2 : g (g⁻¹ r) = r := Equiv.apply_symm_apply g r
  have e3 : g (g⁻¹ s) = s := Equiv.apply_symm_apply g s
  rw [e1, e2, e3] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Sporadic.Co3Group.lift_adjB
statement:
theorem lift_adjB (m : Perm275)
    (hm : McLCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs m) :
    ∀ q r : Fin 276, adjB (liftHom m q) (liftHom m r) = adjB q r
proof:
:= by
  intro q r
  by_cases hq : q.val < 275
  · by_cases hr : r.val < 275
    · rw [lift_apply_below m q hq, lift_apply_below m r hr]
      rw [adjB_below _ _ (m ⟨q.val, hq⟩).isLt (m ⟨r.val, hr⟩).isLt,
        adjB_below q r hq hr]
      apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
      show m ⟨r.val, hr⟩ ∈ nbrsRow (m ⟨q.val, hq⟩) ↔ _
      rw [← McLCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_iff,
        ← McLCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_iff]
      constructor
      · intro h
        by_contra hno
        exact McLCertificates.Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map m hm rfl hno h
      · intro h
        exact McLCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_map m hm rfl h
    · have h275 : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
      have hrv : r = inf := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst hrv
      rw [lift_fixes_inf, adjB_right_inf, adjB_right_inf]
  · have h275 : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
    have hqv : q = inf := Fin.ext (by omega)
    subst hqv
    rw [lift_fixes_inf, adjB_left_inf, adjB_left_inf]

name: Sporadic.Co3Group.lift_preserves
statement:
theorem lift_preserves (m : Perm275)
    (hm : McLCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs m) :
    PreservesTwoG (liftHom m)
proof:
:= by
  intro q r s
  unfold twoG
  rw [lift_adjB m hm q r, lift_adjB m hm q s, lift_adjB m hm r s]

name: Sporadic.Co3Group.co3_preserves_twoG
statement:
theorem co3_preserves_twoG :
    ∀ g ∈ Co3Subgroup, PreservesTwoG g
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun y _ => PreservesTwoG y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact lift_preserves mcla mcla_preserves_nbrs
    · exact lift_preserves mclb mclb_preserves_nbrs
    · exact lift_preserves mclc mclc_preserves_nbrs
    · exact lift_preserves mcld mcld_preserves_nbrs
    · exact lift_preserves mcle mcle_preserves_nbrs
    · exact co3f_preserves
  · intro q r s
    rfl
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    exact preservesTwoG_mul ha hb
  · intro a _ ha
    exact preservesTwoG_inv ha

      | exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ co3b_mem
      | exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ co3c_mem
      | exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ co3d_mem
      | exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ co3e_mem

name: Sporadic.Co3Chain.stab1_orbit_eq
statement:
theorem stab1_orbit_eq :
    MulAction.orbit CStab1 (i274 : Fin 276) = ↑belowSet
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix : g.1.1 inf = inf := by
      have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1 i274 = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hx : (g.1.1 i274).val < 275 := below_mem hfix i274 i274_lt
    rw [hmap] at hx
    simp [belowSet, hx]
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x.val < 275 := by
      simpa [belowSet] using hx
    refine ⟨stab1Element ⟨x.val, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
    show (stab1Element ⟨x.val, hx'⟩).1.1 i274 = x
    show (liftEl (levelOneWord ⟨x.val, hx'⟩)).1 i274 = x
    apply lift_map_point _ i274_lt hx'
    have h274 : (⟨(i274 : Fin 276).val, i274_lt⟩ : Fin 275) =
        (274 : Fin 275) := rfl
    rw [h274]
    exact levelOneWord_maps_star_all ⟨x.val, hx'⟩

name: Sporadic.Co3Chain.stab2_orbit_eq
statement:
theorem stab2_orbit_eq :
    MulAction.orbit CStab2 (i0 : Fin 276) = ↑(upSet (nbrs 274))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfixInf : g.1.1.1 inf = inf := by
      have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix274 : g.1.1.1 i274 = i274 := by
      have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1 i0 = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs (restr g.1.1.1 hfixInf) :=
      restr_preserves (co3_preserves_twoG g.1.1.1 g.1.1.2) hfixInf
    have hfix274' : restr g.1.1.1 hfixInf (274 : Fin 275) =
        (274 : Fin 275) := restr_fix hfixInf i274_lt hfix274
    have hval : (g.1.1.1 i0).val =
        (restr g.1.1.1 hfixInf ⟨(i0 : Fin 276).val, i0_lt⟩).val :=
      restr_val hfixInf i0_lt

  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a.val 275 with h | h

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.exists_stab_map
statement:
theorem exists_stab_map {a b : Fin 276} (ha : a ≠ inf) (hb : b ≠ inf) :
    ∃ g : Co3, g.1 inf = inf ∧ g.1 a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ {v : Fin 276}, v.val < 275 →
      v ∈ MulAction.orbit CStab1 (i274 : Fin 276) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [stab1_orbit_eq]
    simp [belowSet, hv]
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ := hmem (val_lt_of_ne_inf ha)
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2⟩ := hmem (val_lt_of_ne_inf hb)
  have hg1' : g1.1.1 i274 = a := by
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
  have hg2' : g2.1.1 i274 = b := by
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg2
  have hfix1 : g1.1.1 inf = inf := by
    have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g1.2
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
  have hfix2 : g2.1.1 inf = inf := by
    have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g2.2
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
  refine ⟨g2.1 * (g1.1)⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul]
    show g2.1.1 (((g1.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf) = inf
    have hfix1' : ((g1.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf = inf := by
      set σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276) := g1.1.1 with hσ
      have hfixσ : σ inf = inf := hfix1
      have hcoe : ((g1.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 = σ⁻¹ := rfl
      rw [hcoe]
      nth_rewrite 1 [← hfixσ]
      exact Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
    rw [hfix1', hfix2]
  · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul]
    show g2.1.1 (((g1.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 a) = b
    have hback : ((g1.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 a = i274 := by
      rw [← hg1']
      simp
    rw [hback, hg2']

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.pair_transitive
statement:
theorem pair_transitive {p q a b : Fin 276} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ g : Co3, g.1 p = a ∧ g.1 q = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1⟩ := exists_map_inf p
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1⟩ := exists_map_inf a
  have hp' : (g1⁻¹ : Co3).1 p = inf := by
    rw [← hg1]
    simp
  have ha' : (t1⁻¹ : Co3).1 a = inf := by
    rw [← ht1]
    simp
  have hr : (g1⁻¹ : Co3).1 q ≠ inf := by
    intro hcon
    exact hpq ((g1⁻¹ : Co3).1.injective (hp'.trans hcon.symm))
  have hb' : (t1⁻¹ : Co3).1 b ≠ inf := by
    intro hcon
    exact hab ((t1⁻¹ : Co3).1.injective (ha'.trans hcon.symm))
  obtain ⟨m, hmfix, hmmap⟩ := exists_stab_map hr hb'
  refine ⟨t1 * m * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul]
    show t1.1 (m.1 ((g1⁻¹ : Co3).1 p)) = a
    rw [hp', hmfix, ht1]
  · rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul]
    show t1.1 (m.1 ((g1⁻¹ : Co3).1 q)) = b
    rw [hmmap]
    simp

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup Co3) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 276, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : Co3} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 276} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) :
    MulAction.orbit N (inf : Fin 276) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    by_cases hx : x = inf
    · subst hx
      exact ⟨⟨1, N.one_mem⟩, by
        simp [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def]⟩
    · obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg2⟩ := pair_transitive
        (show p ≠ n.1 p from fun h => hp h.symm)
        (show (inf : Fin 276) ≠ x from fun h => hx h.symm)
      refine ⟨⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g⟩, ?_⟩
      show (g * n * g⁻¹ : Co3) • (inf : Fin 276) = x
      rw [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def]
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul]
      show g.1 (n.1 ((g⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf)) = x
      have hback : (g⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf = p := by
        rw [← hg1]
        simp
      rw [hback, hg2]

    (hb : (N.subgroupOf MInCo3) = ⊥) :
