proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun k : N.subgroupOf SInf =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk k.1 : SInf ⧸ MInS)) := by
    intro k1 k2 h12
    have hmem : (k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1 ∈ MInS := QuotientGroup.eq.mp h12
    have hMC : ((k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1).1 ∈ MInCo3 :=
      Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hmem
    have hNC : ((k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1).1 ∈ N := by
      have hK : (k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1 ∈ N.subgroupOf SInf :=
        (N.subgroupOf SInf).mul_mem
          ((N.subgroupOf SInf).inv_mem k1.2) k2.2
      exact Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hK
    have hMN : (⟨((k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1).1, hMC⟩ : MInCo3) ∈
        N.subgroupOf MInCo3 := Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr hNC
    rw [hb, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hMN
    have h1 : ((k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1).1 = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val hMN
    have h2 : (k1.1)⁻¹ * k2.1 = 1 := Subtype.ext h1
    exact Subtype.ext (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h2)
  haveI : Finite (SInf ⧸ MInS) := Quotient.finite _
  calc Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf)
      ≤ Nat.card (SInf ⧸ MInS) :=
        Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
          (fun k : N.subgroupOf SInf =>
            (QuotientGroup.mk k.1 : SInf ⧸ MInS)) hinj
    _ = 2 := card_quot_MInS

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.mem_of_index_le_two
statement:
theorem mem_of_index_le_two (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hidx : N.index ≤ 2) {g : Co3} (hg3 : g ^ 3 = 1) : g ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI : N.Normal := hN
  have hpos : N.index ≠ 0 := Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
  have hcard : Nat.card (Co3 ⧸ N) = N.index :=
    (Subgroup.index_eq_card N).symm
  haveI : Finite (Co3 ⧸ N) := Quotient.finite _
  have h2 : (QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N) ^ N.index = 1 := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact pow_card_eq_one'
  have h3 : (QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N) ^ 3 = 1 := by
    rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, hg3]
    rfl
  have hone : (QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N) = 1 := by
    have hor : N.index = 1 ∨ N.index = 2 := by omega
    rcases hor with h | h
    · rw [h, pow_one] at h2
      exact h2
    · rw [h] at h2
      calc (QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N)
          = ((QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N) ^ 3) *
              (((QuotientGroup.mk g : Co3 ⧸ N) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
            group
        _ = 1 := by
            rw [h3, h2]
            simp
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mp hone

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.eq_top_of_contains_gens
statement:
theorem eq_top_of_contains_gens (N : Subgroup Co3)
    (ha : (⟨co3a, co3a_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
    (hb : (⟨co3b, co3b_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
    (hc : (⟨co3c, co3c_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
    (hd : (⟨co3d, co3d_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
    (he : (⟨co3e, co3e_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
    (hf : (⟨co3f, co3f_mem⟩ : Co3) ∈ N) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  have key : ∀ y, y ∈ Co3Subgroup → ∀ hy : y ∈ Co3Subgroup,
      (⟨y, hy⟩ : Co3) ∈ N := by
    intro y hy0
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun z _ => ∀ hz : z ∈ Co3Subgroup, (⟨z, hz⟩ : Co3) ∈ N)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hy0
    · intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · intro hz'
        exact ha
      · intro hz'
        exact hb
      · intro hz'
        exact hc
      · intro hz'
        exact hd
      · intro hz'
        exact he
      · intro hz'
        exact hf
    · intro hz'
      have h1 : (⟨1, hz'⟩ : Co3) = 1 := rfl
      rw [h1]
      exact N.one_mem
    · intro u v hu hv ihu ihv hz'
      have hm : (⟨u * v, hz'⟩ : Co3) = ⟨u, hu⟩ * ⟨v, hv⟩ := rfl
      rw [hm]
      exact N.mul_mem (ihu hu) (ihv hv)
    · intro u hu ihu hz'
      have hi : (⟨u⁻¹, hz'⟩ : Co3) = (⟨u, hu⟩ : Co3)⁻¹ := rfl
      rw [hi]
      exact N.inv_mem (ihu hu)
  exact key x hx hx

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.top_case
statement:
theorem top_case (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (inf : Fin 276) = Set.univ)
    (ht : (N.subgroupOf MInCo3) = ⊤) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hMN : MInCo3 ≤ N := by
    intro g hg
    have hmem : (⟨g, hg⟩ : MInCo3) ∈ N.subgroupOf MInCo3 := by
      rw [ht]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top _
    exact Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hmem
  have hcardN := card_normal_eq_276_mul_stab N horbit
  rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
  have hMle : (898128000 : ℕ) ≤ Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf) := by
    have hle : MInS ≤ N.subgroupOf SInf := by
      intro g hg
      exact Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mpr
        (hMN (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hg))
    have hc := Subgroup.card_le_of_le hle
    rw [card_MInS] at hc
    exact hc
  have hNcard : 247883328000 ≤ Nat.card N := by
    rw [hcardN]
    omega
  have hidx : N.index ≤ 2 := by
    have hmul := Subgroup.card_mul_index N
    rw [card_co3] at hmul
    by_contra hgt
    push Not at hgt
    nlinarith [hNcard, hmul, hgt]
  refine eq_top_of_contains_gens N
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3a_cube))
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3b_cube))
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3c_cube))
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3d_cube))
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3e_cube))
    (mem_of_index_le_two N hN hidx (Subtype.ext co3f_cube))

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.regular_case_absurd
statement:
theorem regular_case_absurd (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal)
    (horbit : MulAction.orbit N (inf : Fin 276) = Set.univ)
    (hcard : Nat.card N = 276) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcardstab :
      Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer N (inf : Fin 276)) = 1 := by
    have h := card_normal_eq_276_mul_stab N horbit
    rw [hcard] at h
    omega
  have hstabtriv : ∀ n : N, n.1.1 inf = inf → n = 1 := by
    intro n hfix
    have hmem : n ∈ MulAction.stabilizer N (inf : Fin 276) := by
      rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hfix
    haveI : Subsingleton (MulAction.stabilizer N (inf : Fin 276)) :=
      (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hcardstab).1
    have h := Subsingleton.elim
      (⟨n, hmem⟩ : MulAction.stabilizer N (inf : Fin 276))
      ⟨1, (MulAction.stabilizer N (inf : Fin 276)).one_mem⟩
    exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp h
  have hevalinj : ∀ n m : N, n.1.1 inf = m.1.1 inf → n = m := by
    intro n m heq
    have hd : m⁻¹ * n = 1 := by
      apply hstabtriv
      show ((m⁻¹ * n : N) : Co3).1 inf = inf
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul]
      show ((m⁻¹ : N) : Co3).1 (n.1.1 inf) = inf
      rw [heq]
      have hcoe : ((m⁻¹ : N) : Co3) = (m.1)⁻¹ := rfl
      rw [hcoe]
      show ((m.1)⁻¹ : Co3).1 (m.1.1 inf) = inf
      simp
    exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hd).symm
  have hsameorder : ∀ n m : N, n ≠ 1 → m ≠ 1 →
      orderOf (n : N) = orderOf (m : N) := by
    intro n m hn hm
    have hnmoves : n.1.1 inf ≠ inf := fun h => hn (hstabtriv n h)
    have hmmoves : m.1.1 inf ≠ inf := fun h => hm (hstabtriv m h)
    obtain ⟨g, hgfix, hgmap⟩ := exists_stab_map hnmoves hmmoves
    have hconjN : g * n.1 * g⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem n.1 n.2 g
    have heval : (⟨g * n.1 * g⁻¹, hconjN⟩ : N).1.1 inf = m.1.1 inf := by
      show (g * n.1 * g⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf = _
      rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul]
      show g.1 (n.1.1 ((g⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf)) = _
      have hback : (g⁻¹ : Co3).1 inf = inf := by
        nth_rewrite 1 [← hgfix]
        simp
      rw [hback, hgmap]
    have hconj_eq : (⟨g * n.1 * g⁻¹, hconjN⟩ : N) = m :=
      hevalinj _ _ heval
    have horder : orderOf (⟨g * n.1 * g⁻¹, hconjN⟩ : N) =
        orderOf n := by
      have h1 : orderOf (⟨g * n.1 * g⁻¹, hconjN⟩ : N) =
          orderOf (g * n.1 * g⁻¹ : Co3) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype Subtype.val_injective
          (⟨g * n.1 * g⁻¹, hconjN⟩ : N)).symm
      have h2 : orderOf (n : N) = orderOf (n.1 : Co3) :=
        (orderOf_injective N.subtype Subtype.val_injective n).symm
      have h3 : orderOf (g * n.1 * g⁻¹ : Co3) = orderOf (n.1 : Co3) := by
        have h := orderOf_injective (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom
          (MulAut.conj g).injective n.1
        simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using h
      rw [h1, h3, h2]
    rw [← hconj_eq, horder]
  have h2dvd : (2 : ℕ) ∣ Fintype.card N := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
    norm_num
  have h3dvd : (3 : ℕ) ∣ Fintype.card N := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
    norm_num
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨by decide⟩
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  obtain ⟨n2, hn2⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 2 h2dvd
  obtain ⟨n3, hn3⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card (G := N) 3 h3dvd
  have hn2ne : n2 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at hn2
    omega
  have hn3ne : n3 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at hn3
    omega
  have h := hsameorder n2 n3 hn2ne hn3ne
  rw [hn2, hn3] at h
  omega

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.even_moved_of_involution
statement:
theorem even_moved_of_involution (x : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276))
    (hxx : ∀ v, x (x v) = v) :
    Even (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin 276 => x v ≠ v)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices h : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin 276)), (∀ v ∈ T, x v ∈ T) →
      (∀ v ∈ T, x v ≠ v) → Even T.card by
    apply h
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hv ⊢
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      rw [hxx v]
      exact fun hcon => hv.2 hcon.symm
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hv
      exact hv.2
  intro T
  induction T using Finset.strongInduction with
  | _ T ih =>
    intro hmaps hmoves
    rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty T with rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩
    · simp
    · have hxa : x a ∈ T := hmaps a ha
      have hne : x a ≠ a := hmoves a ha
      have hsub : (T.erase a).erase (x a) ⊂ T := by
        apply Finset.ssubset_of_subset_of_ssubset
          (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
        exact Finset.erase_ssubset ha
      have hmaps' : ∀ v ∈ (T.erase a).erase (x a),
          x v ∈ (T.erase a).erase (x a) := by
        intro v hv
        have hvT : v ∈ T :=
          Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hv)
        have hva : v ≠ a :=
          Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hv)
        have hvxa : v ≠ x a := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hv
        refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
          ⟨?_, hmaps v hvT⟩⟩
        · intro hcon
          apply hva
          have h := congrArg x hcon
          rw [hxx, hxx] at h
          exact h
        · intro hcon
          exact hvxa (x.injective (hcon.trans (hxx a).symm))
      have hmoves' : ∀ v ∈ (T.erase a).erase (x a), x v ≠ v :=
        fun v hv => hmoves v
          (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hv))
      have hcard : T.card = ((T.erase a).erase (x a)).card + 2 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem
          (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hxa⟩),
          Finset.card_erase_of_mem ha]
        have hpos : 0 < T.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a, ha⟩
        have h2 : 2 ≤ T.card := by
          have : ({a, x a} : Finset (Fin 276)) ⊆ T := by
            intro v hv
            rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
            · exact ha
            · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hv]
              exact hxa
          calc 2 = ({a, x a} : Finset (Fin 276)).card := by
                rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem
                  (by simpa using fun h => hne h.symm),
                  Finset.card_singleton]
            _ ≤ T.card := Finset.card_le_card this
        omega
      rw [hcard]
      exact (ih _ hsub hmaps' hmoves').add (by decide)

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.exists_lift_map_below
statement:
theorem exists_lift_map_below {v w : Fin 276} (hv : v.val < 275)
    (hw : w.val < 275) : ∃ m : McL, liftHom m.1 v = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1⟩ :=
    McLCertificates.ChainOrbits.first_orbit_witness ⟨v.val, hv⟩
  obtain ⟨m2, hm2⟩ :=
    McLCertificates.ChainOrbits.first_orbit_witness ⟨w.val, hw⟩
  refine ⟨m2 * m1⁻¹, ?_⟩
  have hback : (m1⁻¹ : McL).1 ⟨v.val, hv⟩ = (274 : Fin 275) := by
    rw [← hm1]
    simp
  have happ : (m2 * m1⁻¹ : McL).1 ⟨v.val, hv⟩ = ⟨w.val, hw⟩ := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul]
    show m2.1 ((m1⁻¹ : McL).1 ⟨v.val, hv⟩) = _
    rw [hback, hm2]
  exact lift_map_point _ hv hw happ

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.case552_absurd
statement:
theorem case552_absurd (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal)
    (hcardK : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf) = 2) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K := N.subgroupOf SInf with hK
  haveI : Fintype K := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcardK' : Fintype.card K = 2 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcardK]
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card
    (by omega : 1 < Fintype.card K) 1
  have hsq : ξ * ξ = 1 := by
    have h := pow_card_eq_one (G := K) (x := ξ)
    rw [hcardK'] at h
    rw [← pow_two, h]
  have hdichot : ∀ z : K, z = 1 ∨ z = ξ := by
    intro z
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hcard3 : 3 ≤ Fintype.card K := by
      have hsub : ({1, ξ, z} : Finset K) ⊆ Finset.univ :=
        Finset.subset_univ _
      have hc3 : ({1, ξ, z} : Finset K).card = 3 := by
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem,
          Finset.card_singleton]
        · simpa using fun h => hcon.2 h.symm
        · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
          push Not
          exact ⟨fun h => hξ h.symm, fun h => hcon.1 h.symm⟩
      calc 3 = ({1, ξ, z} : Finset K).card := hc3.symm
        _ ≤ Finset.univ.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ = Fintype.card K := Finset.card_univ
    omega
  
  set x : Co3 := ξ.1.1 with hx
  have hxN : x ∈ N := Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp ξ.2
  have hxS : x ∈ SInf := ξ.1.2
  have hxne : x ≠ 1 := by
    intro hcon
    apply hξ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hcon
  have hxsq : x * x = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : K => z.1.1) hsq
    simpa [hx, Subgroup.coe_mul] using h
  have hxfix : x.1 inf = inf := by
    have h := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hxS
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
  
  have hcomm : ∀ s : Co3, s ∈ SInf → s * x * s⁻¹ = x := by
    intro s hs
    have hnorm : K.Normal := hN.subgroupOf SInf
    have hξK : ξ.1 ∈ K := ξ.2
    have hconj : (⟨s, hs⟩ : SInf) * ξ.1 * (⟨s, hs⟩ : SInf)⁻¹ ∈ K :=
      hnorm.conj_mem ξ.1 hξK ⟨s, hs⟩
    rcases hdichot ⟨_, hconj⟩ with h1 | h1
    · exfalso
      apply hxne
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : K => z.1.1) h1
      simp only at hv
      have hv' : s * x * s⁻¹ = 1 := by
        simpa [hx, Subgroup.coe_mul] using hv
      have hx1 : x = s⁻¹ * (s * x * s⁻¹) * s := by
        group
      rw [hv'] at hx1
      simpa using hx1
    · have hv := congrArg (fun z : K => z.1.1) h1
      simpa [hx, Subgroup.coe_mul] using hv
  
  have hxbelow : ∀ {v : Fin 276}, v.val < 275 → x.1 v = v →
      ∀ {w : Fin 276}, w.val < 275 → x.1 w = w := by
    intro v hv hfixv w hw
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_lift_map_below hv hw
    have hsmem : mclToCo3 m ∈ SInf := M_le_SInf (mclToCo3_mem m)
    have hcm := hcomm (mclToCo3 m) hsmem
    have hmul : (mclToCo3 m) * x = x * (mclToCo3 m) :=
      mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp hcm
    have hpt := congrArg (fun z : Co3 => z.1 v) hmul
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] at hpt
    rw [hfixv] at hpt
    have hlift : (mclToCo3 m).1 v = liftHom m.1 v := rfl
    rw [hlift, hm] at hpt
    exact hpt.symm
  
  have hmoved := even_moved_of_involution x.1 (by
    intro v
    have h := congrArg (fun z : Co3 => z.1 v) hxsq
    simpa [Subgroup.coe_mul] using h)
  by_cases hfixsome : ∃ v : Fin 276, v.val < 275 ∧ x.1 v = v
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hfixv⟩ := hfixsome
    apply hxne
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w.val < 275
    · exact hxbelow hv hfixv hw
    · have h275 : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
      have hweq : w = inf := Fin.ext (by have := w.isLt; omega)
      rw [hweq, hxfix]
      rfl
  · push Not at hfixsome
    have hmovedset : Finset.univ.filter
        (fun v : Fin 276 => x.1 v ≠ v) = belowSet := by
      ext v
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨-, hmove⟩
        by_contra hcon
        have hvinf : v = inf := by
          have hval : ¬ v.val < 275 := by
            intro hlt
            apply hcon
            simp [belowSet, hlt]
          have h275 : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
          exact Fin.ext (by have := v.isLt; omega)
        rw [hvinf] at hmove
        exact hmove hxfix
      · intro hv
        have hval : v.val < 275 := by
          simpa [belowSet] using hv
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hfixsome v hval⟩
    rw [hmovedset, belowSet_card] at hmoved
    exact (by decide : ¬ Even 275) hmoved

name: Sporadic.Co3Simplicity.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup Co3) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have horbit := normal_orbit_inf_eq_univ N hN hnN hp
  haveI : IsSimpleGroup MInCo3 := isSimpleGroup_M
  have hnormal : (N.subgroupOf MInCo3).Normal := hN.subgroupOf MInCo3
  rcases hnormal.eq_bot_or_eq_top with hb | ht
  · exfalso
    have hcardN := card_normal_eq_276_mul_stab N horbit
    rw [card_stabInN_eq] at hcardN
    have hle := stab_card_le_two N hb
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf) := Nat.card_pos
    have hor : Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf) = 1 ∨
        Nat.card (N.subgroupOf SInf) = 2 := by omega
    rcases hor with h | h
    · apply regular_case_absurd N hN horbit
      rw [hcardN, h]
    · exact case552_absurd N hN h
  · exact top_case N hN horbit ht

name: Sporadic.Co3Restrict.below_mem
statement:
theorem below_mem {g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)} (hfix : g inf = inf)
    (v : Fin 276) (hv : v.val < 275) : (g v).val < 275
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (g v).val 275 with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have h276 := (g v).isLt
    have hgv : g v = inf := Fin.ext (by
      have : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
      omega)
    have := g.injective (hgv.trans hfix.symm)
    rw [this] at hv
    have : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
    omega

name: Sporadic.Co3Restrict.lift_restr
statement:
theorem lift_restr (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) (hfix : g inf = inf) :
    liftHom (restr g hfix) = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v.val < 275
  · rw [lift_apply_below (restr g hfix) v hv]
    apply Fin.ext
    show ((restr g hfix) ⟨v.val, hv⟩ : Fin 275).val = (g v).val
    show (g ⟨v.val, _⟩ : Fin 276).val = (g v).val
    congr 1
  · have h275 : (inf : Fin 276).val = 275 := rfl
    have hveq : v = inf := Fin.ext (by omega)
    subst hveq
    rw [lift_fixes_inf, hfix]

name: Sporadic.Co3Restrict.restr_preserves
proof:
:= by
  have hadj : ∀ q r : Fin 276, adjB (g q) (g r) = adjB q r := by
    intro q r
    rw [adjB_eq_twoG_inf q r, adjB_eq_twoG_inf (g q) (g r)]
    have h := hg q r inf
    rw [hfix] at h
    exact h
  intro v
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    have hv6lt : (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276).val < 275 := v.isLt
    have hu6lt : (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276).val < 275 := u.isLt
    have hu' : adjB (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ⟨u.val, by omega⟩ =
        true := by
      rw [adjB_below (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)
        (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) hv6lt hu6lt]
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      have hveq : (⟨(⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276).val, hv6lt⟩ :
          Fin 275) = v := Fin.ext rfl
      have hueq : (⟨(⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276).val, hu6lt⟩ :
          Fin 275) = u := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hveq, hueq]
      exact mem_nbrs_iff.mp hu
    have himg := hadj (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ⟨u.val, by omega⟩
    rw [hu'] at himg
    have hgv : (g (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)).val < 275 :=
      below_mem hfix (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) hv6lt
    have hgu : (g (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)).val < 275 :=
      below_mem hfix (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) hu6lt
    rw [adjB_below (g (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276))
      (g (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)) hgv hgu] at himg
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at himg
    apply mem_nbrs_iff.mpr
    have hrv : ((restr g hfix) v : Fin 275) =
        ⟨(g (⟨v.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)).val, hgv⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    have hru : ((restr g hfix) u : Fin 275) =
        ⟨(g (⟨u.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)).val, hgu⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hrv, hru]
    exact himg
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (restr g hfix).injective]
    rw [nbrs_card_all v, nbrs_card_all ((restr g hfix) v)]

name: Sporadic.Co3Cardinality.stabBase_toPerm_mem
statement: theorem stabBase_toPerm_mem (g : CStabBase) : toPerm g ∈ tailPerms4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hInf, h274, h0, h1, h6, h4⟩ := stabBase_fixes g
  have hpres : PreservesNbrs (restr (toPerm g) hInf) :=
    restr_preserves (co3_preserves_twoG _ (toPerm_mem g)) hInf
  have hres := Co3Residual.fixed_base_cases4 (restr (toPerm g) hInf) hpres
    (restr_fix hInf i274_lt h274) (restr_fix hInf i0_lt h0)
    (restr_fix hInf i1_lt h1) (restr_fix hInf i6_lt h6)
    (restr_fix hInf i4_lt h4)
  have hlift := lift_restr (toPerm g) hInf
  rcases hres with h | h | h | h
  · have : toPerm g = 1 := by
      rw [← hlift, h]
      exact map_one liftHom
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  · have : toPerm g = tC := by
      rw [← hlift, h]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  · have : toPerm g = tauC := by
      rw [← hlift, h]
      exact lift_outer0
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
  · have : toPerm g = tauC⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hlift, h]
      rw [McLCertificates.EdgeParity.outerComp1_eq_inv, map_inv,
        lift_outer0]
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)))

  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have himg : Finset.univ.image toPerm ⊆ tailPerms4 := by
    intro x hx

name: Sporadic.Co3Cardinality.tailPerms4_nodup
statement:
theorem tailPerms4_nodup :
    ([1, tC, tauC, tauC⁻¹] : List (Equiv.Perm (Fin 276))).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ∀ (a b : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) (w : Fin 276),
      a w ≠ b w → a ≠ b := by
    intro a b w hne h
    exact hne (congrArg (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276) => σ w) h)
  have h1t : (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) ≠ tC := by
    refine hval _ _ (⟨16, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ?_
    show (⟨16, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ≠
      liftHom McLCertificates.EdgeParity.tailPerm1 ⟨16, by omega⟩
    decide +kernel
  have h1tau : (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) ≠ tauC := by
    refine hval _ _ (⟨8, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ?_
    decide +kernel
  have h1taui : (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) ≠ tauC⁻¹ := by
    intro h
    have h' := congrArg Inv.inv h
    rw [inv_one, inv_inv] at h'
    exact h1tau h'
  have httau : tC ≠ tauC := by
    refine hval _ _ (⟨8, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) ?_
    show liftHom McLCertificates.EdgeParity.tailPerm1 ⟨8, by omega⟩ ≠
      tauC ⟨8, by omega⟩
    decide +kernel
  have httaui : tC ≠ tauC⁻¹ := by
    intro h
    have h8 := congrArg (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276) => tauC (σ ⟨8, by omega⟩)) h
    revert h8
    show ¬ (tauC (tC ⟨8, by omega⟩) = tauC (tauC⁻¹ ⟨8, by omega⟩))
    have hsimp : tauC (tauC⁻¹ (⟨8, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)) =
        (⟨8, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) := Equiv.apply_symm_apply tauC _
    rw [hsimp]
    show ¬ (tauC (liftHom McLCertificates.EdgeParity.tailPerm1
      ⟨8, by omega⟩) = _)
    decide +kernel
  have htautaui : tauC ≠ tauC⁻¹ := by
    intro h
    have h16 := congrArg
      (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276) => tauC (σ ⟨16, by omega⟩)) h
    revert h16
    show ¬ (tauC (tauC ⟨16, by omega⟩) = tauC (tauC⁻¹ ⟨16, by omega⟩))
    have hsimp : tauC (tauC⁻¹ (⟨16, by omega⟩ : Fin 276)) =
        (⟨16, by omega⟩ : Fin 276) := Equiv.apply_symm_apply tauC _
    rw [hsimp]
    decide +kernel
  have hm1 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 276)) ∉ [tC, tauC, tauC⁻¹] := by
    intro hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact h1t h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact h1tau h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact h1taui h
    · simp at hmem
  have hm2 : tC ∉ [tauC, tauC⁻¹] := by
    intro hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact httau h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact httaui h
    · simp at hmem
  have hm3 : tauC ∉ [tauC⁻¹] := by
    intro hmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | hmem
    · exact htautaui h
    · simp at hmem
  exact List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hm1, List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hm2,
    List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hm3, List.nodup_singleton _⟩⟩⟩

proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Shards.co3f_desc_000_006

name: Sporadic.Co2.isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
statement:
theorem isPreprimitive_of_three_suborbits
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [Finite X] [IsPretransitive G X]
    {a : X} {Δ Γ : Set X}
    (hcover : insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) = Set.univ)
    (haΔ : a ∉ Δ) (haΓ : a ∉ Γ)
    (hΔ : ∀ x ∈ Δ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Δ)
    (hΓ : ∀ x ∈ Γ, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = Γ)
    (hΔdvd : ¬ (Δ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X))
    (hΓdvd : ¬ (Γ.ncard + 1 ∣ Nat.card X)) :
    IsPreprimitive G X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPreprimitive.of_isTrivialBlock_base a
  intro B haB hB
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ B, orbit (stabilizer G a) x ⊆ B := by
    rintro x hx y ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hs : (s : G) • B = B := hB.stabilizer_le haB s.2
    have : (s : G) • x ∈ (s : G) • B := Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx
    rw [hs] at this
    exact this
  have key : ∀ S : Set X, (∀ x ∈ S, orbit (stabilizer G a) x = S) →
      (S ∩ B).Nonempty → S ⊆ B := by
    rintro S hS ⟨x, hxS, hxB⟩
    rw [← hS x hxS]
    exact hsub x hxB
  have hmem : ∀ x, x = a ∨ x ∈ Δ ∨ x ∈ Γ := by
    intro x
    have : x ∈ insert a (Δ ∪ Γ) := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    simpa [or_assoc] using this
  by_cases hd : (Δ ∩ B).Nonempty <;> by_cases hg : (Γ ∩ B).Nonempty
  · right
    refine Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset ?_
    rw [← hcover]
    exact Set.insert_subset haB (Set.union_subset (key Δ hΔ hd) (key Γ hΓ hg))
  · exfalso
    have hBΓ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Γ := fun x hx hxΓ => hg ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Δ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΔ
        · exact absurd hxΓ (hBΓ x hx)
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Δ hΔ hd)
    apply hΔdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΔ] at this
  · exfalso
    have hBΔ : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∉ Δ := fun x hx hxΔ => hd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩
    have hBeq : B = insert a Γ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
        · exact absurd hxΔ (hBΔ x hx)
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hxΓ
      · exact Set.insert_subset haB (key Γ hΓ hg)
    apply hΓdvd
    have := hB.ncard_dvd_card ⟨a, haB⟩
    rwa [hBeq, Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem haΓ] at this
  · left
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases hmem x with rfl | hxΔ | hxΓ
    · rcases hmem y with rfl | hyΔ | hyΓ
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΔ, hy⟩ hd
      · exact absurd ⟨y, hyΓ, hy⟩ hg
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΔ, hx⟩ hd
    · exact absurd ⟨x, hxΓ, hx⟩ hg

name: Sporadic.Co2.isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot
    {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] [FaithfulSMul G X]
    [IsPreprimitive G X] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    IsPretransitive N X
proof:
:= by
  apply IsQuasiPreprimitive.isPretransitive_of_normal (N := N)
  intro hfix
  apply hN
  rw [Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall]
  intro n hn
  apply eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := X)
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ fixedPoints N X := by rw [hfix]; trivial
  simpa using hx ⟨n, hn⟩

theorem card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive
    {N X : Type*} [Group N] [MulAction N X] [IsPretransitive N X] (x : X) :
    Nat.card X ∣ Nat.card N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← index_stabilizer_of_transitive N x]
  exact (stabilizer N x).index_dvd_card

name: Sporadic.Co2.factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h1 : p ∣ n) (h2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ n) : n.factorization p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; simpa using h1
  have hb : ¬ 2 ≤ n.factorization p := by
    rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]; exact h2
  omega

name: Sporadic.Co2.mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
statement:
theorem mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (N : Subgroup G) [hN : N.Normal]
    (hpN : p ∣ Nat.card N) (hp2 : ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ Nat.card G)
    {g : G} (hg : orderOf g = p) : g ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hG0 : Nat.card G ≠ 0 := Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hpG : p ∣ Nat.card G := hpN.trans N.card_subgroup_dvd_card
  have hfac : (Nat.card G).factorization p = 1 :=
    factorization_eq_one_of_sq_not_dvd hp.out hG0 hpG hp2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := N) p hpN
  have hyG : orderOf (y : G) = p := (Subgroup.orderOf_coe y).trans hy
  have hcardQ : Nat.card (zpowers (y : G)) = p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hyG, hfac, pow_one]
  have hcardP : Nat.card (zpowers g) = p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, hg, hfac, pow_one]
  set Q : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers (y : G)) hcardQ with hQ
  set P : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard (zpowers g) hcardP with hP
  have hQN : (Q : Subgroup G) ≤ N := by
    rw [hQ, Sylow.coe_ofCard, zpowers_le]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G Q P
  have hgP : g ∈ (P : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [hP, Sylow.coe_ofCard]; exact mem_zpowers g
  rw [← hc] at hgP
  have hgQ : (MulAut.conj c)⁻¹ • g ∈ (Q : Subgroup G) := by
    rw [← Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    exact hgP
  have hmem : c⁻¹ * g * c ∈ N := by
    refine hQN ?_
    simpa [MulAut.conj, mul_assoc] using hgQ
  have := hN.conj_mem _ hmem c
  simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: Sporadic.Co2.closure_gens
statement: theorem closure_gens : Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : Perm2300) (hx : x ∈ K0),
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y hy => (⟨y, hy⟩ : K0T) ∈ Subgroup.closure ({gA, gB} : Set K0T))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gA])
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp [gB])
    · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ ihy ihz
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ ihy ihz
    · intro y _ ihy
      exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ ihy
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  exact key x hx

name: Sporadic.Co2.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup K0T) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  refine Or.inr ?_
  haveI := hN
  haveI : IsPretransitive N (Fin 2300) :=
    isPretransitive_of_normal_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have h2300 : (2300 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := by
    have := card_dvd_card_of_pretransitive (N := N) (X := Fin 2300) 0
    rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at this
  have h23 : (23 : ℕ) ∣ Nat.card N := dvd_trans (by decide) h2300
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← closure_gens, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 23) N h23 sq23_not_dvd orderOf_gA
  · exact mem_of_orderOf_eq_prime (p := 23) N h23 sq23_not_dvd orderOf_gB

statement: theorem simple_sub : IsSimpleGroup Co2Subgroup
proof:
:=
  letI := nontrivial_sub
  { exists_pair_ne := nontrivial_sub.exists_pair_ne
    eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_normal := fun N hN => normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top N hN }

name: Sporadic.Co2.sift_sound0_0
proof:
:= by

    intro x
    have hp := siftPt0_0 z hz0 x
    change tInvApp0 (co2aApp z) (co2aApp (tApp0 z x)) = _
    rw [hp, siftProd_apply]
    exact tApp0_left _ _
  rw [heq]
  exact siftProd_mem0 _ (facLv0_0 z)

theorem stabLast_subsingleton :
    ∀ g h : MulAction.stabilizer K9T (9 : Fin 2300), g = h
proof:
:= by

  have hg := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2300)) hO9 hSch9 (by decide) T9_base
    g.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  have hh := SimsChain.mem_of_fixes_base
    (K := (⊥ : Subgroup Perm2300)) hO9 hSch9 (by decide) T9_base
    h.1.2 (by
      have := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp h.2
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def] using this)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg hh
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hg, hh]

    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]

      rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]

name: Sporadic.Co2.TGamma_eq_word
statement: theorem TGamma_eq_word (z : Fin 2300) : TGamma z = TGammaWord z
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 2300) (i : ℕ) => (sList1.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp1 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp1_eq i y
  rw [TGamma_apply, TGammaWord, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.Co2.TGamma_memK
statement: theorem TGamma_memK : ∀ z, TGamma z ∈ K1
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [TGamma_eq_word, TGammaWord]
  exact SimsChain.foldl_getD_mem K1 sList1 sList1_mem
    (gammaPath z) 1 K1.one_mem

name: Sporadic.Co2.tGammaMaps_all
statement: theorem tGammaMaps_all : ∀ u : Fin 2300, tGammaMapsRow u = true
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 460 with h1 | h1
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 460 0 tGammaMapsOk0 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 920 with h2 | h2
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 460 460 tGammaMapsOk1 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1380 with h3 | h3
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 460 920 tGammaMapsOk2 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 1840 with h4 | h4
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 460 1380 tGammaMapsOk3 u (by omega) (by omega)
  exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 460 1840 tGammaMapsOk4 u (by omega) (by omega)

name: Sporadic.Co2.TGamma_maps
statement: theorem TGamma_maps : ∀ z ∈ gammaSet, TGamma z (556 : Fin 2300) = z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have h := tGammaMaps_all z
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
  · rw [mem_gamma.mp hz] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact eq_of_beq h2

name: Sporadic.Co2.orbit_gamma
statement: theorem orbit_gamma : orbit K1T (556 : Fin 2300) = ↑gammaSet
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hy : (g : Perm2300) (556 : Fin 2300) ∈ gammaSet := by
      rcases suborbit_cover_pt ((g : Perm2300) (556 : Fin 2300)) with h | h | h
      · 
        exfalso
        have h0 : (g : Perm2300) (0 : Fin 2300) = 0 := K1_fix_b0 g g.2
        have : (((556 : Fin 2300)) : Fin 2300) = 0 :=
          (g : Perm2300).injective (by rw [h, h0])
        exact absurd this (by decide)
      · 
        exfalso
        apply gamma_pt_notin_orbit1
        have hmem : (g : Perm2300) (556 : Fin 2300) ∈ orbit1Set := mem_orbit1.mpr h
        have h1 : ((g : Perm2300) (556 : Fin 2300) : Fin 2300) ∈ orbit K1T (1 : Fin 2300) := by
          rw [orbit_eq1]; exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hmem
        have h2 : (556 : Fin 2300) ∈ orbit K1T (1 : Fin 2300) := by
          have := (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff (a := (g : Perm2300) (556 : Fin 2300))
            (b := (1 : Fin 2300)) (G := K1T)).mpr h1
          rw [← this]
          exact ⟨g⁻¹, by
            simp [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def,
              Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩
        rw [orbit_eq1] at h2
        exact Finset.mem_coe.mp h2
      · exact mem_gamma.mpr h
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hy
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨⟨TGamma y, TGamma_memK y⟩, ?_⟩
    have := TGamma_maps y (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using this

name: Sporadic.Co2.orbit_gamma_of_mem
statement: theorem orbit_gamma_of_mem : ∀ x ∈ gammaSet, orbit K1T x = ↑gammaSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_gamma]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_gamma]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.Co2.orbit_delta_of_mem
statement: theorem orbit_delta_of_mem : ∀ x ∈ orbit1Set, orbit K1T x = ↑orbit1Set
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← orbit_eq1]
  refine (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff).mpr ?_
  rw [orbit_eq1]
  exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx

name: Sporadic.Co2.anyT_apply
statement:
theorem anyT_apply (j : Nat) (y : Nat) (x : Fin 2300) :
    anyT j y x = anyTApp j y x
proof:
:= by
  match j with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | 5 => rfl
  | 6 => rfl
  | 7 => rfl
  | 8 => rfl
  | 9 => rfl
  | n + 10 => rfl

name: Sporadic.Co2.siftProd_apply
statement:
theorem siftProd_apply (l : List (Nat × Nat)) (x : Fin 2300) :
    siftProd l x = siftProdApp l x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [siftProd, siftProdApp, List.foldr_cons]
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      show anyT a.1 a.2 (siftProd rest x) = _
      rw [ih, anyT_apply]
      rfl

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm100}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Graph.J2_preserves_nbrs
statement: theorem J2_preserves_nbrs (g : J2) : PreservesNbrs g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact j2a_preserves_nbrs
      · exact j2b_preserves_nbrs
      · exact j2c_preserves_nbrs
      · exact j2d_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    g.2

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm100) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 100} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) : π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm100) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 100} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) : π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_star_eq_univ
statement: theorem orbit_star_eq_univ : MulAction.orbit J2 (99 : Fin 100) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_J2_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.ChainOrbits.second_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100) (hx : x ∈ nbrs 99) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer J2 (99 : Fin 100), g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨starStabilizerElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelTwoWord x)) (0 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelTwoWord_maps_0_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab99_orbit_zero_eq
statement:
theorem stab99_orbit_zero_eq :
    MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer J2 (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100) =
      ↑(nbrs 99)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix : g.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hx : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1 (J2_preserves_nbrs g.1) hfix (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100) (hx : x ∈ orb42Set) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer J2 (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100),
      g.1.1.1 (38 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab990Element x hx, by

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab990_orbit_38_eq
statement:
theorem stab990_orbit_38_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer J2 (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
        (38 : Fin 100) =
      ↑orb42Set
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix99 : g.1.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1 (38 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs g.1.1.1 := J2_preserves_nbrs g.1.1

      not_mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1 hpres hfix99 (by decide)

    have hne0 : g.1.1.1 (38 : Fin 100) ≠ 0 :=

      pin_orb42 _ hn99 hne99 hn0 hne0

    rw [← secMap_mul]

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Families.preservesFamilies_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    rw [secMap_mul]
    exact hg.1.1 _ (mem_secantList_of_mem (hh.1.1 s hs))
  · intro s hs
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, secMap_mul]
    exact hh.1.2 _ (mem_secantList_of_mem (hg.1.2 s hs))
  · intro F hF
    rw [famMap_mul]
    exact hg.2.1 _ (mem_famList_of_mem (hh.2.1 F hF))
  · intro F hF
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, famMap_mul]
    exact hh.2.2 _ (mem_famList_of_mem (hg.2.2 F hF))

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Families.preservesFamilies_inv
statement:
theorem preservesFamilies_inv {g : Perm28}
    (hg : PreservesFamilies g) : PreservesFamilies g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨hg.1.2, ?_⟩, hg.2.2, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hg.1.1
  · simpa using hg.2.1

name: Sporadic.J2Certificates.Families.U33_preserves_families
statement:
theorem U33_preserves_families {g : Perm28} (hg : g ∈ U33Subgroup) :
    PreservesFamilies g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => PreservesFamilies x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e1, forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e1Inv⟩,
        forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e1, forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e2, forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e2Inv⟩,
        forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e2, forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e2Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e3, forall_sec_of_at _ _ secMap_e3Inv⟩,
        forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e3, forall_fam_of_at _ _ famMap_e3Inv⟩
  · exact preservesFamilies_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact preservesFamilies_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact preservesFamilies_inv hx

name: Sporadic.U33.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 28) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : U33Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toU33 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 28) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 28) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set B := Word.toU33 (zeroStabWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 28) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_fixes_zero_all z hz0
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 28) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_maps_one_all z hz0
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U33.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 28) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : U33Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U33.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup U33Subgroup) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 28, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.U33.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup U33Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U33Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 28} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 28) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U33.T0_le_U33
statement: theorem T0_le_U33 : T0 ≤ U33Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [T0, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  exact transvection_zero_mem k

name: Sporadic.U33.transvection_zero_mem_T0
statement: theorem transvection_zero_mem_T0 (k : Fin 2) : transvectionAt 0 k ∈ T0

name: Sporadic.U33.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (transvectionAt 0 k) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
      exact transvection_comm_zero k k'
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.U33.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N : Subgroup U33Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 28, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (g : U33Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : U33Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 28) (k : Fin 2) (hxe : x = transvectionAt c k)
        (hmem : x ∈ U33Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : U33Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c k hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans 0 c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (mapsTransvections_of_mem m.2).2 c k
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      
      set t : U33Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm28) = transvectionAt 0 k' := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact transvection_zero_mem_T0 k'
      set n : U33Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key 0 0 u33e1_eq_transvection _
    · exact key 1 0 u33e2_eq_transvection _
    · exact key 4 0 u33e3_eq_transvection _
  · 
    refine ⟨1, N.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · 
    rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : U33Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U33Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹), N.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · 
    rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : U33Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U33Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.U33.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N : Subgroup U33Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 28, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (a b : U33Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : U33Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.U33.gen1_commutator
statement:
theorem gen1_commutator :
    (⟨u33e1, u33e1_mem⟩ : U33Subgroup) =
      ⁅(⟨commU1, commU1_mem⟩ : U33Subgroup), ⟨commV1, commV1_mem⟩⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change u33e1 = commU1 * commV1 * commU1⁻¹ * commV1⁻¹

name: Sporadic.U33.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : U33Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : U33Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup)⁆) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (⟨u33e1, _⟩ : U33Subgroup) = ⟨u33e1, u33e1_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen1_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u33e2, _⟩ : U33Subgroup) = ⟨u33e2, u33e2_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen2_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u33e3, _⟩ : U33Subgroup) = ⟨u33e3, u33e3_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen3_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.U33.u33e1_ne_one
statement: theorem u33e1_ne_one : u33e1 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by

    rfl
  exact absurd h0 (by decide)

name: Sporadic.U33.nontrivial_U33
statement: theorem nontrivial_U33 : Nontrivial U33Subgroup
proof:

  intro h
  exact u33e1_ne_one (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: Sporadic.U33.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup U33Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 28, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v :=
    fun u v => normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp u v
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U33Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

name: Sporadic.U33.stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero :
    MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 28) = {x : Fin 28 | x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 28) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 28) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 28) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 28) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.U33.stab0_orbit_one_ncard

    (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 28)).ncard = 27
proof:

  rw [stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 28 | x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 28)) = ({0} : Set (Fin 28))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group U33Subgroup (0 : Fin 28)]

name: Sporadic.U33.mapsTransvections_one
statement: theorem mapsTransvections_one : MapsTransvections 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro c k <;> exact ⟨k, by simp⟩

name: Sporadic.U33.mapsTransvections_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hh.1 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hg.1 (h c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : g * h * transvectionAt c k * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * transvectionAt c k * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    rfl
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hg.2 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hh.2 (g⁻¹ c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ * transvectionAt c k * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c k * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ c = h⁻¹ (g⁻¹ c) := rfl
    rw [this]

name: Sporadic.U33.mapsTransvections_inv
statement:
theorem mapsTransvections_inv {g : Perm28}
    (hg : MapsTransvections g) : MapsTransvections g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.2 c k
    exact ⟨k', by simpa using hk'⟩
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.1 c k
    refine ⟨k', ?_⟩
    simpa using hk'

name: Sporadic.U33.conj_letter_maps
statement:
theorem conj_letter_maps (g : Perm28)
    (idx : Fin 28 → Fin 2 → Fin 2) (idxInv : Fin 28 → Fin 2 → Fin 2)
    (h : ∀ (c : Fin 28) (k : Fin 2),
      g * transvectionAt c k * g⁻¹ = transvectionAt (g c) (idx c k))
    (hinv : ∀ (c : Fin 28) (k : Fin 2),
      g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c k * g = transvectionAt (g⁻¹ c) (idxInv c k)) :
    MapsTransvections g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c k => ⟨idx c k, h c k⟩, fun c k => ⟨idxInv c k, hinv c k⟩⟩

name: Sporadic.U33.mapsTransvections_of_mem
statement:
theorem mapsTransvections_of_mem {g : Perm28} (hg : g ∈ U33Subgroup) :
    MapsTransvections g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => MapsTransvections x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact conj_letter_maps _ _ _ conj_e1 conj_e1Inv
    · exact conj_letter_maps _ _ _ conj_e2 conj_e2Inv
    · exact conj_letter_maps _ _ _ conj_e3 conj_e3Inv
  · exact mapsTransvections_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact mapsTransvections_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact mapsTransvections_inv hx

name: Sporadic.U33.transvectionZeroWord_eval
statement:
theorem transvectionZeroWord_eval :
    ∀ k : Fin 2, Word.eval (transvectionZeroWord k) = transvectionAt 0 k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  apply Equiv.ext

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.representativePerm_orderOf_eq
statement:
theorem representativePerm_orderOf_eq : ∀ i : Fin 10,
    orderOf (representativePerm i) = classElementOrder i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  apply orderOf_eq_of_pow_and_pow_div_prime
  · fin_cases i <;> decide
  · exact representativePerm_pow_order_eq_one i
  · intro p hp hd
    fin_cases i
    · exfalso
      exact hp.not_dvd_one (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
    · have hp_eq : p = 2 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp
          (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 3 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_three).mp
          (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 2 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp
          (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (m := 2) (n := 2)
            (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd))
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 5 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_five).mp
          (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by
        have h : p ∣ 2 * 3 := by
          simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd
        rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp h with h2 | h3
        · exact Or.inl ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp h2)
        · exact Or.inr ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_three).mp h3)
      rcases hp_eq with rfl | rfl <;> decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 2 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp
          (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (m := 2) (n := 3)
            (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd))
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 2 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp
          (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (m := 2) (n := 3)
            (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd))
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 11 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_eleven).mp
          (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
      subst p
      decide
    · have hp_eq : p = 11 := by
        exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_eleven).mp
          (by simpa [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList] using hd)
      subst p
      decide

statement:
theorem rep5A_ambientAlternatingCentralizer_card :
    Nat.card (RepresentativeAmbientAlternatingCentralizer rep5AIndex) = 25
proof:
:= by
  have hker_mul :
      Nat.card (representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom rep5AIndex).ker * 2 = 50 := by
    have h :=
      (representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom rep5AIndex).ker.card_mul_index
    rw [Subgroup.index_ker,
      representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom_range_card_of_odd rep5AIndex
        ⟨rep5AOddCentralizerWitness, rep5AOddCentralizerWitness_mem_ambient⟩
        rep5AOddCentralizerWitness_sign] at h
    have hambient : Nat.card (RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep5AIndex) = 50 := by
      simpa [rep5AIndex, ambientCentralizerOrder, ambientCentralizerOrderList]
        using representativeAmbientCentralizer_card rep5AIndex
    rw [hambient] at h
    exact h
  have hker : Nat.card (representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom rep5AIndex).ker = 25 := by
    omega
  have hmapcard :
      Nat.card ((representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom rep5AIndex).ker.map
          (RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep5AIndex).subtype) =
        Nat.card (representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom rep5AIndex).ker :=
    Subgroup.card_map_of_injective
      (RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep5AIndex).subtype_injective
  rw [← representativeAmbientCentralizerSignHom_ker_map_eq_inf, hmapcard, hker]

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep5ACentralizer_map_le_zpowers
statement:
theorem rep5ACentralizer_map_le_zpowers :
    (RepresentativeCentralizer rep5AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype ≤
      Subgroup.zpowers (representativePerm rep5AIndex)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  have hxAlt :
      x ∈ RepresentativeAmbientAlternatingCentralizer rep5AIndex :=
    representativeCentralizer_map_le_ambient_alternating rep5AIndex hx
  have hxRot := rep5A_ambientAlternatingCentralizer_mem_rotationFinset x hxAlt
  rw [rep5ARotationFinset, Finset.mem_image] at hxRot
  rcases hxRot with ⟨p, -, hp⟩
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  have hxPres : WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks x := by
    rcases hx with ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact WittDesign.M11_preserves_wittBlocks y
  have hij : i = j := by
    apply (rep5ARotation_preserves_wittBlocks_iff i j).mp
    simpa [hp] using hxPres
  subst j
  rw [← hp, rep5ARotation_diag_eq_rep5A_pow]
  exact Subgroup.npow_mem_zpowers (representativePerm rep5AIndex) i.1

  intro x hx
  have hxAmbient : x ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep6AIndex :=
    representativeCentralizer_map_le_ambient rep6AIndex hx
  have hxRot := rep6A_ambientCentralizer_mem_rotationFinset x hxAmbient
  rw [rep6ARotationFinset, Finset.mem_image] at hxRot
  rcases hxRot with ⟨p, -, hp⟩

  have hdiag : i = rep6AParity j ∧ k = rep6AThird j := by
    apply (rep6ARotation_preserves_wittBlocks_iff i j k).mp
    simpa [hp] using hxPres
  rcases hdiag with ⟨hi, hk⟩
  subst i
  subst k
  rw [← hp, rep6ARotation_diag_eq_rep6A_pow]
  exact Subgroup.npow_mem_zpowers (representativePerm rep6AIndex) j.1

proof:

proof:

  have hle : M11Rep11BCentralizer.map M11Subgroup.subtype ≤
      Subgroup.centralizer (M11Subgroup.subtype '' ({rep11BM11} : Set M11)) := by
    exact Subgroup.map_centralizer_le_centralizer_image ({rep11BM11} : Set M11)
      M11Subgroup.subtype
  have himage : M11Subgroup.subtype '' ({rep11BM11} : Set M11) =

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep11A_rep11B_not_isConj
statement:
theorem rep11A_rep11B_not_isConj :
    ¬ IsConj (representativeM11 rep11AIndex) rep11BM11
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases isConj_iff.mp h with ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hperm0 := congrArg (fun z : M11 => (z : Perm11)) hg
  have hperm : g.1 * m11a * g.1⁻¹ = rep11BPerm := by
    simpa [representativeM11_rep11AIndex_val, rep11BM11_val] using hperm0
  have hcback : rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * rep11BPerm * rep11ABOddConjugator = m11a := by
    rw [← rep11ABOddConjugator_conj]
    simp [mul_assoc]
  have hzconj :
      (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1) * m11a *
          (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1)⁻¹ = m11a := by
    calc
      (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1) * m11a * (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1)⁻¹
          = rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * (g.1 * m11a * g.1⁻¹) *
              rep11ABOddConjugator := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * rep11BPerm * rep11ABOddConjugator := by
            rw [hperm]
      _ = m11a := hcback
  have hzcent :
      rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1 ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ({m11a} : Set Perm11) := by
    rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff]
    have hzmul :=
      congrArg (fun z : Perm11 => z * (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1)) hzconj
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hzmul
  have hzAlt : rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1 ∈ alternatingGroup (Fin 11) :=
    m11a_centralizer_le_alternating hzcent
  have hzsign1 : Equiv.Perm.sign (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1) = 1 :=
    Equiv.Perm.mem_alternatingGroup.mp hzAlt
  have hgAlt : g.1 ∈ alternatingGroup (Fin 11) :=
    M11_toPerm_mem_alternatingGroup g
  have hgsign : Equiv.Perm.sign g.1 = 1 :=
    Equiv.Perm.mem_alternatingGroup.mp hgAlt
  have hzsignNeg : Equiv.Perm.sign (rep11ABOddConjugator⁻¹ * g.1) = -1 := by
    rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_mul, Equiv.Perm.sign_inv, rep11ABOddConjugator_sign, hgsign]
    norm_num
  rw [hzsign1] at hzsignNeg
  norm_num at hzsignNeg

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images
statement:
theorem rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images (g : Perm11)
    (hconj : g * representativePerm rep8AIndex * g⁻¹ = representativePerm rep8BIndex)
    (k : Fin 8) (s : Fin 2)
    (h1 : g (1 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (1 : Fin 11))
    (h3 : g (3 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (3 : Fin 11)) :
    g = rep8ABConjugator k s
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ x : Fin 11,
      g (representativePerm rep8AIndex x) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g x) := by
    intro x
    have happly := congrArg (fun p : Perm11 => p (g x)) hconj
    simpa using happly
  have h0 : g (0 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (0 : Fin 11) := by
    have hg0 : g (0 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
      have hfix := hstep (0 : Fin 11)
      change g (0 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (0 : Fin 11)) at hfix
      generalize h0v : g (0 : Fin 11) = y at hfix ⊢
      fin_cases y <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; revert hfix; decide)
    rw [rep8ABConjugator_apply_zero]
    exact hg0
  have h2 : g (2 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (2 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (1 : Fin 11)
    rw [h1] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (1 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (2 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h4 : g (4 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (4 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (3 : Fin 11)
    rw [h3] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (3 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (4 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h5 : g (5 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (5 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (4 : Fin 11)
    rw [h4] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (4 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (5 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h10 : g (10 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (10 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (5 : Fin 11)
    rw [h5] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (5 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (10 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h9 : g (9 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (9 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (10 : Fin 11)
    rw [h10] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (10 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (9 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h7 : g (7 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (7 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (9 : Fin 11)
    rw [h9] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (9 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (7 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h6 : g (6 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (6 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (7 : Fin 11)
    rw [h7] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (7 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (6 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  have h8 : g (8 : Fin 11) = rep8ABConjugator k s (8 : Fin 11) := by
    have h := hstep (6 : Fin 11)
    rw [h6] at h
    change g (representativePerm rep8AIndex (6 : Fin 11)) =
      rep8ABConjugator k s (8 : Fin 11)
    rw [h]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases s <;> decide
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2
  · exact h3
  · exact h4
  · exact h5
  · exact h6
  · exact h7
  · exact h8
  · exact h9
  · exact h10

proof:
:= by

      g (representativePerm rep8AIndex x) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g x) := by
    intro x
    have happly := congrArg (fun p : Perm11 => p (g x)) hconj
    simpa using happly
  have hfix := hstep (0 : Fin 11)
  change g (0 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (0 : Fin 11)) at hfix

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep8_conj_maps_one_or_two
statement:
theorem rep8_conj_maps_one_or_two (g : Perm11)
    (hconj : g * representativePerm rep8AIndex * g⁻¹ = representativePerm rep8BIndex) :
    g (1 : Fin 11) = 1 ∨ g (1 : Fin 11) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ x : Fin 11,
      g (representativePerm rep8AIndex x) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g x) := by
    intro x
    have happly := congrArg (fun p : Perm11 => p (g x)) hconj
    simpa using happly
  have h12 := hstep (1 : Fin 11)
  have h21 := hstep (2 : Fin 11)
  change g (2 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (1 : Fin 11)) at h12
  change g (1 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (2 : Fin 11)) at h21
  have hsq : representativePerm rep8BIndex (representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (1 : Fin 11))) =
      g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    rw [h12] at h21
    exact h21.symm
  have hnotfix : representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (1 : Fin 11)) ≠ g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    intro hfix
    have hg2g1 : g (2 : Fin 11) = g (1 : Fin 11) := by
      rw [hfix] at h12
      exact h12
    have hbad : (2 : Fin 11) = 1 := g.injective hg2g1
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) hbad
  generalize hy : g (1 : Fin 11) = y at hsq hnotfix ⊢
  fin_cases y
  · exfalso; apply hnotfix; decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep8ABConjugator_exists_of_conj
statement:
theorem rep8ABConjugator_exists_of_conj (g : Perm11)
    (hconj : g * representativePerm rep8AIndex * g⁻¹ = representativePerm rep8BIndex) :
    ∃ k : Fin 8, ∃ s : Fin 2, g = rep8ABConjugator k s
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ x : Fin 11,
      g (representativePerm rep8AIndex x) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g x) := by
    intro x
    have happly := congrArg (fun p : Perm11 => p (g x)) hconj
    simpa using happly
  have h0 := rep8_conj_maps_zero g hconj
  rcases rep8_conj_maps_one_or_two g hconj with h1 | h1
  · have h2 : g (2 : Fin 11) = 2 := by
      have h12 := hstep (1 : Fin 11)
      change g (2 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (1 : Fin 11)) at h12
      rw [h1] at h12
      rw [h12]
      decide
    generalize h3v : g (3 : Fin 11) = y at ⊢
    fin_cases y
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h0]; decide))
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h1]; decide))
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 2) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h2]; decide))
    · refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨5, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨2, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨6, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨3, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨4, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨7, 0, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
  · have h2 : g (2 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
      have h12 := hstep (1 : Fin 11)
      change g (2 : Fin 11) = representativePerm rep8BIndex (g (1 : Fin 11)) at h12
      rw [h1] at h12
      rw [h12]
      decide
    generalize h3v : g (3 : Fin 11) = y at ⊢
    fin_cases y
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h0]; decide))
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 2) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h2]; decide))
    · exfalso
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective (by rw [h3v, h1]; decide))
    · refine ⟨0, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨5, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨2, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨6, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨1, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨3, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨4, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide
    · refine ⟨7, 1, ?_⟩
      apply rep8ABConjugator_eq_of_conj_of_images g hconj
      · rw [h1]; decide
      · rw [h3v]; decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep8A_rep8B_not_isConj
statement:
theorem rep8A_rep8B_not_isConj :
    ¬ IsConj (representativeM11 rep8AIndex) (representativeM11 rep8BIndex)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases isConj_iff.mp h with ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hperm0 := congrArg (fun z : M11 => (z : Perm11)) hg
  have hperm : g.1 * representativePerm rep8AIndex * g.1⁻¹ = representativePerm rep8BIndex := by
    simpa [representativeM11_val] using hperm0
  rcases rep8ABConjugator_exists_of_conj g.1 hperm with ⟨k, s, hgks⟩
  have hpres : WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks (rep8ABConjugator k s) := by
    rw [← hgks]
    exact WittDesign.M11_preserves_wittBlocks g
  have htrue := (wittBlockPreservationCheck_eq_true_iff (rep8ABConjugator k s)).mpr hpres
  rw [rep8ABConjugator_wittBlockPreservationCheck_false k s] at htrue
  contradiction

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_disjoint_of_not_isConj
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hxi' : IsConj x (representativeM11 i) := by
    simpa [classOrbit] using (ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp hxi)
  have hxj' : IsConj x (representativeM11 j) := by
    simpa [classOrbit] using (ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp hxj)
  exact hnot (hxi'.symm.trans hxj')

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.same_order_distinct_index_cases
statement:
theorem same_order_distinct_index_cases {i j : Fin 10} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (horder : classElementOrder i = classElementOrder j) :
    (i = rep8AIndex ∧ j = rep8BIndex) ∨
      (i = rep8BIndex ∧ j = rep8AIndex) ∨
      (i = rep11AIndex ∧ j = rep11BIndex) ∨
      (i = rep11BIndex ∧ j = rep11AIndex)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [classElementOrder, classElementOrderList, rep8AIndex, rep8BIndex,
      rep11AIndex, rep11BIndex] at horder hij ⊢

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem classOrbit_pairwiseDisjoint : Pairwise (Disjoint on classOrbit)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases horder : classElementOrder i = classElementOrder j
  · rcases same_order_distinct_index_cases hij horder with h | h | h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact rep8A_rep8B_classOrbit_disjoint
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact rep8A_rep8B_classOrbit_disjoint.symm
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact rep11A_rep11B_classOrbit_disjoint
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact rep11A_rep11B_classOrbit_disjoint.symm
  · exact classOrbit_disjoint_of_order_ne horder

proof:
:= by
  rcases isConj_iff.mp hx with ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hg1 : g * x * g⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rwa [representativeM11_rep1AIndex_eq_one] at hg
  have hgx : g * x = g := by
    rw [mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul] at hg1
    simpa using hg1
  exact mul_left_cancel hgx

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep1AConjOrbit_card
statement:
theorem rep1AConjOrbit_card :
    Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 ⟨0, by decide⟩)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    intro x y
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hxconj0 : IsConj x.1 (representativeM11 ⟨0, by decide⟩) :=
      ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp x.2
    have hyconj0 : IsConj y.1 (representativeM11 ⟨0, by decide⟩) :=
      ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp y.2
    have hxone : x.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_isConj_rep1A hxconj0
    have hyone : y.1 = 1 := eq_one_of_isConj_rep1A hyconj0
    rw [hxone, hyone]
  · refine ⟨⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct, representativeM11_rep1AIndex_eq_one]

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_ncard
statement:
theorem classOrbit_ncard (i : Fin 10) :
    (classOrbit i).ncard = classSizeList.get ⟨i.1, by
      rw [classSizeList_length]
      exact i.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 ⟨0, by decide⟩)) = 1
    exact rep1AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep2AIndex)) = 165
    exact rep2AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep3AIndex)) = 440
    exact rep3AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep4AIndex)) = 990
    exact rep4AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep5AIndex)) = 1584
    exact rep5AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep6AIndex)) = 1320
    exact rep6AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep8AIndex)) = 990
    exact rep8AConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep8BIndex)) = 990
    exact rep8BConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep11AIndex)) = 720
    rw [representativeM11_rep11AIndex_eq_m11aM11]
    exact m11aConjOrbit_card
  · rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    change Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) (representativeM11 rep11BIndex)) = 720
    exact rep11BConjOrbit_card

theorem representativeM11_orderOf_eq (i : Fin 10) :

proof:
