name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.orderOf_eq_of_isConj
statement:
theorem orderOf_eq_of_isConj {x y : M11} (hxy : IsConj x y) :
    orderOf x = orderOf y
proof:
:= by
  rcases isConj_iff.mp hxy with ⟨g, hg⟩
  refine SemiconjBy.orderOf_eq g ?_
  rw [SemiconjBy]
  rwa [mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul] at hg

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_disjoint_of_order_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hxi' : IsConj x (representativeM11 i) := by
    simpa [classOrbit] using (ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp hxi)
  have hxj' : IsConj x (representativeM11 j) := by
    simpa [classOrbit] using (ConjAct.mem_orbit_conjAct.mp hxj)
  have hi := orderOf_eq_of_isConj hxi'
  have hj := orderOf_eq_of_isConj hxj'
  exact horder (by
    rw [← representativeM11_orderOf_eq i, ← representativeM11_orderOf_eq j]
    exact hi.symm.trans hj)

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_iUnion_ncard_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem classOrbit_iUnion_ncard_of_pairwise
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on classOrbit)) :
    (⋃ i : Fin 10, classOrbit i).ncard = 7920
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : ∀ i : Fin 10, (classOrbit i).Finite := fun _ => Set.toFinite _
  rw [Set.ncard_iUnion_of_finite hfin hdisj]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]
  simp [classOrbit_ncard, classSizeList]
  decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.classOrbit_iUnion_eq_univ_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem classOrbit_iUnion_eq_univ_of_pairwise
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on classOrbit)) :
    (⋃ i : Fin 10, classOrbit i) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : (⋃ i : Fin 10, classOrbit i).ncard < Nat.card M11 :=
    Set.ncard_lt_card hne
  rw [classOrbit_iUnion_ncard_of_pairwise hdisj, M11Cardinality.card_M11] at hlt
  omega

name: Sporadic.Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
proof:

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)

    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 11) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx

name: Sporadic.Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M11 (0 : Fin 11)) (1 : Fin 11))
        (2 : Fin 11) =
      {x : Fin 11 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 11) = 0 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) h20
    · intro hx1
      have hfix1 : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
        have hg1 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
      have h21 : (2 : Fin 11) = 1 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) h21
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M11 (0 : Fin 11)) (1 : Fin 11))
        (2 : Fin 11)).ncard = 9
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 11 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1} : Set (Fin 11)) =
      ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 11))ᶜ := by
    ext x

  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl]
  norm_num

name: Sporadic.Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M11 (0 : Fin 11)) (1 : Fin 11))
          (2 : Fin 11))
        (3 : Fin 11) =
      {x : Fin 11 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
      have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h30 : (3 : Fin 11) = 0 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) h30
    · constructor
      · intro hx1
        have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
          have hg1 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
        have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
        have h31 : (3 : Fin 11) = 1 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
        exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) h31
      · intro hx2
        have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 11) = 2 := by
          have hg2 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg2
        have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) = 2 := by
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx2] using hg
        have h32 : (3 : Fin 11) = 2 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix2])
        exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 11) ≠ 2) h32
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1, hx2⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1 hx2
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_ncard
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M11 (0 : Fin 11)) (1 : Fin 11))
          (2 : Fin 11))
        (3 : Fin 11)).ncard = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 11 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2} : Set (Fin 11)) =
      ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 11))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl]
  have hcard : ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 11)).ncard = 3 := by
    rw [show ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 11)) = insert (0 : Fin 11) ({1, 2} : Set (Fin 11)) by
      ext x
      simp]
    rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
    · rw [show ({1, 2} : Set (Fin 11)) = insert (1 : Fin 11) ({2} : Set (Fin 11)) by
        ext x
        simp]
      rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
      · simp
      · simp
    · simp
  rw [hcard]
  norm_num

proof:
:= by

    Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hg
  have happly := congrArg (fun h : Perm11 => h x) hcomm
  change g (representativePerm rep4AIndex x) = representativePerm rep4AIndex (g x)

proof:

  have hcomm : g * representativePerm rep4AIndex = representativePerm rep4AIndex * g :=

  · rw [Finset.image_subset_iff]

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4AFixedParam_apply_zero_one
statement:
theorem rep4AFixedParam_apply_zero_one
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex) :
    rep4AFixedPerm (rep4AFixedParam g) (0 : Fin 11) = g (0 : Fin 11) ∧
      rep4AFixedPerm (rep4AFixedParam g) (1 : Fin 11) = g (1 : Fin 11)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : g (0 : Fin 11) ∈ rep4AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h1 : g (1 : Fin 11) ∈ rep4AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h01 : g (0 : Fin 11) ≠ g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective h)
  generalize h0g : g (0 : Fin 11) = y0
  generalize h1g : g (1 : Fin 11) = y1
  fin_cases y0 <;> fin_cases y1 <;>
    simp [rep4AFixedParam, rep4AFixedPerm, rep4AFixedPermList, rep4AFixedPointFinset,
      h0g, h1g] at h0 h1 h01 ⊢ <;> decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4AFixedParam_apply_two
statement:
theorem rep4AFixedParam_apply_two
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex) :
    rep4AFixedPerm (rep4AFixedParam g) (2 : Fin 11) = g (2 : Fin 11)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := rep4AFixedParam_apply_zero_one hg
  have h2 : g (2 : Fin 11) ∈ rep4AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h20 : g (2 : Fin 11) ≠ g (0 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) (g.injective h)
  have h21 : g (2 : Fin 11) ≠ g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective h)
  generalize hr : rep4AFixedParam g = r
  fin_cases r
  all_goals
    simp [rep4AFixedPerm, rep4AFixedPermList, hr] at h01 ⊢
    rcases h01 with ⟨h0, h1⟩
    rw [← h0] at h20
    rw [← h1] at h21
    generalize h2g : g (2 : Fin 11) = y2
    fin_cases y2
    all_goals
      simp [rep4AFixedPointFinset, h2g] at h2 h20 h21 ⊢
      try contradiction
      try simp
      try decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset
statement:
theorem rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex)
    {x : Fin 11} (hx : x ∈ rep4AMovedPointFinset) :
    g x ∈ rep4AMovedPointFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rep4A_movedPoint_iff] at hx ⊢
  intro hfix
  have hcomm : g * representativePerm rep4AIndex = representativePerm rep4AIndex * g :=
    Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hg
  have happly := congrArg (fun h : Perm11 => h x) hcomm
  have hgpx : g (representativePerm rep4AIndex x) = g x := by
    simpa [hfix] using happly
  exact hx (g.injective hgpx)

    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex)
    (hA : rep4ACycleAFinset.image g = rep4ACycleAFinset) :
    rep4ACycleBFinset.image g = rep4ACycleBFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · rw [Finset.image_subset_iff]
    intro x hxB
    have hxMoved : x ∈ rep4AMovedPointFinset := by
      simp [rep4AMovedPointFinset, hxB]
    have hgxMoved := rep4A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset hg hxMoved
    rcases rep4A_movedPoint_mem_cycleA_or_cycleB hgxMoved with hgxA | hgxB
    · have hgxImage : g x ∈ rep4ACycleAFinset.image g := by
        simpa [hA] using hgxA
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hgxImage
      rcases hgxImage with ⟨y, hyA, hgy⟩
      have hyx : y = x := g.injective hgy
      subst y
      exact False.elim (rep4ACycleBFinset_not_mem_cycleAFinset x hxB hyA)
    · exact hgxB
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ g.injective]

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4A_ambientCentralizer_card_le_allRotationFinset
statement:
theorem rep4A_ambientCentralizer_card_le_allRotationFinset :
    Nat.card (RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex) ≤ rep4AAllRotationFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hle :
      Fintype.card (RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex) ≤
        Fintype.card {g : Perm11 // g ∈ rep4AAllRotationFinset} := by
    refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective
      (fun g : RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex =>
        (⟨g.1, rep4A_ambientCentralizer_mem_allRotationFinset g.2⟩ :
          {g : Perm11 // g ∈ rep4AAllRotationFinset})) ?_
    intro g h hgh
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg
      (fun y : {g : Perm11 // g ∈ rep4AAllRotationFinset} => y.1) hgh
  rwa [Fintype.card_coe] at hle

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4ACentralizer_map_mem_preservingRotationFinset
statement:
theorem rep4ACentralizer_map_mem_preservingRotationFinset
    {x : Perm11}
    (hx : x ∈ (RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype) :
    x ∈ rep4APreservingRotationFinset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxAmbient : x ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep4AIndex :=
    representativeCentralizer_map_le_ambient rep4AIndex hx
  have hxAll := rep4A_ambientCentralizer_mem_allRotationFinset hxAmbient
  rw [rep4AAllRotationFinset, Finset.mem_image] at hxAll
  rcases hxAll with ⟨p, -, hp⟩
  rcases p with ⟨⟨⟨r, s⟩, i⟩, j⟩
  have hxPres : WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks x := by
    rcases hx with ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact WittDesign.M11_preserves_wittBlocks y
  have hparam : rep4APreservingParam r s i j := by
    apply (rep4ARotation_preserves_wittBlocks_iff r s i j).mp
    simpa [hp] using hxPres
  rw [← hp]
  exact rep4ARotation_mem_preservingRotationFinset_of_preservingParam r s i j hparam

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4ACentralizer_map_card_le_preservingRotationFinset
statement:
theorem rep4ACentralizer_map_card_le_preservingRotationFinset :
    Nat.card ((RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype) ≤
      rep4APreservingRotationFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hle :
      Fintype.card ((RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype) ≤
        Fintype.card {x : Perm11 // x ∈ rep4APreservingRotationFinset} := by
    refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective
      (fun x : (RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype =>
        (⟨x.1, rep4ACentralizer_map_mem_preservingRotationFinset x.2⟩ :
          {x : Perm11 // x ∈ rep4APreservingRotationFinset})) ?_
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg
      (fun z : {x : Perm11 // x ∈ rep4APreservingRotationFinset} => z.1) hxy
  rwa [Fintype.card_coe] at hle

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep4A_centralizer_card_le
statement:

    Nat.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex) ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  have hmapcard :
      Nat.card ((RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype) =
        Nat.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep4AIndex) :=
    Subgroup.card_map_of_injective M11Subgroup.subtype_injective
  have hle := rep4ACentralizer_map_card_le_preservingRotationFinset
  rw [hmapcard, rep4APreservingRotationFinset_card] at hle
  exact hle

    (hinv : ∀ i : Fin 66, blockMap g⁻¹ (wittBlockAt i) = wittBlockAt (invIndex i)) :
    PreservesWittBlocks g

:=

    forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g⁻¹ invIndex hinv⟩

name: Sporadic.Certificates.WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks.one

proof:

  constructor <;> intro B hB
  · rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_wittBlocks_of_mem_wittBlockList hB
  · change blockMap (1 : Perm11) B ∈ wittBlocks
    rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_wittBlocks_of_mem_wittBlockList hB

name: Sporadic.Certificates.WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks.mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro B hB
    rw [blockMap_mul]
    have hhB : blockMap h B ∈ wittBlocks := hh.1 B hB
    exact hg.1 (blockMap h B) (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks hhB)
  · intro B hB
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, blockMap_mul]
    have hgB : blockMap g⁻¹ B ∈ wittBlocks := hg.2 B hB
    exact hh.2 (blockMap g⁻¹ B) (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks hgB)

statement: theorem M11_preserves_wittBlocks (g : M11) : PreservesWittBlocks g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesWittBlocks x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact m11a_preserves_wittBlocks
      · exact m11b_preserves_wittBlocks)
    PreservesWittBlocks.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesWittBlocks.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesWittBlocks.inv hx)
    g.2

name: Sporadic.Certificates.WittDesign.outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id
statement:
theorem outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id (f : Outside → Outside)
    (h012 : CommutesWithOutside f tau012)
    (h013 : CommutesWithOutside f tau013)
    (h023 : CommutesWithOutside f tau023)
    (h123 : CommutesWithOutside f tau123) :
    ∀ x, f x = x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma0 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h013 h023) h123) h012
    have hfixed : sigma0 (f 0) = f 0 := by
      have h := hcomm 0
      have h0 : sigma0 0 = 0 := by decide
      simpa [h0] using h.symm
    exact (sigma0_fixed_iff (f 0)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma1 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h023 h123) h013) h012
    have hfixed : sigma1 (f 1) = f 1 := by
      have h := hcomm 1
      have h1 : sigma1 1 = 1 := by decide
      simpa [h1] using h.symm
    exact (sigma1_fixed_iff (f 1)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma2 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h013 h123) h023) h012
    have hfixed : sigma2 (f 2) = f 2 := by
      have h := hcomm 2
      have h2 : sigma2 2 = 2 := by decide
      simpa [h2] using h.symm
    exact (sigma2_fixed_iff (f 2)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma3 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h123 h023) h013) h012
    have hfixed : sigma3 (f 3) = f 3 := by
      have h := hcomm 3
      have h3 : sigma3 3 = 3 := by decide
      simpa [h3] using h.symm
    exact (sigma3_fixed_iff (f 3)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma4 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h123 h013) h023) h012
    have hfixed : sigma4 (f 4) = f 4 := by
      have h := hcomm 4
      have h4 : sigma4 4 = 4 := by decide
      simpa [h4] using h.symm
    exact (sigma4_fixed_iff (f 4)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma5 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h023 h013) h123) h012
    have hfixed : sigma5 (f 5) = f 5 := by
      have h := hcomm 5
      have h5 : sigma5 5 = 5 := by decide
      simpa [h5] using h.symm
    exact (sigma5_fixed_iff (f 5)).mp hfixed

name: Sporadic.Certificates.WittDesign.perm_maps_outsidePoint
statement:
theorem perm_maps_outsidePoint (g : Perm11)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2)
    (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h9 : g 9 = 9) (i : Outside) :
    IsOutsidePoint (g (outsidePoint i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOutsidePoint_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 0 := by simpa [h0] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 0 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 1 := by simpa [h1] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 1 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 2 := by simpa [h2] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 2 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 3 := by simpa [h3] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 3 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.2.1 hi
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 9 := by simpa [h9] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 9 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.2.2 hi

proof:

statement:
theorem outsideMap_commutes_tau012 (g : Perm11) (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2)
    (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h9 : g 9 = 9) :
    CommutesWithOutside (outsideMap g) tau012
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hMemW :
      ({0, 1, 2, outsidePoint i, outsidePoint (tau012 i)} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks :=
    (triple012_pair_mem_iff i (tau012 i)).mpr rfl
  have hImage := hg.1 _ (pair_block_mem_list_of_mem_blocks hMemW)
  have hi := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 i
  have hit := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (tau012 i)
  have hMapped :
      ({0, 1, 2, outsidePoint (outsideMap g i),
        outsidePoint (outsideMap g (tau012 i))} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks := by
    simpa [blockMap, h0, h1, h2, ← hi, ← hit] using hImage
  exact (triple012_pair_mem_iff (outsideMap g i) (outsideMap g (tau012 i))).mp hMapped

name: Sporadic.Certificates.WittDesign.fixed_four_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one
statement:
theorem fixed_four_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one (g : Perm11)
    (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2) (h3 : g 3 = 3) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h9 := fixed_four_preserves_wittBlocks_fixes_nine g hg h0 h1 h2 h3
  have houtside := outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id (outsideMap g)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau012 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h9)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau013 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h9)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau023 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h9)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau123 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h9)
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · simpa using h0
  · simpa using h1
  · simpa using h2
  · simpa using h3
  · have hmap := houtside (0 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (0 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (0 : Outside) = 4 := by decide
    calc
      g 4 = g (outsidePoint (0 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 0) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (0 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 4 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (1 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (1 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (1 : Outside) = 5 := by decide
    calc
      g 5 = g (outsidePoint (1 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 1) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (1 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 5 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (2 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (2 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (2 : Outside) = 6 := by decide
    calc
      g 6 = g (outsidePoint (2 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 2) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (2 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 6 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (3 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (3 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (3 : Outside) = 7 := by decide
    calc
      g 7 = g (outsidePoint (3 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 3) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (3 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 7 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (4 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (4 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (4 : Outside) = 8 := by decide
    calc
      g 8 = g (outsidePoint (4 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 4) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (4 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 8 := hp
  · simpa using h9
  · have hmap := houtside (5 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h9 (5 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (5 : Outside) = 10 := by decide
    calc
      g 10 = g (outsidePoint (5 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 5) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (5 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 10 := hp

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_ambientCentralizer_apply_comm
statement:
theorem rep2A_ambientCentralizer_apply_comm
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex)
    (x : Fin 11) :
    g (representativePerm rep2AIndex x) = representativePerm rep2AIndex (g x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : g * representativePerm rep2AIndex = representativePerm rep2AIndex * g :=
    Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hg
  have happly := congrArg (fun h : Perm11 => h x) hcomm
  simpa using happly

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_fixedPoint_iff
statement:
theorem rep2A_fixedPoint_iff (x : Fin 11) :
    representativePerm rep2AIndex x = x ↔ x ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset
statement:
theorem rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex)
    {x : Fin 11} (hx : x ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset) :
    g x ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rep2A_fixedPoint_iff] at hx ⊢
  calc
    representativePerm rep2AIndex (g x) = g (representativePerm rep2AIndex x) :=
      (rep2A_ambientCentralizer_apply_comm hg x).symm
    _ = g x := by rw [hx]

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2AFixedParam_apply_zero_one
statement:
theorem rep2AFixedParam_apply_zero_one
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex) :
    rep4AFixedPerm (rep2AFixedParam g) (0 : Fin 11) = g (0 : Fin 11) ∧
      rep4AFixedPerm (rep2AFixedParam g) (1 : Fin 11) = g (1 : Fin 11)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : g (0 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h1 : g (1 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h01 : g (0 : Fin 11) ≠ g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective h)
  generalize h0g : g (0 : Fin 11) = y0
  generalize h1g : g (1 : Fin 11) = y1
  fin_cases y0 <;> fin_cases y1 <;>
    simp [rep2AFixedParam, rep4AFixedParam, rep4AFixedPerm, rep4AFixedPermList,
      rep2AFixedPointFinset, h0g, h1g] at h0 h1 h01 ⊢ <;> decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2AFixedParam_apply_two
statement:
theorem rep2AFixedParam_apply_two
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex) :
    rep4AFixedPerm (rep2AFixedParam g) (2 : Fin 11) = g (2 : Fin 11)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_zero_one hg
  have h2 : g (2 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset :=
    rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_fixedPointFinset hg (by decide)
  have h20 : g (2 : Fin 11) ≠ g (0 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 0) (g.injective h)
  have h21 : g (2 : Fin 11) ≠ g (1 : Fin 11) := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 11) ≠ 1) (g.injective h)
  generalize hr : rep2AFixedParam g = r
  fin_cases r
  all_goals
    simp [rep2AFixedParam, rep4AFixedPerm, rep4AFixedPermList, hr] at h01 ⊢
    rcases h01 with ⟨h0, h1⟩
    rw [← h0] at h20
    rw [← h1] at h21
    generalize h2g : g (2 : Fin 11) = y2
    fin_cases y2
    all_goals
      simp [rep2AFixedPointFinset, h2g] at h2 h20 h21 ⊢
      try contradiction
      try simp
      try decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex)
    {x : Fin 11} (hx : x ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset) :
    rep4AFixedPerm (rep2AFixedParam g) x = g x
proof:
:= by
  rcases rep2AFixedParam_apply_zero_one hg with ⟨h0, h1⟩
  fin_cases x
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact rep2AFixedParam_apply_two hg
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide
  · exfalso; revert hx; decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset
statement:
theorem rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset
    {g : Perm11} (hg : g ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex)
    {x : Fin 11} (hx : x ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset) :
    g x ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rep2A_movedPoint_iff] at hx ⊢
  intro hfix
  have hgpx : g (representativePerm rep2AIndex x) = g x := by
    calc
      g (representativePerm rep2AIndex x) = representativePerm rep2AIndex (g x) :=
        rep2A_ambientCentralizer_apply_comm hg x
      _ = g x := hfix
  exact hx (g.injective hgpx)

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2AMovedCoord_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem rep2AMovedCoord_eq_of_mem
    {x y : Fin 11} (hx : x ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset) (hy : y ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset)
    (hxy : rep2AMovedCoord x = rep2AMovedCoord y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y <;>
    simp [rep2AMovedPointFinset, rep2AMovedCoord] at hx hy hxy ⊢ <;>
    try contradiction <;> try decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_centralizer_to_ambient
statement:
theorem rep2A_centralizer_to_ambient
    (g : RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex) :
    g.1.1 ∈ RepresentativeAmbientCentralizer rep2AIndex
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      g.1.1 ∈ (RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex).map M11Subgroup.subtype :=
    ⟨g.1, g.2, rfl⟩
  exact representativeCentralizer_map_le_ambient rep2AIndex hmap

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2ACentralizer_param_injective
statement:
theorem rep2ACentralizer_param_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (fun g : RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex =>
        (rep2AFixedParam g.1.1, rep2AMovedCoord (g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11))))
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hgAmbient := rep2A_centralizer_to_ambient g
  have hhAmbient := rep2A_centralizer_to_ambient h
  have hparam :
      rep2AFixedParam g.1.1 = rep2AFixedParam h.1.1 :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hgh
  have hcoord :
      rep2AMovedCoord (g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11)) =
        rep2AMovedCoord (h.1.1 (3 : Fin 11)) :=
    congrArg Prod.snd hgh
  have h0 : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 11) = h.1.1 (0 : Fin 11) := by
    have hg0 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hgAmbient (by decide :
      (0 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    have hh0 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hhAmbient (by decide :
      (0 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    rw [← hg0, ← hh0, hparam]
  have h1 : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 11) = h.1.1 (1 : Fin 11) := by
    have hg1 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hgAmbient (by decide :
      (1 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    have hh1 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hhAmbient (by decide :
      (1 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    rw [← hg1, ← hh1, hparam]
  have h2 : g.1.1 (2 : Fin 11) = h.1.1 (2 : Fin 11) := by
    have hg2 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hgAmbient (by decide :
      (2 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    have hh2 := rep2AFixedParam_apply_of_mem_fixedPoint hhAmbient (by decide :
      (2 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AFixedPointFinset)
    rw [← hg2, ← hh2, hparam]
  have hg3mem : g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset :=
    rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset hgAmbient (by decide)
  have hh3mem : h.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) ∈ rep2AMovedPointFinset :=
    rep2A_ambientCentralizer_maps_movedPointFinset hhAmbient (by decide)
  have h3 : g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) = h.1.1 (3 : Fin 11) :=
    rep2AMovedCoord_eq_of_mem hg3mem hh3mem hcoord
  let q : M11 := h.1⁻¹ * g.1
  have hqPres : WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks q.1 :=
    WittDesign.M11_preserves_wittBlocks q
  have hq0 : q.1 (0 : Fin 11) = 0 := by
    change (h.1.1)⁻¹ (g.1.1 (0 : Fin 11)) = 0
    rw [h0]
    simp
  have hq1 : q.1 (1 : Fin 11) = 1 := by
    change (h.1.1)⁻¹ (g.1.1 (1 : Fin 11)) = 1
    rw [h1]
    simp
  have hq2 : q.1 (2 : Fin 11) = 2 := by
    change (h.1.1)⁻¹ (g.1.1 (2 : Fin 11)) = 2
    rw [h2]
    simp
  have hq3 : q.1 (3 : Fin 11) = 3 := by
    change (h.1.1)⁻¹ (g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11)) = 3
    rw [h3]
    simp
  have hqOnePerm : q.1 = 1 :=
    WittDesign.fixed_four_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one q.1 hqPres hq0 hq1 hq2 hq3
  have hqOne : q = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hqOnePerm
  have hM11 : g.1 = h.1 := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun z : M11 => h.1 * z) hqOne
    simpa [q, mul_assoc] using hm
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hM11

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_centralizer_card_le
statement:
theorem rep2A_centralizer_card_le :
    Nat.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex) ≤ 48
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc
    Fintype.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex)
        ≤ Fintype.card (Fin 6 × Fin 8) := by
          exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective
            (fun g : RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex =>
              (rep2AFixedParam g.1.1, rep2AMovedCoord (g.1.1 (3 : Fin 11))))
            rep2ACentralizer_param_injective
    _ = 48 := by decide

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.rep2A_centralizer_card_ge
statement:
theorem rep2A_centralizer_card_ge :
    48 ≤ Nat.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hle :
      Fintype.card {x : M11 // x ∈ rep2ACentralizerElementFinset} ≤
        Fintype.card (RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex) := by
    refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective
      (fun x : {x : M11 // x ∈ rep2ACentralizerElementFinset} =>
        (⟨x.1, rep2ACentralizerElementFinset_subset_centralizer x.2⟩ :
          RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex)) ?_
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg
      (fun z : RepresentativeCentralizer rep2AIndex => (z.1 : M11)) hxy
  rw [Fintype.card_coe, rep2ACentralizerElementFinset_card,
    ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hle
  exact hle

name: Sporadic.Certificates.ConjugacyClasses.conjOrbit_card_of_centralizer_card_eq_fortyEight
statement:
theorem conjOrbit_card_of_centralizer_card_eq_fortyEight (g : M11)
    (hcentralizer : Nat.card (Subgroup.centralizer ({g} : Set M11)) = 48) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) g) = 165
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group (ConjAct M11) g
  have hstab : Fintype.card (MulAction.stabilizer (ConjAct M11) g) = 48 := by
    rw [conjActStabilizer_card_eq_centralizer_card, hcentralizer]
  rw [hstab] at h
  have hG : Fintype.card (ConjAct M11) = 7920 := by
    rw [ConjAct.card]
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact M11Cardinality.card_M11
  rw [hG] at h
  have horbit : Fintype.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct M11) g) = 165 := by
    omega
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact horbit

statement: theorem hsc_preserves_nbrs : PreservesNbrs hsc
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  revert v
  decide +kernel

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.one
statement: theorem PreservesNbrs.one : PreservesNbrs (1 : Perm100)

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm100}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.HS_preserves_nbrs
statement: theorem HS_preserves_nbrs (g : HS) : PreservesNbrs g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hsa_preserves_nbrs
      · exact hsb_preserves_nbrs
      · exact hsc_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    g.2

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm100) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 100} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) : π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm100) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 100} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) : π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (π : Perm100) {u w e : Fin 100}
    (hu : π u = e) (hne : w ≠ u) : π w ≠ e

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.common_nbrs_012
statement:
theorem common_nbrs_012 :
    ∀ w : Fin 100, 0 ∈ nbrs w → 1 ∈ nbrs w → 2 ∈ nbrs w →
      w = 22 ∨ w = 99

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.pin_inside_B0
statement:
theorem pin_inside_B0 :
    ∀ w : Fin 100, w ∈ nbrs 99 → w ∈ nbrs 22 → w ≠ 0 → w ≠ 1 → w ≠ 2 →
      w ∈ ({3, 4, 21} : Finset (Fin 100))

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_symm
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_symm :
    ∀ u v : Fin 100, u ∈ nbrs v → v ∈ nbrs u

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.common_nbr_exists
statement:
theorem common_nbr_exists :
    ∀ u v : Fin 100, u ≠ v → v ∉ nbrs u →
      ∃ w : Fin 100, w ∈ nbrs u ∧ w ∈ nbrs v

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Graph.common_non_nbr_exists
statement:
theorem common_non_nbr_exists :
    ∀ u v : Fin 100, v ∈ nbrs u →
      ∃ w : Fin 100, w ∉ nbrs u ∧ w ∉ nbrs v ∧ w ≠ u ∧ w ≠ v

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Gen.toPerm_mem_HSSubgroup
statement: theorem toPerm_mem_HSSubgroup (g : Gen) : g.toPerm ∈ HSSubgroup
proof:

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Word.eval_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_nil : eval [] = (1 : Perm100)

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Word.eval_cons
statement:

theorem eval_cons (g : Gen) (rest : Word) :

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.Word.eval_mem_HSSubgroup
statement: theorem eval_mem_HSSubgroup : ∀ w : Word, eval w ∈ HSSubgroup
proof:
| [] => by simp [eval]
  | g :: rest => by

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.first_orbit_HS_witness
statement:
theorem first_orbit_HS_witness (x : Fin 100) :
    ∃ g : HS, g.1 (99 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨Word.toHS (levelOneWord x), by simpa using levelOneWord_maps_star_all x⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_star_eq_univ
statement: theorem orbit_star_eq_univ : MulAction.orbit HS (99 : Fin 100) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_HS_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_star_ncard
statement: theorem orbit_star_ncard : (MulAction.orbit HS (99 : Fin 100)).ncard = 100

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.second_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100) (hx : x ∈ nbrs 99) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100), g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨starStabilizerElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelTwoWord x)) (0 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelTwoWord_maps_0_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab99_orbit_zero_eq
statement:
theorem stab99_orbit_zero_eq :
    MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100) =
      ↑(nbrs 99)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix : g.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hx : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1) hfix (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab99_orbit_zero_ncard
statement:
theorem stab99_orbit_zero_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100))
      (0 : Fin 100)).ncard = 22

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.third_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100)
    (hx : x ∈ nbrs 99) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100),
      g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab990Element x hx hx0, by
    change (Word.eval (levelThreeWord x)) (1 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelThreeWord_maps_1_all x hx hx0⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab990_orbit_one_eq
statement:
theorem stab990_orbit_one_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
        (1 : Fin 100) =
      ↑((nbrs 99).erase 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix99 : g.1.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hmem : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1) hfix99 (by decide)
    have hne : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1 hfix0 (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hmem hne
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hmem⟩)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hne, hmem⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hmem hne
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab990_orbit_one_ncard
statement:
theorem stab990_orbit_one_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
        (1 : Fin 100)).ncard = 21

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100)
    (hx : x ∈ nbrs 99) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
        (1 : Fin 100),
      g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab9901Element x hx hx0 hx1, by
    change (Word.eval (levelFourWord x)) (2 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelFourWord_maps_2_all x hx hx0 hx1⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab9901_orbit_two_eq
statement:
theorem stab9901_orbit_two_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
          (1 : Fin 100))
        (2 : Fin 100) =
      ↑(((nbrs 99).erase 0).erase 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix99 : g.1.1.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hmem : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1) hfix99 (by decide)
    have hne0 : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1 hfix0 (by decide)
    have hne1 : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) ≠ 1 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1 hfix1 (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hmem hne0 hne1
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr
      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne1, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne0, hmem⟩⟩)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hne1, hx'⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨hne0, hmem⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx'
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hmem hne0 hne1
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab9901_orbit_two_ncard
statement:
theorem stab9901_orbit_two_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
          (1 : Fin 100))
        (2 : Fin 100)).ncard = 20

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.fixes_b0_vertex
statement:
theorem fixes_b0_vertex (π : Perm100) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    (h99 : π 99 = 99) (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h1 : π 1 = 1) (h2 : π 2 = 2) :
    π 22 = 22
proof:
:= by
  have m0 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 0 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h0 (by decide)
  have m1 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 1 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h1 (by decide)
  have m2 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 2 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h2 (by decide)
  have hor := common_nbrs_012 (π 22) (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m0)
    (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m1) (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m2)
  rcases hor with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_value π h99 (by decide))

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100)
    (hx : x ∈ nbrs 99) (hx22 : x ∉ nbrs 22) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
          (1 : Fin 100))
        (2 : Fin 100),
      g.1.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨levelFiveElement x hx hx22, by
    change (Word.eval (levelFiveWord x)) (5 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelFiveWord_maps_5_all x hx hx22⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab99012_orbit_five_eq
statement:
theorem stab99012_orbit_five_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
            (1 : Fin 100))
          (2 : Fin 100))
        (5 : Fin 100) = ↑(nbrs 99 \ nbrs 22)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix99 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) = 2 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hfix22 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (22 : Fin 100) = 22 :=
      fixes_b0_vertex g.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1)
        hfix99 hfix0 hfix1 hfix2
    have hmem : g.1.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1) hfix99 (by decide)
    have hnot : g.1.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 100) ∉ nbrs 22 :=
      not_mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1) hfix22
        (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hmem hnot
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hmem, hnot⟩)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hmem, hnot⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hmem hnot
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab99012_orbit_five_ncard
statement:
theorem stab99012_orbit_five_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
            (1 : Fin 100))
          (2 : Fin 100))
        (5 : Fin 100)).ncard = 16

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.mem_targets_iff
statement:
theorem mem_targets_iff :
    ∀ x : Fin 100, x ∈ ({3, 4, 21} : Finset (Fin 100)) →
      (x = 3 ∨ x = 4 ∨ x = 21)

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.sixth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem sixth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 100)
    (hx : x = 3 ∨ x = 4 ∨ x = 21) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
            (1 : Fin 100))
          (2 : Fin 100))
        (5 : Fin 100),
      g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨levelSixElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelSixWord x)) (3 : Fin 100) = x
    exact levelSixWord_maps_3_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.ChainOrbits.stab990125_orbit_three_eq
statement:
theorem stab990125_orbit_three_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer
              (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer HS (99 : Fin 100)) (0 : Fin 100))
              (1 : Fin 100))
            (2 : Fin 100))
          (5 : Fin 100))
        (3 : Fin 100) = ↑({3, 4, 21} : Finset (Fin 100))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix99 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (99 : Fin 100) = 99 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 100) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 100) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 100) = 2 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hfix22 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (22 : Fin 100) = 22 :=
      fixes_b0_vertex g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1.1)
        hfix99 hfix0 hfix1 hfix2
    have hmem99 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 99 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1.1) hfix99
        (by decide)
    have hmem22 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) ∈ nbrs 22 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (HS_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1.1) hfix22
        (by decide)
    have hne0 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1.1 hfix0 (by decide)
    have hne1 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) ≠ 1 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1.1 hfix1 (by decide)
    have hne2 : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100) ≠ 2 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1.1 hfix2 (by decide)
    have hpin := pin_inside_B0 (g.1.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 100))
      hmem99 hmem22 hne0 hne1 hne2
    rw [hmap] at hpin
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hpin
  · intro hx
    have hxor := mem_targets_iff x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := sixth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hxor
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.HSCertificates.FinalStabilizer.fixed_base_preserves_nbrs_eq_one
statement:
theorem fixed_base_preserves_nbrs_eq_one (π : Perm100)
    (hpres : PreservesNbrs π) (hsign : Equiv.Perm.sign π = 1)
    (h99 : π 99 = 99) (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h1 : π 1 = 1) (h2 : π 2 = 2)
    (h5 : π 5 = 5) (h3 : π 3 = 3) : π = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : π 22 = 22 := by
    have m0 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 0 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h0 (by decide)
    have m1 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 1 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h1 (by decide)
    have m2 : π 22 ∈ nbrs 2 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h2 (by decide)
    have hor := common_nbrs_012 (π 22) (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m0)
      (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m1) (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ m2)
    rcases hor with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_value π h99 (by decide))
  have hmem99 : π 4 ∈ nbrs 99 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres h99 (by decide)
  have hmem22 : π 4 ∈ nbrs 22 := mem_nbrs_map π hpres hb0 (by decide)
  have h4or := pin_four (π 4) hmem99 hmem22
    (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h1 (by decide))
    (ne_of_value π h2 (by decide))
  rcases h4or with h4 | h4 | h4
  · exact absurd h4 (ne_of_value π h3 (by decide))
  · exact eq_one_of_fix_four π hpres h99 h0 h1 h2 h5 h3 h4
  · exfalso
    have htau := eq_tau_of_swap_four π hpres h99 h0 h1 h2 h5 h3 h4
    rw [htau, tauOuter_sign] at hsign
    exact absurd hsign (by decide)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.pairSet_sortPair
statement:
theorem pairSet_sortPair (u v : Fin 275) :
    pairSet (sortPair u v) = ({u, v} : Finset (Fin 275))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sortPair pairSet
  by_cases hlt : u.val < v.val
  · rw [if_pos hlt]
  · rw [if_neg hlt]
    exact Finset.pair_comm v u

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.sortPair_lt
statement:
theorem sortPair_lt (u v : Fin 275) (h : u ≠ v) :
    (sortPair u v).1.val < (sortPair u v).2.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold sortPair
  by_cases hlt : u.val < v.val
  · rw [if_pos hlt]
    exact hlt
  · rw [if_neg hlt]
    have hne : u.val ≠ v.val := fun hh => h (Fin.ext hh)
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlt)
      (fun hh => hne hh.symm)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.edge_ext
statement: theorem edge_ext {e f : EdgeT} (h : pairSet e.1 = pairSet f.1) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, hadj⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨⟨c, d⟩, hcd, hcadj⟩ := f
  simp only [pairSet] at h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h1 : a ∈ ({c, d} : Finset (Fin 275)) := by
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  have h2 : b ∈ ({c, d} : Finset (Fin 275)) := by
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
  have hab' : a.val < b.val := hab
  have hcd' : c.val < d.val := hcd
  have hkey : a = c ∧ b = d := by
    rcases h1 with h1e | h1e <;> rcases h2 with h2e | h2e
    · exact absurd (congrArg Fin.val (h1e.trans h2e.symm)) (by omega)
    · exact ⟨h1e, h2e⟩
    · exact absurd (congrArg Fin.val h1e)
        (by
          have hb := congrArg Fin.val h2e
          omega)
    · exact absurd (congrArg Fin.val (h1e.trans h2e.symm)) (by omega)
  show (a, b) = (c, d)
  rw [hkey.1, hkey.2]

    pairSet (edgeSmul m e).1 = (pairSet e.1).image m.1
proof:

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.smul_def

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.smul_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem smul_eq_self_iff (m : McL) (e : EdgeT) :
    m • e = e ↔ EdgeFixed m.1 e.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hp : pairSet (edgeSmul m e).1 = pairSet e.1 := by
      rw [← smul_def, h]
    rw [pairSet_edgeSmul] at hp
    have h1 : m.1 e.1.1 ∈ pairSet e.1 := by
      rw [← hp]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    have h2 : m.1 e.1.2 ∈ pairSet e.1 := by
      rw [← hp]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _
        (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
    unfold pairSet at h1 h2
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
    unfold EdgeFixed
    have hne : e.1.1 ≠ e.1.2 := by
      intro hcon
      have := congrArg Fin.val hcon
      have hlt : e.1.1.val < e.1.2.val := e.2.1
      omega
    rcases h1 with ha | ha
    · rcases h2 with hb | hb
      · exact absurd (m.1.injective (ha.trans hb.symm)) hne
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · rcases h2 with hb | hb
      · exact Or.inr ⟨ha, hb⟩
      · exact absurd (m.1.injective (ha.trans hb.symm)) hne
  · intro h
    apply edge_ext
    show pairSet (edgeSmul m e).1 = pairSet e.1
    rw [pairSet_edgeSmul]
    unfold pairSet
    rw [Finset.image_insert, Finset.image_singleton]
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [h1, h2]
    · rw [h1, h2]
      exact Finset.pair_comm _ _

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.signEdge_eq_one
statement: theorem signEdge_eq_one (g : McL) : signEdge g = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hg⟩ := g
  have key : ∀ x, x ∈ McLSubgroup →
      ∀ hm : x ∈ McLSubgroup, signEdge ⟨x, hm⟩ = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun y _ => ∀ hm : y ∈ McLSubgroup, signEdge ⟨y, hm⟩ = 1)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy hm
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact signEdge_of_cube (mem_cube_eq_one hm mcla_cube)
      · exact signEdge_of_cube (mem_cube_eq_one hm mclb_cube)
      · exact signEdge_of_cube (mem_cube_eq_one hm mclc_cube)
      · exact signEdge_of_cube (mem_cube_eq_one hm mcld_cube)
      · exact signEdge_of_cube (mem_cube_eq_one hm mcle_cube)
    · intro hm
      have h1 : (⟨1, hm⟩ : McL) = 1 := rfl
      rw [h1, map_one]
    · intro y z hyc hzc ihy ihz hm
      have h1 : (⟨y * z, hm⟩ : McL) = ⟨y, hyc⟩ * ⟨z, hzc⟩ := rfl
      rw [h1, map_mul, ihy hyc, ihz hzc, one_mul]
    · intro y hyc ihy hm
      have h1 : (⟨y⁻¹, hm⟩ : McL) = (⟨y, hyc⟩ : McL)⁻¹ := rfl
      rw [h1, map_inv, ihy hyc, inv_one]
  exact key gp hg hg

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.fiber_card_eq_rowMoved
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : ((nbrsRow u).filter (fun w =>
      u.val < w.val ∧ ¬ EdgeFixed m.1 (u, w))).Nodup :=
    (nbrsRow_nodup u).filter _
  have key : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun e : EdgeT => m • e ≠ e)).filter
        (fun e => e.1.1 = u)).card =
      (⟨(↑((nbrsRow u).filter (fun w =>
          u.val < w.val ∧ ¬ EdgeFixed m.1 (u, w))) : Multiset (Fin 275)),
        Multiset.coe_nodup.mpr hnd⟩ : Finset (Fin 275)).card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij' (fun e _ => e.1.2)
      (fun v hv => ⟨(u, v), ?_⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · 
      simp only [Finset.mem_mk, Multiset.mem_coe, List.mem_filter,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at hv
      exact ⟨hv.2.1, mem_nbrs_iff.mpr hv.1⟩
    · 
      intro e he
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at he
      obtain ⟨hmoved, hfst⟩ := he
      subst hfst
      simp only [Finset.mem_mk, Multiset.mem_coe, List.mem_filter,
        decide_eq_true_eq]
      refine ⟨mem_nbrs_iff.mp e.2.2, e.2.1, ?_⟩
      intro hfix
      exact hmoved ((smul_eq_self_iff m e).mpr hfix)
    · 
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_mk, Multiset.mem_coe, List.mem_filter,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_true]
      intro hcon
      exact hv.2.2 ((smul_eq_self_iff m _).mp hcon)
    · intro e he
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at he
      apply Subtype.ext
      show (u, e.1.2) = e.1
      rw [← he.2]
    · intro v _
      rfl
  unfold rowMoved
  exact key

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.support_card_eq_movedCount
statement:
theorem support_card_eq_movedCount (m : McL) :
    (edgeHom m).support.card = movedCount m.1 0 275
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : (edgeHom m).support =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun e : EdgeT => m • e ≠ e) := by
    ext e
    simp only [Equiv.Perm.mem_support, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simpa [edgeHom, MulAction.toPermHom_apply] using h
    · intro h
      simpa [edgeHom, MulAction.toPermHom_apply] using h
  have hfib := @Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise EdgeT (Fin 275) _
    (fun e => e.1.1) (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : EdgeT => m • e ≠ e))
    Finset.univ (fun e _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
  rw [hsupp, movedCount_eq_plain, ← Fin.sum_univ_def, hfib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => fiber_card_eq_rowMoved m u)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.outer0_pow_four
statement: theorem outer0_pow_four : outerComp0 ^ 4 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : outerComp0 ^ 2 = tailPerm1 := by
    rw [pow_two]
    exact outerComp0_sq
  have h4 : outerComp0 ^ 4 = outerComp0 ^ 2 * outerComp0 ^ 2 := by

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.signEdge_of_eq_outer0
statement:
theorem signEdge_of_eq_outer0 (m : McL) (hm : m.1 = outerComp0) :
    signEdge m = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hm4 : m ^ 4 = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, hm]
    exact outer0_pow_four
  have hphi4 : (edgeHom m) ^ 4 = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, hm4, map_one]
  have hs : (edgeHom m).support.card = 15330 := by
    rw [support_card_eq_movedCount, hm]
    exact movedOuter_total
  have hs2 : ((edgeHom m) ^ 2).support.card = 15120 := by
    have hsq : (edgeHom m) ^ 2 = edgeHom (m ^ 2) := by
      rw [map_pow]
    have hmsq : (m ^ 2).1 = tailPerm1 := by
      rw [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, hm, pow_two]
      exact outerComp0_sq
    rw [hsq, support_card_eq_movedCount, hmsq]
    exact movedTail_total
  have hsign := SignPowFour.sign_eq_neg_one (edgeHom m) hphi4
    15330 15120 hs hs2
    (fun a b h1 h2 => by
      have hb : b = 3780 := by omega
      have ha : a = 105 := by omega
      subst hb ha
      exact ⟨1942, by norm_num⟩)
  show Equiv.Perm.sign (edgeHom m) = -1
  exact hsign

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.mem_ne_outer0
statement: theorem mem_ne_outer0 (m : McL) : m.1 ≠ outerComp0
proof:
:= by
  intro hm
  have h1 := signEdge_eq_one m
  have h2 := signEdge_of_eq_outer0 m hm
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.mem_ne_outer1
statement: theorem mem_ne_outer1 (m : McL) : m.1 ≠ outerComp1
proof:
:= by
  intro hm
  have hminv : (m⁻¹).1 = outerComp0 := by
    have : (m⁻¹).1 = m.1⁻¹ := rfl
    rw [this, hm, outerComp1_eq_inv, inv_inv]
  have h1 := signEdge_eq_one m⁻¹
  have h2 := signEdge_of_eq_outer0 m⁻¹ hminv
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.holdsOn_union
proof:
:= by
  intro v hlo hhi
  by_cases hmid : v.val < mid
  · exact h₁ v hlo hmid
  · exact h₂ v (Nat.le_of_not_gt hmid) hhi

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm275}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.McL_preserves_nbrs
statement: theorem McL_preserves_nbrs (g : McL) : PreservesNbrs g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact mcla_preserves_nbrs
      · exact mclb_preserves_nbrs
      · exact mclc_preserves_nbrs
      · exact mcld_preserves_nbrs
      · exact mcle_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    g.2

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm275) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 275} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm275) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 275} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

    ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ | ⟨hlo, hhi⟩

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.U43_preserves_hemis
statement:
theorem U43_preserves_hemis {g : Perm112} (hg : g ∈ U43Subgroup) :
    PreservesHemis g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => PreservesHemis x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e1,
        forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e2,
        forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e2Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e3,
        forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e3Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e4,
        forall_hemi_of_at _ _ hemiMap_e4Inv⟩
  · exact preservesHemis_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact preservesHemis_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact preservesHemis_inv hx

        (0 : Fin 275) = ↑(nbrs 274)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix : g.1.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 275) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hx : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 274 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1 (McL_preserves_nbrs g.1) hfix (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_witness x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)

:= by

    have hfix274 : g.1.1.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 275) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 275) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs g.1.1.1 := McL_preserves_nbrs g.1.1
    have h274 : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 274 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1 hpres hfix274 (by decide)
    have h0 : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 0 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1 hpres hfix0 (by decide)
    have hx : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 275) ∈ orb30Set := pin_orb30 _ h274 h0
    rw [hmap] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_witness x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)

      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 275) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)

    rw [hmap] at hx

  · intro hx

statement:
theorem stab4_orbit_eq :
    MulAction.orbit Stab4 (4 : Fin 275) = ↑orb9Set
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix274 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (274 : Fin 275) = 274 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 275) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 275) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix6 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (6 : Fin 275) = 6 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 275) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs g.1.1.1.1.1 := McL_preserves_nbrs g.1.1.1.1
    have h274 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 274 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1 hpres hfix274 (by decide)
    have h0 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 0 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1.1.1 hpres hfix0 (by decide)
    have h6 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 275) ∈ nbrs 6 :=

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.hemiList_length
statement: theorem hemiList_length : hemiList.length = 162

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.hemiAt_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem hemiAt_eq_getElem (i : Fin 162) :
    hemiAt i = hemiList[i.1]'(by rw [hemiList_length]; exact i.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hemiAt, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [hemiList_length]; exact i.2)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.hemiAt_mem
statement: theorem hemiAt_mem (i : Fin 162) : hemiAt i ∈ hemis

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.mem_hemiList_exists_at
statement:
theorem mem_hemiList_exists_at {H : Finset (Fin 112)}
    (hH : H ∈ hemiList) : ∃ i : Fin 162, H = hemiAt i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hH
  have hn' : n < 162 := by rwa [hemiList_length] at hn
  exact ⟨⟨n, hn'⟩, (hemiAt_eq_getElem ⟨n, hn'⟩).symm⟩

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.hemiMap_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hemiMap_one (H : Finset (Fin 112)) : hemiMap (1 : Perm112) H = H

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.hemiMap_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hemiMap_mul (g h : Perm112) (H : Finset (Fin 112)) :
    hemiMap (g * h) H = hemiMap g (hemiMap h H)

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.preservesHemis_one
statement: theorem preservesHemis_one : PreservesHemis 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro H hH <;>
    simp only [inv_one, hemiMap_one] <;>
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hH

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.mem_hemiList_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_hemiList_of_mem {H : Finset (Fin 112)} (h : H ∈ hemis) :
    H ∈ hemiList

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.preservesHemis_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro H hH
    rw [hemiMap_mul]
    exact hg.1 _ (mem_hemiList_of_mem (hh.1 H hH))
  · intro H hH
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, hemiMap_mul]
    exact hh.2 _ (mem_hemiList_of_mem (hg.2 H hH))

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.Families.preservesHemis_inv
statement:
theorem preservesHemis_inv {g : Perm112}
    (hg : PreservesHemis g) : PreservesHemis g⁻¹

name: Sporadic.McLCertificates.EdgeParity.sum_ite_split
statement:
private theorem sum_ite_split (f : Fin 275 → Nat) (lo mid hi : Nat)
    (hlm : lo ≤ mid) (hmh : mid ≤ hi) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin 275),
      (l.map (fun u => if lo ≤ u.val ∧ u.val < hi then f u else 0)).sum =
        (l.map (fun u =>
          if lo ≤ u.val ∧ u.val < mid then f u else 0)).sum +
          (l.map (fun u =>
            if mid ≤ u.val ∧ u.val < hi then f u else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih]
    have hsplit : (if lo ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < hi then f a else 0) =
        (if lo ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < mid then f a else 0) +
          (if mid ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < hi then f a else 0) := by
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega

proof:

  exact sum_ite_split rowEdge lo mid hi hlm hmh _

proof:

  unfold movedCount

name: Sporadic.SignPowFour.disjoint_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem disjoint_mul_eq_one {σ τ : Perm α} (hd : Perm.Disjoint σ τ)
    (h : σ * τ = 1) : σ = 1 ∧ τ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hτ : τ = σ⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h
  have hdis : _root_.Disjoint σ.support τ.support :=
    Equiv.Perm.disjoint_iff_disjoint_support.mp hd
  rw [hτ, Equiv.Perm.support_inv] at hdis
  have hsupp : σ.support = ∅ := by
    have hbot := _root_.Disjoint.eq_bot_of_self hdis
    simpa using hbot
  have hσ : σ = 1 := Equiv.Perm.support_eq_empty_iff.mp hsupp
  refine ⟨hσ, ?_⟩
  rw [hτ, hσ, inv_one]

name: Sporadic.SignPowFour.exists_counts
statement:
theorem exists_counts (σ : Perm α) (h : σ ^ 4 = 1) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ,
      σ.support.card = 2 * a + 4 * b ∧
      (σ ^ 2).support.card = 4 * b ∧
      Equiv.Perm.sign σ = (-1) ^ (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  induction σ using Equiv.Perm.cycle_induction_on with
  | base_one =>
      intro _
      exact ⟨0, 0, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | base_cycles σ hσ =>
      intro h
      
      have horder : orderOf σ = σ.support.card := hσ.orderOf
      have hdvd : orderOf σ ∣ 4 := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h
      have hge : 2 ≤ σ.support.card := hσ.two_le_card_support
      have hle : orderOf σ ≤ 4 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
      have hge' : 2 ≤ orderOf σ := by omega
      have hcases : σ.support.card = 2 ∨ σ.support.card = 4 := by
        have h234 : orderOf σ = 2 ∨ orderOf σ = 3 ∨ orderOf σ = 4 := by
          omega
        rcases h234 with h3 | h3 | h3
        · exact Or.inl (by omega)
        · exfalso
          rw [h3] at hdvd
          norm_num at hdvd
        · exact Or.inr (by omega)
      rcases hcases with h2 | h4
      · 
        refine ⟨1, 0, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hord : orderOf σ = 2 := by rw [horder, h2]
          have : σ ^ 2 = 1 := by
            rw [← hord]
            exact pow_orderOf_eq_one σ
          rw [this]
          simp
        · rw [hσ.sign, h2]
          decide
      · 
        have hord : orderOf σ = 4 := by rw [horder, h4]
        have hne : σ ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by
          intro hcon
          have := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hcon
          rw [hord] at this
          norm_num at this
        have hsub : (σ ^ 2).support ⊆ σ.support := Perm.support_pow_le σ 2
        have hall : σ.support ⊆ (σ ^ 2).support := by
          intro x hx
          rw [Equiv.Perm.mem_support] at hx ⊢
          intro hcon
          exact hne ((hσ.pow_eq_one_iff' hx).mpr hcon)
        have hsupp2 : (σ ^ 2).support = σ.support :=
          le_antisymm hsub hall
        refine ⟨0, 1, by omega, by rw [hsupp2]; omega, ?_⟩
        rw [hσ.sign, h4]
        decide
  | induction_disjoint σ τ hd hc ihσ ihτ =>
      intro h
      
      have hcomm : Commute σ τ := hd.commute
      have hpow : (σ * τ) ^ 4 = σ ^ 4 * τ ^ 4 := hcomm.mul_pow 4
      have hd4 : Perm.Disjoint (σ ^ 4) (τ ^ 4) := hd.pow_disjoint_pow 4 4
      have hboth : σ ^ 4 = 1 ∧ τ ^ 4 = 1 := by
        apply disjoint_mul_eq_one hd4
        rw [← hpow, h]
      obtain ⟨a₁, b₁, hs₁, hq₁, hg₁⟩ := ihσ hboth.1
      obtain ⟨a₂, b₂, hs₂, hq₂, hg₂⟩ := ihτ hboth.2
      refine ⟨a₁ + a₂, b₁ + b₂, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hd.card_support_mul, hs₁, hs₂]
        ring
      · have hd2 : Perm.Disjoint (σ ^ 2) (τ ^ 2) := hd.pow_disjoint_pow 2 2
        have hpow2 : (σ * τ) ^ 2 = σ ^ 2 * τ ^ 2 := hcomm.mul_pow 2
        rw [hpow2, hd2.card_support_mul, hq₁, hq₂]
        ring
      · rw [map_mul, hg₁, hg₂, ← pow_add]
        congr 1
        ring

name: Sporadic.SignPowFour.sign_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem sign_eq_neg_one (σ : Perm α) (h : σ ^ 4 = 1)
    (s s₂ : ℕ) (hs : σ.support.card = s) (hs₂ : (σ ^ 2).support.card = s₂)
    (hodd : ∀ a b : ℕ, s = 2 * a + 4 * b → s₂ = 4 * b → Odd (a + b)) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign σ = -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hsign⟩ := exists_counts σ h
  rw [hsign]
  have : Odd (a + b) := hodd a b (by omega) (by omega)
  exact Odd.neg_one_pow this

name: Sporadic.U43.holdsOnK_blocks
statement:
theorem holdsOnK_blocks {P : Fin 20 → Prop}
    (h0 : HoldsOnK 0 2 P)
    (h1 : HoldsOnK 2 4 P)
    (h2 : HoldsOnK 4 6 P)
    (h3 : HoldsOnK 6 8 P)
    (h4 : HoldsOnK 8 10 P)
    (h5 : HoldsOnK 10 12 P)
    (h6 : HoldsOnK 12 14 P)
    (h7 : HoldsOnK 14 16 P)
    (h8 : HoldsOnK 16 18 P)
    (h9 : HoldsOnK 18 20 P) :
    ∀ k : Fin 20, P k
proof:
:= by
  have h0_1 : HoldsOnK 0 4 P := holdsOnK_union h0 h1
  have h0_2 : HoldsOnK 0 6 P := holdsOnK_union h0_1 h2
  have h0_3 : HoldsOnK 0 8 P := holdsOnK_union h0_2 h3
  have h0_4 : HoldsOnK 0 10 P := holdsOnK_union h0_3 h4
  have h0_5 : HoldsOnK 0 12 P := holdsOnK_union h0_4 h5
  have h0_6 : HoldsOnK 0 14 P := holdsOnK_union h0_5 h6
  have h0_7 : HoldsOnK 0 16 P := holdsOnK_union h0_6 h7
  have h0_8 : HoldsOnK 0 18 P := holdsOnK_union h0_7 h8
  have h0_9 : HoldsOnK 0 20 P := holdsOnK_union h0_8 h9
  intro k
  exact h0_9 k (Nat.zero_le _) k.isLt
