name: Sporadic.U43.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 112) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : U43Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toU43 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 112) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U43_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toU43 (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 112) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_zero_all z hz
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 112) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U43.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 112) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : U43Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U43.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 112)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : U43Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 5 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toU43 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 112) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U43_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 112) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set C := Word.toU43 (nonEdgeWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (0 : Fin 112) = 0 := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_fixes_zero_all z hz hz0
  have hC5 : C.1 (5 : Fin 112) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_maps_all z hz hz0
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 5 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC5, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U43.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 112)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : U43Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 5 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U43.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 112, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.U43.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U43Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 112} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 112) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U43.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U43Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 112} (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p)
    (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 112) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U43.normal_zero_witness
statement:
theorem normal_zero_witness (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U43Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 112} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 112) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 0 x (fun h => hx0 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 w hw0
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · 
    by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx, hw0', hwx'⟩ := common_non_nbr_exists 0 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 w hw0 hw0'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 x hxadj hx0

name: Sporadic.U43.T0_le_U43
statement: theorem T0_le_U43 : T0 ≤ U43Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [T0, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  exact transvection_zero_mem k

name: Sporadic.U43.transvection_zero_mem_T0
statement: theorem transvection_zero_mem_T0 (k : Fin 20) : transvectionAt 0 k ∈ T0

name: Sporadic.U43.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (transvectionAt 0 k) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
      exact transvection_comm_zero k k'
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.U43.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 112, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c) (g : U43Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : U43Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 112) (k : Fin 20)
        (hxe : x = transvectionAt c k) (hmem : x ∈ U43Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : U43Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c k hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (mapsTransvections_of_mem m.2).2 c k
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      set t : U43Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm112) = transvectionAt 0 k' := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact transvection_zero_mem_T0 k'
      set n : U43Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key _ _ u43e1_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ _ u43e2_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ _ u43e3_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ _ u43e4_eq_transvectionAt _
  · refine ⟨1, N.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : U43Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U43Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹), N.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : U43Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U43Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.U43.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 112, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c) (a b : U43Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : U43Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.U43.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : U43Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : U43Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup)⁆)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (⟨u43e1, _⟩ : U43Subgroup) = ⟨u43e1, u43e1_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen1_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u43e2, _⟩ : U43Subgroup) = ⟨u43e2, u43e2_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen2_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u43e3, _⟩ : U43Subgroup) = ⟨u43e3, u43e3_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen3_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u43e4, _⟩ : U43Subgroup) = ⟨u43e4, u43e4_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen4_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.U43.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup U43Subgroup)
    (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have htrans : ∀ c : Fin 112, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c :=
    fun c => normal_zero_witness N hN hnN hp c
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U43Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

name: Sporadic.U43.mapsTransvections_one
statement: theorem mapsTransvections_one : MapsTransvections 1

name: Sporadic.U43.mapsTransvections_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hh.1 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hg.1 (h c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : g * h * transvectionAt c k * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * transvectionAt c k * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    rfl
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hg.2 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hh.2 (g⁻¹ c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ * transvectionAt c k * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c k * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ c = h⁻¹ (g⁻¹ c) := rfl
    rw [this]

    (hg : MapsTransvections g) : MapsTransvections g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.2 c k
    exact ⟨k', by simpa using hk'⟩
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.1 c k
    refine ⟨k', ?_⟩
    simpa using hk'

name: Sporadic.U43.card_U43_lower

proof:

  have h4 : 9 * 2 ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab012 (4 : Fin 112)).ncard * Nat.card StabTail :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul stab012_orbit_lower stabTail_lower
  have h3 : 54 * (9 * 2) ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab01 (6 : Fin 112)).ncard * Nat.card Stab012 := by
    rw [card_stab012_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul stab01_orbit_lower h4
  have h2 : 30 * (54 * (9 * 2)) ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 112)).ncard * Nat.card Stab01 := by
    rw [card_stab01_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul stab0_orbit_one_lower h3
  have h1 : 112 * (30 * (54 * (9 * 2))) ≤ 112 * Nat.card Stab0 := by
    rw [card_stab0_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 112 h2
  calc (3265920 : ℕ) = 112 * (30 * (54 * (9 * 2))) := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 112 * Nat.card Stab0 := h1
    _ = Nat.card U43Subgroup := card_U43_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer.symm

name: Sporadic.U43.GQ.PreservesNbrs.inv

theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm112}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.U43.GQ.U43_preserves_nbrs
statement:
theorem U43_preserves_nbrs {g : Perm112} (hg : g ∈ U43Subgroup) :
    PreservesNbrs g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact u43e1_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u43e2_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u43e3_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u43e4_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    hg

proof:

  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.Word.eval_nil
statement:

theorem eval_nil : eval [] = (1 : Perm22)

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.Word.eval_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_cons (g : Gen) (rest : Word) :
    eval (g :: rest) = eval rest * g.toPerm

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.Word.eval_mem_M22Subgroup
statement: theorem eval_mem_M22Subgroup : ∀ w : Word, eval w ∈ M22Subgroup
proof:
| [] => by simp [eval]
  | g :: rest => by
      exact M22Subgroup.mul_mem (eval_mem_M22Subgroup rest) (Gen.toPerm_mem_M22Subgroup g)

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.exists_wittBlockAt_eq_get

    ∃ j : Fin 77, wittBlockList.get i = wittBlockAt j
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin 77 := ⟨i.1, by simpa [wittBlockList_length] using i.2⟩
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  unfold wittBlockAt
  congr

statement:
theorem forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt (g : Perm22) (index : Fin 77 → Fin 77)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 77, blockMap g (wittBlockAt i) = wittBlockAt (index i)) :
    ∀ B ∈ wittBlockList, blockMap g B ∈ wittBlocks
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.forall_mem_iff_get]
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hget⟩ := exists_wittBlockAt_eq_get i
  rw [hget, h]
  exact wittBlockAt_mem (index j)

theorem PreservesWittBlocks.of_blockMapAt (g : Perm22)
    (index invIndex : Fin 77 → Fin 77)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 77, blockMap g (wittBlockAt i) = wittBlockAt (index i))
    (hinv : ∀ i : Fin 77, blockMap g⁻¹ (wittBlockAt i) = wittBlockAt (invIndex i)) :
    PreservesWittBlocks g
proof:
:=
  ⟨forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g index h,
    forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g⁻¹ invIndex hinv⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesWittBlocks.one
statement: theorem PreservesWittBlocks.one : PreservesWittBlocks (1 : Perm22)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro B hB
  · rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_wittBlocks_of_mem_wittBlockList hB
  · change blockMap (1 : Perm22) B ∈ wittBlocks
    rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_wittBlocks_of_mem_wittBlockList hB

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesWittBlocks.mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro B hB
    rw [blockMap_mul]
    have hhB : blockMap h B ∈ wittBlocks := hh.1 B hB
    exact hg.1 (blockMap h B) (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks hhB)
  · intro B hB
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, blockMap_mul]
    have hgB : blockMap g⁻¹ B ∈ wittBlocks := hg.2 B hB
    exact hh.2 (blockMap g⁻¹ B) (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks hgB)

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesWittBlocks.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesWittBlocks.inv {g : Perm22}
    (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g) : PreservesWittBlocks g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hg.2
  · exact hg.1

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.m22a_preserves_wittBlocks
statement: theorem m22a_preserves_wittBlocks : PreservesWittBlocks m22a
proof:
:=
  PreservesWittBlocks.of_blockMapAt m22a m22aBlockIndex m22aInvBlockIndex
    m22a_blockMapAt m22aInv_blockMapAt

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.m22b_preserves_wittBlocks
statement: theorem m22b_preserves_wittBlocks : PreservesWittBlocks m22b
proof:
:=
  PreservesWittBlocks.of_blockMapAt m22b m22bBlockIndex m22bInvBlockIndex
    m22b_blockMapAt m22bInv_blockMapAt

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.M22_preserves_wittBlocks
statement: theorem M22_preserves_wittBlocks (g : M22) : PreservesWittBlocks g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesWittBlocks x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact m22a_preserves_wittBlocks
      · exact m22b_preserves_wittBlocks)
    PreservesWittBlocks.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesWittBlocks.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesWittBlocks.inv hx)
    g.2

statement: theorem wittBlockAt_zero : wittBlockAt (0 : Fin 77) = blockB0

statement:
theorem mem_wittBlockList_exists_at {B : Block} (hB : B ∈ wittBlockList) :

proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_wittBlockAt_eq_get n

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.mem_blockMap
statement:
theorem mem_blockMap (g : Perm22) {B : Block} {x : Fin 22} (hx : x ∈ B)
    {v : Fin 22} (hv : g x = v) : v ∈ blockMap g B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hv]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem g hx

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (g : Perm22) {u w : Fin 22} {e : Fin 22}
    (hu : g u = e) (hne : w ≠ u) : g w ≠ e

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.blockMap_eq_of_three
statement:
theorem blockMap_eq_of_three (g : Perm22)
    (hpres : ∀ B ∈ wittBlockList, blockMap g B ∈ wittBlocks)
    {B B' : Block} {i₀ : Fin 77} (hBat : wittBlockAt i₀ = B)
    {x y z : Fin 22} (hx : x ∈ B) (hy : y ∈ B) (hz : z ∈ B)
    {ix iy iz : Fin 22} (hgx : g x = ix) (hgy : g y = iy) (hgz : g z = iz)
    {t : Fin 77}
    (huniq : ∀ i : Fin 77, ix ∈ wittBlockAt i → iy ∈ wittBlockAt i →
      iz ∈ wittBlockAt i → i = t)
    (hat : wittBlockAt t = B') :
    blockMap g B = B'
proof:
:= by
  have hBmem : B ∈ wittBlockList :=
    mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks (hBat ▸ wittBlockAt_mem i₀)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_wittBlockList_exists_at
    (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks (hpres B hBmem))
  have h1 : ix ∈ wittBlockAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hx hgx
  have h2 : iy ∈ wittBlockAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hy hgy
  have h3 : iz ∈ wittBlockAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hz hgz
  rw [hi, huniq i h1 h2 h3, hat]

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.SteinerSystem.mem_of_blockMap_eq
statement:
theorem mem_of_blockMap_eq (g : Perm22) {B B' : Block}
    (hmap : blockMap g B = B') {w : Fin 22} (hw : w ∈ B) : g w ∈ B'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hmap]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem g hw

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_zero_eq_univ
statement: theorem orbit_zero_eq_univ : MulAction.orbit M22 (0 : Fin 22) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by

  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_M22_witness x

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.second_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 22) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22), g.1.1 (1 : Fin 22) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroStabilizerElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (zeroStabilizerWord x)) (1 : Fin 22) = x
    exact zeroStabilizerWord_maps_one_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 22) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 22) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_ncard
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22)).ncard = 21
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_eq_nonzero]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 22 | x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 22)) = ({0} : Set (Fin 22))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.third_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 22) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22),
      g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 22) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroOneStabilizerElement x hx0 hx1, by
    change (Word.eval (zeroOneStabilizerWord x)) (2 : Fin 22) = x
    exact zeroOneStabilizerWord_maps_two_all x hx0 hx1⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
        (2 : Fin 22) =
      {x : Fin 22 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 22) = 0 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 22) ≠ 0) h20
    · intro hx1
      have hfix1 : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 22) = 1 := by
        have hg1 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 22) = 1 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
      have h21 : (2 : Fin 22) = 1 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 22) ≠ 1) h21
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_ncard
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
        (2 : Fin 22)).ncard = 20
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 22 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1} : Set (Fin 22)) =
      ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 22))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl]
  norm_num

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 22) (hx : x ∈ blockB0ᶜ) :

        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
        (2 : Fin 22),
      g.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 22) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨levelFourElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelFourWord x)) (5 : Fin 22) = x
    exact levelFourWord_maps_five_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.blockMap_B0_of_fixes
statement:
theorem blockMap_B0_of_fixes (π : Perm22)
    (hpres : ∀ B ∈ wittBlockList, blockMap π B ∈ wittBlocks)
    (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h1 : π 1 = 1) (h2 : π 2 = 2) :
    blockMap π blockB0 = blockB0
proof:
:=
  blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres wittBlockAt_zero (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    h0 h1 h2 unique_block_012 wittBlockAt_zero

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab012_orbit_five_eq
statement:
theorem stab012_orbit_five_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
          (2 : Fin 22))
        (5 : Fin 22) = ↑(blockB0ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 22) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 22) = 2 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (5 : Fin 22) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hB0 : blockMap g.1.1.1.1 blockB0 = blockB0 :=
      blockMap_B0_of_fixes g.1.1.1.1 (M22_preserves_wittBlocks g.1.1.1).1
        hfix0 hfix1 hfix2
    rw [Finset.coe_compl, Set.mem_compl_iff, Finset.mem_coe]
    intro hxB0
    rw [← hB0] at hxB0
    obtain ⟨w, hwB0, hw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxB0
    have hw5 : w = 5 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hw, hmap])
    rw [hw5] at hwB0
    exact (by decide : (5 : Fin 22) ∉ blockB0) hwB0
  · intro hx
    have hxc : x ∈ blockB0ᶜ := Finset.mem_coe.mp hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hxc
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab012_orbit_five_ncard
statement:
theorem stab012_orbit_five_ncard :

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 22) (hx : x = 3 ∨ x = 4 ∨ x = 21) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
          (2 : Fin 22))

      g.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 22) = x
proof:

    change (Word.eval (levelFiveWord x)) (3 : Fin 22) = x
    exact levelFiveWord_maps_three_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab0125_orbit_three_eq
statement:
theorem stab0125_orbit_three_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
            (2 : Fin 22))
          (5 : Fin 22))
        (3 : Fin 22) = ↑({3, 4, 21} : Finset (Fin 22))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 22) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 22) = 1 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 22) = 2 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 22) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hB0 : blockMap g.1.1.1.1.1 blockB0 = blockB0 :=
      blockMap_B0_of_fixes g.1.1.1.1.1 (M22_preserves_wittBlocks g.1.1.1.1).1
        hfix0 hfix1 hfix2
    have hmem : x ∈ blockB0 := by
      rw [← hmap]
      exact mem_of_blockMap_eq g.1.1.1.1.1 hB0 (by decide)
    rw [Finset.mem_coe]
    refine pin_three x hmem ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [← hmap]
      exact ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1 hfix0 (by decide)
    · rw [← hmap]
      exact ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1 hfix1 (by decide)
    · rw [← hmap]
      exact ne_of_value g.1.1.1.1.1 hfix2 (by decide)
  · intro hx
    have hxor := mem_targets_iff x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hxor
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab0125_orbit_three_ncard
statement:
theorem stab0125_orbit_three_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit

            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M22 (0 : Fin 22)) (1 : Fin 22))
            (2 : Fin 22))
          (5 : Fin 22))
        (3 : Fin 22)).ncard = 3

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.FinalStabilizer.eq_one_of_fix_four
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_fix_four (π : Perm22)
    (hpres : ∀ B ∈ wittBlockList, blockMap π B ∈ wittBlocks)
    (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h1 : π 1 = 1) (h2 : π 2 = 2) (h3 : π 3 = 3)
    (h5 : π 5 = 5) (h4 : π 4 = 4) : π = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hKBA_21 : blockMap π ({1, 2, 5, 6, 11, 12} : Block) = ({1, 2, 5, 6, 11, 12} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_21 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h1 h2 h5 uniqA_21 atA_21
  have hKBA_49 : blockMap π ({3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10} : Block) = ({3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_49 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h3 h4 h5 uniqA_49 atA_49
  have hvA_6 : π 6 = 6 :=
    stepA_0 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_21 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_49 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_29 : blockMap π ({1, 4, 5, 7, 18, 20} : Block) = ({1, 4, 5, 7, 18, 20} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_29 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h1 h4 h5 uniqA_29 atA_29
  have hKBA_37 : blockMap π ({2, 3, 5, 7, 17, 19} : Block) = ({2, 3, 5, 7, 17, 19} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_37 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h2 h3 h5 uniqA_37 atA_37
  have hvA_7 : π 7 = 7 :=
    stepA_1 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_29 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_37 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_25 : blockMap π ({1, 3, 5, 8, 14, 15} : Block) = ({1, 3, 5, 8, 14, 15} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_25 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h1 h3 h5 uniqA_25 atA_25
  have hKBA_41 : blockMap π ({2, 4, 5, 8, 13, 16} : Block) = ({2, 4, 5, 8, 13, 16} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_41 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h2 h4 h5 uniqA_41 atA_41
  have hvA_8 : π 8 = 8 :=
    stepA_2 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_25 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_41 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_5 : blockMap π ({0, 2, 5, 9, 14, 18} : Block) = ({0, 2, 5, 9, 14, 18} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_5 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h0 h2 h5 uniqA_5 atA_5
  have hvA_9 : π 9 = 9 :=
    stepA_3 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_5 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_49 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_1 : blockMap π ({0, 1, 5, 10, 16, 19} : Block) = ({0, 1, 5, 10, 16, 19} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_1 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h0 h1 h5 uniqA_1 atA_1
  have hvA_10 : π 10 = 10 :=
    stepA_4 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_1 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_49 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_13 : blockMap π ({0, 4, 5, 11, 15, 17} : Block) = ({0, 4, 5, 11, 15, 17} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_13 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h0 h4 h5 uniqA_13 atA_13
  have hvA_11 : π 11 = 11 :=
    stepA_5 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_13 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_21 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hKBA_9 : blockMap π ({0, 3, 5, 12, 13, 20} : Block) = ({0, 3, 5, 12, 13, 20} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_9 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h0 h3 h5 uniqA_9 atA_9
  have hvA_12 : π 12 = 12 :=
    stepA_6 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_9 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_21 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hvA_13 : π 13 = 13 :=
    stepA_7 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_9 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_41 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hvA_14 : π 14 = 14 :=
    stepA_8 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_5 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_25 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hvA_15 : π 15 = 15 :=
    stepA_9 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_13 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_25 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hvA_16 : π 16 = 16 :=
    stepA_10 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_1 (by decide)) (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_41 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide))
  have hvA_17 : π 17 = 17 :=
    stepA_11 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_13 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h4 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_11 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_15 (by decide))
  have hvA_18 : π 18 = 18 :=
    stepA_12 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_5 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h2 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_9 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_14 (by decide))
  have hvA_19 : π 19 = 19 :=
    stepA_13 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_1 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h1 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_10 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_16 (by decide))
  have hvA_20 : π 20 = 20 :=
    stepA_14 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_9 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h3 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h5 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_12 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hvA_13 (by decide))
  have hKBA_0 : blockMap π ({0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 21} : Block) = ({0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 21} : Block) :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres atA_0 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      h0 h1 h2 uniqA_0 atA_0
  have hvA_21 : π 21 = 21 :=
    stepA_15 _ (mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKBA_0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h1 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h2 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h3 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h4 (by decide))
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · exact h0.trans (by decide)
  · exact h1.trans (by decide)
  · exact h2.trans (by decide)
  · exact h3.trans (by decide)
  · exact h4.trans (by decide)
  · exact h5.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_6.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_7.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_8.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_9.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_10.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_11.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_12.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_13.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_14.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_15.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_16.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_17.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_18.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_19.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_20.trans (by decide)
  · exact hvA_21.trans (by decide)

name: Sporadic.M22Certificates.FinalStabilizer.fixed_base_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one
statement:
theorem fixed_base_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one (π : Perm22)
    (hg : PreservesWittBlocks π) (hsign : Equiv.Perm.sign π = 1)
    (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h1 : π 1 = 1) (h2 : π 2 = 2) (h3 : π 3 = 3)
    (h5 : π 5 = 5) : π = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpres := hg.1
  have hKB0 : blockMap π blockB0 = blockB0 :=
    blockMap_eq_of_three π hpres wittBlockAt_zero (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide) h0 h1 h2 unique_block_012 wittBlockAt_zero
  have hmem4 : π 4 ∈ blockB0 := mem_of_blockMap_eq π hKB0 (by decide)
  have h4or : π 4 = 4 ∨ π 4 = 21 :=
    pin_four _ hmem4
      (ne_of_value π h0 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h1 (by decide))
      (ne_of_value π h2 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h3 (by decide))
  rcases h4or with h4 | h4
  · exact eq_one_of_fix_four π hpres h0 h1 h2 h3 h5 h4
  · exfalso
    have htau := eq_tau_of_swap_four π hpres h0 h1 h2 h3 h5 h4
    rw [htau, tauOuter_sign] at hsign
    exact absurd hsign (by decide)

theorem mapsElations_mul {g h : Perm21}
    (hg : MapsElations g) (hh : MapsElations h) : MapsElations (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  intro x k
  obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := hh x k
  obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := hg (h x) k₁
  refine ⟨k₂, ?_⟩
  have : g * h * elationAt x k * (g * h)⁻¹ =
      g * (h * elationAt x k * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
    group
  rw [this, hk₁, hk₂]
  rfl

      · exact mapsElations₂_gen2

statement: theorem elation_mem (x : Fin 21) (k : Fin 15) : elationAt x k ∈ L34Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (Word.eval (orbitZeroWord x)) (0 : Fin 21) = x :=
    orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  set g : Perm21 := Word.eval (orbitZeroWord x) with hgdef
  have hgmem : g ∈ L34Subgroup := Word.eval_mem_L34Subgroup _
  have hginv : g⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hw]
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (mapsElations₂_of_mem hgmem).2 x k
  rw [hginv] at hk'
  have : elationAt x k = g * elationAt 0 k' * g⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hk']
    group
  rw [this]
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hgmem (elation_zero_mem k'))
    (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hgmem)

name: Sporadic.L34.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 21) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : L34Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toL34 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 21) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 21) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set B := Word.toL34 (zeroStabWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 21) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_fixes_zero_all z hz0
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 21) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_maps_one_all z hz0
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.L34.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 21) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : L34Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.L34.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup L34Subgroup) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 21, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.L34.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup L34Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : L34Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 21} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 21) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.L34.T0_le_L34
statement: theorem T0_le_L34 : T0 ≤ L34Subgroup

name: Sporadic.L34.elation_zero_mem_T0
statement: theorem elation_zero_mem_T0 (k : Fin 15) : elationAt 0 k ∈ T0

name: Sporadic.L34.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (elationAt 0 k) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
      exact elation_comm_zero k k'
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.L34.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N : Subgroup L34Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 21, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (g : L34Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : L34Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 21) (k : Fin 15) (hxe : x = elationAt c k)
        (hmem : x ∈ L34Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : L34Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c k hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans 0 c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (mapsElations₂_of_mem m.2).2 c k
      rw [inv_inv, hminv] at hk'
      
      set t : L34Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm21) = elationAt 0 k' := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact elation_zero_mem_T0 k'
      set n : L34Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key 20 7 l34e1_eq_elation _
    · exact key 18 14 l34e2_eq_elation _
    · exact key 14 5 l34e3_eq_elation _
  · 
    refine ⟨1, N.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · 
    rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : L34Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : L34Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹), N.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · 
    rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : L34Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : L34Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.L34.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N : Subgroup L34Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 21, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (a b : L34Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : L34Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.L34.gen1_commutator
statement:
theorem gen1_commutator :
    (⟨l34e1, l34e1_mem⟩ : L34Subgroup) =
      ⁅(⟨commU1, commU1_mem⟩ : L34Subgroup), ⟨commV1, commV1_mem⟩⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change l34e1 = commU1 * commV1 * commU1⁻¹ * commV1⁻¹
  rw [inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right commU1_sq, inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right commV1_sq]
  exact l34e1_comm_id

name: Sporadic.L34.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : L34Subgroup, g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : L34Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup)⁆) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (⟨l34e1, _⟩ : L34Subgroup) = ⟨l34e1, l34e1_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen1_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨l34e2, _⟩ : L34Subgroup) = ⟨l34e2, l34e2_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen2_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨l34e3, _⟩ : L34Subgroup) = ⟨l34e3, l34e3_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen3_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

:= by

name: Sporadic.L34.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup L34Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 21, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v :=
    fun u v => normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp u v
  have hcomm_le : ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L34Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

    ∃ g : Stab0, g.1.1 (1 : Fin 21) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroStabElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (zeroStabWord x)) (1 : Fin 21) = x
    exact zeroStabWord_maps_one_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.L34.stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero :
    MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 21) = {x : Fin 21 | x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 21) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 21) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 21) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 21) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.L34.stab0_orbit_one_ncard
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 21)).ncard = 20
proof:
:= by
  rw [stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 21 | x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 21)) = ({0} : Set (Fin 21))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

theorem card_L34_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer :
    Nat.card L34Subgroup = 21 * Nat.card Stab0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group L34Subgroup (0 : Fin 21)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, orbit_zero_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab0)]

    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group Stab0 (1 : Fin 21)]

name: Sporadic.L34.stab01List_nodup
statement: theorem stab01List_nodup : stab01List.Nodup
proof:
:= by

  rw [← stab01List_map_eval] at h
  exact h.of_map _

name: Sporadic.L34.stab01List_length

name: Sporadic.L34.stab01_lower
statement: theorem stab01_lower : 48 ≤ Nat.card Stab01
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype Stab01 := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc 48 = stab01List.length := stab01List_length.symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card Stab01 := stab01List_nodup.length_le_card

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.Gen.toPerm_mem_M12Subgroup
statement: theorem toPerm_mem_M12Subgroup (g : Gen) : g.toPerm ∈ M12Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  cases g <;>
    simp [toPerm, m12a_mem_M12Subgroup, m12b_mem_M12Subgroup, m12c_mem_M12Subgroup]

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.Word.eval_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_nil : eval [] = (1 : Perm12)

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.Word.eval_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_cons (g : Gen) (rest : Word) :
    eval (g :: rest) = eval rest * g.toPerm

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.Word.eval_mem_M12Subgroup
statement: theorem eval_mem_M12Subgroup : ∀ w : Word, eval w ∈ M12Subgroup
proof:
| [] => by simp [eval]
  | g :: rest => by
      exact M12Subgroup.mul_mem (eval_mem_M12Subgroup rest) (Gen.toPerm_mem_M12Subgroup g)

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.Word.toM12_toPerm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toM12_toPerm (w : Word) : (toM12 w).1 = eval w

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.target_index_product
statement: theorem target_index_product : 12 * 11 * 10 * 9 * 8 = 95040

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all
statement:
theorem orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all :
    ∀ x : Fin 12, (Word.eval (orbitZeroWord x)) (0 : Fin 12) = x

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.orbitZeroWord_maps_zero
statement:
theorem orbitZeroWord_maps_zero (x : Fin 12) :
    (Word.eval (orbitZeroWord x)) (0 : Fin 12) = x

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.first_orbit_word_witness
statement:
theorem first_orbit_word_witness (x : Fin 12) :
    ∃ w : Word, (Word.eval w) (0 : Fin 12) = x

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.first_orbit_M12_witness
statement:
theorem first_orbit_M12_witness (x : Fin 12) :
    ∃ g : M12, g.1 (0 : Fin 12) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨Word.toM12 (orbitZeroWord x), by simpa using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero x⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.orbit_zero_eq_univ
statement: theorem orbit_zero_eq_univ : MulAction.orbit M12 (0 : Fin 12) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_M12_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 12) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 12) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

  have hset : ({x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 12)) = ({0} : Set (Fin 12))ᶜ := by
    ext x

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_orbit_two_eq_remaining :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M12 (0 : Fin 12)) (1 : Fin 12))
        (2 : Fin 12) =
      {x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 12) = 0 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 12) ≠ 0) h20
    · intro hx1
      have hfix1 : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 12) = 1 := by
        have hg1 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 12) = 1 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
      have h21 : (2 : Fin 12) = 1 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 12) ≠ 1) h21
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M12 (0 : Fin 12)) (1 : Fin 12))
          (2 : Fin 12))
        (3 : Fin 12) =
      {x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
      have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h30 : (3 : Fin 12) = 0 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 12) ≠ 0) h30
    · constructor
      · intro hx1
        have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 12) = 1 := by
          have hg1 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg1
        have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 12) = 1 := by
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
        have h31 : (3 : Fin 12) = 1 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
        exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 12) ≠ 1) h31
      · intro hx2
        have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 12) = 2 := by
          have hg2 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg2
        have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 12) = 2 := by
          simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx2] using hg
        have h32 : (3 : Fin 12) = 2 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix2])
        exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 12) ≠ 2) h32
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1, hx2⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1 hx2
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_ncard
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M12 (0 : Fin 12)) (1 : Fin 12))
          (2 : Fin 12))
        (3 : Fin 12)).ncard = 9
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_one_two_orbit_three_eq_remaining]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2} : Set (Fin 12)) =
      ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 12))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl]
  have hcard : ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 12)).ncard = 3 := by
    rw [show ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 12)) = insert (0 : Fin 12) ({1, 2} : Set (Fin 12)) by
      ext x
      simp]
    rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
    · rw [show ({1, 2} : Set (Fin 12)) = insert (1 : Fin 12) ({2} : Set (Fin 12)) by
        ext x
        simp]
      rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
      · simp
      · simp
    · simp
  rw [hcard]
  norm_num

theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_three_orbit_four_eq_remaining :

            (2 : Fin 12))
          (3 : Fin 12))
        (4 : Fin 12) =
      {x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2 ∧ x ≠ 3}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
        have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.1.2)

        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h40 : (4 : Fin 12) = 0 := g.1.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])

    · constructor
      · intro hx1

        have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 12) = 1 := by

        have h41 : (4 : Fin 12) = 1 := g.1.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
        exact (by decide : (4 : Fin 12) ≠ 1) h41
      · constructor
        · intro hx2
          have hfix2 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 12) = 2 := by
            have hg2 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
            simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg2
          have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 12) = 2 := by
            simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx2] using hg
          have h42 : (4 : Fin 12) = 2 := g.1.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix2])
          exact (by decide : (4 : Fin 12) ≠ 2) h42
        · intro hx3
          have hfix3 : g.1.1.1.1.1 (3 : Fin 12) = 3 := by
            have hg3 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
            simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg3
          have hmap : g.1.1.1.1.1 (4 : Fin 12) = 3 := by
            simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx3] using hg
          have h43 : (4 : Fin 12) = 3 := g.1.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix3])
          exact (by decide : (4 : Fin 12) ≠ 3) h43
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1, hx2, hx3⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fifth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx0 hx1 hx2 hx3
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.StabilizerChain.stabilizer_zero_one_two_three_orbit_four_ncard
statement:
theorem stabilizer_zero_one_two_three_orbit_four_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer
            (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M12 (0 : Fin 12)) (1 : Fin 12))
            (2 : Fin 12))
          (3 : Fin 12))
        (4 : Fin 12)).ncard = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [stabilizer_zero_one_two_three_orbit_four_eq_remaining]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ 2 ∧ x ≠ 3} : Set (Fin 12)) =
      ({0, 1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 12))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl]
  have hcard : ({0, 1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)).ncard = 4 := by
    rw [show ({0, 1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)) =
        insert (0 : Fin 12) ({1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)) by
      ext x
      simp]
    rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
    · rw [show ({1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)) =
          insert (1 : Fin 12) ({2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)) by
        ext x
        simp]
      rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
      · rw [show ({2, 3} : Set (Fin 12)) = insert (2 : Fin 12) ({3} : Set (Fin 12)) by
          ext x
          simp]
        rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem]
        · simp
        · simp
      · simp
    · simp
  rw [hcard]
  norm_num

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.WittDesign.PreservesWittBlocks.mul

  · intro B hB

  · intro B hB
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, blockMap_mul]
    have hgB : blockMap g⁻¹ B ∈ wittBlocks := hg.2 B hB
    exact hh.2 (blockMap g⁻¹ B) (mem_wittBlockList_of_mem_wittBlocks hgB)

proof:

  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesWittBlocks x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.WittDesign.outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id
statement:
theorem outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id (f : Outside → Outside)
    (h0123 : CommutesWithOutside f tau0123)
    (h0124 : CommutesWithOutside f tau0124)
    (h0134 : CommutesWithOutside f tau0134)
    (h0234 : CommutesWithOutside f tau0234)
    (h1234 : CommutesWithOutside f tau1234) :
    ∀ x, f x = x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma0 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h0234) h1234
    have hfixed : sigma0 (f 0) = f 0 := by
      have h := hcomm 0
      have h0 : sigma0 0 = 0 := by decide
      simpa [h0] using h.symm
    exact (sigma0_fixed_iff (f 0)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma1 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h0134) h0234
    have hfixed : sigma1 (f 1) = f 1 := by
      have h := hcomm 1
      have h1 : sigma1 1 = 1 := by decide
      simpa [h1] using h.symm
    exact (sigma1_fixed_iff (f 1)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma2 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h1234) h0234
    have hfixed : sigma2 (f 2) = f 2 := by
      have h := hcomm 2
      have h2 : sigma2 2 = 2 := by decide
      simpa [h2] using h.symm
    exact (sigma2_fixed_iff (f 2)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma3 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h1234) h0134
    have hfixed : sigma3 (f 3) = f 3 := by
      have h := hcomm 3
      have h3 : sigma3 3 = 3 := by decide
      simpa [h3] using h.symm
    exact (sigma3_fixed_iff (f 3)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma4 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h0134) h1234
    have hfixed : sigma4 (f 4) = f 4 := by
      have h := hcomm 4
      have h4 : sigma4 4 = 4 := by decide
      simpa [h4] using h.symm
    exact (sigma4_fixed_iff (f 4)).mp hfixed
  · have hcomm : CommutesWithOutside f sigma5 :=
      CommutesWithOutside.mul
        (CommutesWithOutside.mul
          (CommutesWithOutside.mul h0123 h0124) h0234) h0134
    have hfixed : sigma5 (f 5) = f 5 := by
      have h := hcomm 5
      have h5 : sigma5 5 = 5 := by decide
      simpa [h5] using h.symm
    exact (sigma5_fixed_iff (f 5)).mp hfixed

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.WittDesign.perm_maps_outsidePoint
statement:
theorem perm_maps_outsidePoint (g : Perm12)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2)
    (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h4 : g 4 = 4) (h6 : g 6 = 6) (i : Outside) :
    IsOutsidePoint (g (outsidePoint i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOutsidePoint_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 0 := by simpa [h0] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 0 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 1 := by simpa [h1] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 1 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 2 := by simpa [h2] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 2 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 3 := by simpa [h3] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 3 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.2.1 hi
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 4 := by simpa [h4] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 4 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout
    exact hout.2.2.2.2.1 hi
  · intro h
    have : g (outsidePoint i) = g 6 := by simpa [h6] using h
    have hi : outsidePoint i = 6 := g.injective this
    have hout := outsidePoint_isOutside i
    rw [isOutsidePoint_iff] at hout

theorem outsideMap_commutes_tau0123 (g : Perm12) (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2)
    (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h4 : g 4 = 4) (h6 : g 6 = 6) :
    CommutesWithOutside (outsideMap g) tau0123
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hMemW :
      ({0, 1, 2, 3, outsidePoint i, outsidePoint (tau0123 i)} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks :=

  have hit := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (tau0123 i)
  have hMapped :
      ({0, 1, 2, 3, outsidePoint (outsideMap g i),
        outsidePoint (outsideMap g (tau0123 i))} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks := by
    simpa [blockMap, h0, h1, h2, h3, ← hi, ← hit] using hImage

statement:
theorem outsideMap_commutes_tau0134 (g : Perm12) (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2)
    (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h4 : g 4 = 4) (h6 : g 6 = 6) :
    CommutesWithOutside (outsideMap g) tau0134
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hMemW :
      ({0, 1, 3, 4, outsidePoint i, outsidePoint (tau0134 i)} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks :=
    (quad0134_pair_mem_iff i (tau0134 i)).mpr rfl
  have hImage := hg.1 _ (pair_block_mem_list_of_mem_blocks hMemW)
  have hi := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 i
  have hit := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (tau0134 i)
  have hMapped :
      ({0, 1, 3, 4, outsidePoint (outsideMap g i),
        outsidePoint (outsideMap g (tau0134 i))} : Block) ∈ wittBlocks := by
    simpa [blockMap, h0, h1, h3, h4, ← hi, ← hit] using hImage
  exact (quad0134_pair_mem_iff (outsideMap g i) (outsideMap g (tau0134 i))).mp hMapped

name: Sporadic.M12Certificates.WittDesign.fixed_five_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one
statement:
theorem fixed_five_preserves_wittBlocks_eq_one (g : Perm12)
    (hg : PreservesWittBlocks g)
    (h0 : g 0 = 0) (h1 : g 1 = 1) (h2 : g 2 = 2) (h3 : g 3 = 3) (h4 : g 4 = 4) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h6 := fixed_five_preserves_wittBlocks_fixes_six g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
  have houtside := outside_commuting_pairings_eq_id (outsideMap g)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau0123 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau0124 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau0134 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau0234 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6)
    (outsideMap_commutes_tau1234 g hg h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6)
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  fin_cases x
  · simpa using h0
  · simpa using h1
  · simpa using h2
  · simpa using h3
  · simpa using h4
  · have hmap := houtside (0 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (0 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (0 : Outside) = 5 := by decide
    calc
      g 5 = g (outsidePoint (0 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 0) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (0 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 5 := hp
  · simpa using h6
  · have hmap := houtside (1 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (1 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (1 : Outside) = 7 := by decide
    calc
      g 7 = g (outsidePoint (1 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 1) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (1 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 7 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (2 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (2 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (2 : Outside) = 8 := by decide
    calc
      g 8 = g (outsidePoint (2 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 2) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (2 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 8 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (3 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (3 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (3 : Outside) = 9 := by decide
    calc
      g 9 = g (outsidePoint (3 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 3) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (3 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 9 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (4 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (4 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (4 : Outside) = 10 := by decide
    calc
      g 10 = g (outsidePoint (4 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 4) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (4 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 10 := hp
  · have hmap := houtside (5 : Outside)
    have happly := outsideMap_apply g h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h6 (5 : Outside)
    have hp : outsidePoint (5 : Outside) = 11 := by decide
    calc
      g 11 = g (outsidePoint (5 : Outside)) := by rw [hp]
      _ = outsidePoint (outsideMap g 5) := happly.symm
      _ = outsidePoint (5 : Outside) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = 11 := hp

statement:
theorem forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt (g : Perm24) (index : Fin 759 → Fin 759)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 759, blockMap g (octadAt i) = octadAt (index i)) :
    ∀ B ∈ octadList, blockMap g B ∈ octads
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := mem_octadList_exists_at hB
  rw [h i]

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesOctads.of_blockMapAt
statement:
theorem PreservesOctads.of_blockMapAt (g : Perm24)
    (index invIndex : Fin 759 → Fin 759)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 759, blockMap g (octadAt i) = octadAt (index i))
    (hinv : ∀ i : Fin 759, blockMap g⁻¹ (octadAt i) = octadAt (invIndex i)) :
    PreservesOctads g
proof:
:=
  ⟨forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g index h,
    forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g⁻¹ invIndex hinv⟩

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesOctads.one
statement: theorem PreservesOctads.one : PreservesOctads (1 : Perm24)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro B hB
  · rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_octads_of_mem_octadList hB
  · change blockMap (1 : Perm24) B ∈ octads
    rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_octads_of_mem_octadList hB

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesOctads.mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro B hB
    rw [blockMap_mul]
    have hhB : blockMap h B ∈ octads := hh.1 B hB
    exact hg.1 (blockMap h B) (mem_octadList_of_mem_octads hhB)
  · intro B hB
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, blockMap_mul]
    have hgB : blockMap g⁻¹ B ∈ octads := hg.2 B hB
    exact hh.2 (blockMap g⁻¹ B) (mem_octadList_of_mem_octads hgB)

theorem PreservesOctads.inv {g : Perm24}
    (hg : PreservesOctads g) : PreservesOctads g⁻¹

  constructor
  · exact hg.2
  · exact hg.1

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.M24_preserves_octads
statement: theorem M24_preserves_octads (g : M24) : PreservesOctads g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesOctads x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact m24a_preserves_octads
      · exact m24b_preserves_octads
      · exact m24c_preserves_octads
      · exact m24d_preserves_octads)
    PreservesOctads.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesOctads.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesOctads.inv hx)
    g.2

proof:

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.ne_of_value

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.SteinerSystem.blockMap_eq_of_five
statement:
theorem blockMap_eq_of_five (g : Perm24)
    (hpres : ∀ B ∈ octadList, blockMap g B ∈ octads)
    {B B' : Block} {i₀ : Fin 759} (hBat : octadAt i₀ = B)
    {x y z w u : Fin 24}
    (hx : x ∈ B) (hy : y ∈ B) (hz : z ∈ B) (hw : w ∈ B) (hu : u ∈ B)
    {ix iy iz iw iu : Fin 24}
    (hgx : g x = ix) (hgy : g y = iy) (hgz : g z = iz) (hgw : g w = iw)
    (hgu : g u = iu)
    {t : Fin 759}
    (huniq : ∀ i : Fin 759, ix ∈ octadAt i → iy ∈ octadAt i →
      iz ∈ octadAt i → iw ∈ octadAt i → iu ∈ octadAt i → i = t)
    (hat : octadAt t = B') :
    blockMap g B = B'
proof:
:= by
  have hBmem : B ∈ octadList :=
    mem_octadList_of_mem_octads (hBat ▸ octadAt_mem i₀)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_octadList_exists_at
    (mem_octadList_of_mem_octads (hpres B hBmem))
  have h1 : ix ∈ octadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hx hgx
  have h2 : iy ∈ octadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hy hgy
  have h3 : iz ∈ octadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hz hgz
  have h4 : iw ∈ octadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hw hgw
  have h5 : iu ∈ octadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hu hgu
  rw [hi, huniq i h1 h2 h3 h4 h5, hat]

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_last_eq_univ

    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_M24_witness x

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.second_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 24) (hx : x ≠ 23) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer M24 (23 : Fin 24), g.1.1 (22 : Fin 24) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨lastStabilizerElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelTwoWord x)) (22 : Fin 24) = x
    exact levelTwoWord_maps_22_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab23_orbit_22_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx23
    have hfix : g.1.1 (23 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
      have hg23 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg23
    have hmap : g.1.1 (22 : Fin 24) = 23 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx23] using hg
    have h2223 : (22 : Fin 24) = 23 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (22 : Fin 24) ≠ 23) h2223
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab23_orbit_22_ncard
statement:
theorem stab23_orbit_22_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer M24 (23 : Fin 24)) (22 : Fin 24)).ncard = 23
proof:
:= by
  rw [stab23_orbit_22_eq]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 24 | x ≠ 23} : Set (Fin 24)) = ({23} : Set (Fin 24))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.third_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 24) (hx23 : x ≠ 23) (hx22 : x ≠ 22) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M24 (23 : Fin 24)) (22 : Fin 24),
      g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 24) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab2322Element x hx23 hx22, by
    change (Word.eval (levelThreeWord x)) (0 : Fin 24) = x
    exact levelThreeWord_maps_0_all x hx23 hx22⟩

name: Sporadic.M24Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab2322_orbit_zero_eq
statement:
theorem stab2322_orbit_zero_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M24 (23 : Fin 24)) (22 : Fin 24))
        (0 : Fin 24) =
      {x : Fin 24 | x ≠ 23 ∧ x ≠ 22}
proof:
:= by

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.exists_heptadAt_eq_get

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt
statement:
theorem forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt (g : Perm23) (index : Fin 253 → Fin 253)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 253, blockMap g (heptadAt i) = heptadAt (index i)) :
    ∀ B ∈ heptadList, blockMap g B ∈ heptads
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.forall_mem_iff_get]
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hget⟩ := exists_heptadAt_eq_get i
  rw [hget, h]
  exact heptadAt_mem (index j)

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesHeptads.of_blockMapAt
statement:
theorem PreservesHeptads.of_blockMapAt (g : Perm23)
    (index invIndex : Fin 253 → Fin 253)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 253, blockMap g (heptadAt i) = heptadAt (index i))
    (hinv : ∀ i : Fin 253, blockMap g⁻¹ (heptadAt i) = heptadAt (invIndex i)) :
    PreservesHeptads g
proof:
:=
  ⟨forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g index h,
    forall_mem_blockMap_mem_of_blockMapAt g⁻¹ invIndex hinv⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesHeptads.one
statement: theorem PreservesHeptads.one : PreservesHeptads (1 : Perm23)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro B hB
  · rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_heptads_of_mem_heptadList hB
  · change blockMap (1 : Perm23) B ∈ heptads
    rw [blockMap_one]
    exact mem_heptads_of_mem_heptadList hB

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesHeptads.mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro B hB
    rw [blockMap_mul]
    have hhB : blockMap h B ∈ heptads := hh.1 B hB
    exact hg.1 (blockMap h B) (mem_heptadList_of_mem_heptads hhB)
  · intro B hB
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, blockMap_mul]
    have hgB : blockMap g⁻¹ B ∈ heptads := hg.2 B hB
    exact hh.2 (blockMap g⁻¹ B) (mem_heptadList_of_mem_heptads hgB)

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.PreservesHeptads.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesHeptads.inv {g : Perm23}
    (hg : PreservesHeptads g) : PreservesHeptads g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hg.2
  · exact hg.1

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.m23a_preserves_heptads
statement: theorem m23a_preserves_heptads : PreservesHeptads m23a
proof:
:=
  PreservesHeptads.of_blockMapAt m23a m23aBlockIndex m23aInvBlockIndex
    m23a_blockMapAt m23aInv_blockMapAt

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.m23b_preserves_heptads

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.m23c_preserves_heptads
