name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.M23_preserves_heptads
statement: theorem M23_preserves_heptads (g : M23) : PreservesHeptads g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesHeptads x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact m23a_preserves_heptads
      · exact m23b_preserves_heptads
      · exact m23c_preserves_heptads)
    PreservesHeptads.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesHeptads.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesHeptads.inv hx)
    g.2

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.heptadAt_zero
statement: theorem heptadAt_zero : heptadAt (0 : Fin 253) = blockB0

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.unique_block_01222
statement:
theorem unique_block_01222 :
    ∀ i : Fin 253, (0 : Fin 23) ∈ heptadAt i → (1 : Fin 23) ∈ heptadAt i →
      (2 : Fin 23) ∈ heptadAt i → (22 : Fin 23) ∈ heptadAt i → i = 0

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.mem_heptadList_exists_at
statement:
theorem mem_heptadList_exists_at {B : Block} (hB : B ∈ heptadList) :
    ∃ i : Fin 253, B = heptadAt i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hB
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_heptadAt_eq_get n
  exact ⟨j, by rw [← hn, hj]⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.mem_blockMap
statement:
theorem mem_blockMap (g : Perm23) {B : Block} {x : Fin 23} (hx : x ∈ B)
    {v : Fin 23} (hv : g x = v) : v ∈ blockMap g B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hv]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem g hx

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (g : Perm23) {u w : Fin 23} {e : Fin 23}
    (hu : g u = e) (hne : w ≠ u) : g w ≠ e

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.blockMap_eq_of_four
statement:
theorem blockMap_eq_of_four (g : Perm23)
    (hpres : ∀ B ∈ heptadList, blockMap g B ∈ heptads)
    {B B' : Block} {i₀ : Fin 253} (hBat : heptadAt i₀ = B)
    {x y z w : Fin 23} (hx : x ∈ B) (hy : y ∈ B) (hz : z ∈ B) (hw : w ∈ B)
    {ix iy iz iw : Fin 23}
    (hgx : g x = ix) (hgy : g y = iy) (hgz : g z = iz) (hgw : g w = iw)
    {t : Fin 253}
    (huniq : ∀ i : Fin 253, ix ∈ heptadAt i → iy ∈ heptadAt i →
      iz ∈ heptadAt i → iw ∈ heptadAt i → i = t)
    (hat : heptadAt t = B') :
    blockMap g B = B'
proof:
:= by
  have hBmem : B ∈ heptadList :=
    mem_heptadList_of_mem_heptads (hBat ▸ heptadAt_mem i₀)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_heptadList_exists_at
    (mem_heptadList_of_mem_heptads (hpres B hBmem))
  have h1 : ix ∈ heptadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hx hgx
  have h2 : iy ∈ heptadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hy hgy
  have h3 : iz ∈ heptadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hz hgz
  have h4 : iw ∈ heptadAt i := by
    rw [← hi]
    exact mem_blockMap g hw hgw
  rw [hi, huniq i h1 h2 h3 h4, hat]

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.SteinerSystem.mem_of_blockMap_eq
statement:
theorem mem_of_blockMap_eq (g : Perm23) {B B' : Block}
    (hmap : blockMap g B = B') {w : Fin 23} (hw : w ∈ B) : g w ∈ B'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hmap]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem g hw

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.first_orbit_M23_witness
statement:
theorem first_orbit_M23_witness (x : Fin 23) :
    ∃ g : M23, g.1 (22 : Fin 23) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨Word.toM23 (levelOneWord x), by simpa using levelOneWord_maps_last_all x⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_last_eq_univ
statement: theorem orbit_last_eq_univ : MulAction.orbit M23 (22 : Fin 23) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_M23_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.orbit_last_ncard
statement: theorem orbit_last_ncard : (MulAction.orbit M23 (22 : Fin 23)).ncard = 23

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.second_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 23) (hx : x ≠ 22) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23), g.1.1 (0 : Fin 23) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨lastStabilizerElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (levelTwoWord x)) (0 : Fin 23) = x
    exact levelTwoWord_maps_zero_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab22_orbit_zero_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx22
    have hfix : g.1.1 (22 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
      have hg22 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg22
    have hmap : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx22] using hg
    have h022 : (0 : Fin 23) = 22 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 23) ≠ 22) h022
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab22_orbit_zero_ncard
statement:
theorem stab22_orbit_zero_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23)).ncard = 22
proof:
:= by
  rw [stab22_orbit_zero_eq]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 23 | x ≠ 22} : Set (Fin 23)) = ({22} : Set (Fin 23))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.third_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 23) (hx22 : x ≠ 22) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23),
      g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 23) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab220Element x hx22 hx0, by
    change (Word.eval (levelThreeWord x)) (1 : Fin 23) = x
    exact levelThreeWord_maps_one_all x hx22 hx0⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab220_orbit_one_eq
statement:
theorem stab220_orbit_one_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23))
        (1 : Fin 23) =
      {x : Fin 23 | x ≠ 22 ∧ x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx22
      have hfix22 : g.1.1.1 (22 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
        have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx22] using hg
      have h122 : (1 : Fin 23) = 22 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix22])
      exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 23) ≠ 22) h122
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 23) = 0 := by
        have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
      have hmap : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 23) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h10 : (1 : Fin 23) = 0 := g.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 23) ≠ 0) h10
  · rintro ⟨hx22, hx0⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx22 hx0
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab220_orbit_one_ncard
statement:
theorem stab220_orbit_one_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23))
        (1 : Fin 23)).ncard = 21
proof:
:= by
  rw [stab220_orbit_one_eq]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 23 | x ≠ 22 ∧ x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 23)) =
      ↑(({22, 0} : Finset (Fin 23))ᶜ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.coe_compl, Set.mem_compl_iff,
      Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or, ne_eq]
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  decide

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 23)
    (hx22 : x ≠ 22) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23))
        (1 : Fin 23),
      g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 23) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab2201Element x hx22 hx0 hx1, by
    change (Word.eval (levelFourWord x)) (2 : Fin 23) = x
    exact levelFourWord_maps_two_all x hx22 hx0 hx1⟩

name: Sporadic.M23Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab2201_orbit_two_eq
statement:
theorem stab2201_orbit_two_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer
          (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer M23 (22 : Fin 23)) (0 : Fin 23))
          (1 : Fin 23))
        (2 : Fin 23) =
      {x : Fin 23 | x ≠ 22 ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hx22
      have hfix22 : g.1.1.1.1 (22 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
        have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
      have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 23) = 22 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx22] using hg
      have h222 : (2 : Fin 23) = 22 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix22])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 23) ≠ 22) h222
    · intro hx0
      have hfix0 : g.1.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 23) = 0 := by
        have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
      have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 23) = 0 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 23) = 0 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix0])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 23) ≠ 0) h20
    · intro hx1
      have hfix1 : g.1.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 23) = 1 := by
        have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
      have hmap : g.1.1.1.1 (2 : Fin 23) = 1 := by
        simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx1] using hg
      have h21 : (2 : Fin 23) = 1 := g.1.1.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix1])
      exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 23) ≠ 1) h21
  · rintro ⟨hx22, hx0, hx1⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fourth_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hx22 hx0 hx1

:= by

  have h0_2 : HoldsOn 0 96 P := holdsOn_union h0_1 h2

  have h0_8 : HoldsOn 0 266 P := holdsOn_union h0_7 h8

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm266}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.J1_preserves_nbrs
statement: theorem J1_preserves_nbrs (g : J1) : PreservesNbrs g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact j1a_preserves_nbrs
      · exact j1b_preserves_nbrs
      · exact j1c_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    g.2

proof:
:= by

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm266) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 266} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

theorem not_mem_nbrs2_map (π : Perm266) (hpres : PreservesNbrs2 π)
    {u u' v : Fin 266} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs2 u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs2 u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs4.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs4 v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs4 v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.PreservesNbrs4.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs4.inv {g : Perm266}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs4 g) : PreservesNbrs4 g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Graph.J1_preserves_nbrs4
statement: theorem J1_preserves_nbrs4 (g : J1) : PreservesNbrs4 g.1
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs4 x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact j1a_preserves_nbrs4
      · exact j1b_preserves_nbrs4
      · exact j1c_preserves_nbrs4)
    PreservesNbrs4.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs4.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs4.inv hx)
    g.2

theorem second_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 266) (hx : x ∈ nbrs 265) :

proof:
:=
  ⟨starStabilizerElement x hx, by

    exact levelTwoWord_maps_0_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab_orbit_zero_eq
statement:
theorem stab_orbit_zero_eq :
    MulAction.orbit (MulAction.stabilizer J1 (265 : Fin 266)) (0 : Fin 266) =
      ↑(nbrs 265)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix : g.1.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 266) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hx : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 266) ∈ nbrs 265 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1 (J1_preserves_nbrs g.1) hfix (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_stabilizer_witness x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.ChainOrbits.third_orbit_stabilizer_witness
statement:
theorem third_orbit_stabilizer_witness (x : Fin 266)
    (hx : x ∈ nbrs 265) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer J1 (265 : Fin 266)) (0 : Fin 266),
      g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 266) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨stab0Element x hx hx0, by
    change (Word.eval (levelThreeWord x)) (1 : Fin 266) = x
    exact levelThreeWord_maps_1_all x hx hx0⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.ChainOrbits.stab0_orbit_one_eq
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_eq :
    MulAction.orbit
        (MulAction.stabilizer (MulAction.stabilizer J1 (265 : Fin 266)) (0 : Fin 266))
        (1 : Fin 266) =
      ↑(nbrs 265 \ {0})
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hfix265 : g.1.1.1 (265 : Fin 266) = 265 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.1.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hfix0 : g.1.1.1 (0 : Fin 266) = 0 := by
      have h := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using h
    have hmap : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 266) = x := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs g.1.1.1 := J1_preserves_nbrs g.1.1
    have hn : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 266) ∈ nbrs 265 :=
      mem_nbrs_map g.1.1.1 hpres hfix265 (by decide)
    have hne : g.1.1.1 (1 : Fin 266) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_value g.1.1.1 hfix0 (by decide)
    rw [hmap] at hn hne
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
      ⟨hn, by simpa using hne⟩)
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hn, hne⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    have hne' : x ≠ 0 := by simpa using hne
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := third_orbit_stabilizer_witness x hn hne'
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Families.preservesFamilies_one
statement: theorem preservesFamilies_one : PreservesFamilies 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro s hs <;>
    simp only [inv_one, hexMap_one, matchMap_one] <;>
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hs

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Families.preservesFamilies_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F hF
    rw [matchMap_mul]
    exact hg.1.1 _ (mem_matchList_of_mem (hh.1.1 F hF))
  · intro F hF
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, matchMap_mul]
    exact hh.1.2 _ (mem_matchList_of_mem (hg.1.2 F hF))
  · intro s hs
    rw [hexMap_mul]
    exact hg.2.1.1 _ (mem_hexAList_of_mem (hh.2.1.1 s hs))
  · intro s hs
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, hexMap_mul]
    exact hh.2.1.2 _ (mem_hexAList_of_mem (hg.2.1.2 s hs))
  · intro s hs
    rw [hexMap_mul]
    exact hg.2.2.1 _ (mem_hexBList_of_mem (hh.2.2.1 s hs))
  · intro s hs
    rw [show (g * h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ * g⁻¹ by simp, hexMap_mul]
    exact hh.2.2.2 _ (mem_hexBList_of_mem (hg.2.2.2 s hs))

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Families.preservesFamilies_inv
statement:
theorem preservesFamilies_inv {g : Perm12}
    (hg : PreservesFamilies g) : PreservesFamilies g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨hg.1.2, ?_⟩, ⟨hg.2.1.2, ?_⟩, hg.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hg.1.1
  · simpa using hg.2.1.1
  · simpa using hg.2.2.1

name: Sporadic.J1Certificates.Families.L211_preserves_families
statement:
theorem L211_preserves_families {g : Perm12} (hg : g ∈ L211Subgroup) :
    PreservesFamilies g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => PreservesFamilies x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨forall_match_of_at _ _ matchMap_e1,
          forall_match_of_at _ _ matchMap_e1Inv⟩,
        ⟨forall_hexA_of_at _ _ hexAMap_e1,
          forall_hexA_of_at _ _ hexAMap_e1Inv⟩,
        forall_hexB_of_at _ _ hexBMap_e1,
        forall_hexB_of_at _ _ hexBMap_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨forall_match_of_at _ _ matchMap_e2,
          forall_match_of_at _ _ matchMap_e2Inv⟩,
        ⟨forall_hexA_of_at _ _ hexAMap_e2,
          forall_hexA_of_at _ _ hexAMap_e2Inv⟩,
        forall_hexB_of_at _ _ hexBMap_e2,
        forall_hexB_of_at _ _ hexBMap_e2Inv⟩
  · exact preservesFamilies_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact preservesFamilies_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact preservesFamilies_inv hx

name: Sporadic.L211.mapsUnipotents_one

name: Sporadic.L211.mapsUnipotents_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hh.1 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hg.1 (h c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : g * h * unipotentAt c k * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * unipotentAt c k * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    rfl
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hg.2 c k
    obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hh.2 (g⁻¹ c) k1
    refine ⟨k2, ?_⟩
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ * unipotentAt c k * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * unipotentAt c k * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [this, hk1, hk2]
    have : (g * h)⁻¹ c = h⁻¹ (g⁻¹ c) := rfl
    rw [this]

name: Sporadic.L211.mapsUnipotents_inv

    (hg : MapsUnipotents g) : MapsUnipotents g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.2 c k
    exact ⟨k', by simpa using hk'⟩
  · intro c k
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hg.1 c k
    refine ⟨k', ?_⟩
    simpa using hk'

    (idx : Fin 12 → Fin 10 → Fin 10) (idxInv : Fin 12 → Fin 10 → Fin 10)

      g * unipotentAt c k * g⁻¹ = unipotentAt (g c) (idx c k))
    (hinv : ∀ (c : Fin 12) (k : Fin 10),
      g⁻¹ * unipotentAt c k * g = unipotentAt (g⁻¹ c) (idxInv c k)) :
    MapsUnipotents g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c k => ⟨idx c k, h c k⟩, fun c k => ⟨idxInv c k, hinv c k⟩⟩

name: Sporadic.L211.mapsUnipotents_of_mem
statement:
theorem mapsUnipotents_of_mem {g : Perm12} (hg : g ∈ L211Subgroup) :
    MapsUnipotents g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => MapsUnipotents x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact conj_letter_maps _ _ _ conj_e1 conj_e1Inv
    · exact conj_letter_maps _ _ _ conj_e2 conj_e2Inv
  · exact mapsUnipotents_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact mapsUnipotents_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact mapsUnipotents_inv hx

name: Sporadic.L211.pair_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem pair_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 12) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ g : L211Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toL211 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 12) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 12) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set B := Word.toL211 (zeroStabWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_fixes_zero_all z hz0
  have hBone : B.1 (1 : Fin 12) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using zeroStabWord_maps_one_all z hz0
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.L211.pair_witness
statement:
theorem pair_witness (p q u v : Fin 12) (hpq : p ≠ q) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ∃ g : L211Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := pair_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := pair_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.L211.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup L211Subgroup) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 12, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.L211.normal_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem normal_orbit_witness (N : Subgroup L211Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : L211Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 12} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p) (u v : Fin 12) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [huv]⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := pair_witness p (n.1 p) u v (Ne.symm hp) huv
    refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
    have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
      rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
    change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.L211.T0_le_L211

name: Sporadic.L211.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (unipotentAt 0 k) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
      exact unipotent_comm_zero k k'
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.L211.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N : Subgroup L211Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 12, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (g : L211Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : L211Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 12) (k : Fin 10) (hxe : x = unipotentAt c k)
        (hmem : x ∈ L211Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : L211Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c k hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans 0 c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (mapsUnipotents_of_mem m.2).2 c k
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      set t : L211Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm12) = unipotentAt 0 k' := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact unipotent_zero_mem_T0 k'
      set n : L211Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact key 11 0 l211e1_eq_unipotent _
    · exact key 0 9 l211e2_eq_unipotent _
  · 
    refine ⟨1, N.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · 
    rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : L211Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : L211Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹), N.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · 
    rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : L211Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : L211Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.L211.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N : Subgroup L211Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 12, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v) (a b : L211Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : L211Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.L211.gen1_commutator

name: Sporadic.L211.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : L211Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : L211Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup)⁆) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (⟨l211e1, _⟩ : L211Subgroup) = ⟨l211e1, l211e1_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen1_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨l211e2, _⟩ : L211Subgroup) = ⟨l211e2, l211e2_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen2_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.L211.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup L211Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have htrans : ∀ u v : Fin 12, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v :=
    fun u v => normal_orbit_witness N hN hnN hp u v
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup L211Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

name: Sporadic.L211.orbit_zero_eq_univ
statement:
theorem orbit_zero_eq_univ :
    MulAction.orbit L211Subgroup (0 : Fin 12) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := first_orbit_witness x
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.L211.orbit_zero_ncard
statement:
theorem orbit_zero_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit L211Subgroup (0 : Fin 12)).ncard = 12

name: Sporadic.L211.second_orbit_witness
statement:
theorem second_orbit_witness (x : Fin 12) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : Stab0, g.1.1 (1 : Fin 12) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroStabElement x hx, by
    change (Word.eval (zeroStabWord x)) (1 : Fin 12) = x
    exact zeroStabWord_maps_one_all x hx⟩

name: Sporadic.L211.stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero :
    MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 12) = {x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ hx0
    have hfix : g.1.1 (0 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
      have hg0 := (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp g.2)
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg0
    have hmap : g.1.1 (1 : Fin 12) = 0 := by
      simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, hx0] using hg
    have h10 : (1 : Fin 12) = 0 := g.1.1.injective (by rw [hmap, hfix])
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 12) ≠ 0) h10
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := second_orbit_witness x hx
    exact ⟨g, by simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, Equiv.Perm.smul_def] using hg⟩

name: Sporadic.L211.stab0_orbit_one_ncard
statement:
theorem stab0_orbit_one_ncard :
    (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (1 : Fin 12)).ncard = 11
proof:
:= by
  rw [stab0_orbit_one_eq_nonzero]
  have hset : ({x : Fin 12 | x ≠ 0} : Set (Fin 12)) = ({0} : Set (Fin 12))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton]
  simp

name: Sporadic.L211.card_L211_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer
statement:
theorem card_L211_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer :
    Nat.card L211Subgroup = 12 * Nat.card Stab0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group L211Subgroup (0 : Fin 12)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, orbit_zero_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab0)]

name: Sporadic.L211.card_stab0_eq_second_orbit_mul_stabilizer
statement:
theorem card_stab0_eq_second_orbit_mul_stabilizer :
    Nat.card Stab0 = 11 * Nat.card Stab01
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group Stab0 (1 : Fin 12)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, stab0_orbit_one_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab01)]

name: Sporadic.L211.stab01List_nodup
statement: theorem stab01List_nodup : stab01List.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have h := stab01WordList_evals_nodup
  rw [← stab01List_map_eval] at h
  exact h.of_map _

name: Sporadic.L211.stab01List_length
statement: theorem stab01List_length : stab01List.length = 5

name: Sporadic.L211.stab01_lower
statement: theorem stab01_lower : 5 ≤ Nat.card Stab01
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype Stab01 := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc 5 = stab01List.length := stab01List_length.symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card Stab01 := stab01List_nodup.length_le_card

name: Sporadic.U62.mem_nbrs_iff
statement: theorem mem_nbrs_iff {u w : Fin 693} : w ∈ nbrs u ↔ adjB u w = true

name: Sporadic.U62.preservesNbrs_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, mem_nbrs_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [h v x]
    exact hx
  · intro hw
    have hgi : g (g⁻¹ w) = w := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
    refine ⟨g⁻¹ w, ?_, hgi⟩
    rw [← h v (g⁻¹ w), hgi]
    exact hw

name: Sporadic.U62.symm_all
statement: theorem symm_all : ∀ u : Fin 693, symmRow u = true
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 116 with h1 | h1
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 116 0 symmOk0 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 232 with h2 | h2
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 116 116 symmOk1 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 348 with h3 | h3
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 116 232 symmOk2 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 464 with h4 | h4
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 116 348 symmOk3 u (by omega) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.val 580 with h5 | h5
  · exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 116 464 symmOk4 u (by omega) (by omega)
  exact SimsChain.rowOkB_sound 113 580 symmOk5 u (by omega) (by omega)

name: Sporadic.U62.adjB_symm
statement: theorem adjB_symm : ∀ u v : Fin 693, adjB u v = adjB v u
proof:
:= by
  intro u v
  exact eq_of_beq (List.all_eq_true.mp (symm_all u) v
    (List.mem_finRange v))

name: Sporadic.U62.mem_nbrs_symm
statement: theorem mem_nbrs_symm : ∀ u v : Fin 693, u ∈ nbrs v → v ∈ nbrs u
proof:
:= by
  intro u v h
  rw [mem_nbrs_iff] at h ⊢
  rw [adjB_symm]
  exact h

statement:
theorem common_nbr_exists :
    ∀ u v : Fin 693, u ≠ v → v ∉ nbrs u →
      ∃ w : Fin 693, w ∈ nbrs u ∧ w ∈ nbrs v
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv hadj

  have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp (diam_all u) v (List.mem_finRange v)
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hv with h1 | h2
  · rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h1 with he | ha
    · exact absurd (eq_of_beq he) huv
    · exact absurd ha hadj
  · obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h2
    obtain ⟨hwu, hwv⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hw
    exact ⟨w, mem_nbrs_iff.mpr hwu, mem_nbrs_iff.mpr hwv⟩

name: Sporadic.U62.common_non_nbr_exists
statement:
theorem common_non_nbr_exists :
    ∀ u v : Fin 693, v ∈ nbrs u →
      ∃ w : Fin 693, w ∉ nbrs u ∧ w ∉ nbrs v ∧ w ≠ u ∧ w ≠ v
proof:
:= by
  intro u v hadj
  rw [mem_nbrs_iff] at hadj
  have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp (codiam_all u) v (List.mem_finRange v)
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hv with h1 | h2
  · rw [hadj] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h2
    obtain ⟨hw3, hwv⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hw
    obtain ⟨hw2, hwu⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hw3
    obtain ⟨hnu, hnv⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true _ _ |>.mp hw2
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_nbrs_iff]
      exact fun hc => absurd (hc ▸ hnu) (by decide)
    · rw [mem_nbrs_iff]
      exact fun hc => absurd (hc ▸ hnv) (by decide)
    · exact fun hc => by simp [hc] at hwu
    · exact fun hc => by simp [hc] at hwv

name: Sporadic.U62.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm693}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.U62.U62_preserves_nbrs
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact u62e1_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u62e2_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u62e3_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u62e4_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u62e5_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u62e6_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    hg

theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm693) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 693} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.U62.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm693) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 693} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.U62.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (π : Perm693) {u u' w : Fin 693}
    (hu : π u = u') (hw : w ≠ u) : π w ≠ u'
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hw (π.injective (h.trans hu.symm))

name: Sporadic.U62.common_count_map
statement:
theorem common_count_map (π : Perm693) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' : Fin 693} (hu : π u = u') (v : Fin 693) :
    (nbrs (π v) ∩ nbrs u').card = (nbrs v ∩ nbrs u).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← hu, ← hpres v, ← hpres u,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ π.injective

name: Sporadic.U62.common_count2_map
statement:
theorem common_count2_map (π : Perm693) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u1 u1' u2 u2' : Fin 693} (hu1 : π u1 = u1') (hu2 : π u2 = u2')
    (v : Fin 693) :
    (nbrs (π v) ∩ nbrs u1' ∩ nbrs u2').card =
      (nbrs v ∩ nbrs u1 ∩ nbrs u2).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← hu1, ← hu2, ← hpres v, ← hpres u1, ← hpres u2,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ π.injective

theorem perm_apply_inv_self (f : Perm693) (x : Fin 693) :

name: Sporadic.U62.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 693) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : U62Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 15 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toSub (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 693) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U62_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toSub (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 693) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_zero_all z hz
  have hBone : B.1 (15 : Fin 693) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 15 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U62.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 693) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : U62Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 15 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U62.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 693)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : U62Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toSub (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 693) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U62_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 693) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set C := Word.toSub (nonEdgeWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (0 : Fin 693) = 0 := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_fixes_zero_all z hz hz0
  have hC5 : C.1 (1 : Fin 693) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_maps_all z hz hz0
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC5, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U62.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 693)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : U62Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U62.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hbot : N' ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ p : Fin 693, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.U62.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U62Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 693} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 693) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U62.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U62Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 693}
    (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p) (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 693) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U62.normal_zero_witness
statement:
theorem normal_zero_witness (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U62Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 693} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 693) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨1, N'.one_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · exact normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj 0 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 0 x (fun h => hx0 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj 0 w hw0
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N'.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx, hw0', hwx'⟩ :=
        common_non_nbr_exists 0 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp 0 w hw0 hw0'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N'.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp 0 x hxadj hx0

name: Sporadic.U62.TBase_le
statement: theorem TBase_le : TBase ≤ U62Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [TBase, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ rfl
  exact transvection_zero_mem

name: Sporadic.U62.transvection_zero_mem_TBase
statement: theorem transvection_zero_mem_TBase : transvectionAt 0 ∈ TBase

name: Sporadic.U62.TBase_comm
statement: theorem TBase_comm : ∀ a ∈ TBase, ∀ b ∈ TBase, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ TBase, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ rfl b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (transvectionAt 0) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ rfl
      exact Commute.refl _
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.U62.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 693, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c) (g : U62Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : U62Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 693) (hxe : x = transvectionAt c)
        (hmem : x ∈ U62Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : U62Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      have hk' := (mapsTransvections_of_mem m.2).2 c
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      set t : U62Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm693) = transvectionAt 0 := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact transvection_zero_mem_TBase
      set n : U62Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N' := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N' := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N'.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N'.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key _ u62e1_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u62e2_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u62e3_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u62e4_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u62e5_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u62e6_eq_transvectionAt _
  · refine ⟨1, N'.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U62Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹),
      N'.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U62Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N'.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.U62.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 693, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c) (a b : U62Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N'
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N' hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N' hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N' with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : U62Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N' := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := TBase_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.U62.tauC0_commutator
statement:
theorem tauC0_commutator :
    (⟨transvectionAt 60, tauC0_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
      ⁅(⟨commU, commU_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup), ⟨commV, commV_mem⟩⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change transvectionAt 60 = commU * commV * commU⁻¹ * commV⁻¹
  exact tauC0_comm_id

name: Sporadic.U62.tauC0_in_commutator
statement:
theorem tauC0_in_commutator :
    (⟨transvectionAt 60, tauC0_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆

name: Sporadic.U62.gen1_in_commutator
statement:
theorem gen1_in_commutator :
    (⟨u62e1, u62e1_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hw := (mapsTransvections_of_mem
    (Word.eval_mem toC1Word)).1 (60 : Fin 693)
  rw [toC1_maps] at hw
  have hgen : (⟨u62e1, u62e1_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
      (Word.toSub toC1Word) * ⟨transvectionAt 60, tauC0_mem⟩ *
        (Word.toSub toC1Word)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change u62e1 =
      Word.eval toC1Word * transvectionAt 60 *
        (Word.eval toC1Word)⁻¹
    rw [hw, u62e1_eq_transvectionAt]
  rw [hgen]
  have hnorm :
      (⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆).Normal :=
    inferInstance
  exact hnorm.conj_mem _ tauC0_in_commutator _

name: Sporadic.U62.gen2_in_commutator
statement:
theorem gen2_in_commutator :
    (⟨u62e2, u62e2_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hw := (mapsTransvections_of_mem
    (Word.eval_mem toC2Word)).1 (60 : Fin 693)
  rw [toC2_maps] at hw
  have hgen : (⟨u62e2, u62e2_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
      (Word.toSub toC2Word) * ⟨transvectionAt 60, tauC0_mem⟩ *
        (Word.toSub toC2Word)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change u62e2 =
      Word.eval toC2Word * transvectionAt 60 *
        (Word.eval toC2Word)⁻¹
    rw [hw, u62e2_eq_transvectionAt]
  rw [hgen]
  have hnorm :
      (⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆).Normal :=
    inferInstance
  exact hnorm.conj_mem _ tauC0_in_commutator _

name: Sporadic.U62.gen3_in_commutator
statement:
theorem gen3_in_commutator :
    (⟨u62e3, u62e3_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hw := (mapsTransvections_of_mem
    (Word.eval_mem toC3Word)).1 (60 : Fin 693)
  rw [toC3_maps] at hw
  have hgen : (⟨u62e3, u62e3_mem⟩ : U62Subgroup) =
      (Word.toSub toC3Word) * ⟨transvectionAt 60, tauC0_mem⟩ *
        (Word.toSub toC3Word)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change u62e3 =

name: Sporadic.U62.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : U62Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : U62Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact gen1_in_commutator
    · exact gen2_in_commutator
    · exact gen3_in_commutator
    · exact gen4_in_commutator
    · exact gen5_in_commutator
    · exact gen6_in_commutator
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.U62.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N' : Subgroup U62Subgroup)
    (hN : N'.Normal) :
    N' = ⊥ ∨ N' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N' = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N' hbot
  have htrans : ∀ c : Fin 693, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c :=
    fun c => normal_zero_witness N' hN hnN hp c
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U62Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N' := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N' hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

theorem sApp1_eq : ∀ (i : Nat) (y : Fin 693),

:= by
  intro i y
  match i with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | 5 => rfl
  | 6 => rfl
  | 7 => rfl
  | 8 => rfl
  | n + 9 => rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.Tword1_apply
statement:
theorem Tword1_apply (z x : Fin 693) :
    Tword1 z x = TwordApp1 z x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 693) (i : ℕ) => (sList1.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp1 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp1_eq i y
  rw [Tword1, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, TwordApp1, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.orbit1_closed
statement:
theorem orbit1_closed :
    ∀ s ∈ sList1, ∀ z ∈ orbit1Set, s z ∈ orbit1Set
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit1.mp hz
  rw [mem_orbit1]
  simp only [sList1, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
    or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h := clos1_0_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_1_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_2_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_3_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_4_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_5_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_6_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_7_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos1_8_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2

name: Sporadic.U62.sApp2_eq
statement:
theorem sApp2_eq : ∀ (i : Nat) (y : Fin 693),
    (sList2.getD i 1) y = sApp2 i y
proof:
:= by
  intro i y
  match i with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | 5 => rfl
  | 6 => rfl
  | n + 7 => rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.Tword2_apply
statement:
theorem Tword2_apply (z x : Fin 693) :
    Tword2 z x = TwordApp2 z x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 693) (i : ℕ) => (sList2.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp2 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp2_eq i y
  rw [Tword2, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, TwordApp2, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.orbit2_closed
statement:
theorem orbit2_closed :
    ∀ s ∈ sList2, ∀ z ∈ orbit2Set, s z ∈ orbit2Set
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit2.mp hz
  rw [mem_orbit2]
  simp only [sList2, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
    or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h := clos2_0_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_1_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_2_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_3_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_4_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_5_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos2_6_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2

name: Sporadic.U62.sApp3_eq

theorem sApp3_eq : ∀ (i : Nat) (y : Fin 693),
    (sList3.getD i 1) y = sApp3 i y
proof:
:= by
  intro i y
  match i with
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl
  | n + 5 => rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.Tword3_apply
statement:
theorem Tword3_apply (z x : Fin 693) :
    Tword3 z x = TwordApp3 z x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 693) (i : ℕ) => (sList3.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp3 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp3_eq i y
  rw [Tword3, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, TwordApp3, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.orbit3_closed
statement:
theorem orbit3_closed :
    ∀ s ∈ sList3, ∀ z ∈ orbit3Set, s z ∈ orbit3Set
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs z hz
  have hz0 := mem_orbit3.mp hz
  rw [mem_orbit3]
  simp only [sList3, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
    or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h := clos3_0_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos3_1_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos3_2_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos3_3_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2
  · have h := clos3_4_all z
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h with h1 | h2
    · rw [hz0] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact h2

name: Sporadic.U62.Tword4_apply
statement:
theorem Tword4_apply (z x : Fin 693) :
    Tword4 z x = TwordApp4 z x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun (y : Fin 693) (i : ℕ) => (sList4.getD i 1) y) =
      (fun y i => sApp4 i y) := by
    funext y i
    exact sApp4_eq i y
  rw [Tword4, SimsChain.foldl_perm_apply, TwordApp4, hfun]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.mapsTransvections_one
statement: theorem mapsTransvections_one : MapsTransvections 1

name: Sporadic.U62.mapsTransvections_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c
    have hstep : g * h * transvectionAt c * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * transvectionAt c * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hh.1 c, hg.1 (h c)]
    rfl
  · intro c
    have hstep : (g * h)⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hg.2 c, hh.2 (g⁻¹ c)]
    rfl

name: Sporadic.U62.mapsTransvections_inv
statement:
theorem mapsTransvections_inv {g : Perm693}
    (hg : MapsTransvections g) : MapsTransvections g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c
    simpa using hg.2 c
  · intro c
    simpa using hg.1 c

name: Sporadic.U62.mapsTransvections_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => MapsTransvections x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨conj_e1, conj_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e2, conj_e2Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e3, conj_e3Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e4, conj_e4Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e5, conj_e5Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e6, conj_e6Inv⟩
  · exact mapsTransvections_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact mapsTransvections_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact mapsTransvections_inv hx

name: Sporadic.U52.card_chain1
statement:
theorem card_chain1 :
    Nat.card AutGammaT =
      (MulAction.orbit AutGammaT (0 : Fin 165)).ncard *
        Nat.card Stab1A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group AutGammaT
      (0 : Fin 165)]
  rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard]
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab1A)]

name: Sporadic.U52.orbit1_le
statement:

    (MulAction.orbit AutGammaT (0 : Fin 165)).ncard ≤ 165
proof:
:= by
  have h := Set.ncard_le_ncard
    (Set.subset_univ (MulAction.orbit AutGammaT (0 : Fin 165)))

name: Sporadic.U52.orbit2_subset
statement:
theorem orbit2_subset :
    MulAction.orbit Stab1A (1 : Fin 165) ⊆
      ↑pinList2.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨g, rfl⟩
  change g.1.1 1 ∈ (↑pinList2.toFinset : Set (Fin 165))
  refine Finset.mem_coe.mpr (List.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_)
  exact
    (pin2_mem _ (not_mem_nbrs_map g.1.1 (s1_pres g) (s1_fixes_0 g) (by decide))
      (ne_of_value g.1.1 (s1_fixes_0 g) (by decide)))

name: Sporadic.U52.orbit2_le
statement:
theorem orbit2_le :
    (MulAction.orbit Stab1A (1 : Fin 165)).ncard ≤
      128
proof:
:= by
  have h := Set.ncard_le_ncard orbit2_subset
    pinList2.toFinset.finite_toSet
  rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset] at h
  calc (MulAction.orbit Stab1A (1 : Fin 165)).ncard
      ≤ pinList2.toFinset.card := h

name: Sporadic.U52.double_injective
statement: theorem double_injective : Function.Injective double
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, bk⟩ ⟨l, bl⟩ h
  have hval : (double (k, bk)).1 = (double (l, bl)).1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  cases bk <;> cases bl
  · exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hval) rfl
  · exfalso
    have hsign := congrArg Equiv.Perm.sign hval
    rw [show (double (k, false)).1 = k.1 from rfl,
      show (double (l, true)).1 = frob * l.1 from rfl] at hsign
    rw [k.2.2, map_mul, sign_frob, l.2.2, mul_one] at hsign
    exact (by decide : ¬((1 : ℤˣ) = -1)) hsign
  · exfalso
    have hsign := congrArg Equiv.Perm.sign hval
    rw [show (double (k, true)).1 = frob * k.1 from rfl,
      show (double (l, false)).1 = l.1 from rfl] at hsign
    rw [map_mul, sign_frob, k.2.2, mul_one, l.2.2] at hsign
    exact (by decide : ¬((-1 : ℤˣ) = 1)) hsign
  · have hcancel : frob * k.1 = frob * l.1 := hval
    have : k.1 = l.1 := mul_left_cancel hcancel
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext this) rfl

    (p := fun x _ => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact u52e1_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u52e2_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u52e3_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u52e4_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u52e5_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    hg

name: Sporadic.U52.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm165) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 165} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.U52.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm165) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 165} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.U52.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (π : Perm165) {u u' w : Fin 165}
    (hu : π u = u') (hw : w ≠ u) : π w ≠ u'
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hw (π.injective (h.trans hu.symm))

name: Sporadic.U52.common_count_map
statement:
theorem common_count_map (π : Perm165) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' : Fin 165} (hu : π u = u') (v : Fin 165) :
    (nbrs (π v) ∩ nbrs u').card = (nbrs v ∩ nbrs u).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres v, ← hpres u,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ π.injective

name: Sporadic.U52.common_count2_map
statement:
theorem common_count2_map (π : Perm165) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u1 u1' u2 u2' : Fin 165} (hu1 : π u1 = u1') (hu2 : π u2 = u2')
    (v : Fin 165) :
    (nbrs (π v) ∩ nbrs u1' ∩ nbrs u2').card =
      (nbrs v ∩ nbrs u1 ∩ nbrs u2).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu1, ← hu2, ← hpres v, ← hpres u1, ← hpres u2,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ π.injective]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ π.injective

name: Sporadic.U52.perm_apply_inv_self
statement:
theorem perm_apply_inv_self (f : Perm165) (x : Fin 165) :
    f (f⁻¹ x) = x

name: Sporadic.U52.perm_inv_apply_self
statement:
theorem perm_inv_apply_self (f : Perm165) (x : Fin 165) :
    f⁻¹ (f x) = x

name: Sporadic.U52.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 165) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : U52Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 15 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toSub (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 165) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U52_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toSub (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 165) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_zero_all z hz
  have hBone : B.1 (15 : Fin 165) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 15 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U52.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 165) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : U52Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 15 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U52.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 165)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : U52Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toSub (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 165) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U52_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 165) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set C := Word.toSub (nonEdgeWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (0 : Fin 165) = 0 := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_fixes_zero_all z hz hz0
  have hC5 : C.1 (1 : Fin 165) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_maps_all z hz hz0
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC5, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U52.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 165)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : U52Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U52.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hbot : N' ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ p : Fin 165, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.U52.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U52Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 165} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 165) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U52.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U52Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 165}
    (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p) (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 165) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U52.normal_zero_witness
statement:
theorem normal_zero_witness (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    {n : U52Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N') {p : Fin 165} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 165) :
    ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨1, N'.one_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · exact normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj 0 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 0 x (fun h => hx0 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj 0 w hw0
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N' hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N'.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx, hw0', hwx'⟩ :=
        common_non_nbr_exists 0 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp 0 w hw0 hw0'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N'.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N' hN hnN hadj hp 0 x hxadj hx0

name: Sporadic.U52.T0_le
statement: theorem T0_le : T0 ≤ U52Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [T0, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ rfl
  exact transvection_zero_mem

name: Sporadic.U52.transvection_zero_mem_T0
statement: theorem transvection_zero_mem_T0 : transvectionAt 0 ∈ T0

name: Sporadic.U52.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ rfl b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (transvectionAt 0) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ rfl
      exact Commute.refl _
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.U52.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 165, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c) (g : U52Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : U52Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 165) (hxe : x = transvectionAt c)
        (hmem : x ∈ U52Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N', ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : U52Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      have hk' := (mapsTransvections_of_mem m.2).2 c
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      set t : U52Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm165) = transvectionAt 0 := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact transvection_zero_mem_T0
      set n : U52Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N' := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N' := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N'.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N'.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key _ u52e1_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u52e2_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u52e3_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u52e4_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u52e5_eq_transvectionAt _
  · refine ⟨1, N'.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : U52Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U52Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹),
      N'.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : U52Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U52Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N'.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.U52.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup) (hN : N'.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 165, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c) (a b : U52Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N'
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N' hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N' hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N' with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : U52Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N' := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.U52.tauC0_commutator
statement:
theorem tauC0_commutator :
    (⟨transvectionAt 38, tauC0_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) =
      ⁅(⟨commU, commU_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup), ⟨commV, commV_mem⟩⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change transvectionAt 38 = commU * commV * commU⁻¹ * commV⁻¹
  exact tauC0_comm_id

name: Sporadic.U52.tauC0_in_commutator
statement:
theorem tauC0_in_commutator :
    (⟨transvectionAt 38, tauC0_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆

name: Sporadic.U52.gen1_in_commutator
statement:
theorem gen1_in_commutator :
    (⟨u52e1, u52e1_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hw := (mapsTransvections_of_mem
    (Word.eval_mem toC1Word)).1 (38 : Fin 165)
  rw [toC1_maps] at hw
  have hgen : (⟨u52e1, u52e1_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) =
      (Word.toSub toC1Word) * ⟨transvectionAt 38, tauC0_mem⟩ *
        (Word.toSub toC1Word)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change u52e1 =
      Word.eval toC1Word * transvectionAt 38 *
        (Word.eval toC1Word)⁻¹
    rw [hw, u52e1_eq_transvectionAt]
  rw [hgen]
  have hnorm :
      (⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆).Normal :=
    inferInstance
  exact hnorm.conj_mem _ tauC0_in_commutator _

name: Sporadic.U52.gen2_in_commutator
statement:
theorem gen2_in_commutator :
    (⟨u52e2, u52e2_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hw := (mapsTransvections_of_mem
    (Word.eval_mem toC2Word)).1 (38 : Fin 165)
  rw [toC2_maps] at hw
  have hgen : (⟨u52e2, u52e2_mem⟩ : U52Subgroup) =
      (Word.toSub toC2Word) * ⟨transvectionAt 38, tauC0_mem⟩ *
        (Word.toSub toC2Word)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change u52e2 =

name: Sporadic.U52.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : U52Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : U52Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact gen1_in_commutator
    · exact gen2_in_commutator
    · exact gen3_in_commutator
    · exact gen4_in_commutator
    · exact gen5_in_commutator
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.U52.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N' : Subgroup U52Subgroup)
    (hN : N'.Normal) :
    N' = ⊥ ∨ N' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N' = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N' hbot
  have htrans : ∀ c : Fin 165, ∃ m ∈ N', m.1 0 = c :=
    fun c => normal_zero_witness N' hN hnN hp c
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U52Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N' := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N' hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)
