name: Sporadic.U52.card_lower
statement: theorem card_lower : 13685760 ≤ Nat.card U52Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 96 * 24 ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab01 (3 : Fin 165)).ncard *
        Nat.card StabTail :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul stab01_orbit_lower stabTail_lower
  have h2 : 36 * (96 * 24) ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (15 : Fin 165)).ncard *
        Nat.card Stab01 := by
    rw [card_stab01_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul stab0_orbit_lower h3
  have h1 : 165 * (36 * (96 * 24)) ≤ 165 * Nat.card Stab0 := by
    rw [card_stab0_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 165 h2
  calc (13685760 : ℕ) = 165 * (36 * (96 * 24)) := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 165 * Nat.card Stab0 := h1
    _ = Nat.card U52Subgroup := card_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer.symm

theorem conj_letter_inv {g : Perm165}
    (h : ∀ c : Fin 165,
      g * transvectionAt c * g⁻¹ = transvectionAt (g c)) :
    ∀ c : Fin 165,
      g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * g = transvectionAt (g⁻¹ c)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  have h' := h (g⁻¹ c)
  have happ : g (g⁻¹ c) = c := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [happ] at h'
  rw [← h']
  group

proof:
:= by

  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge c.val 55 with h1 | h1
  · exact conjPt_e5_shard0 c (by omega) h1
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge c.val 110 with h2 | h2
  · exact conjPt_e5_shard1 c h1 h2

name: Sporadic.U52.mapsTransvections_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c
    have hstep : g * h * transvectionAt c * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * transvectionAt c * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hh.1 c, hg.1 (h c)]
    rfl
  · intro c
    have hstep : (g * h)⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hg.2 c, hh.2 (g⁻¹ c)]
    rfl

name: Sporadic.U52.mapsTransvections_inv
statement:
theorem mapsTransvections_inv {g : Perm165}
    (hg : MapsTransvections g) : MapsTransvections g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c
    simpa using hg.2 c
  · intro c
    simpa using hg.1 c

name: Sporadic.U52.mapsTransvections_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => MapsTransvections x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨conj_e1, conj_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e2, conj_e2Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e3, conj_e3Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e4, conj_e4Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e5, conj_e5Inv⟩
  · exact mapsTransvections_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact mapsTransvections_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact mapsTransvections_inv hx

name: Sporadic.U42.fixed_base_unique
statement:
theorem fixed_base_unique (π : Perm45)
    (hpres : PreservesNbrs π) (h0 : π 0 = 0) (h15 : π 15 = 15) (h3 : π 3 = 3) (h19 : π 19 = 19)
    (h13 : π 13 = 13) :
    π = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv16 : π 16 = 16 :=
  force_1 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h0 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h15 (by decide))
    (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h3 (by decide))
  have hv9 : π 9 = 9 :=
  force_2 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h19 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv16 (by decide))
    (ne_of_value π h15 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π h3 (by decide))
  have hv20 : π 20 = 20 :=
  force_3 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h0 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h15 (by decide))
    (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h13 (by decide))
  have hv7 : π 7 = 7 :=
  force_4 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h19 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv9 (by decide))
    (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv20 (by decide))
  have hv21 : π 21 = 21 :=
  force_5 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h15 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h13 (by decide))
    (ne_of_value π h19 (by decide)) (ne_of_value π hv20 (by decide))
  have hv5 : π 5 = 5 :=
  force_6 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h13 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv21 (by decide))
    (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres h0 (by decide)) (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv16 (by decide))
  have hv10 : π 10 = 10 :=
  force_7 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv20 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv7 (by decide))
    (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres h3 (by decide)) (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv5 (by decide))
  have hv1 : π 1 = 1 :=
  force_8 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h15 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv21 (by decide))
    (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres h3 (by decide)) (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv10 (by decide))
  have hv2 : π 2 = 2 :=
  force_9 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h15 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h19 (by decide))
    (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv5 (by decide)) (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv10 (by decide))
  have hv4 : π 4 = 4 :=
  force_10 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres h13 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv20 (by decide))
    (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv9 (by decide)) (not_mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv1 (by decide))
  have hv6 : π 6 = 6 :=
  force_11 _ (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv16 (by decide)) (mem_nbrs_map π hpres hv9 (by decide))

name: Sporadic.U42.stabLast_le
statement: theorem stabLast_le : Nat.card Stab5 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype Stab5 := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  rw [Fintype.card_le_one_iff]
  intro g h
  have hg : g.1.1.1.1.1.1 = 1 :=
    fixed_base_unique _ (s5_pres g) (s5_fixes_0 g) (s5_fixes_15 g) (s5_fixes_3 g)
      (s5_fixes_19 g) (s5_fixes_13 g)
  have hh : h.1.1.1.1.1.1 = 1 :=
    fixed_base_unique _ (s5_pres h) (s5_fixes_0 h) (s5_fixes_15 h) (s5_fixes_3 h)
      (s5_fixes_19 h) (s5_fixes_13 h)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hg.trans hh.symm

name: Sporadic.U42.card_AutGamma_le
statement: theorem card_AutGamma_le : Nat.card AutGammaT ≤ 51840
proof:
:= by
  calc Nat.card AutGammaT
      = (MulAction.orbit AutGammaT (0 : Fin 45)).ncard *
        ((MulAction.orbit Stab1 (15 : Fin 45)).ncard *
          ((MulAction.orbit Stab2 (3 : Fin 45)).ncard *
            ((MulAction.orbit Stab3 (19 : Fin 45)).ncard *
              ((MulAction.orbit Stab4 (13 : Fin 45)).ncard *
                Nat.card Stab5)))) := by
        rw [card_chain1, card_chain2, card_chain3, card_chain4,
          card_chain5]
    _ ≤ 45 * (12 * (24 * (2 *
          (2 * 1)))) := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul orbit1_le
          (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit2_le
            (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit3_le
              (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit4_le
                (Nat.mul_le_mul orbit5_le stabLast_le))))
    _ = 51840 := by norm_num

name: Sporadic.U42.sign_swProd
statement:
theorem sign_swProd (l : List (Fin 45 × Fin 45))
    (h : ∀ p ∈ l, p.1 ≠ p.2) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign (swProd l) = (-1) ^ l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [swProd]
  | cons p rest ih =>
      have hp : p.1 ≠ p.2 := h p (by simp)
      have hrest : ∀ q ∈ rest, q.1 ≠ q.2 := fun q hq =>
        h q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq)
      rw [swProd, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, map_mul,
        Equiv.Perm.sign_swap hp]
      have hr : Equiv.Perm.sign (swProd rest) = (-1) ^ rest.length :=
        ih hrest
      rw [swProd] at hr
      rw [hr, List.length_cons, pow_succ, mul_comm]

name: Sporadic.U42.double_injective
statement: theorem double_injective : Function.Injective double
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, bk⟩ ⟨l, bl⟩ h
  have hval : (double (k, bk)).1 = (double (l, bl)).1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  cases bk <;> cases bl
  · exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hval) rfl
  · exfalso
    have hsign := congrArg Equiv.Perm.sign hval
    rw [show (double (k, false)).1 = k.1 from rfl,
      show (double (l, true)).1 = frob * l.1 from rfl] at hsign
    rw [k.2.2, map_mul, sign_frob, l.2.2, mul_one] at hsign
    exact (by decide : ¬((1 : ℤˣ) = -1)) hsign
  · exfalso
    have hsign := congrArg Equiv.Perm.sign hval
    rw [show (double (k, true)).1 = frob * k.1 from rfl,
      show (double (l, false)).1 = l.1 from rfl] at hsign
    rw [map_mul, sign_frob, k.2.2, mul_one, l.2.2] at hsign
    exact (by decide : ¬((-1 : ℤˣ) = 1)) hsign
  · have hcancel : frob * k.1 = frob * l.1 := hval
    have : k.1 = l.1 := mul_left_cancel hcancel
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext this) rfl

name: Sporadic.U42.PreservesNbrs.mul
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have : (nbrs v).image ⇑(g * h) = ((nbrs v).image h).image g := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  rw [this, hh v, hg (h v)]
  rfl

name: Sporadic.U42.PreservesNbrs.inv
statement:
theorem PreservesNbrs.inv {g : Perm45}
    (hg : PreservesNbrs g) : PreservesNbrs g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have h := hg (g⁻¹ v)
  have hv : g (g⁻¹ v) = v := Equiv.Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq.mp rfl
  rw [hv] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.image_image]
  have hcomp : (⇑g⁻¹ ∘ ⇑g) = id := by
    funext x
    exact Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl
  rw [hcomp, Finset.image_id]

name: Sporadic.U42.U42_preserves_nbrs
statement:
theorem U42_preserves_nbrs {g : Perm45} (hg : g ∈ U42Subgroup) :
    PreservesNbrs g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => PreservesNbrs x)
    (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact u42e1_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u42e2_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u42e3_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u42e4_preserves_nbrs
      · exact u42e5_preserves_nbrs)
    PreservesNbrs.one
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => PreservesNbrs.mul hx hy)
    (fun x _ hx => PreservesNbrs.inv hx)
    hg

name: Sporadic.U42.mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm45) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 45} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    π v ∈ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem π hv

name: Sporadic.U42.not_mem_nbrs_map
statement:
theorem not_mem_nbrs_map (π : Perm45) (hpres : PreservesNbrs π)
    {u u' v : Fin 45} (hu : π u = u') (hv : v ∉ nbrs u) :
    π v ∉ nbrs u'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hu, ← hpres u]
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hww⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hv (π.injective hww ▸ hw)

name: Sporadic.U42.ne_of_value
statement:
theorem ne_of_value (π : Perm45) {u u' w : Fin 45}
    (hu : π u = u') (hw : w ≠ u) : π w ≠ u'
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hw (π.injective (h.trans hu.symm))

statement: theorem perm_inv_apply_self (f : Perm45) (x : Fin 45) : f⁻¹ (f x) = x

name: Sporadic.U42.edge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem edge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 45) (hxy : y ∈ nbrs x) :
    ∃ g : U42Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 15 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toU42 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 45) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U42_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  set B := Word.toU42 (levelTwoWord z) with hB
  have hBfix : B.1 (0 : Fin 45) = 0 := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_fixes_zero_all z hz
  have hBone : B.1 (15 : Fin 45) = z := by
    simpa [hB] using levelTwoWord_maps_all z hz
  refine ⟨A * B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * B.1) 15 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hBone, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U42.edge_witness
statement:
theorem edge_witness (p q u v : Fin 45) (hpq : q ∈ nbrs p)
    (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ g : U42Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := edge_witness_from_base p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := edge_witness_from_base u v huv
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 15 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U42.nonedge_witness_from_base
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness_from_base (x y : Fin 45)
    (hxy : y ∉ nbrs x) (hne : y ≠ x) :
    ∃ g : U42Subgroup, g.1 0 = x ∧ g.1 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Word.toU42 (orbitZeroWord x) with hA
  have hA0 : A.1 (0 : Fin 45) = x := by
    simpa [hA] using orbitZeroWord_maps_zero_all x
  have hAinv : A.1⁻¹ x = 0 := by
    rw [← hA0, perm_inv_apply_self]
  set z := A.1⁻¹ y with hzdef
  have hz : z ∉ nbrs 0 := by
    have hpres : PreservesNbrs A.1⁻¹ :=
      PreservesNbrs.inv (U42_preserves_nbrs A.2)
    have := not_mem_nbrs_map A.1⁻¹ hpres hAinv hxy
    rwa [← hzdef] at this
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have : y = A.1 (0 : Fin 45) := by
      rw [← h, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]
    rw [this, hA0]
  set C := Word.toU42 (nonEdgeWord z) with hC
  have hCfix : C.1 (0 : Fin 45) = 0 := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_fixes_zero_all z hz hz0
  have hC5 : C.1 (1 : Fin 45) = z := by
    simpa [hC] using nonEdgeWord_maps_all z hz hz0
  refine ⟨A * C, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 0 = x
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hCfix, hA0]
  · change (A.1 * C.1) 1 = y
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hC5, hzdef, perm_apply_inv_self]

name: Sporadic.U42.nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem nonedge_witness (p q u v : Fin 45)
    (hpq : q ∉ nbrs p) (hqp : q ≠ p) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ g : U42Subgroup, g.1 p = u ∧ g.1 q = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g1, h1p, h1q⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base p q hpq hqp
  obtain ⟨g2, h2u, h2v⟩ := nonedge_witness_from_base u v huv hvu
  have hinvp : g1.1⁻¹ p = 0 := by
    rw [← h1p, perm_inv_apply_self]
  have hinvq : g1.1⁻¹ q = 1 := by
    rw [← h1q, perm_inv_apply_self]
  refine ⟨g2 * g1⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) p = u
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvp, h2u]
  · change (g2.1 * g1.1⁻¹) q = v
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinvq, h2v]

name: Sporadic.U42.exists_moved_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_moved_of_ne_bot (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hbot : N ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ p : Fin 45, n.1 p ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hbot
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro n hn
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  simpa using h n hn p

name: Sporadic.U42.normal_edge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_edge_witness (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U42Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 45} (hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p)
    (u v : Fin 45) (huv : v ∈ nbrs u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := edge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hadj huv
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U42.normal_nonedge_witness
statement:
theorem normal_nonedge_witness (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U42Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 45}
    (hnadj : n.1 p ∉ nbrs p) (hne : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (u v : Fin 45) (huv : v ∉ nbrs u) (hvu : v ≠ u) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hgq⟩ := nonedge_witness p (n.1 p) u v hnadj hne huv hvu
  refine ⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem n hnN g, ?_⟩
  have hinv : g.1⁻¹ u = p := by
    rw [← hgp, perm_inv_apply_self]
  change (g.1 * n.1 * g.1⁻¹) u = v
  rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hinv, hgq]

name: Sporadic.U42.normal_zero_witness
statement:
theorem normal_zero_witness (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    {n : U42Subgroup} (hnN : n ∈ N) {p : Fin 45} (hp : n.1 p ≠ p)
    (x : Fin 45) :
    ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨1, N.one_mem, by simp [hx0]⟩
  by_cases hadj : n.1 p ∈ nbrs p
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · exact normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 x hxadj
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx⟩ :=
        common_nbr_exists 0 x (fun h => hx0 h.symm) hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj 0 w hw0
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ := normal_edge_witness N hN hnN hadj w x
        (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ hwx)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
  · by_cases hxadj : x ∈ nbrs 0
    · obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwx, hw0', hwx'⟩ := common_non_nbr_exists 0 x hxadj
      obtain ⟨m1, hm1N, hm1⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 w hw0 hw0'
      have hxw : x ∉ nbrs w := fun h => hwx (mem_nbrs_symm _ _ h)
      obtain ⟨m2, hm2N, hm2⟩ :=
        normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp w x hxw
          (fun h => hwx' h.symm)
      refine ⟨m2 * m1, N.mul_mem hm2N hm1N, ?_⟩
      change (m2.1 * m1.1) 0 = x
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hm1, hm2]
    · exact normal_nonedge_witness N hN hnN hadj hp 0 x hxadj hx0

name: Sporadic.U42.T0_le_U42
statement: theorem T0_le_U42 : T0 ≤ U42Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  rw [T0, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ rfl
  exact transvection_zero_mem

name: Sporadic.U42.transvection_zero_mem_T0
statement: theorem transvection_zero_mem_T0 : transvectionAt 0 ∈ T0

name: Sporadic.U42.T0_comm
statement: theorem T0_comm : ∀ a ∈ T0, ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun a _ => ∀ b ∈ T0, Commute a b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ rfl b hb
    refine Subgroup.closure_induction
      (p := fun b _ => Commute (transvectionAt 0) b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
    · rintro _ rfl
      exact Commute.refl _
    · exact Commute.one_right _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hx.mul_right hy
    · intro x _ hx
      exact hx.inv_right
  · intro b _
    exact Commute.one_left _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy b hb
    exact (hx b hb).mul_left (hy b hb)
  · intro x _ hx b hb
    exact (hx b hb).inv_left

name: Sporadic.U42.decompose
statement:
theorem decompose (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 45, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c) (g : U42Subgroup) :
    ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, g = n * t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT,
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : U42Subgroup) = n * t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin 45) (hxe : x = transvectionAt c)
        (hmem : x ∈ U42Subgroup),
        ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ t ∈ TT, (⟨x, hmem⟩ : U42Subgroup) = n * t := by
      intro c hxe hmem
      obtain ⟨m, hmN, hm0⟩ := htrans c
      have hminv : m.1⁻¹ c = 0 := by
        rw [← hm0, perm_inv_apply_self]
      have hk' := (mapsTransvections_of_mem m.2).2 c
      rw [hminv] at hk'
      set t : U42Subgroup := m⁻¹ * ⟨x, hmem⟩ * m with htdef
      have htT : t ∈ TT := by
        rw [TT, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
        have : (t : Perm45) = transvectionAt 0 := by
          rw [htdef]
          change m.1⁻¹ * x * m.1 = _
          rw [hxe, ← hk']
        rw [this]
        exact transvection_zero_mem_T0
      set n : U42Subgroup := m * t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ with hndef
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        rw [hndef]
        have h1 : t * m⁻¹ * t⁻¹ ∈ N := by
          have := hN.conj_mem m⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hmN) t
          simpa [mul_assoc] using this
        have := N.mul_mem hmN h1
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
      refine ⟨n, hnN, t, htT, ?_⟩
      rw [hndef, htdef]
      group
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact key _ u42e1_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u42e2_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u42e3_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u42e4_eq_transvectionAt _
    · exact key _ u42e5_eq_transvectionAt _
  · refine ⟨1, N.one_mem, 1, TT.one_mem, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · rintro x y hxm hym ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩ ⟨n2, hn2, t2, ht2, hy⟩
    have hxy : (⟨x * y, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hxm hym⟩ : U42Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U42Subgroup) * ⟨y, hym⟩ := rfl
    refine ⟨n1 * (t1 * n2 * t1⁻¹), N.mul_mem hn1 (hN.conj_mem n2 hn2 t1),
      t1 * t2, TT.mul_mem ht1 ht2, ?_⟩
    rw [hxy, hx, hy]
    group
  · rintro x hxm ⟨n1, hn1, t1, ht1, hx⟩
    have hxi : (⟨x⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hxm⟩ : U42Subgroup) =
        (⟨x, hxm⟩ : U42Subgroup)⁻¹ := rfl
    refine ⟨t1⁻¹ * n1⁻¹ * t1, ?_, t1⁻¹, TT.inv_mem ht1, ?_⟩
    · have := hN.conj_mem n1⁻¹ (N.inv_mem hn1) t1⁻¹
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    · rw [hxi, hx]
      group

name: Sporadic.U42.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem commutator_mem (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup) (hN : N.Normal)
    (htrans : ∀ c : Fin 45, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c) (a b : U42Subgroup) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hN
  obtain ⟨na, hna, ta, hta, ha⟩ := decompose N hN htrans a
  obtain ⟨nb, hnb, tb, htb, hb⟩ := decompose N hN htrans b
  set φ := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hφ
  have hker : ∀ g : U42Subgroup, φ g = 1 ↔ g ∈ N := by
    intro g
    exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g
  have hφa : φ a = φ ta := by
    rw [ha, map_mul, (hker na).mpr hna, one_mul]
  have hφb : φ b = φ tb := by
    rw [hb, map_mul, (hker nb).mpr hnb, one_mul]
  have hcomm : Commute ta tb := by
    have h := T0_comm ta.1 (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hta) tb.1
      (Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp htb)
    exact Subtype.ext h
  have : φ ⁅a, b⁆ = 1 := by
    rw [map_commutatorElement, hφa, hφb, ← map_commutatorElement,
      commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr hcomm, map_one]
  exact (hker _).mp this

name: Sporadic.U42.top_le_commutator
statement:
theorem top_le_commutator :
    ∀ g : U42Subgroup,
      g ∈ ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup)⁆
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨gp, hgmem⟩ := g
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x hx => (⟨x, hx⟩ : U42Subgroup) ∈
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup)⁆)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgmem
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [show (⟨u42e1, _⟩ : U42Subgroup) = ⟨u42e1, u42e1_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen1_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u42e2, _⟩ : U42Subgroup) = ⟨u42e2, u42e2_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen2_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u42e3, _⟩ : U42Subgroup) = ⟨u42e3, u42e3_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen3_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u42e4, _⟩ : U42Subgroup) = ⟨u42e4, u42e4_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen4_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    · rw [show (⟨u42e5, _⟩ : U42Subgroup) = ⟨u42e5, u42e5_mem⟩ from rfl,
        gen5_commutator]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
  · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · intro x y hxm hym hx hy
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hx hy
  · intro x hxm hx
    exact Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx

name: Sporadic.U42.normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_eq_bot_or_eq_top (N : Subgroup U42Subgroup)
    (hN : N.Normal) :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  right
  obtain ⟨n, hnN, p, hp⟩ := exists_moved_of_ne_bot N hbot
  have htrans : ∀ c : Fin 45, ∃ m ∈ N, m.1 0 = c :=
    fun c => normal_zero_witness N hN hnN hp c
  have hcomm_le :
      ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup), (⊤ : Subgroup U42Subgroup)⁆ ≤ N := by
    rw [Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro g₁ _ g₂ _
    exact commutator_mem N hN htrans g₁ g₂
  refine le_antisymm le_top ?_
  intro g _
  exact hcomm_le (top_le_commutator g)

proof:

name: Sporadic.U42.card_U42_lower
statement: theorem card_U42_lower : 25920 ≤ Nat.card U42Subgroup
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 24 * 2 ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab01 (3 : Fin 45)).ncard *
        Nat.card StabTail :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul stab01_orbit_lower stabTail_lower
  have h2 : 12 * (24 * 2) ≤
      (MulAction.orbit Stab0 (15 : Fin 45)).ncard *
        Nat.card Stab01 := by
    rw [card_stab01_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul stab0_orbit_lower h3
  have h1 : 45 * (12 * (24 * 2)) ≤ 45 * Nat.card Stab0 := by
    rw [card_stab0_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 45 h2
  calc (25920 : ℕ) = 45 * (12 * (24 * 2)) := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 45 * Nat.card Stab0 := h1
    _ = Nat.card U42Subgroup := card_U42_eq_first_orbit_mul_stabilizer.symm

name: Sporadic.U42.mapsTransvections_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c
    have hstep : g * h * transvectionAt c * (g * h)⁻¹ =
        g * (h * transvectionAt c * h⁻¹) * g⁻¹ := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hh.1 c, hg.1 (h c)]
    rfl
  · intro c
    have hstep : (g * h)⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * (g * h) =
        h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * transvectionAt c * g) * h := by
      group
    rw [hstep, hg.2 c, hh.2 (g⁻¹ c)]
    rfl

  · intro c
    simpa using hg.2 c
  · intro c
    simpa using hg.1 c

    MapsTransvections g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => MapsTransvections x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨conj_e1, conj_e1Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e2, conj_e2Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e3, conj_e3Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e4, conj_e4Inv⟩
    · exact ⟨conj_e5, conj_e5Inv⟩
  · exact mapsTransvections_one
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact mapsTransvections_mul hx hy
  · intro x _ hx
    exact mapsTransvections_inv hx
